items.description: Watch the behavior of the office clerks closely and find the one who is merely pretending to be human. You have only one bullet to survive this cycle. Make a mistake, and the anomaly will attack you.
items.description_ja: オフィスワーカーの行動を注意深く観察し、人間のふりをしているだけの者を見つけ出せ。このサイクルを生き残るための弾丸は1発しかない。ミスをすれば、アノマリーがお前に襲いかかる。
items.title: Metro Anomaly

items.description:
You are trapped in the observatory of a star-obsessed professor atop Mount Clearveil.
Plan your survival during the day, confront the darkness of the basement at night.
Can you break the ritual and uncover the mystery?
items.description_ja:
あなたは星に取り憑かれた教授の天文台に閉じ込められてしまった。
昼は生き残るために計画を立て、夜は地下の闇に立ち向かえ。
儀式を止め、謎を解き明かすことができるか？
items.title: Life & Shadow: Celestial Call

items.description: Live through the final days of an old man in a small village threatened by an approaching giant Leviathan. An existential horror game about inevitability, loneliness, and a man with nowhere to go and no reason to leave.
items.description_ja: 巨大なリヴァイアサンが迫り来る小さな村で、老人 Petro の最後の日々を体験してください。避けられない運命、孤独、そして行く場所も去る理由もない一人の男を描く、実存的ホラーゲームです。
items.title: Leviathan: Rhino

items.description: In this physics-based co-op platformer, you and a friend must carry your short-tempered king through deadly medieval courses. Dodge traps, maintain balance, and work together to reach the throne room. One wrong step, and the king might crown you with his rage!
items.description_ja: 王様が谷間に落ちた！ここから2人で王を担ぐ“搬送”アドベンチャーが始まる！息を合わせて担架を操作し、王様を落とさず王座まで運び切れ。道中は危険だらけ。バランスを崩せばすぐ転ぶ。失敗は派手で笑える。成功は努力と実力への褒美。親友を誘って二人きりの抱腹絶倒の時間を過ごそう。
items.title: Hold Your King

items.description:
This desktop incremental shooter pits you against swarms of mechanical bugs spawning from screen edges to destroy your PC core. Grab weapons and shoot to hold back bug waves.
Earn gold each run to unlock a massive skill tree, upgrading weapons, damage, desktop pets, special abilities.
items.description_ja:
デスクトップを戦場にしたインクリメンタルシューティング！画面の四方から機械虫が次々と湧き出て、PC 本体を破壊しようと襲ってくる。様々な武器を手に取り、虫の大群を撃退しよう。

各ラウンドで虫を倒すとゴールドが手に入る。試合外で巨大なスキルツリーを解放し、武器・攻撃力・防御力・特殊能力を強化可能。可愛いアシスタントの援護を受けたり、デスクトップペットをアンロックして共に戦える！
items.title: DESKTOP BUG KILLER

items.description: A unicycle, a bomb ready to blow, and sausages struggling to balance! Cooperate with your friends or blow them up in this 2-4 player physics-based chaos game! Reach the summit before the bomb goes off. Don't fall, don't explode, and try to stay a sausage!
items.description_ja: 一輪車、爆発寸前の爆弾、そしてバランスを取ろうと必死なソーセージたち！2〜4人で遊べるこの物理演算カオスゲームで、友達と協力するか、それとも彼らを爆破するか！爆弾が爆発する前に山の頂上を目指しましょう。落ちるな、爆発するな、ソーセージのままでいろ！
items.title: Unicycle Together

items.description: 500 STABS. 20 MINUTES TO ESCAPE. A horror roguelite about stabbing yourself in the hand 500 times to escape a deadly trap. Can you make it out with all your fingers? Or will you bleed out on the table?
items.description_ja: 500 STABS. 20 MINUTES TO ESCAPE. A horror roguelite about stabbing yourself in the hand 500 times to escape a deadly trap. Can you make it out with all your fingers? Or will you bleed out on the table?
items.title: 500 FINGER FILLET

items.description:
“That customer today might turn hot! Maybe you should trust your gut and try dating him!”
Encouraged by your pet chinchilla, you start a trial relationship on a hunch!
Will he actually turn hot… or not!?
A romantic comedy Otome game. Fully voiced (except for the protagonist).
items.description_ja:
「今日来てる客は、イケメンになるかもだから勘で付き合ってみては？」
ペットのチンチラにそそのかされ、カフェに来た見知らぬお客さんと勘でお試し交際スタート！
果たして彼はイケメンになるのか、それとも…？
疾走ドタバタラブコメ乙女ゲーム。フルボイス（主人公除く）

evidence.excerpt: - Steam full version: "1st Bigbang" and "Extra" only The "2nd Bigbang" story, which is only in the full version, may not be streamed or shown in videos. Logos and background art for stream thumbnails…

The "2nd Bigbang" story, which is only in the full version, may not be streamed or shown in videos. Logos and background art for stream thumbnails are available on our official website. Feel free to …

items.title: Ikemen Big Bang: A Dating Game About Potentially Hot Guys

items.description: Create and combine your own spells through a dynamic spellcrafting system. Fight through a hostile kingdom, disrupt its events and grow your magical powers on a quest to slay the king.
items.description_ja: ダイナミックなスペルクラフトシステムで自分だけの魔法を作り、組み合わせる一人称視点のアクション・ファンタジーRPG。敵対する王国で戦い、イベントを妨害し、魔力を高め、最終的に王を討ち倒そう。
items.title: SpellChain

items.description:
A psychological horror adventure experienced through a "selfie-cam" perspective.
Contradictions in the timeline, subtle anomalies in the footage—every detail holds the key to the truth.
Reconstruct her fragmented records, and uncover what was truly left behind.
items.description_ja:
「自撮り視点」で追体験する、サイコロジカルホラー探索アドベンチャー。
時系列や記録の違和感が、物語のキーとなる。
見届けよう、彼女の残したかった記録を。
items.title: Cyan Heart

items.description: A co-op group climbing game for 1-8 friends! Head out on a chill but challenging climb with regular checkpoints. Use axes, ropes, pogo sticks, item delivery drones and more to reach the summit. Just remember to watch your step!
items.description_ja: 1～8人で遊べる協力型グループクライミングゲーム！定期的にチェックポイントが設置された、まったりながらも険しいクライミングに挑戦。斧やロープ、ホッピングステッキ、アイテム配達ドローンなどを駆使して頂上を目指せ。くれぐれも足元には注意！
items.title: Sunset Summit

items.description: 1983: a killer satellite is put into orbit, then forgotten. 2041: it wakes up, and everything circling the Earth becomes a target. One shot, a cloud of debris, a chain reaction. A short incremental pixel-art game where you set off the Kessler syndrome.
items.description_ja: 1983年、衛星を破壊するために打ち上げられ、そのまま忘れられた衛星。2041年、目を覚ましたその衛星は、地球を回るすべてを標的にする。一発の砲撃、広がる破片、連鎖反応。ケスラーシンドロームを自ら引き起こす、ピクセルアートの短編インクリメンタルゲーム。
items.title: KESSLER: Orbital Incremental

items.description: MATE, This Place is a MESS! is a cozy organizing game where you sort 5,000 yerba mate packages in a messy museum. Fill the shelves, brew your mate, unlock abilities and kick packages into place. At the end of the hall, a huge curtain hides the truth about the museum. What could it be?
items.description_ja: 『MATE, This Place is a MESS!』は、散らかった博物館で5,000個のマテ茶パッケージを片付ける癒やし系の整理ゲーム。棚を埋めて、マテをいれて、スキルを解放し、パッケージを蹴って定位置へ。大広間の奥では、巨大な幕が博物館の真実を隠している。その正体とは？
items.title: MATE, This Place is a MESS!

items.description:
Bad Fruits have taken over the Roads! Fight off waves of Fruits in this comedic chaotic side-scrolling shooter!
Deliver Cargo, Upgrade your Ride, Hire Defenders, and choose the right Gear to protect your Caravan and survive the Road ahead!
items.description_ja:
Bad Fruits have taken over the Roads! Fight off waves of Fruits in this comedic chaotic side-scrolling shooter!
Deliver Cargo, Upgrade your Ride, Hire Defenders, and choose the right Gear to protect your Caravan and survive the Road ahead!
items.title: Caravan Carnage: Fruity Road

items.description: The prologue to Agent of Strange — a dark role-playing thriller where every mission is a labyrinth of choices and possibilities. Start your path as a Conspirator in a desperate struggle against the secret occult regime.
items.description_ja: The prologue to Agent of Strange — a dark role-playing thriller where every mission is a labyrinth of choices and possibilities. Start your path as a Conspirator in a desperate struggle against the secret occult regime.
items.title: Agent of Strange: Arrival

items.description: A melancholic first-person adventure through a dreamlike, half-remembered nowhere. Explore, encounter its strange inhabitants, and solve puzzles as you unravel a story about the fragility of existence.
items.description_ja: 夢のようにおぼろげな、忘れかけたどこでもない場所を巡る、物悲しい一人称視点のアドベンチャー。探索し、奇妙な住人たちと出会い、謎を解きながら、存在の儚さをめぐる物語を少しずつ紐解いていく。
items.title: My Beautiful Faraway, Please Don't Be Cruel To Me

items.description:
Let's show〈Yuu〉, the new student, around school.
A short psycho-horror visual novel depicting
a mysterious relationship with her,
unfolding without context like a dream.

The Steam version of an experimental retro game
designed to fit on a single 3.5-inch floppy disk.
items.description_ja:
転校生の〈ユウ〉に学校を案内しよう。夢のように脈絡なく展開する物語の中で、彼女との奇妙な関係を描く短編サイコホラーノベル。
3.5インチフロッピーディスク1枚に収録された、実験的なレトロゲームのSteam版。
items.title: DISK-Y

items.description: NOW WITH PUBLIC LOBBIES! Blend into the environment and eat objects around you as a sneaky Mimic, or burn, zap, and explode everything as a crafty Exterminator to root out the Mimics in this Prop-Hunt inspired multiplayer game of chaos and frenetic fun!
items.description_ja: NOW WITH PUBLIC LOBBIES! Blend into the environment and eat objects around you as a sneaky Mimic, or burn, zap, and explode everything as a crafty Exterminator to root out the Mimics in this Prop-Hunt inspired multiplayer game of chaos and frenetic fun!
items.title: Mimicry!

items.description:
A retro-inspired PSX survival horror game set in the mysterious Noiret Mansion.
Explore a cursed estate, solve puzzles, uncover the fate of the Noiret family, and survive the horrors lurking within its walls.
items.description_ja:
ノワール邸を舞台にした、レトロなPSX風サバイバルホラーゲーム。
呪われた屋敷を探索し、パズルを解き、ノワール家の運命を解き明かし、屋敷の奥に潜む恐怖から生き延びましょう。
items.title: VESSELS: Noiret Mansion

items.description: A first-person psychological horror game with a found-footage aesthetic. In search of the mysterious Street 7, an urban explorer finds himself trapped in a loop of distorted realities, rituals, and a supernatural presence that controls the Favela das Almas.
items.description_ja: A first-person psychological horror game with a found-footage aesthetic. In search of the mysterious Street 7, an urban explorer finds himself trapped in a loop of distorted realities, rituals, and a supernatural presence that controls the Favela das Almas.
items.title: Otherside Tapes: Favela

items.description: Dashoot: ABYA's Adventure is a pixel-art precision platformer. Fire your floating cannon to trigger switches and move platforms. Grab items to dash with varying charges, directions and distances. Chart a path underground, restart power stations, and uncover the AI Deus's secrets.
items.description_ja: 『Dashoot: ABYA's Adventure』は、精密な操作が鍵を握るピクセルアートの2Dプラットフォームアクション。浮遊砲でスイッチを撃ち、足場を動かし、能力アイテムを消費してダッシュ。使える回数や方向、距離はアイテムごとに異なります。仕掛けだらけの地下世界でルートを見極め、発電所を再起動し、AI「Deus」が語らない秘密を解き明かそう。
items.title: Dashoot: ABYA's Adventure

items.description: A co-op horror game where you and up to 5 friends clean, fix and survive, in a lo-fi mall with high-key problems. Welcome to the Night Crew - you are NOT paid enough for this!
items.description_ja: あなたと最大5人の仲間で掃除して、修理して、生き延びる協力型ホラーゲーム。舞台はローファイなモール、トラブルはハイボリューム。Night Crewへようこそ。この給料じゃ、ぜんっぜん割に合わない！
items.title: Night Crew

items.description:
"Real friends exist in the online world!"

The Doomed Otaku is a multi-ending adventure that follows a wandering 20-something otaku as they navigate both the real and cyber worlds, experiencing various events along the way.
items.description_ja:
「オンラインの世界にも本当の友達がいる！」
「破滅のオタク」は、現実とサイバー、二つの世界を行き来しながらさまざまな出来事を体験する、さまよう20代オタクのマルチエンディングアドベンチャーです。
items.title: Doomed Otaku

items.description: Mycelium: The Silent Contract is a co-op/single player extraction horror set in a haunted liminal forest. Your contract is simple: get mycelium and extract. But in this forest, nothing is what it seems. So what did you sign, exactly?
items.description_ja: 『Mycelium: The Silent Contract（マイセリウム：沈黙の契約）』は、呪われたリミナルな森を舞台にした、協力／シングルプレイヤー対応の脱出ホラーゲームです。あなたの契約はシンプル。「菌糸体を採取して脱出すること」。しかしこの森では、見かけ通りのものは何一つありません。では、あなたは一体何に署名してしまったのでしょうか？
items.title: Mycelium: The Silent Contract

items.description: SHRIMP GAME: KRILL CONFIRMED is a solo or multiplayer third-person shooter RPG intro to SHRIMP GAME set in an abyssal realm. Pilot your SHRIMP platform to fight giant sea monsters, master elemental classes, and unearth secrets in a co-op campaign, or just krill your friends in multiplayer PVP!
items.description_ja: SHRIMP GAME: KRILL CONFIRMED is a solo or multiplayer third-person shooter RPG intro to SHRIMP GAME set in an abyssal realm. Pilot your SHRIMP platform to fight giant sea monsters, master elemental classes, and unearth secrets in a co-op campaign, or just krill your friends in multiplayer PVP!
items.title: SHRIMP GAME: KRILL CONFIRMED

items.description: Run a chaotic gas station sandbox: fuel cars, clean and repair vehicles, buy wild tools, catch wanted drivers, earn reviews, unlock upgrades, climb the leaderboard, or turn every stop into total mayhem.
items.description_ja: Run a chaotic gas station sandbox: fuel cars, clean and repair vehicles, buy wild tools, catch wanted drivers, earn reviews, unlock upgrades, climb the leaderboard, or turn every stop into total mayhem.
items.title: Gas N Cars

items.description: Flick light switches on and off throughout a long-abandoned house to shift the environment from a safe reality to a horror-filled echo where wicked puzzles manifest. A short psychological horror game where you must balance the light needed to progress with the terrifying nightmares it summons.
items.description_ja: 部屋のスイッチを入れると、現実はオフになる。グロテスクな世界へと飛び込み、家族の歪んだ過去を明らかにせよ。このサイコロジカルホラーでは、明かりがなくては進めない。しかし、その光は戦慄の悪夢を呼び寄せる――あなたはこの恐怖から逃げ切れるか？
items.title: Flick

items.description: Take on the role of a town’s rules-driven (and reckless) bus driver in Thank You Bus Driver! Drive fast, slap faster, and toss any rulebreakers out of your bus to reach true victory: being appreciated.
items.description_ja: Take on the role of a town’s rules-driven (and reckless) bus driver in Thank You Bus Driver! Drive fast, slap faster, and toss any rulebreakers out of your bus to reach true victory: being appreciated.
items.title: Thank You Bus Driver

items.description: Deadzoned is a sci-fi turn-based action Roguelike. Blast your way through zones battling the beasts, bandits, and monsters that stalk the blackouts. But you'll need your wits to make best use of the gear you stumble upon to survive and save the fate of the planet!
items.description_ja: Deadzoned is a sci-fi turn-based action Roguelike. Blast your way through zones battling the beasts, bandits, and monsters that stalk the blackouts. But you'll need your wits to make best use of the gear you stumble upon to survive and save the fate of the planet!
items.title: Deadzoned

items.description: Chaotic foosball matches for up to 4 players! Use crazy power-ups, battle through unique arenas and opponents, and turn every friendly match into a chaotic showdown with friends.
items.description_ja: 友達と一緒に超高速のテーブルサッカー対戦を楽しもう！これは物理的なマルチ乱闘ゲームで、クレイジーで面白いアイテムを使って相手を打ち負かし、真のテーブルサッカー王者を目指せ！
items.title: Pimbolas

items.description: A raccoon co-op extraction game for 1-8 players, blending goofy horror with a roguelite twist. Loot procedural ruins, extract relics, defeat powerful bosses and rescue NPCs together… All while Mammon, the Greed Demon, tests your trust in each other.
items.description_ja: アライグマになってお宝を持ち帰る、1～8人用の協力型エクストラクションゲーム。おバカなホラーにローグライト要素をプラス！自動生成の遺跡でお宝を漁り、遺物を回収し、仲間と強大なボスを倒してNPCを救い出そう…その間も、強欲の悪魔マモンは仲間同士の信頼を試してくる。
items.title: Greedy

items.description: Complete unhinged jobs in the best OPEN WORLD RAGE GAME of 2026 or cry trying!
items.description_ja: Complete unhinged jobs in the best OPEN WORLD RAGE GAME of 2026 or cry trying!
items.title: FROG IS CRIME

items.description: The original Dementium II, restored by the team who made it. William Redmoor wakes with fresh staples in his skull inside an asylum for the criminally insane, where the walls peel back to reveal something worse. Fight, solve and survive the cult DS horror classic, now on PC.
items.description_ja: The original Dementium II, restored by the team who made it. William Redmoor wakes with fresh staples in his skull inside an asylum for the criminally insane, where the walls peel back to reveal something worse. Fight, solve and survive the cult DS horror classic, now on PC.
items.title: Dementium II

items.description: Your Grandpa descends into madness in a family cosmic horror. Dig cursed relics, meet eldritch beings, and awaken a forgotten God.
items.description_ja: 祖父が狂気に沈んでいく、家族のコズミックホラー。呪われた遺物を掘り出し、異形の存在と出会い、忘れられた神を目覚めさせろ。
items.title: The Old Flesh of Nuraga

items.description:
🐸Free-To-Play🐸 Stop following someone else's route. Create your own way to the top by building your own path
🐸 Frog Climb is a stylized co-op climbing adventure where you must escape from terrariums
🐸 Level up, gain powerful upgrades, and prove that no wall is too high for a frog with a plan 🐸
items.description_ja:
🐸Free-To-Play🐸 Stop following someone else's route. Create your own way to the top by building your own path
🐸 Frog Climb is a stylized co-op climbing adventure where you must escape from terrariums
🐸 Level up, gain powerful upgrades, and prove that no wall is too high for a frog with a plan 🐸
items.title: Frog Climb

items.description: Experience minigame chaos in WE’RE ALL IN!, an online party game for 1-8 players where you win by betting on your friends in a series of fast-paced games and challenges.
items.description_ja: 『WE’RE ALL IN!』でミニゲームの大混乱を体験しよう。1～8人で遊べるオンラインパーティーゲームで、テンポの速いゲームやチャレンジで誰が勝つかフレンドに賭けて勝利を目指します。
items.title: WE'RE ALL IN!

items.description: nudge is a cozy organization-sim about finding space for your work, mom, and huge assortment of gacha toys. Unbox over 50 collectibles from 8 unique sets, decorate your first apartment, and try to find room for everything in your life, including mom.
items.description_ja: nudge is a cozy organization-sim about finding space for your work, mom, and huge assortment of gacha toys. Unbox over 50 collectibles from 8 unique sets, decorate your first apartment, and try to find room for everything in your life, including mom.
items.title: nudge

items.description:
As highly qualified goose parents, work together to bring your little egg home safely. Every crack makes it harder to control, every mistake more hilarious. A co-op physics game for 2 or 4 players about teamwork, clumsiness and honking. 
HONK!
items.description_ja:
高度な訓練を受けたガチョウの親として、小さな卵を無事に家へ連れ帰るために協力しよう。ぶつかるほど操作は難しくなり、ミスはさらに面白くなる。2～4人で遊ぶ協力物理ゲーム、チームワークとドタバタとガチョウの鳴き声。
HONK!
items.title: An Eggstremely Hard Game

items.description: An asteroid will hit Earth in 90 days. The government held a tender, and one miner came with his own pickaxe. He asked for no money and said the asteroid would pay for itself. Dig 5,000,000 m³ in first person, solo or in online co-op for up to 8. Sell the ore and buy ship guns that fire as you dig.
items.description_ja: 90日後、小惑星が地球に衝突する。政府が入札を開くと、来たのは自前のつるはしを持った鉱夫一人。金はいらない、小惑星が自分で払うと言う。一人称視点で500万m³を掘り、鉱石を売り、あなたが掘っている間も撃ち続ける母船の砲台を買おう。ソロでも、最大8人のオンライン協力プレイでも遊べる。
items.title: No Asteroids

items.description: Silent Wounds is an episodic psychological horror anthology. Each episode offers a compact and intense narrative experience. In this first episode, a man returns home and trades reality for the dangerous, silent obsession with a perfect doll.
items.description_ja: 『サイレント・ウォンズ』は、オムニバス形式のサイコロジカルホラーです。各エピソードで、短くも濃密な物語体験を提供します。第1話では、ある男が帰宅し、現実を捨てて完璧な人形への危険で静かな執着に溺れていく姿が描かれます。
items.title: Silent Wounds - The Doll

items.description: A chaotic co-op armageddon game where you build ridiculous structures to survive world-ending disasters with sticky hands, physics chaos & friends who probably won’t save you. Don´t be a Sitting Duck!
items.description_ja: A chaotic co-op armageddon game where you build ridiculous structures to survive world-ending disasters with sticky hands, physics chaos & friends who probably won’t save you. Don´t be a Sitting Duck!
items.title: Sitting Ducks

items.description: The You Quiz is a multiplayer game where the questions are about you! Be the King and judge your friends' answers about yourself. Or be a Courtier, guess their quirks, tastes, and dreams. Invite up to 7 friends for free using the Friend's Pass!
items.description_ja:
The You Quizは、“あなたのこと”をテーマにしたマルチプレイヤーゲーム！
王様になって、友だちがあなたについて答えた内容をジャッジしよう。
あるいは家臣になって、その人のクセや好み、夢を当ててみよう。
Friend's Passを使えば、最大7人の友だちを無料で招待して一緒に遊べるよ！
items.title: The You Quiz

items.description: The Doll Shop is a hand-drawn narrative game – part romance, part horror – set in the Japanese countryside. Play as a young dollmaker who reunites with his childhood friend in an eerie snowbound village. Will you dare confess your secret?
items.description_ja: 「ドールショップ」は手描きで描かれたビジュアルノベルで、日本の田舎を舞台に、ロマンスとホラーが織り交ぜられています。雪に閉ざされた不気味な村で幼なじみと再会する若い人形職人としてプレイします。自分の秘密を告白する勇気がありますか？
items.title: The Doll Shop

items.description: A short active incremental game with a satirical story about extreme growth. Help a little snail turn a desert into lush forest it can abuse for profit. Hire minions, unlock immoral plants, get ungodly rich, and remember: Blood is a type of juice.
items.description_ja: カタツムリパワーで砂漠を緑の森へと育て、究極レベルまで利益の最大化を目指すアクティブインクリメンタルゲーム。植物を最適な配置にして、複数の資源の生産を自動化。ミニオンを雇い、不徳な植物を解放して罪深き大金持ちを目指そう。そして忘れるな：血もエキスの一種だ。
items.title: Feed The Forest

items.description: Mushroom Simulator Co-op is a "cozy" co-op game where you grow by using your own voice, hide from mushroom hunters, protect your little mushrooms, and try to survive in the forest with your friends. Yes, you're literally a mushroom.
items.description_ja: Mushroom Simulator Co-opは、自分の声で成長し、キノコ狩りのおじいさんから隠れ、小さなキノコたちを守りながら、仲間と一緒に森でのサバイバルに挑む「ほのぼの」協力プレイゲームです。そう、あなたは文字どおりキノコなのです。
items.title: Mushroom Simulator Co-op

items.description: A co-op horror comedy game for you and your friends about burglarizing a nightmarish neighborhood full of mutated pets. No one said this would be easy, but maybe you can make it out of there with a sweet wood paneled video cassette recorder.
items.description_ja: 変異ペットの巣窟と化した悪夢の住宅街で、みんな一緒にドロボーだ。1人でもフレンドでも楽しめる、協力型ホラー・コメディゲーム。楽勝だなんて一言も言ってない。でももしかすると、イケてるウッドパネルのビデオデッキを持って家から脱出できるかもしれない。
items.title: Burgle Supply Company

items.description: A multi-ball roulette roguelite. Spin multiple balls at once and rewrite the wheel: add colors, change the numbers, rebalance payouts and stack multipliers with 100+ mementos and 50 trick balls. You’re live on a twisted TV show, and the puppet Host is grinning. Hit his targets, or the show ends you.
items.description_ja: マルチボール・ルーレットのローグライト。複数のボールを一斉に投げ入れ、ホイールそのものを書き換えましょう。色を足し、数字を変え、配当を組み替え、倍率を重ねがけ。武器は100種以上のメメントと、クセ者ぞろいの特殊ボール50種。あなたは狂気のテレビ番組に生出演中。人形の司会者がニタリと笑っています。彼の課すノルマを果たせなければ、番組があなたの人生を打ち切ります。
items.title: Trust Your Gut

items.description:
🌐 Language Independent

“Rules are absolute. Break them, and you die. No Exceptions.”

Escape a building from the 10th floor in this death game. Each floor has prohibited actions. Break a rule and it’s game over. Don’t run. Don’t stop. Don’t look. Learn the rules. Obey them. Escape alive.
items.description_ja:
🌐 言語不要
【規則は絶対。破れば即、＂死＂】無人の雑居ビルからの脱出を目指す、一人称視点の短編脱出デスゲーム。ランダムに変化する規則を絶対に守り抜き、ギミックを突破して脱出せよ。

items.title: No exceptions

items.description: Equipped only with a weapon that consumes your own blood, explore an ancient brutalist catacomb. Beware the Eyes of The Whispering Crypt. Find the 4 artifacts of desire. Confront God.
items.description_ja: Equipped only with a weapon that consumes your own blood, explore an ancient brutalist catacomb. Beware the Eyes of The Whispering Crypt. Find the 4 artifacts of desire. Confront God.
items.title: CONCRETE BURIAL

items.description: A newly assembled face wants to find the perfect body; this mysterious platforming adventure will take you through a maze of rooms with many doors to enter and many puzzles to solve; will you acquire the perfect combination of limbs to suit each situation and discover the secret to a perfect body?
items.description_ja: A newly assembled face wants to find the perfect body; this mysterious platforming adventure will take you through a maze of rooms with many doors to enter and many puzzles to solve; will you acquire the perfect combination of limbs to suit each situation and discover the secret to a perfect body?
items.title: Bouncing Body Bits

items.description: A cozy first-person tidying game. Thousands of board game boxes lie scattered across a charming two-storey shop. Gather stacks of copies, shelve every game in its category and watch the shop come back to life, one satisfying section at a time.
items.description_ja: 一人称視点で遊ぶ、心やすらぐお片付けゲーム。2階建ての素敵なお店に、何千ものボードゲームの箱が散らばっている。同じゲームを積み重ねて集め、カテゴリーごとの棚に並べよう。棚の区画がひとつ埋まるたびに、お店が少しずつ息を吹き返していく。

evidence.excerpt: Streaming, Let's Plays and monetized videos are welcome, no permission needed.

items.title: The Cozy Board Game Shop: Tidy Up

items.description: When I was sunken in a deep depression, I set off on a journey.
items.description_ja: 深い憂鬱に沈んでいた頃、私は旅に出た。
items.title: Moon-Oriented Autonomous Biological Model

items.description: 3D physics-platformer where you are an egg!  Roll, hop and slide your way back home.
items.description_ja: タマゴとなって、転がって、跳ねて、滑って…家に帰ろう！３Dローリングアクションゲーム
items.title: Oeuf

items.description: An anime android maid and her work drone are meeting a quota at the warehouse! A simple yet engaging game about the monotonous, relaxing process of working as a mover. Short but challenging levels, multiplayer, and lots and lots of boxes await you!
items.description_ja: アニメのアンドロイドメイドと彼女の作業ドローンが倉庫でノルマを達成中！運送業者として働く単調でリラックスできるプロセスについての、シンプルだけど魅力的なゲーム。短くてもやりがいのあるレベル、マルチプレイヤー、そしてたくさんの箱があなたを待っています！
items.title: MAID MOVING BOXES

items.description: In a broken world ruled by demons, the gears of productivity still turn. Complete tasks, solve puzzles, and explore a society under demonic regime from the perspective of an ordinary office clerk.
items.description_ja: たとえ魔物の支配された世界でも、社会の歯車はひたすら回り続ける。崩壊した世界を生きるごく普通の会社員として、日々の仕事をこなし、パズルを解き、この歪んだ社会の真実を紐解いていこう。
items.title: HR: Human Remains

items.description: Find My Frogs: Branches is a cozy hidden object game where you search for frogs and toads in a hand-drawn village nestled high in the branches of an ancient tree. Explore charming corners, discover tiny secrets, and help Uncle Froger find his missing hat.
items.description_ja: Find My Frogs: Branches は、古木の枝に佇む手描きの村でカエルやヒキガエルを探す、ほっこりとした隠しオブジェクトゲームです。魅力的な場所を探索し、小さな秘密を発見し、フロガーおじさんの失くした帽子を探しましょう。
items.title: Find My Frogs: Branches

items.description: Hard on purpose: one slip can undo a long climb, so it is best with friends who laugh at falls. Drive your car up impossible tracks with up to 8 players in this chaotic online co-op physics climb. New map: Neon Junction, a neon night city.
items.description_ja: あえて難しく作ってある。ひとつのミスで長い登りが水の泡になることもあるから、落ちても笑い合える友達と遊ぶのがいちばん。最大8人でオンライン協力プレイできる、物理演算のドタバタ登山ゲーム。車を運転して、ありえないコースを登りきろう。新マップ「Neon Junction」。
items.title: Drive UP: Together

items.description: Bar After Bar is a multiplayer game where 5 friends drive to the top of a mountain. You will be mixing drinks and throwing them at each other the whole way up. The drunker you get, the harder it is to drive. How far can you make it?
items.description_ja: Bar After Bar is a multiplayer game where 5 friends drive to the top of a mountain. You will be mixing drinks and throwing them at each other the whole way up. The drunker you get, the harder it is to drive. How far can you make it?
items.title: Bar After Bar

items.description: A late-night thrill turns into a nightmare. Olivia sneaks into Creepwood Wonderland Carnival with her boyfriend, expecting a fun night alone in the park. But something feels off. Distant footsteps. Faint whispers. Someone else is here… Watching.
items.description_ja: 深夜のスリルが悪夢へと変わる。オリビアは彼氏とクリープウッド・ワンダーランド・カーニバルに忍び込み、パーク内で二人きりの楽しい一夜を過ごすつもりだった。でも、何かがおかしい。遠くで聞こえる足音。かすかに囁く声。ここには他に誰かがいる… 見られている。
items.title: The Stalked 3

items.description: Experience the psychological horror of being kidnapped by a serial killer. Desperate to escape, explore everything around you, use your wits, uncover his secrets and face the dread of being in the victim's place. Inspired by a true story.
items.description_ja: 連続殺人犯に誘拐される心理的恐怖を体験せよ。脱出を求めて周囲のすべてを探索し、知恵を絞り、彼の秘密を暴き、被害者の立場に置かれる恐怖と向き合え。実話に着想を得た作品。
items.title: Butcherman

items.description: Beso's Shawarma is a short, narrative-driven horror game. A late-night call lures you on a surreal journey through empty streets to a sketchy shawarma shop. Talk to a cast of strange characters, make a terrifying choice, and try to escape a disjointed, looping nightmare.
items.description_ja: Beso's Shawarma is a short, narrative-driven horror game. A late-night call lures you on a surreal journey through empty streets to a sketchy shawarma shop. Talk to a cast of strange characters, make a terrifying choice, and try to escape a disjointed, looping nightmare.
items.title: Beso's Shawarma

items.description:
Explore, investigate, and survive this new infection.
Collect clues, meet and interact with people, and bond with the main cast. Solve the mysteries like a true detective and follow the non-linear narrative. Are you ready to face this new deadly infection? 👁
items.description_ja:
Explore, investigate, and survive this new infection.
Collect clues, meet and interact with people, and bond with the main cast. Solve the mysteries like a true detective and follow the non-linear narrative. Are you ready to face this new deadly infection? 👁
items.title: Mycopsychosys: Project Jupiter

items.description: The original version of the hit puzzle game with over 13 million downloads worldwide!
items.description_ja: 全世界で1300万ダウンロード突破の大人気パズルゲームのオリジナル版！
items.title: Suika Game

items.description: Hungry Horrors is a story-driven deckbuilder set in the folklore of the British Isles. Cook real traditional dishes, chain flavour synergies, meet mythical characters, and feed legendary Horrors before they feed on you.
items.description_ja: 「ハングリー・ホラーズ」は、ブリテン諸島の民間伝承を舞台に、カードでデッキを組みながら物語を進めるゲームです。実在する伝統料理を作り、味の組み合わせで効果を高めながら冒険する中で、神話や伝説のキャラクターたちとの出会いが待っています。怪物たちに食べられてしまう前に、料理でそのお腹を満たすことが目標です。
items.title: Hungry Horrors

items.description: Asymmetrical horror comedy co-op for up to 8 players. Play either a pack of Rats trying to sabotage a restaurant, or the Chef determined to stop them.
items.description_ja: 最大8人で遊べる、非対称型ホラーコメディ協力ゲーム。レストランを台無しにしようとするネズミの群れか、それを阻止しようとするシェフのどちらかになってプレイしよう。
items.title: Rat Game

items.description: A vibrant co-op social deduction adventure with roguelike twists, wild abilities, monsters, and nonstop mayhem.
items.description_ja: 鮮烈なソーシャル推理ゲーム。ローグライク要素、ぶっ飛んだアビリティ、モンスター、そして止まらないメイヘム。
items.title: Masters of Mayhem

items.description: A simple tower defense game where you need to protect your house from Boykissers
items.description_ja: A simple tower defense game where you need to protect your house from Boykissers
items.title: BOYKISSER IS COMING

items.description: 长泽小学的一年级女生结奈，和青梅竹马的好朋友真也约好了一起玩捉迷藏。但是，最近他们的身边似乎出现了可疑的人物，街道的氛围也变得紧张了起来。即便如此，今天放学后也要去公园玩捉迷藏哦……
items.description_ja: 長沢小学校の一年生の女の子・結奈ちゃんは、幼馴染の親友・真也くんとかくれんぼうで遊ぶ約束をしていた。だが最近、二人の周りには不審な人物が現れるようになり、町の雰囲気もどこかぴりぴりし始めていた。それでも今日、放課後は公園でかくれんぼうをするつもりだった……
items.title: 捉迷藏 - Hide and Seek

items.description: Survive the horrors of hell’s deadest-end job: a human mail clerk. Process occult specimens, sort infernal mail, repair cursed machinery, and survive your shift in a cozy horror workplace simulator.
items.description_ja:
あなたはカリフォルニア州モデストにある「地獄支部」の郵便室で働き始める。
最初はただの単純作業のはずだった――。
だが、やがて常識を揺るがす恐怖があなたを包み込む。

今日も地獄の郵便が届く。
items.title: The Mailroom

items.author: hypnoto
items.description: Fired on Monday. Rehired next Monday. Survive the comeback keynote in a 10-minute survivors-like comedy.
items.title: Leatherman 2: The return of Leatherman

items.description: In this short visual novel, four prisoners on death row are cleared of all charges. But the prison has a quota to meet. The four are put in a room and asked to decide among themselves over the course of an hour... who will be the one to die?
items.description_ja: In this short visual novel, four prisoners on death row are cleared of all charges. But the prison has a quota to meet. The four are put in a room and asked to decide among themselves over the course of an hour... who will be the one to die?
items.title: Prison of Lies

items.description: A voice acting party game: dub any video clip with your friends. Claim the roles, record every line in the booth, then watch the premiere together. On the couch, friends join and record from their phones, or one mic goes round. Online, up to 16 players and five party games.
items.description_ja: 声優気分で動画を吹き替えるパーティーゲーム。好きな動画クリップに友達とアフレコ。役を決めて、ブースで1セリフずつ録音し、みんなでプレミア上映。ソファではスマホから参加して録音するか、1本のマイクを回し、オンラインは最大16人で5つのパーティーゲームを遊べます。
items.title: Dub Party

items.author: gregs-games
items.description: Vampire Teethbuilding Autobiter Game
items.title: NOSFER-A-TOOTH

items.description: An online co-op burger flipping game with scary and strange customers that you shouldn't anger.
items.description_ja: An online co-op burger flipping game with scary and strange customers that you shouldn't anger.
items.title: Burger Bots Inc.

items.description: Dravo's Twisted Show is a 1–4 player co-op horror game set in a deadly carnival. Survive twisted minigames, earn tickets to unlock the exit, and evade the show's terrifying Cast. Use proximity voice chat, teamwork, and whatever you can find to escape before you become part of the show.
items.description_ja: Dravo's Twisted Show is a 1–4 player co-op horror game set in a deadly carnival. Survive twisted minigames, earn tickets to unlock the exit, and evade the show's terrifying Cast. Use proximity voice chat, teamwork, and whatever you can find to escape before you become part of the show.
items.title: Dravo's Twisted Show

items.description: Grab a mic and redub the internet. Dub Night Live mutes the cast of a short clip and hands the roles to you and up to 8 friends. Everyone records at once, nobody hears anyone, then the whole party watches the finished cut together. Build your own clips with the in-app editor.
items.description_ja: マイクを握って、インターネットの動画にアフレコしよう。Dub Night Liveはショートクリップの音声をミュートにし、あなたと最大8人のフレンドに配役を割り当てます。全員が一斉に録音を行い、録音中はお互いの声は聞こえません。そして、完成した映像をパーティー全員で一緒に鑑賞します。アプリ内エディターを使って自分だけのクリップを作成することも可能です。
items.title: Dub Night Live

items.description: S.O.N.A.R. (Submarine Operators Not Actually Ready) is a 1–6 player co-op submarine sim where teamwork is essential, panic is inevitable, and sinking is always one wrong button away. Use sonar, pilot, fight, repair, and pray your friends know what to do.
items.description_ja: S.O.N.A.R.（Submarine Operators Not Actually Ready）は、1～6人用オンライン協力型潜水艦シム。チームワークは必須、パニックは不可避、沈没はボタンの押し間違いひとつで目前です。sonarを使い、操縦し、戦い、修理し、仲間が何をすべきか分かっていることを祈りましょう。
items.title: S.O.N.A.R. - Submarine Operators Not Actually Ready

items.description: Reunite with your favorite classmate, but you can never really graduate from the past... Wander through a nostalgic, shifting maze of old high school memories with a cheerful friend named Chesa. But the exits are vanishing, the hallways are warping, and a silent observer is tracking your every step.
items.description_ja: Reunite with your favorite classmate, but you can never really graduate from the past... Wander through a nostalgic, shifting maze of old high school memories with a cheerful friend named Chesa. But the exits are vanishing, the hallways are warping, and a silent observer is tracking your every step.
items.title: Sabado

items.description: Grenouilles 3D is a multiplayer co-hopping game. Hop your way out of polluted ponds and try to find a more suitable place to live. With a unique mouse only control scheme, alone or with your colorful friends hop to the top!
items.description_ja: Grenouilles 3D is a multiplayer co-hopping game. Hop your way out of polluted ponds and try to find a more suitable place to live. With a unique mouse only control scheme, alone or with your colorful friends hop to the top!
items.title: Grenouilles 3D

items.description: An infuriating platformer themed around Monty Python and the Holy Grail starring Pipkin Pippa in her search for the holy grail. Climb through 5 levels to reach the end, be careful not to fall and lose all your progress!
items.description_ja: An infuriating platformer themed around Monty Python and the Holy Grail starring Pipkin Pippa in her search for the holy grail. Climb through 5 levels to reach the end, be careful not to fall and lose all your progress!
items.title: Pippa of Caerbannog

items.author: barelyanonymousgaming
items.description: Your parents want their $100,000 back. Deny exit forms by day, smuggle public servants out of Gungahlin by night.
items.title: Escape Gungahlin

items.author: bolodev
items.description: Wash dishes by hand, from a dead sponge at a greasy diner to your own plant and the millionth dish.
items.title: Dish Pit

items.description: You wake up in a terrifying psychiatric hospital. Fire and Ashes is an immersive horror game where madness and reality blur, and every monster hears your scream… even beyond the hospital walls.
items.description_ja: あなたは不気味な精神病院で目を覚ます。『Fire and Ashes』は、狂気と現実が交錯し、すべての怪物にあなたの悲鳴が届く没入型ホラーゲームです……たとえ病院の外であっても。
items.title: FIRE AND ASHES

items.author: clpeterson84
items.description: They want money. Give it to 'em.
items.title: HARDWORKER

items.author: coolom-games
items.description: A comedic dating sim about surviving the complexities of modern love (and serial killers).
items.title: Dating Killmulator 2

items.description: Frenetic action and LCD aesthetic! In this 2D Shoot 'Em Up, switch between a robot hero and his benign tumor to stop a bizarre cult. You have 8 hours to save humanity's memory: defeat grotesque bosses, ride the skies on your Future Board, and master the chaos in a retro-futuristic Tokyo.
items.description_ja: 切り替えアクション × LCDレトロ！ロボットと謎の共生体を瞬時に切り替え、奇妙なカルト集団を阻止せよ。人類の記憶が消されるまで残り8時間。グロテスクなボス、空を滑走するFuture Board、レトロフューチャー東京を舞台にした高速2Dシューティング。
items.title: Future Knight

items.description: A short atmospheric horror experience set in the remote north of Sweden. Explore an abandoned village where something is deeply wrong, uncover strange clues, and face a lurking evil hidden beneath the quiet surface.
items.description_ja: A short atmospheric horror experience set in the remote north of Sweden. Explore an abandoned village where something is deeply wrong, uncover strange clues, and face a lurking evil hidden beneath the quiet surface.
items.title: A Northern Evil: Tape One

items.description: Escape the mansion before it claims you. A 1–5 player co-op horror.
items.description_ja: 屋敷に飲み込まれる前に脱出しろ。1–5人協力ホラー。
items.title: Fat Chance

items.description: Good Heavens! is an open-world crafting and building RPG for solo and online co-op up to 8 players. Explore mysterious biomes, build your base, master six distinct tech trees, rebuild fallen cities, and help a clumsy God restore his world on the brink of collapse.
items.description_ja: 『グッドヘヴン！』は1人でも最大8人のオンライン協力プレイでも楽しめる、オープンワールドのクラフト＆建築RPGだ。不思議な地域を探索し、拠点を築き種類の技術ツリーを極め、崩壊した街を復興させよう。そして、少しドジな神様が残した崩壊寸前の世界を立て直すのを手伝おう。
items.title: Good Heavens!

items.description: A first-person, PSX-style horror game about living with a monster. Do as you're told... or don't. Just be ready for the consequences.
items.description_ja:
モンスターと共に暮らす、一人称視点のPSX風ホラーゲーム。
言われた通りにしろ…それとも逆らうか。どちらにせよ、その結果を受け入れる覚悟はしておけ。
items.title: FEED IT

items.description: Dig your way out of hell with a rusty spoon! A horror game set in the bottom of a broken well. Crawl through abandoned tunnels. They fear the light! Keep them on with the hand-crank machines. Escape the nightmare.
items.description_ja:
井戸は枯れ果てた。その原因を突き止めるのは、あなただ。
廃墟と化した地下道を進む中で、決して見られるはずのなかった儀式の痕跡に出くわす。
壊れかけの機械を起動させ、暗闇に光を灯せ。
崩れた土を掘り進み、地の底から這い上がれ。
この地下深くでは、あなたは探検者ではない…
侵入者だ。
items.title: THE WELL IS NOT EMPTY

items.description: A psychological horror game about testing dolls and determining if they are Good or Dangerous. Play in a strange location with dolls potentially filled with bloodlust. Uncover secrets about who you are, where you are, and just WHAT is happening.
items.description_ja: A psychological horror game about testing dolls and determining if they are Good or Dangerous. Play in a strange location with dolls potentially filled with bloodlust. Uncover secrets about who you are, where you are, and just WHAT is happening.
items.title: Play Things

items.description:
It’s Jess’s Birthday! Explore a labyrinth of DVD menus to find her the perfect birthday gift. Just don’t get distracted. 
Play as a standalone PC game or burn it to DVD yourself! What could go wrong…?
items.description_ja:
It’s Jess’s Birthday! Explore a labyrinth of DVD menus to find her the perfect birthday gift. Just don’t get distracted. 
Play as a standalone PC game or burn it to DVD yourself! What could go wrong…?
items.title: Buitopia DVD

items.description: Wise Guys is a ruthless, high-stakes social deduction game where trust is a weapon and betrayal is just survival. Up to 12 players race against time to clean up their criminal operation and get out before the raid hits. Meanwhile, a Rat is quietly sabotaging the crew at every turn.
items.description_ja: Wise Guys is a ruthless, high-stakes social deduction game where trust is a weapon and betrayal is just survival. Up to 12 players race against time to clean up their criminal operation and get out before the raid hits. Meanwhile, a Rat is quietly sabotaging the crew at every turn.
items.title: WISE GUYS

items.description: CH13: Rest Stop is a psychological horror game set in early 2000s Poland. What begins as a calm drive through the woods turns into something you weren't prepared for... Will you find out what awaits at the end of the road?
items.description_ja: CH13: Rest Stopは、2000年代初頭のポーランドを舞台にしたサイコロジカルホラーゲームです。森の中を穏やかにドライブするところから始まった旅は、やがてはるかに不穏なものへと変わっていきます…。道の果てに何が待ち受けているのか、あなたは突き止められるでしょうか？
items.title: CH13: Rest Stop

items.description: Play a flute to solve puzzles and unlock secrets, looking for an exit of a dark place before the darkness consumes everything. In this dark immersive horror puzzle game, knowledge is key to put the pieces together. No music experience required.
items.description_ja: Play a flute to solve puzzles and unlock secrets, looking for an exit of a dark place before the darkness consumes everything. In this dark immersive horror puzzle game, knowledge is key to put the pieces together. No music experience required.
items.title: Fugaz

items.description: Halloween On Goober Street is a first-person horror-comedy taking place on Halloween night. Players must Trick-or-Treat their way to 100 candies or face the consequences.  With lots of fun interactions and scares with the zippiest of characters, this Halloween night is one sure to be remembered.
items.description_ja: Halloween On Goober Street is a first-person horror-comedy taking place on Halloween night. Players must Trick-or-Treat their way to 100 candies or face the consequences.  With lots of fun interactions and scares with the zippiest of characters, this Halloween night is one sure to be remembered.
items.title: Halloween On Goober Street

items.description: Chain massive trick combos, dodge deadly debris, and chase huge scores in this fast-paced arcade adventure. Earn coins, upgrade abilities, collect rare items, and uncover a wild time-bending narrative aboard this doomed flight in the year 1995
items.description_ja: 巨大なトリックコンボをつなぎ、致命的な瓦礫をかわし、超高得点を目指せるハイテンポなアーケードアドベンチャー。コインを稼いでアビリティを強化し、レアアイテムを集め、1995年の墜落必至のフライトで繰り広げられる、時間を歪める奇想天外な物語を解き明かそう
items.title: Freefall '95

items.author: oliver-kuso
items.description: Clear the desert. One spoonful at a time.
items.title: Every Last Grain

items.description: Design, maintain and manage a hi-tech hospital facility, making the most of limited resources and turning cures into cash. Can you balance the books and the bedpans?
items.description_ja: ハイテク病院施設を設計、維持、管理し、限られた資源を最大限に活用し、治療を現金に変えましょう。収支のやりくりと便器の世話、両方こなせますか？
items.title: Theme Hospital™

items.description: Dive into a cozy, idle fishing experience! Cast your line from a little corner on your desktop. Customize your cute avatar and background, then feed and collect adorable cats of all breeds. Unlock beautiful scenes and jump into multiplayer and sneak in some "chill-time" with friends!
items.description_ja: ほっこり癒やし系の放置型釣りゲームです。PCデスクトップの片隅でのんびり釣りを楽しみ、可愛いアバターや背景を自由にカスタマイズ。様々な種類の猫たちに餌をあげてコレクションしましょう。美しい新しいシナリオを徐々にアンロックして、お仕事や勉強の合間をもっと楽しく。マルチプレイ対応で、みんなでこっそり“サボりタイム”を！
items.title: Cozy~Fishing Kitten

items.description: Step into a fully 3D medieval world of deception. diffiCULT is a multiplayer social deduction game where you must uncover hidden cultists. Use proximity voice chat, investigate houses at night, survive daily votes, and reveal who is truly on your side.
items.description_ja: 欺瞞に満ちたフル3Dの中世世界へ。『diffiCULT』は、正体を隠したカルト信者を見破るマルチプレイヤー型ソーシャルディダクションゲーム。近接ボイスチャットで情報を集め、夜は家々を調査し、昼の投票を生き延びながら、本当の味方を見極めよう。
items.title: diffiCULT

items.description: Every [key]stroke makes your sausage bigger. Let it sit in the corner of your screen and watch it grow while you use your PC. Feed it different meats, upgrade your butcher, and see the magic happen. Have you ever dreamed of growing your sausage? Now it’s finally possible!
items.description_ja: Every [key]stroke makes your sausage bigger. Let it sit in the corner of your screen and watch it grow while you use your PC. Feed it different meats, upgrade your butcher, and see the magic happen. Have you ever dreamed of growing your sausage? Now it’s finally possible!
items.title: How to Grow Your Sausage

items.description: Take a well-deserved break before searching for your next job! Spend time doing all the things you've always wanted to: cook delicious meals, relax, collect cute figurines, chat with friends, and enjoy life at your own pace. Work can wait a little longer... you've earned this vacation.
items.description_ja: Take a well-deserved break before searching for your next job! Spend time doing all the things you've always wanted to: cook delicious meals, relax, collect cute figurines, chat with friends, and enjoy life at your own pace. Work can wait a little longer... you've earned this vacation.
items.title: The Cozy Funemployment

items.description: Set off on a playful search to track down the wandering pup Polka in this game of exploration and serendipity. Meet charming characters, lend them a hand to make new friends, and explore a cozy world sketched in ballpoint pen. You don't need words on this adventure, just smiles and high-fives!
items.description_ja: ポルカを探す小さな冒険。旅のなかで出会う困っている人を助け、ともだちになろう。ともだちは、きっとあなたを助けてくれる。

evidence.excerpt: 「1周目のエンディング」まで可能です。 2周目以降の内容については、配信・投稿をお控えください。 本ガイドラインの他、PARCO GAMESの

items.title: Finding Polka

items.description: WOIM is a puzzle game where you play as a worm! Push blocks, flip switches, eat apples and... cut yourself in half! WOIM will push you to keep digging downwards, solving tricky puzzles, finding secrets, and making new friends (that were once part of you).
items.description_ja: WOIM は、ミミズになって遊ぶパズルゲーム！ブロックを押して、スイッチを切り替えて、リンゴを食べて……自分の体を真っ二つに！？WOIM はキミをどんどん下へと掘り進ませる。頭をひねるパズルを解き、秘密を見つけ、新しい仲間（元はキミの一部）を作ろう。
items.title: WOIM

items.description: The official remake of the 2012 viral hit Slenderman's Shadow is out! A faceless, slender man hunts you across your favourite maps. Survive with friends in multiplayer, immerse yourself in VR, and build your own terrifying maps with the in-game editor. He is ready. Are you?
items.description_ja: 2012年のバイラルの伝説が帰ってきた。細身で顔のない怪人が、ゼロから作り直されたおなじみのマップであなたを狩る——新マップForestも登場。オンラインマルチプレイや画面分割で仲間と生き延び、VRでプレイし、エディターで自分だけの恐怖のマップを作ろう。あなたは生き延びられるか？
items.title: Slenderman’s Shadow Returns

items.author: larprieyegers
items.description: snowman ahh mod
items.title: Koy Koy Yeni Bir Kat (OH NO MY SNOWMAN'S MELTED BROTHER)

items.description: A horror-romance visual novel following the trials of a dysfunctional friend group thrust back into the wish-granting wonderland of their youth. Either they face the issues plaguing them or risk dying in horrific ways again… and again… and again.
items.description_ja: A horror-romance visual novel following the trials of a dysfunctional friend group thrust back into the wish-granting wonderland of their youth. Either they face the issues plaguing them or risk dying in horrific ways again… and again… and again.
items.title: Our Wonderland

items.description: A Roguelite survivor starring streamers. Rescue your followers to stay off the unemployment line, unlock unique characters, stack powerful runes, and become a wrecking ball of total chaos. Learn. Die. Repeat.
items.description_ja: 配信者が主役のローグライト・サバイバー。フォロワーを救って無職を回避し、ユニークなキャラクターを解放し、強力なルーンを積み重ね、純粋な混沌の破壊球と化せ。学べ。死ね。繰り返せ。
items.title: Just Dying

items.description: Collect hundreds of thousands of golf balls, earn money, buy new tools, and clean up the golf yard. BALL PICKER is an active incremental game centered on the quiet satisfaction of tidying up.
items.description_ja: 何十万個ものゴルフボールを拾い集めてお金を稼ぎ、新しい道具を買って、ゴルフ場をすっきり片付けよう。『BALL PICKER』は、片付けと癒やしをテーマにした、手を動かして進めるインクリメンタルゲームです。
items.title: BALL PICKER - Clean Up the Golf Yard

items.description: A chill, exploration-based incremental game about harvesting and cleansing an alien planet of its radiation with a swarm of high-tech toasters.
items.description_ja: A chill, exploration-based incremental game about harvesting and cleansing an alien planet of its radiation with a swarm of high-tech toasters.
items.title: A Thousand Cloys

items.description: To see, you must speak. To speak is to be found. A co-op horror in near-total darkness where every sound sends out a wave that lights the level — and calls whatever lives in it. 1–4 players, real voice, microphone required.
items.description_ja: 見るには、声を出すしかない。声を出せば、見つかる。ほぼ完全な暗闇の中、あらゆる音が波となって広がり、一瞬だけ世界を照らし出す――そして、そこに潜むものを呼び寄せる協力型ホラー。1〜4人プレイ、本物の声で遊ぶゲーム。マイク必須。
items.title: Echo Mates

items.description: A co-op climbing game about two stuck-together toys on an escape mission from their evil owner.
items.description_ja: 二人協力の極限クライムゲーム！友達とくっついて奇抜な仕掛けや奇怪な部屋を攻略。登攀、ブランコ渡り、UFOに引きずられ、謎の巨大な手に追われる…息ぴったりで乗り越えろ！一歩のミスでやり直し、失敗自体が大笑いのネタ。友情よりゲームが第一。罵り合いもハグも、どうぞご自由に！
items.title: Stuck Together

items.description: Hello! Hi! How are you? It's time to play! TAKE CARE OF THE DOG is a short story about... taking care of a dog! Play around, follow him, find items, go get the water in the basement (for some reason) and a lot more!
items.description_ja: こんにちは！やあ！元気ですか？さあ、遊びましょう！『TAKE CARE OF THE DOG』は…犬のお世話をする、ちょっとしたストーリーです！自由に動き回ったり、犬について行ったり、アイテムを見つけたり、地下室にある水ボトルを取りに行ったり（なぜか）、他にもいろいろ楽しめます！
items.title: TAKE CARE OF THE DOG

items.description: Turnip Mountain is a physics-based climbing adventure in which you control each hand independently using two mice or two analogue sticks. Grab, swing and launch yourself to the summit your own way.
items.description_ja: この両スティック操作のクライミングプラットフォーマーで、自分だけの道を切り開きながら、手を伸ばし、揺れ、舞い上がってTurnip Mountainの頂上を目指そう!
items.title: Turnip Mountain

items.description: Join Tom, the village’s new postgirl, and get to know the locals, perhaps a little too well. Her method, although controversial, is highly effective: intense, obsessive stalking.
items.description_ja: 村に新しくやってきた郵便配達員のトムと一緒に、地元の人々と親しくなっていこう。もしかしたら、親しくなりすぎるかもしれない。彼女のやり方は物議を醸すものの、非常に効果的だ。それは、執拗で執着心あふれるストーキングである。
items.title: Tom the Postgirl

items.description: You're stuck in a dream. Blink and change your surroundings to escape the shadows of your past.
items.description_ja:
夢から抜け出したと思った？違う。ただ“目を覚ました”だけだ。耳の奥で囁く“何か”が、終わりなき夢の底へ沈みゆくあなたの目玉を欲している。視界を切り替え、記憶の断片を辿り、もがき続けて悪夢から脱出する…か。
目覚めの鐘はすでに鳴った。この果てしない夢を、直視せよ。
items.title: Time To Wake Up

items.description: Explore a world without your eyes and ears to guide you.  Uncover the secrets this world has to offer, hoard all the items you can find or get lost trying.
items.description_ja: Explore a world without your eyes and ears to guide you.  Uncover the secrets this world has to offer, hoard all the items you can find or get lost trying.
items.title: Helen Keller Simulator

items.description: Join up to three friends in this mouse-sized adventure! Explore, gather resources, solve puzzles, and battle enemies as you try to bring your kidnapped brothers and sisters home.
items.description_ja: Join up to three friends in this mouse-sized adventure! Explore, gather resources, solve puzzles, and battle enemies as you try to bring your kidnapped brothers and sisters home.
items.title: Let's Save Mice

items.description: A disappearance in a secluded community. A mountain hiding its secrets. A detective running out of time. Welcome to Hillthorn, a dark investigation game that invites you to uncover the mystery without a single word spoken, using your skills of logic and intuition through cards.
items.description_ja: 隔絶された共同体で起こった失踪事件。真相が眠る山。探偵に迫るタイムリミット。ダークな捜査ゲーム、Hillthornへようこそ。ゲーム中の会話は一切なし。プレイヤーのあなたは論理力と直感力を駆使しながら、手渡されたカードを元に謎の究明を目指す。
items.title: Hillthorn

items.description: A virus is spreading. You can't afford to pickle everyone. Keep the bar open and decide who gets pickled before the outbreak decides who dies.
items.description_ja: ウイルスが広がっている。全員をピクルス化する金はない。店を回しながら、誰をピクルス化するか決めろ。アウトブレイクが誰かを選ぶ前に。
items.title: [Bober Bros] Last Pill Bar

items.description: Journey TD is a roguelite tower defense where your towers are the maze. Pick your elements and draft from 168 towers. Combine power-ups, gear, runes and three skill trees into deadly builds. Every week, battle other players on the same seed to top the leaderboard.
items.description_ja: Journey TDは、タワーそのものが迷路になるローグライトタワーディフェンスです。属性を選び、168種のタワーからドラフトしましょう。パワーアップ、装備、ルーン、3つのスキルツリーを組み合わせれば、凶悪なビルドの完成です。毎週、同じ Seed でほかのプレイヤーと競い合い、ランキング1位を目指しましょう。
items.title: Journey TD

items.description: The world above is gone. Guide two souls through a rotting underground and shape who they become with character traits in this grimdark role playing game. Sneak past strangers, try to understand them, or tear them apart. Anyone can die, your choices matter, and people remember how you treat them.
items.description_ja: 地上の世界は消え去った。腐りゆく地下世界で二つの魂を導き、性格特性によって彼らの生き方を形作るグリムダークRPG。見知らぬ者の目を盗んで忍び抜けるか、理解しようと努めるか、それとも引き裂くか。誰もが死にうる。あなたの選択には意味があり、人々はあなたにどう扱われたかを忘れない。
items.title: Grimdelve

items.description: You've been hired by a real estate agency to photograph their listings at night, giving them a unique look online. Grab your camera, explore dark, quiet homes, and capture every required shot before the property notices you. Uncover the truth: why do these listings need to be photographed at night?
items.description_ja: You've been hired by a real estate agency to photograph their listings at night, giving them a unique look online. Grab your camera, explore dark, quiet homes, and capture every required shot before the property notices you. Uncover the truth: why do these listings need to be photographed at night?
items.title: FLASH AND DIE

items.description: You wake up in a strange place, not knowing who you are, where you are, or how you got here. Trapped in an environment that twists to break your sanity, your only way out is to delve into the unknown and face the horrors of a past your mind is trying to hide.
items.description_ja: You wake up in a strange place, not knowing who you are, where you are, or how you got here. Trapped in an environment that twists to break your sanity, your only way out is to delve into the unknown and face the horrors of a past your mind is trying to hide.
items.title: Unanswered

items.description: "Stories to Tell" Is a psychological horror game series developed by a 16 year old were each installment is based on a dream/nightmare that I, the developer, have experienced. This is a game you wouldn't want to miss...
items.description_ja: "Stories to Tell" Is a psychological horror game series developed by a 16 year old were each installment is based on a dream/nightmare that I, the developer, have experienced. This is a game you wouldn't want to miss...
items.title: [Stories to Tell] The Stoneville Incident

items.description: Your parents have left, and you're home alone. What begins as an ordinary evening after school slowly turns into a living nightmare, where every little sound makes your heart race. Remember the most important rule: don't open the door for anyone.
items.description_ja: Your parents have left, and you're home alone. What begins as an ordinary evening after school slowly turns into a living nightmare, where every little sound makes your heart race. Remember the most important rule: don't open the door for anyone.
items.title: Can I Come In?

items.description: Become the exorcist that the world needs! Use Holy Relics and the knowledge from your book to fight demonic possessions. Investigate unholy events and take part in church rituals in this medieval pixel horror game.
items.description_ja: Become the exorcist that the world needs! Use Holy Relics and the knowledge from your book to fight demonic possessions. Investigate unholy events and take part in church rituals in this medieval pixel horror game.
items.title: Ritus Exorcismus

items.description: Wink Out your rivals in this physics-driven 1v1 shooter! Create clever synergies, adapt between rounds, and outplay opponents by sending them flying out of the arena.
items.description_ja: 物理演算に基づく1対1シューティングでライバルを吹き飛ばそう！賢いカードシナジーを組み上げ、ラウンド間でビルドを調整し、相手をアリーナ外へ弾き飛ばして勝利をつかもう。
items.title: Wink Out

items.description: A first-person psychological horror game. Explore a maze-like alleyway, using your camera to distinguish between supernatural "Aberrations" and deceptive "Deceptions" while escaping the relentless pursuit of a vengeful ghost.
items.description_ja: 無限に続く迷路のような路地裏を探索する、一人称視点のサイコロジカルホラー。カメラを通して「鬼痕」と「幻象」を見極め、迫りくる鬼の追跡を逃れて脱出を目指しましょう。
items.title: The Alley

items.author: blake-gocey
items.description: A clicker game about building robot pigeons to spy on everyone
items.title: Birds Are Not Real

items.author: ookii-tsuki
items.description: Protect your RAM from Sam
items.title: RAM Raider

items.author: szrot-games-studiopl
items.description: Memiczna strzelanka 3D w stylu lat 90. Toksyczne pierogi, Janusz z ogórkami i Król Pierogów.
items.title: Laboratorium 13: Polish Edytion

items.description: A different kind of liminal experience. Explore surreal spaces inspired by nostalgia, discover hidden paths, and unravel a mystery that is shaped by your own mind. No monsters, no combat. Just atmosphere, discovery, and dread.
items.description_ja: 現実が解き明かされる不思議な中間空間の奥深くへと導く、不気味な探索体験。 このウォーキング シミュレーターは、あなたの好奇心を刺激し、限界環境を探索し、その秘密を明らかにし、正気を保ったまま脱出するよう誘います。
items.title: Liminal Shroud

items.description: in this game u play as Fuck and u get to use crappy weapons and talk to horrible NPCs and find the bible crystals and explore my game and find secrets and play further to see what the next part of the game is
items.description_ja: in this game u play as Fuck and u get to use crappy weapons and talk to horrible NPCs and find the bible crystals and explore my game and find secrets and play further to see what the next part of the game is
items.title: Fuck's Quest II

items.description: Backpack-like × strategy × bullet heaven xianxia Roguelike. Random artifacts, limited grid, fusion & evolution to build your ultimate setup. Meet junior sisters, upgrade your Dao Body, and defend the last pure land. Easy to play, hard to stop!
items.description_ja: バックパックライク×戦略×弾幕シューティングの仙侠ローグライク。ランダム法宝、限られたマス、合成と進化で最強ビルドを構築。紅顔の師妹と出会い、道身を強化し、最後の浄土を守れ。気軽に遊べて、やめられない！
items.title: Mortal Path: Mighty Senior Brother

items.description: Embark on a journey to reunite with your bread in this bite-sized 3D action-platformer featuring everyone's favorite shark!
items.description_ja: みんなの大好きなあのサメと一緒に、パンとの再会を目指す旅へ出発しよう！お手軽に遊べる3Dアクションゲーム！
items.title: Gawr Gura: Quest for Bread

items.description: Run your bar as a gorilla and hunt down the humans in animal costumes hiding among your customers. Observe them closely, spot the clues that give their disguises away, test their slogans, and blow the imposters away with your shotgun. Choose your targets wisely... or become the hunted.
items.description_ja: ゴリラとしてバーを経営し、客の中に紛れた動物の着ぐるみを着た人間を狩れ。注意深く観察し、変装を見破る手がかりを見つけ、スローガンを試し、ショットガンでインポスターを排除せよ。賢く標的を選べ…さもなくば狩られる側になる。
items.title: Animaly Bar: NO HUMANITY!

items.description:
Just keep walking left. The latest Tsugunohi returns to the series’ roots with its early visual style and atmosphere.
On a sweltering summer day, a girl walks home past “righteous” people, a thread of salvation, and her mother beneath a white umbrella.
Is that hand salvation—or a curse?
items.description_ja:
操作は左に歩くだけ。日常侵食ホラー「つぐのひ」シリーズ最新作。本作は、初期の絵柄と空気感に立ち返った“原点回帰”の一作。
うだる夏の住宅街で、落書きだらけの家に住む少女は、今日も学校から家へ帰る。毎日現れる“正しい”人たち、空から垂れる救いの糸、白い傘の母。その手は、救いか、呪いか。

items.description: A group of university students is going to spend a week in the old hotel "Amnea". Within these seven days they have to find out what is hidden behind its facade and to unravel all the mysteries without losing their minds.
items.description_ja: A group of university students is going to spend a week in the old hotel "Amnea". Within these seven days they have to find out what is hidden behind its facade and to unravel all the mysteries without losing their minds.
items.title: Amnea28: Two Eternities

items.description:
LET'S BE HONEST.
You're in deep shit.
Straitjacket locked tight.  
Hood over your head.  
And the atmosphere? Definitely not a dream vacation.
But hey… it happened.  
You did what you did.
And now you're here...
items.description_ja:
正直に言いましょう。
あなたはとんでもない状況に陥っています。
拘束衣はきつく締められています。
頭にはフード。
そしてこの雰囲気？とても夢のバカンスとは言えません。
でも……起きてしまったことです。
あなたは自分のしたことをしました。
そして今、あなたはここにいます…
items.title: Get Out ! A "Very Bad Dreams" Story

items.description: In Serve Or Die, you work alone in a small sandwich shop during the night shift. With a VHS-inspired style and an increasingly unsettling atmosphere, survive as simple orders turn into something far more disturbing.
items.description_ja: Serve Or Die では、夜勤中に小さなサンドイッチ店で一人きりで働きます。VHS風のスタイルと、次第に不穏さを増していく雰囲気の中で、単純な注文がはるかに不気味なものへと変わっていく状況を生き延びましょう。
items.title: Serve Or Die

items.description: Sit back and relax with a desktop fishing game that stays in the corner of your screen. Catch fish, cook recipes, upgrade your gear, and complete your collection guide. Customize your character’s look and even design your very own custom fish to catch!
items.description_ja: 画面の片隅に釣り人を浮かべてでのんびり楽しめるデスクトップ釣りゲームです。魚を釣り、料理し、装備を強化しながら図鑑を完成させましょう。釣り人のスキンはもちろん、釣り上げる魚まで自由にかわいくカスタムできます！
items.title: SCREENSIDE FISHER

items.description: Painting PC is a relaxing painting game where you take on commissions, earn money, gain fans, unlock new tools, and work your way towards becoming a famous artist.
items.description_ja: Painting PC is a relaxing painting game where you take on commissions, earn money, gain fans, unlock new tools, and work your way towards becoming a famous artist.
items.title: Painting PC

items.description: When demons leave your head and fill the whole world, all you can do is close your eyes and go forward. Immerse yourself in the atmospheric and moving adventure of white crow Ankou — one of pain, loneliness, and salvation that no one asked for.
items.description_ja: When demons leave your head and fill the whole world, all you can do is close your eyes and go forward. Immerse yourself in the atmospheric and moving adventure of white crow Ankou — one of pain, loneliness, and salvation that no one asked for.
items.title: Provoron

items.description: Sniper Dan is a delightfully funny, family-friendly 3D Hidden Object game with a big twist. Use a sniper rifle to solve hundreds of low-stakes jobs across six packed locations, discover surprising secrets, snap hilarious photo ops, and unlock costumes, upgrades, office décor, collectables and more!
items.description_ja: 『スナイパー・ダン：ワンショットの何でも屋』は面白おかしく、家族で遊べる一風変わった3D隠しオブジェクトゲーム。強力なスナイパーライフルを使い、小さな問題を解決していこう。スコープで場面をのぞき、問題を見つけ、解決策を撃ち抜く。暴力要素はなし。あるのはただ、ほっこりするカオスと善意だけ！
items.title: Sniper Dan

items.description: Steal a face. Study a life. Survive the conversation.
items.description_ja: Steal a face. Study a life. Survive the conversation.
items.title: Legion Was Here

items.description:
An online VR co-op horror game about delivering parcels into haunted mines. 
Avoid monsters, drop off packages, and pray you reach the quota! 
Team up with up to 5 other delivery goblins, survive your shift and pay back your student loans. (VR crossplay supported)
items.description_ja:
An online VR co-op horror game about delivering parcels into haunted mines. 
Avoid monsters, drop off packages, and pray you reach the quota! 
Team up with up to 5 other delivery goblins, survive your shift and pay back your student loans. (VR crossplay supported)

items.description:
Subversive Memories is a story driven survival horror set in Brazil during the last military dictatorship.
Explore the backrooms of an oppressive regime, escape ominous presences and scavenge every corner of this land in search of your ██████.
items.description_ja:
Subversive Memories is a story driven survival horror set in Brazil during the last military dictatorship.
Explore the backrooms of an oppressive regime, escape ominous presences and scavenge every corner of this land in search of your ██████.
items.title: Subversive Memories

items.description: No Legs. Just Flips. A hard and punishing game where you flip, fall, and climb as Flippy, using only rotation. Do you have what it takes to get back to Jeff?
items.description_ja: 足はない。フリップだけ。Flippyとなり、回転だけを使ってフリップし、落下し、相棒のもとへ戻るために登り続ける、難しく容赦のないゲーム。

evidence.excerpt: Streaming and monetized videos are welcome.

items.title: Flipping is Hard

items.description: YOU ARE SENTENCED TO DEATH... Slither your way through an impenetrable fortress crawling with devils faster, stronger, and more cunning than any human. By sheer luck you've slipped through the cracks, but discovery means certain death. How long are you going to delay the inevitable?
items.description_ja: YOU ARE SENTENCED TO DEATH... Slither your way through an impenetrable fortress crawling with devils faster, stronger, and more cunning than any human. By sheer luck you've slipped through the cracks, but discovery means certain death. How long are you going to delay the inevitable?
items.title: DEATH PENALTY

items.description: The battle for the pig throne has begun! Fight your way to the top in this arena party brawler for up to 4 players.
items.description_ja: ピッグキングの座を巡る戦いが始まった！最大 4 人のプレイヤーが参加する、アリーナ形式のパーティーバトルゲームで頂点を目指そう。
items.title: Pig King

items.description: "Weeping Souls" is a visual novel game. The player takes on the role of the protagonist and chooses the right path to ensure the safety of themselves and their friends. The game features multiple endings, determined by your choices.
items.description_ja: "Weeping Souls" is a visual novel game. The player takes on the role of the protagonist and chooses the right path to ensure the safety of themselves and their friends. The game features multiple endings, determined by your choices.
items.title: Weeping Souls

items.description_ja:
