items.description: In this 2D Survival-Horror, you switch between two protagonists as you advance through the story: Neo, a man lost in his own mind, trying to survive an endless nightmare, and Lavina, a loyal friend who will do anything to try to save him.
items.description_ja: In this 2D Survival-Horror, you switch between two protagonists as you advance through the story: Neo, a man lost in his own mind, trying to survive an endless nightmare, and Lavina, a loyal friend who will do anything to try to save him.
items.title: Touch of Madness

items.description: Hitler Waifu 2 - is a parody third-person 3D shooter with satire and black humor
items.description_ja: Hitler Waifu 2 - is a parody third-person 3D shooter with satire and black humor
items.title: HITLER WAIFU 2

items.description:
Puni the Florist is a cozy flower shop simulation game that highlights creative expressions.
Manage the shop, design unique bouquets, and join Puni on a silly, wholesome, and relatable journey of self-discovery.
items.description_ja: 『Puni the Florist』は、花と彩りで想いをかたちにする、心あたたまるお花屋さんシミュレーションゲームです。お店を切り盛りしながら、世界にひとつだけの花束を作ってみませんか？ちょっとヘンテコで心温まる、そして誰もがどこか共感できる、そんなプニの自分探しの旅へ一緒に出かけましょう。
items.title: Puni the Florist

items.description: "Arai-san Mansion Exploration Game: Incarnation" is a command-based text adventure based on the "Kemono Friends". As an investigator, explore an eerie mansion with astronomical floors. Use your skills and Ally cards to survive anomalies, and find a way to contain the mystery.
items.description_ja: 「アライさんマンション探索ゲーム～Incarnation～」は、天文学的な数の階層が広がる不気味なマンションを調査する、「けものフレンズ」「アライさんマンション」を原作とした、コマンド選択式のテキストアドベンチャーゲームです。プレイヤーは調査員として、フレンズとの協力やスキルを駆使し、怪異が潜む未知の階層へと挑みます。限られたリソースの中で「探索」と「撤退」を判断し、マンションの安全な収容方法を解明してください。
items.title: Arai-san Mansion Exploration Game: Incarnation

items.description: DISTURBING FEARS is an episodic psychological horror game based on true events that immerses players in haunting narratives.
items.description_ja: DISTURBING FEARS is an episodic psychological horror game based on true events that immerses players in haunting narratives.
items.title: DISTURBING FEARS - Workplace

items.description: SSTWL - Sector Breach is a sit and survive, point-and-click survival-horror game about the characters and world created by Liam Vickers.
items.description_ja: SSTWL - Sector Breach is a sit and survive, point-and-click survival-horror game about the characters and world created by Liam Vickers.
items.title: SSTWL - Sector Breach

items.description: Find your community at summer camp, one friendship at a time. Take a beat, enjoy a breath of fresh air - all while playing at the beach, strolling in the woods, and dancing with friends. This short cozy game was created by two dads, celebrating their kids’ journeys to find their voices.
items.description_ja: サマーキャンプでひとりひとりと友情を育み、自分の居場所を見つけよう。ゆったりと新鮮な空気を味わいながらビーチで遊び、森を散歩し、友達とダンスするコージーな短編ゲーム。開発者はふたりの父親。子どもたちが自分の“声”を見つけたことを記念して、このゲームをつくりました。
items.title: Find Your Words

items.description: A stealth-focused, satire co-op horror game where players must descend through an infinite series of mazes, evading the all-hearing Maze Creep and numerous other threats.
items.description_ja: A stealth-focused, satire co-op horror game where players must descend through an infinite series of mazes, evading the all-hearing Maze Creep and numerous other threats.
items.title: Maze Creep!!

items.description: Paint, combine and discover! Garden Ink is a cozy sandbox game. Combine decorations and use painting tools to customize your world. With hand-painted graphics and a relaxing soundtrack, it’s time to discover every cute surprise.
items.description_ja: 描いて、組み合わせて、発見しよう！Garden Ink は居心地のよいサンドボックスゲーム。デコレーションを組み合わせ、ペイントツールを使って自分だけの世界にカスタマイズしよう。手描きのグラフィックと心安らぐサウンドトラックとともに、かわいい驚きをすべて見つけよう。
items.title: Garden Ink

items.description:
Use just two buttons to climb a colossal pinball table spanning the history of western philosophy. 
Fallosophy is a minimalist game that turns pinball into a quiet struggle against gravity. No score. No tilts. No savers. Falling down means climbing back up again.

Why climb? What does it all mean?
items.description_ja:
2つのボタンのみで、西洋哲学史を辿る長大なピンボールテーブルを昇れ。
『Fallosophy』はミニマリストなデザインのゲーム。ピンボールが、重力を相手にした静かなる苦闘に変わる。スコア、揺らし、ボールセーバーはなし。落ちたならば、もう一度昇るのみ。

なぜ昇るのか？そこに何の意味があるのか？
items.title: Fallosophy

items.description: A short horror cooking game. Run your dead uncle's burger cart on a foggy harbour pier in the 1970s. Cook for the locals, spot the drowned before they reach your window, and find out who really killed your uncle.
items.description_ja: 短めのホラー料理ゲーム。1970年代、霧に包まれた港の桟橋で、亡くなった叔父のハンバーガー屋台を引き継ごう。町の人たちに料理を出し、窓口に来る前に溺死者を見抜き、叔父を本当に殺したのは誰なのかを突き止めよう。
items.title: The Usual, Please

items.description: <Only Fans> is an object finding game where you find mildly boobs and mildly butts objects in a gooning rehab full of fans.
items.description_ja: <Only Fans> は、扇風機だらけの「煩悩浄化センター」で、おっぱいとお尻に見える物体を探す隠しアイテム探しゲームです。
items.title: Only Fans

items.description: There’s no place like home - and yours is no home at all. Play as Rosa, a neglected child trying to escape her abusive family. Sneak out, but be ever so quiet. Mom is listening, dad is angry, and your big sister is always watching…
items.description_ja: There’s no place like home - and yours is no home at all. Play as Rosa, a neglected child trying to escape her abusive family. Sneak out, but be ever so quiet. Mom is listening, dad is angry, and your big sister is always watching…
items.title: Step Lightly

items.description: Model, paint, and blend in! FAKE ME is an online multiplayer hide-and-seek game where you create your own disguise. Use simple 3D modeling tools to build the object you’ll hide as. You can also create your own costume by modeling. Hide from the Seekers or find every Faker before time runs out!
items.description_ja: まあだだよ。シーカーの目の前に隠れて、何周目で見つかるか試そう！友達を誘って、楽しいかくれんぼに！家具に変身して色を塗り、周囲に溶け込んだり、変な音声を録音してイタズラしたり、両陣営のスキルを駆使して大活躍！今度は君が探す番？気をつけて。部屋のどのアイテムも、何か企んでいるかも……！
items.title: FAKE ME

items.description: An absurd personality testing experience with a whole lot of questions for you.
items.description_ja: An absurd personality testing experience with a whole lot of questions for you.
items.title: Foole's World

items.description: A horror adventure game inspired by the art of Theodor Geisel and the works of HP Lovecraft, featuring a mixture of point and click and survival horror elements.
items.description_ja: A horror adventure game inspired by the art of Theodor Geisel and the works of HP Lovecraft, featuring a mixture of point and click and survival horror elements.
items.title: The Island of Doctor Morose

items.description: HOPE 01 is a single player extraction survival RPG with multiple endings.  Explore, Loot, and Fight your way through the dangerous enemies and bosses of the hab cluster and solve the mystery of the legendary HAB 01.
items.description_ja:
「HOPE 01」は、複数のエンディングを備えたシングルプレイヤー向けのエクストラクション・サバイバルRPGです。
探索し、物資を集め、戦い抜きながら危険なハブクラスターを進み、伝説の「HAB 01」に秘められた謎を解き明かしましょう。
items.title: HOPE 01

items.description: Descend into infested crypts beneath a cursed cemetery in this visceral action-horror FPS. Fight through rotting horrors with heavy gunplay, brutal dismemberment, and only a dying flashlight between you and the darkness.
items.description_ja: 呪われた墓地の地下に広がる、蟲に侵された地下墓地へ足を踏み入れろ。重量感ある銃撃、凄惨な四肢切断、そして消えかけた懐中電灯だけを頼りに闇へ挑む、残酷なアクションホラーFPS。
items.title: GUTTED: Infested Crypts

items.description: Use your mouse to balance a cake that slides with every step in this horror game. Escape twisted beings and overcome dangerous traps, uncover the mystery behind the cake, and see the story through to its conclusion.
items.description_ja: 歩くたびにグラグラ揺れるケーキを、マウスでバランスを取りながら運ぶホラーゲーム。異形の存在や危険な仕掛けを乗り越え、ケーキに隠された謎と物語の結末を見届けよう。

evidence.excerpt: Feel free to stream or upload videos of the game.

items.title: Don't Drop The Cake

items.description: A psychological horror anthology inspired by disturbing real-life cases. In No Witnesses, a simple road trip turns into a brutal fight for survival when two sisters cross paths with a ruthless serial killer stalking the highways at night.
items.description_ja: A psychological horror anthology inspired by disturbing real-life cases. In No Witnesses, a simple road trip turns into a brutal fight for survival when two sisters cross paths with a ruthless serial killer stalking the highways at night.
items.title: Tales Beyond The Tomb - No Witnesses

items.description: Onion Voting Simulator 3D is an action-packed walking sim where you perform America's most taboo act: Voting. It’s Election Day and your choice could change the country's fate! But it won’t be easy: Resist the allure of staying home! Explore a school gym! And don’t get lost, because Hell is real!
items.description_ja: Onion Voting Simulator 3D is an action-packed walking sim where you perform America's most taboo act: Voting. It’s Election Day and your choice could change the country's fate! But it won’t be easy: Resist the allure of staying home! Explore a school gym! And don’t get lost, because Hell is real!
items.title: The Onion Voting Simulator 3D

items.description: Dig, build rails, and survive underground as a Goblin miner for WHAAG MINING INC. Light your path or the darkness will drain your life. Explore fully destructible biomes, fight hostile creatures, and hunt the legendary Giant Crystal, solo or online co-op
items.description_ja: トンネルを掘り、レールを敷け。WHAAG MINING INC.のゴブリン鉱夫として地下で生き延びよう。道を照らさなければ、暗闇がゴブリンを支配する。破壊可能なバイオームを探索したり、敵対する生物と戦ったり、ソロまたはオンライン協力プレイで伝説の巨大クリスタルをゲットしよう。
items.title: Goblin Company

items.description: 2-4 Sneaky and squeaky low-poly mice face off against a lone cat in the battlefield of a human house. Mice use proximity chat to communicate with other players, while the cat hunts their noises. Will the mice perform enough tasks to destroy the house, or will the cat defeat enough mice to save it?
items.description_ja: 2-4 Sneaky and squeaky low-poly mice face off against a lone cat in the battlefield of a human house. Mice use proximity chat to communicate with other players, while the cat hunts their noises. Will the mice perform enough tasks to destroy the house, or will the cat defeat enough mice to save it?
items.title: Low Poly Mouse Game

items.description: It's been three years since your first date with Chester the Otter. It's your anniversary today, and you've both got surprises in store. Are you ready for a date that's truly out of this world?
items.description_ja: It's been three years since your first date with Chester the Otter. It's your anniversary today, and you've both got surprises in store. Are you ready for a date that's truly out of this world?
items.title: A Date With Chester 2

items.description: A first-person psychological horror game. Play as Marlene, an 86-year-old woman preparing for her family's visit. They're coming. They always do.
items.description_ja: A first-person psychological horror game. Play as Marlene, an 86-year-old woman preparing for her family's visit. They're coming. They always do.
items.title: As Long As She Forgot

items.description: Love, Death & My Daughter is a free game that combines a virtual desktop interface with narrative storytelling. you will repair a memory program within an old software system, gradually recover memories from the past, and come to understand the love a mother left behind in a new light.
items.description_ja: 『愛と死と、私の娘』は、無料で遊べる短編のピクセルアート・ナラティブゲームです。雨の墓地を歩き、不具合を修復し、記憶と記録をたどってください。かすかな恐怖と歪みの中で、ひとりの母親が遺した愛を知る物語です。
items.title: Love, Death & My Daughter

items.description:
Check the suspect's status and solve the mystery!
A status-checking mystery ADV in which a rookie detective takes on difficult cases that take place in a fantasy world.
items.description_ja:
容疑者のステータスを見て謎を解け！
ファンタジーな世界で起こった難事件に新米探偵が挑む、ステータス確認系ミステリーADV。
items.title: ステータス確認探偵

items.description: Carefully observe your sorroundings and come back to your reality by finding what doesn't fit. If something's wrong take the bus back from across the street. A game situated in the haze of Buenos Aires.
items.description_ja: Carefully observe your sorroundings and come back to your reality by finding what doesn't fit. If something's wrong take the bus back from across the street. A game situated in the haze of Buenos Aires.
items.title: Buenos Aires Mirror Line

items.description:
An atmospheric climbing experience for solo players or up to 4 in co-op.
A short, minimalist platformer about the cold, isolation, and quiet persistence.
items.description_ja:
シングルプレイ、または最大4人の協力プレイで楽しめる、情緒あふれる登山体験。
寒さ、孤独、そして静かな忍耐を描いた、短編ミニマル・プラットフォーマー。
items.title: But Why?

items.description: A medical simulation where you examine and treat magical girls injured in kaiju disasters. With limited hospital beds and stamina, decide who to accept, who to refuse, and which treatment to choose.
items.description_ja: 怪獣災害で傷ついた魔法少女たちを診察し治療する救命シミュレーション。限られた病床と体力の中で誰を受け入れ、誰を拒否し、どの治療を行うかを判断してください。
items.title: Magical Girl ER

items.description: A 1-4 player co-op cheating simulator where you and your friends try to survive the final week of exams. Steal answers, elude the teacher, and use every tool in your cheating arsenal to graduate from school without studying a single page.
items.description_ja: 1～4人で遊べる、友達と協力して期末試験の最終週を生き抜く、協力型カンニングシミュレーター！答えを盗み、教師の目をかいくぐり、あらゆるカンニング道具を駆使して、教科書を1ページも読まずに卒業を目指そう！
items.title: Finals Week ✍🏻

items.description: Destroy your friendships with adorable chaos. Roombattle is a fast-paced party battler for up to 6 players where you play as customizable vacuum cleaners, battling friends in frantic arenas and wildly unpredictable minigames across multiple game modes.
items.description_ja: かわいいカオスで、友情をぶち壊せ！『Roombattle（ルームバトル）』は、最大6人まで遊べるハイスピードなパーティ対戦アクション。自分好みにカスタマイズした「お掃除ロボ」を操作して、友達や家族と大バトル！ハチャメチャで予測不能なミニゲームや多彩なモードをたくさん楽しめます！
items.title: Roombattle

items.description:
Feed your fellow Shape Buddies to Glutton Monsters before they put you on the menu!
Catch, balance, roll or fling food using anything from swords to croissants and tuna fish. 
Play solo or with a friend locally or via Steam Remote Play Together.
items.description_ja: 「命がけ」の惑星へようこそ！『一口ちょうだい！』では、落ちてくる食べ物をキャッチして腹ペコのモンスターたちに食べさせないと、逆にキミが食べられてしまいます！ゲームはシングル、2人協力、対戦モードに対応。友達を誘って、このドタバタなエサやりアドベンチャーを生き残りましょう！
items.title: One More Plate!

items.description: Play cards with your friends or meet new opponents at a local bar where every match is a brand-new challenge! Test your strategy across 3 different game modes, each with their own unique rules and systems! Victory is never guaranteed, and there's always one card that can flip everything.
items.description_ja: 『Capote（カポテ）』は、ブラジルの伝統的なバーゲームに着想を得たマルチプレイカードゲームです。運、ブラフ、そして戦略が賑やかなバーの雰囲気でぶつかり合う。勝利は決して保証されず——たった1枚のカードが試合をひっくり返します。あなたは賭けを成功させられるのか、それとも大失敗するのか？
items.title: Capote

items.description: A short first-person point & click survival horror game where you're a prisoner tasked with crabbing for priceless Southern King Crabs to pay off your debt to the Feudostate. Navigate the harsh waters of the Antarctic and defend your ship from the threats that dwell under the icy waters.
items.description_ja: 『Crabmeat』は短編一人称ポイント&クリック・サバイバルホラーゲームだ。フェウド国家への借金を背負い、希少なサザンタラバガニ漁を命じられた囚人として、南極の過酷な海へ出よう。氷の海に潜む脅威から船を守り抜け。
items.title: Crabmeat

items.description: Adorable sushi race at full speed in a training × racing game! Become a sushi chef, craft unique toppings, and enter your trained sushi into races. Don't forget to cheer on your sushi during the race. Win the prestigious S1 Cup championship, and become a top-tier sushi chef!
items.description_ja: かわいいお寿司たちが育成×レースで大疾走！あなたは寿司職人となって個性豊かなネタを握り、鍛えた寿司でレースに出走します。レース中はお寿司を応援することも忘れずに。栄光ある寿司レースの頂・「S1」カップ優勝を勝ち獲り、一流の寿司職人となれ！
items.title: Wabisabi SushiDerby

items.description: Play as a tumbling bumblebee on a quest to rescue its captured family from a cave filled with arachnid nightmares.
items.description_ja: 囚われの家族を助けるため、一匹のマルハナバチが旅立つ。恐ろしき蜘蛛が巣くう洞窟で転げ回れ。
items.title: Tumblebee

items.description: You play as a young woman taking a temporary evening job at a bakery on New Year's Eve. Your task is to serve a variety of customers while trying to uncover why, instead of holiday cheer, this place is shrouded in darkness...
items.description_ja: Last Bakeでは、大晦日にベーカリーで夜間販売員として働く若い女性となります。さまざまなお客様の注文を受けながら、この場所がなぜ祝祭ムードではなく不気味な闇に包まれているのかを解き明かしましょう……
items.title: Last Bake

items.description: A service industry adventure with an apocalyptic flavor. A manic genre mashup told across two broken realities. Step through the cracks: find your Exit.
items.description_ja: サービス業アドベンチャー、隠し味はアポカリプス。壊れた二つの現実が交錯するイカレたジャンル・マッシュアップ。ひび割れを踏み越え、出口を探せ。
items.title: Roman Sands RE:Build

items.description: Gospodar's Tales is a Romanian folk horror game set in 2009. Explore a rural village, uncover a dark story of greed, guilt, and betrayal, and face the consequences of a past that refuses to stay buried.
items.description_ja: Gospodar's Tales is a Romanian folk horror game set in 2009. Explore a rural village, uncover a dark story of greed, guilt, and betrayal, and face the consequences of a past that refuses to stay buried.
items.title: Gospodar's Tales

items.description: You are a British WW1 soldier, trapped in an endless looping trench. Inspect your surroundings and report anything that is out of place. Will you escape? Shellshock is a short anomaly hunting experience (-30 minutes) inspired by liminal spaces and psychological horror.
items.description_ja:
あなたは第一次世界大戦中のイギリス兵士として、果てしなくループする塹壕に閉じ込められています。
周囲を注意深く調べ、何かおかしいものがないか報告してください。
あなたは脱出できるでしょうか？Shellshockは、リミナルスペースと心理ホラーを着想源とした、短時間の異常探し体験（最大30分）です。
items.title: Shellshock

items.description: A free fishing game made by one guy who has been making fishing games since 2008. Catch 100+ weird fish for the fridge door, work your way up from an Oak Branch to the Necro-pole, win the weekly derbies, beat real players 1v1, and tune the deck radio: 4 stations, DJs and 160+ original songs.
items.description_ja: 無料の釣りゲーム。作ったのは、2008年から釣りゲームを作り続けているたった一人の男。変な魚100種類以上を冷蔵庫のドアに飾り、樫の枝からネクロポールまで竿を育て、毎週のダービーを制し、本物のプレイヤーと1対1で勝負。デッキのラジオは4局、DJ付き、オリジナル曲160曲以上だ。
items.title: Hillbilly Yacht Club: Fishing

items.description: Play as Vroombi, a brave little robo-vacuum who needs to keep Lily's house nice and clean! Clean away dust, dirt and debris in this satisfying twist on an interactive cleaning simulator. What awaits little Vroombi at night? What is Lily scared of?
items.description_ja: Play as Vroombi, a brave little robo-vacuum who needs to keep Lily's house nice and clean! Clean away dust, dirt and debris in this satisfying twist on an interactive cleaning simulator. What awaits little Vroombi at night? What is Lily scared of?
items.title: 7 Nights with Vroombi

items.description: Steal $5,000 from an abandoned apartment complex while avoiding a demented man.
items.description_ja: 廃墟となったマンションから5,000ドルを盗み出し、その際、狂った男をかわす。
items.title: The Wheelchair Man

items.description: Experience liminal horror like never before. Inspired by the Backrooms, FailRooms traps you in an endless world of absurd architecture, broken spaces, and things that should never have been built. Laugh while you can. Can you escape a place that was never designed to make sense?
items.description_ja: かつてないリミナル・ホラーを体験せよ。「The Backrooms」にインスパイアされた『FailRooms』は、不条理な建築物、崩壊した空間、そして絶対に造られるべきではなかったモノたちが無限に続く世界へとあなたを閉じ込める。笑えるうちに笑っておけ。そもそも理にかなうように設計されていないこの場所から、あなたは逃げ出すことができるだろうか？
items.title: FailRooms

items.description: Inspired by early 2010s rage games, BOOM! Buster bursts through the arcade genre with a fresh, new experience in this unrelenting hot-potato platformer.
items.description_ja: Inspired by early 2010s rage games, BOOM! Buster bursts through the arcade genre with a fresh, new experience in this unrelenting hot-potato platformer.
items.title: BOOM! Buster

items.description: A cozy horror cooking game with a deadly twist. Serve bizarre fantasy creatures and secretly eliminate targets as an assassin hiding in plain sight. Just keep an eye out for those out to get you.
items.description_ja: 致命的などんでん返しが待つ、ほっこり系ホラー料理ゲーム。奇妙なファンタジーの生き物たちに料理を振る舞いながら、人目につかないところで暗殺者として標的を密かに始末せよ。あなたを狙う者たちにも、くれぐれも気をつけて。
items.title: Chopped Up

items.description:
You are trapped in an endlessly looping indoor swimming pool. Inspect the pool carefully and look for anomalies.
If anything feels wrong, press the RED button. If everything seems normal, press the GREEN button.
Make the wrong call, and the loop continues.
items.description_ja: あなたは、終わりなくループする屋内プールに閉じ込められています。 プールを注意深く調べ、異変を見つけてください。 何かおかしいと感じたら赤いボタンを押してください。すべて正常なら緑のボタンを押してください。 判断を誤れば、ループは続きます。
items.title: POOL LOOP

items.description: Follow a recluse who is the only being left in the world as she struggles with little things in her everyday life. This game was made entirely out of scanned traditional watercolor art.
items.description_ja: Follow a recluse who is the only being left in the world as she struggles with little things in her everyday life. This game was made entirely out of scanned traditional watercolor art.
items.title: MONOPHOBIA

items.description: Build, manage, and scale your very own Bakso restaurant in this first-person simulator. Design your layout, hire and train various staffs, upgrade your gear, expand your place and satisfy every customer to become the best Bakso empire in the world!
items.description_ja: この一人称視点シミュレーターで、自分だけのバクソ（インドネシア風肉団子）レストランを建設、管理、そして発展させよう！店内をデザインし、スタッフを雇って育成し、設備をアップグレードして店舗を拡大。すべてのお客さんを満足させて、世界最高のバクソ帝国を築き上げよう！
items.title: Bakso Simulator 2

items.description: First-person psychological horror about ignorance and attempts. Protect yourself as a lone carpenter, hastily look for materials in your house to board up a door that shouldn’t exist. At any cost.
items.description_ja: 無知と試みについての、一人称視点のサイコロジカルホラー。孤独な大工として身を守り、存在するはずのないドアを塞ぐために、家の中の材料を急いで探してください。どんな犠牲を払っても。
items.title: Box of Broken Nails

items.description: Gas Station Horror is a psychological, atmospheric 20-minute horror game where all the action takes place during a single night shift at a gas station
items.description_ja: Gas Station Horror is a psychological, atmospheric 20-minute horror game where all the action takes place during a single night shift at a gas station
items.title: Gas Station Horror

items.description: Whack-A-Monster. An incremental game about Whacking, Smashing, Splashing & BONKING monsters. Upgrade through the skill tree and unlock new weapons to vanquish all evil from this world.
items.description_ja: Whack-A-Monster。モンスターを叩いて、潰して、飛び散らせて、BONKするインクリメンタルゲーム。スキルツリーで強化し、新たな武器をアンロックして、この世界の悪をすべて打ち倒そう。
items.title: Whack-A-Monster

items.description: This hilarious party brawler features iconic characters, stages, and music reimagined for a modern generation—and simplifies combat, including an all new PARTY MODE, perfect for friends new to the genre
items.description_ja: This hilarious party brawler features iconic characters, stages, and music reimagined for a modern generation—and simplifies combat, including an all new PARTY MODE, perfect for friends new to the genre
items.title: Royalty Free-For-All

items.description: Meat Train is an open world zombie survival game where you operate a train that uses MEAT for FUEL. Scavenge for weapons and loot while you explore a wasteland where everything wants you dead. Upgrade your train and attempt to destroy GRM: a rogue AI that has enslaved what's left of humanity.
items.description_ja: Meat Train is an open world zombie survival game where you operate a train that uses MEAT for FUEL. Scavenge for weapons and loot while you explore a wasteland where everything wants you dead. Upgrade your train and attempt to destroy GRM: a rogue AI that has enslaved what's left of humanity.
items.title: MEAT TRAIN

items.description: A casual companion that lives on your Windows desktop. Strike the woodfish to earn Merit, collect skins, open chests, complete collections and crafting, and play online with up to 3 Steam friends.
items.description_ja: Windowsデスクトップに常駐する癒やし系デスクトップペット。木魚を叩いて功徳をため、スキン収集、宝箱、図鑑、合成を楽しみ、最大3人のSteamフレンドとオンラインで遊べます。
items.title: Electronic Woodfish

items.description: Arcadia Cafe  - domestic horror in early 2000s. Work the night shift as a student at a roadside cafe. Meet bizarre guests, get cash for your job, but beware — homecoming may be much more horrible than you expect.
items.description_ja: Arcadia Cafe — 2000年代初頭を舞台にしたドメスティック・ホラー。学生としてロードサイドのカフェで夜勤をこなそう。奇妙な客を迎え、報酬を稼ごう。だが用心せよ。帰宅の道は、想像以上に恐ろしいものになるかもしれない。
items.title: Arcadia Cafe

items.description: Panthalassa is a Point and click Puzzle game set in an underwater alien world. You play as an AI reborn in a highly advanced body they do not recognize. Interface with otherworldly technology and unlock the secrets behind this strange planet.
items.description_ja:
Panthalassa は、水中の異星の世界を舞台にしたポイント アンド クリック ビジュアル ノベルです。
プレイヤーは AI としてプレイし、自分の体の前の持ち主の記憶を解き明かそうとします。
さまざまなユーザー インターフェイスを通じて、物理世界とデジタル世界が衝突する世界を体験します。
items.title: Panthalassa

items.description: Skibidi Wars is a fast-paced multiplayer FPS/TPS action game inspired by internet meme culture. The game pits two iconic and absurd factions against each other: the technologically advanced Cameraman and the chaotic Skibidi Toilets.
items.description_ja: Skibidi Wars は、インターネットミーム文化に触発されたペースの速いマルチプレイヤーFPS/TPSアクションゲームです。このゲームは、象徴的で不条理な2つの派閥、技術的に進歩したカメラマンと混沌としたスキビディトイレを互いに戦わせます。
items.title: Skibidi Wars

items.description: The sequel to Brother Hai's Pho Restaurant! While a manhunt unfolds elsewhere, in an unrelated development, you're a HUST student selling Banh Mi at the legendary Parabol Gate. Manage your cart and keep the sales booming!
items.description_ja: The sequel to Brother Hai's Pho Restaurant! While a manhunt unfolds elsewhere, in an unrelated development, you're a HUST student selling Banh Mi at the legendary Parabol Gate. Manage your cart and keep the sales booming!
items.title: The Hust Banhmi | Bánh Mì Bách Khoa

items.description:
Crush your friends in combat by embodying these adorable yet Gnaughty Gnomes!
Throw everything you find along the way, choose cards to upgrade your build, change the rules of the game... whatever it takes to win.
items.description_ja:
友だちと一緒にわんぱくノームが駆け回る、めまぐるしいアリーナバトルに挑もう！
目につくものを投げまくり、おかしなエフェクトやスキルでノームを強化。ゲームのルールを書き換えながら、勝利を手にしよう！
items.title: Gnaughty Gnomes

items.description: Put the ‘love’ in 'Lovecraftian horror!' When a captivating comet named Hheily crashes into your apartment, you are drawn into an interplanetary conflict between light and dark. Feed Hheily's fire to save the world in this horror-comedy visual novel… and maybe even win a smooch!
items.description_ja: ラヴクラフト風ホラーで愛を育もう！魅惑的な彗星ハレイがマンションの自室に墜落し、君は光と闇の惑星間戦争に巻き込まれてしまう。ホラーコメディービジュアルノベルでハレイに火を与え続けて世界を救え…そしてごほうびにキスをもらおう！
items.title: Sucker for Love: Crush Landing

items.description: Escape: Immersion is a cinematic 2.5D horror adventure set inside a collapsing underwater military base. Explore flooded corridors, solve environmental puzzles, evade deadly traps, and uncover your past.
items.description_ja: Escape: Immersionは、崩壊しつつある海底軍事基地を舞台にしたシネマティックな2.5Dホラーアドベンチャー。浸水した通路を探索し、環境パズルを解き、致命的な罠をかわし、自らの過去を解き明かそう。
items.title: Escape: Immersion

items.description: POTENTIAL MAN is a role-playing experience where you must navigate the whims and woes of a humble seed. This wacky story features fully hand-drawn visuals, zany characters, and a classic JRPG-styled soundtrack to boot. Are you ready to achieve your true potential?
items.description_ja: POTENTIAL MAN is a role-playing experience where you must navigate the whims and woes of a humble seed. This wacky story features fully hand-drawn visuals, zany characters, and a classic JRPG-styled soundtrack to boot. Are you ready to achieve your true potential?
items.title: POTENTIAL MAN

items.description: Your neighbor invites you on a double date, setting you up with the new girl from out of town. After sneaking into an abandoned house, your neighbor suggests everyone play a game, 67 Minutes in Heaven.
items.description_ja: Your neighbor invites you on a double date, setting you up with the new girl from out of town. After sneaking into an abandoned house, your neighbor suggests everyone play a game, 67 Minutes in Heaven.
items.title: 67 Minutes in Heaven

items.description: An RPG set in a distant, lonely future. Follow Arem, a young man lured from his small island community to explore the desolate megastructure beneath it: “The Well.” With the simple goal of finding the exit, Arem will burden himself with something more terrible than he ever thought possible.
items.description_ja: An RPG set in a distant, lonely future. Follow Arem, a young man lured from his small island community to explore the desolate megastructure beneath it: “The Well.” With the simple goal of finding the exit, Arem will burden himself with something more terrible than he ever thought possible.
items.title: A Song Of Sunlight

items.description: Simple controls, premium gameplay! Blueblood Arena features a variety of characters with wildly different playstyles, with a free-flowing combo structure where anything is possible!
items.description_ja: Simple controls, premium gameplay! Blueblood Arena features a variety of characters with wildly different playstyles, with a free-flowing combo structure where anything is possible!
items.title: Blueblood Arena

items.author: nomnomnami
items.description: senbei is my april fool...
items.title: Date Senbei

items.description: A squirmy, bouncy shooter filled with lovely sights and horrible places. Careen across the planet, blast yourself to new heights, and discover the dark tunnels and deep places of a world beneath our own.
items.description_ja: 低レベルのアメリカを舞台にした、高速モードガン風ゲーム。ゴブリンの大統領を憑依させ、イエロー・サンの美しいメダルを獲得し、鮮やかな人生の色彩に身を任せよう。
items.title: goblinAmerica

items.description: Who Do Voodoo is a multiplayer party game of real-time combat and social deduction for up to 16 players. Collect and craft cards, cast spells to deal damage and defeat opponents, or deceive your friends using proximity voice chat.
items.description_ja: Who Do Voodooは、リアルタイムバトルと正体隠匿を楽しめる、最大16人のマルチプレイヤーパーティーゲームです。カードを集めてクラフトし、呪文でダメージを与えて敵を倒すか、近接ボイスチャットで友達を欺きましょう。
items.title: Who Do Voodoo

items.description: MoonMiners is a cooperative survival simulator of miners in space, in an alternative dystopian future. You take on the role of space miners working for an evil corporation far from home, and it will be much easier for you to die than to do your job.
items.description_ja: MoonMinersは、ディストピア的な未来を舞台にした、宇宙で働く鉱夫たちの協力型サバイバル・シミュレーターです。あなたは故郷から遠く離れた悪の企業のために働く宇宙鉱夫となり、仕事をするよりも死ぬ方がずっと簡単です。
items.title: MoonMiners

items.description: Plinko-style INCREMENTAL game. Shoot gumballs at gears and buy upgrades to make bigger and bigger numbers until you break the game! Short, sweet, relaxing, and addictive!
items.description_ja: ピンボール風放置ゲーム！ガムボールをギアに撃ち込み、アップグレードを購入してどんどん資産が増えまくる。ついにゲームの限界を突破せよ！短くて濃密、リラックスできてついハマってしまう作品です！
items.title: Idle Gumball Machine

items.description: Sudokiller is a cozy mystery puzzle game where you place suspects on a sudoku-style grid to unmask a killer hiding in plain sight. Every guest leaves a clue pinning down where they stood at the time of the murder. Deduce your way through case after case in this cozy, cleverly deceptive mystery.
items.description_ja: Sudokillerは、数独風のグリッドに容疑者を配置して、すぐそばに潜む殺人犯の正体を暴く、ほっこりミステリーパズルゲームです。客たちはそれぞれ、事件の瞬間にどこにいたかを示す手がかりを残します。ほっこりしつつも巧妙に欺かれるミステリーで、事件を次々と推理しましょう。
items.title: Sudokiller

items.description: A Lovecraftian investigative gamebook. New York, 1927. A case pulled from real history, wrapped in cosmic horror. His name was Billy Gaffney. The man who took him was real. But his purpose was from another plane of existence. You play a journalist. You make choices. The story remembers all of them.
items.description_ja: A Lovecraftian investigative gamebook. New York, 1927. A case pulled from real history, wrapped in cosmic horror. His name was Billy Gaffney. The man who took him was real. But his purpose was from another plane of existence. You play a journalist. You make choices. The story remembers all of them.
items.title: Omen Exitio: Hunger

items.description: Haunt a suit of armour. Explore an abandoned castle. Recover your memories... and bring the ghosts of the past to rest in this melancholy visual novel about love, family and regret.
items.description_ja: Haunt a suit of armour. Explore an abandoned castle. Recover your memories... and bring the ghosts of the past to rest in this melancholy visual novel about love, family and regret.
items.title: The Last Winter Knight

items.description: Witchblood is a first-person psychological horror game that draws you into the heart of a dark curse. Explore a decaying house where reality begins to unravel. Uncover the truth behind a forgotten family’s tragedy and face what should have remained buried.
items.description_ja: Witchbloodは、あなたを呪いの核心へと引き込む、一人称視点のサイコロジカルホラーゲームです。現実が徐々に崩壊していく朽ち果てた屋敷を探索しましょう。忘れ去られた家族の悲劇に隠された真実を明らかにし、本来なら埋められたままであるべきだったものと向き合うことになります。
items.title: Witchblood

items.description: STICKER/BALL is a pool game roguelike from the future. Fire balls. Hit dice. Earn points. Add stickers. Trigger crazy combos. Enjoy the chaos, it’s on purpose.
items.description_ja: 「ステッカー/ボール」は、未来からやってきたビリヤード風ローグライクゲーム。ボールを放ち、ダイスに当て、ポイントを稼ぎ、ステッカーを追加し、ド派手なコンボを決めよう。そして、意図的に仕組まれたカオスを楽しもう。
items.title: STICKER/BALL

items.description: Draw your robot, play as your drawing! Face your friends in Scribble Bots, a 2D, physics based sandbox party game. Will your robot be a mechanical masterpiece, or a dysfunctional abomination?
items.description_ja: Draw your robot, play as your drawing! Face your friends in Scribble Bots, a 2D, physics based sandbox party game. Will your robot be a mechanical masterpiece, or a dysfunctional abomination?
items.title: Scribble Bots

items.description: Smash and thrash the mysterious Forever Chicken, a living ragdoll at the heart of a frightful Midnight Carnival. Uncle Tontine insists you can leave whenever you desire, yet no child has ever gone home. Will you be the first?
items.description_ja: Smash and thrash the mysterious Forever Chicken, a living ragdoll at the heart of a frightful Midnight Carnival. Uncle Tontine insists you can leave whenever you desire, yet no child has ever gone home. Will you be the first?
items.title: Crawling Angels

items.description: Sit back and relax with Neko Station, a cozy 2D Pixel Art Desktop Idle Game! Manage your very own 'cat train,' decorating it with the perfect furniture to attract a diverse cast of feline customers. Pick them up at various stations and build friendships in this heartwarming adventure.
items.description_ja: いやしの放置型２Dゲーム、「ネコの車掌さん」でまったりと電車の旅に出かけませんか？自分だけの「ネコちゃん電車」を好きな家具や飾りで装飾して様々なネコちゃんのお客様を迎えましょう。停車先の駅では新しい出会いと絆が待っています。
items.title: Neko Station

items.description: 『Who's Next?』  is a free-for-all Tail Tag social deduction game set in the traditional Korean hell, featuring a massacre of ghosts and spirits, with individual survival competition rather than team battles,.
items.description_ja: 『Who's Next?』 は個人戦のソーシャルディダクションゲームです。卑劣な手を使って最後まで生き残り、転生を手に入れるのです！ ここでは過程はどうでもいいんです。生き残ったら勝です。全プレイヤーは狙う向きで円を描くように繋がっています。順番に全ての獲物を殺し、最後の一人になれば勝利です！
items.title: Who's Next?

items.description: DIG Raiders is a co-op game about blasting underground in search of aliens. Deep in debt, you've taken on a mysterious dig site. Team up, blow a path below, explore, find aliens, and put them to work in your alien shopping district—or ditch the job and start an all-out brawl with your friends!
items.description_ja: DIG Raidersは、爆弾で地表をぶち抜き、宇宙人を探し出す協力マルチゲーム。借金して謎の遺跡を請け負ったあなたは、仲間と地下への道を爆破し、探索して宇宙人を発見。彼らを働かせてエイリアン商店街を経営しよう。あるいは仕事を放り出して、仲間と大乱闘！
items.title: DIG Raiders: Anomaly Extraction

items.description: Check license plates, handle incidents, and keep working your shift while an unauthorized visitor keeps insisting on getting into the lot. What starts as a dull routine turns into an increasingly terrifying night
items.description_ja: Check license plates, handle incidents, and keep working your shift while an unauthorized visitor keeps insisting on getting into the lot. What starts as a dull routine turns into an increasingly terrifying night
items.title: Night Guard - The Last Shift

items.description: Where will the trail lead you? Join your new friend Tendou on a hiking date and find out in this short and sweet fully voice-acted Visual Novel!
items.description_ja: この道は、どこへ続くのだろう? 新しい友だち天道とのハイキングデートで、その答えを確かめに行こう。短くて甘い、フルボイスのビジュアルノベル!
items.title: Nature Hike

items.description:
Love or Money? Or destroy them both?
No Love No Money is a comedy visual novel that starts as a school dating sim and ends with a socialist revolution.
Or maybe not.
items.description_ja:
Love or Money? Or destroy them both?
No Love No Money is a comedy visual novel that starts as a school dating sim and ends with a socialist revolution.
Or maybe not.
items.title: No Love No Money

items.description: "Parking Together!" is a chaotic co-op "parking" game! Navigate non-stop hazards to deliver a car to the goal that explodes instantly on impact... Work with your partner to overcome obstacles, clear stages, and conquer the Time Attack!
items.description_ja:
「Parking Together! 」はカオスな協力"駐車"ゲーム！
次々起こるハプニングを乗り越え、「ぶつけたら即爆発」してしまう車を協力してゴールまで届けなくてはなりません...
仲間と共に障害を乗り越え、ステージをクリアし、タイムアタックを制覇しよう！
items.title: Parking Together!

items.description:
Buy, Decorate, Rent, Relax.
Start with a tiny apartment, decorate cozy spaces, manage rentals and businesses, and rise from a poor neighborhood to the city’s most prestigious zones.
A calming yet deep management experience where every room tells a story.
items.description_ja: のんびり気ままなゲストハウスオーナーになろう！部屋を自由にコーディネートし、お客さんの日常をのぞいてみよう。家賃を設定して収支を管理し、新しいゲストハウスを購入したり、レストランやテーマパークを開いたりして、部屋づくりと経営の両方を楽しもう。自分だけの理想の暮らしを気軽に実現しよう！
items.title: Dearbnb

items.description: Navigate love, friendship, art, and mental horror to find meaning in a dying world.  A visual novel.
items.description_ja: Navigate love, friendship, art, and mental horror to find meaning in a dying world.  A visual novel.
items.title: Autumn's end (Part 1)

items.description: Heavy Metal Death Can is an Old-School Survival Horror game set on a Swedish Cold War–era submarine. Trapped beneath the ocean, you must fight against the terrifying Sludge which has turned your crew into Zombies. Look for survivors and uncover the truth behind the madness.
items.description_ja: Heavy Metal Death Can は、1970年代後半のスウェーデンを舞台にした、レトロ風のサバイバルホラーゲームです。海底に閉じ込められたあなたは、乗組員をゾンビに変えた恐ろしい「スラッジ」と戦わなければなりません。生存者を探し、狂気の真相を突き止めましょう。
items.title: Heavy Metal Death Can

items.description: A cinematic, story-driven horror set in 1999 Ohio. Work the night shift at a remote gas station. A mysterious briefcase from the lake. Stolen uranium fuel. A blood-covered coworker.
items.description_ja: 1999年のオハイオ州を舞台にした、映画のような演出で描くストーリー重視のエイリアンホラー。人里離れたガソリンスタンドで夜勤をする。湖から引き上げられた謎のブリーフケース。盗まれたウラン燃料。血まみれの同僚。
items.title: [HERROR] Gas Station Case

items.description: A slacker stick figure named Bota moves onto your desktop. An idle app where you sneak peeks between tasks as he idly mutters to himself to match the time of day and the day of the week. He won't get in your way. Sometimes he talks to you. That's the whole app.
items.description_ja: あなたのデスクトップに、さぼり魔の棒人間「ぼう太」が住み着く。時間帯や曜日に合わせてゆるく独り言をこぼすのを、作業の合間にそっと覗き見る放置アプリ。じゃまはしてこない。たまに話しかけてくる。それだけのアプリ。

evidence.excerpt: Anyone is free to stream this game or post videos of it, monetized or not.

items.title: Sill Sticks

items.description: Yuki leads an ordinary life, weighed down by debt, surrounded by a few friends, and consumed by poems shared with no one. Until the arrival of a transfer student. Because some presences cannot be resisted. Only surrender is possible.
items.description_ja: ユウキは、借金の重荷、わずかな友人、そして誰にも見せない詩と共に、ありふれた日々を送っていた。あの転校生が教室に現れるまでは。抗えない存在がある。ただ、ひれ伏すことしかできないのだ。
items.title: Highschool J

items.description: Soviet Backrooms is a first-person survival horror set in abandoned Soviet apartment blocks. Explore decaying apartments, stairwells, and endless corridors, search for a way out, and listen for the footsteps of something you cannot see.
items.description_ja: Soviet Backroomsは、廃墟と化したソ連時代の集合住宅を舞台にした一人称視点のサバイバルホラー。荒れ果てた部屋や階段、果てしない廊下を探索して出口を探し、姿の見えない何者かの足音に耳を澄ませよう。
items.title: Soviet Backrooms

items.description: Welcome to Bob Company! Fill orders, haul goods, and make work easier with automation. Rise from Intern to Director in a relaxing first-person warehouse sim. Each promotion opens new areas of the company and reveals more of the stories behind it.
items.description_ja: ボブ社へようこそ！注文を確認し、荷物を運び、自動化設備で仕事を少しずつ楽にしましょう。インターンからディレクターへと成長する、ゆったり遊べる一人称倉庫シミュレーター。昇進するほど、会社の新しいエリアと、その裏に隠れた物語が見えてきます。
items.title: BOB LOGISTICS

items.description: First-person horror metroidvania about fisting your way through a prison island crawling with cybernetic monstrosities. Explore, evolve, escape. Inspired by Tetsuo: The Iron Man.
items.description_ja: サイバネティックな怪物がひしめく監獄島を、拳で殴り抜ける一人称ホラーメトロイドヴァニア。探索し、変異し、脱出せよ。『鉄男』にインスパイアされた作品。
items.title: Voltage High Society

items.description:
Test your sixth sense.
Will you eat a wild rabbit, or tie someone to the train tracks?
Every choice is yours to make.
May you find a reason to laugh inside your nightmares.
items.description_ja:
あなたの第六感を試してみてください。
野ウサギを食べるか、それとも人を線路に縛りつけるか…。
すべてはあなたの選択次第。
悪夢の中で笑えることを願っています。
items.title: a Dogs Dream

items.description: A prince who has lost his kingdom and everything else. His uncle and aide-de-camp, unable to leave him. In a cramped rented room abroad, click on objects and piece together a codependent relationship filled with brutality and endurance. Watch helplessness turn into violence, tenderness into torture.
items.description_ja:
すべてを失った亡国の王子。彼を見捨てられない、叔父であり副官でもある男。異国の部屋でオブジェクトをクリックしながら、二人の共依存の記憶を追う。
無力さが暴力に、愛情が拷問に変わっていく様子を見る。

evidence.excerpt: FREE TO STREAM
Feel free to stream, upload, and post about the full game!

items.title: Dissolution of My Self

items.description:
An urban legend says there are alligators living in the sewers of New York.
Go down there… and see for yourself. A 90s-style comedy horror game featuring classic single-voice VHS dubbing.
items.description_ja:
An urban legend says there are alligators living in the sewers of New York.
Go down there… and see for yourself. A 90s-style comedy horror game featuring classic single-voice VHS dubbing.
items.title: Crococo

items.description: A 4-player co-op horror comedy where you drop in as couriers delivering packages in a dystopian world ruled by grotesque monsters. You share 99 lives - deliver, don’t die, and make it count!
items.description_ja: 最大4人でプレイ可能な協力型ホラーコメディ。異形のモンスターが支配するディストピアで、配達員として荷物を届けろ。共有される命は99。荷物を届け、死を回避し、その命を無駄にするな！
items.title: Panic Delivery

items.description:
A 1–4 player co-op horror game.
Cleanse cursed lands, perform forbidden rituals, and survive a spreading plague.
Fear is not scripted. It emerges from your choices, your mistakes, and your team.
items.description_ja:
Devil of the Plague は1〜4人でプレイできる協力型ホラー体験です。
呪われた土地を浄化し、禁断の儀式を行い、広がる疫病の中で生き延びましょう。
恐怖は脚本によって作られるものではなく、あなたの選択、あなたのミス、そしてチームから生まれます。
items.title: Devil of the Plague

items.description: A horror roguelike bento-builder. You're trapped in an underground kitchen, forced to feed a half-chef monster. Gamble with your life, assemble meals, and master your multipliers. Whatever you do, Don't Let it Starve.
items.description_ja: 恐怖のローグライク"ベントウ"ビルダー。地下室のキッチンに閉じ込められたあなたは、シェフのモンスターに料理を与え続けなければならない。自らの命を賭けて、食材を組み合わせて、乗数の与えてくれるうまみを生かそう。どんな手を使っても、"絶対に奴を空腹にするな"。
items.title: Don't Let It Starve

items.description: Dive into a sunny beach in this cozy hidden object game! Rotate the endless scene, watch funny elves go about their day, and find over 130 hidden objects to the soothing beats of a lo-fi soundtrack. The perfect way to unwind and relax!
items.description_ja: 居心地よい隠しアイテム探しゲームで、陽光あふれるビーチへ飛び込もう！エンドレスに回転するシーンを眺め、愉快なエルフたちの日常を見守りながら、130以上の隠されたアイテムをlo-fiサウンドトラックに癒されつつ探し出そう。のんびりくつろぐのにぴったりのゲームです！
items.title: Hidden Things Beach Elves

items.description: The printer is bleeding, the Wi-Fi is haunted, and Ticket #666 just came in. As the latest hire for a company run by cosmic horrors, your job is simple: Swipe to survive. Make binary decisions to survive the night shift in this dark comedy desktop simulator. I.T truly never ends.
items.description_ja: The printer is bleeding, the Wi-Fi is haunted, and Ticket #666 just came in. As the latest hire for a company run by cosmic horrors, your job is simple: Swipe to survive. Make binary decisions to survive the night shift in this dark comedy desktop simulator. I.T truly never ends.
items.title: I.T. Never Ends

items.description: A multiplayer social deduction horror where spells are spoken aloud. One of you is altered. Cast magic with your voice, hunt the traitor, survive the ritual. Every word can save - or kill.
items.description_ja: 呪文を声に出して唱える、マルチプレイヤーホラー推理ゲーム。仲間の一人は憑かれている。声で魔法を放ち、裏切り者を暴き、儀式を生き延びろ。その一言が、命取りになるかもしれない。
items.title: Alterum

items.description: Explore, loot, and rush back to defend your ship against alien hordes. Solo or 4-player coop, grow stronger run after run in this frantic action roguelite with a touch of tower defense.
items.description_ja: 探索し、略奪し、急いで戻ってエイリアンの大群から自分の船を守れ。ソロまたは最大4人の協力プレイで、プレイを重ねるごとに強くなる、タワーディフェンス要素を取り入れたハイテンポなアクションローグライト。
items.title: Kritter: Defend Together

items.description: Bonnie Bear Saves Frogtime is a frog-obsessed comedy adventure featuring tactical frog battles, bizarre quests, and the mother of all frogs: the motherfrogger.
items.description_ja:
『ボニーベア セイブズ フロッグタイム』 (Bonnie Bear Saves Frogtime)はカエルだらけのコミカルなアドベンチャーゲーム。
タクティカルなカエルバトル、奇妙なクエスト、そしてすべてのカエルの母である「マザーフロッガー」が登場！
items.title: Bonnie Bear Saves Frogtime

items.description: You're the world's softest criminals in an island prison with mandatory nap rooms. Your escape plan? Eat bread, poop until the gates open, and pee on the robots chasing you. Break out with three friends, or play the robots tucking them back in. A wacky 4v2 prison break in quick 10-minute matches.
items.description_ja: 【Ver.2.0大型アップデート配信中！】かわいい見た目で超カオス！動物と看守ロボットに分かれて戦う4対2の非対称アクションパーティーゲーム。新ステージ3つ、新キャラクター4体、一発逆転のスペシャルアイテムが登場！動物は「うんぴ」や「おぴっこ」、個性豊かなスキルを駆使して脱獄！ロボットはカスタマイズしたパーツとガジェットで捕まえよう！シンプル操作で誰でも楽しめて、極めるほどに笑える――世界初(!?)の排泄型脱出アクションパーティーゲーム、さらに進化！
items.title: PRITTO PRISONER

items.description: A literary horror adventure made in RPG Maker MV, where you explore a land of endless rain and continue a lonely journey through fleeting encounters with ghosts. Rain-soaked landscapes and quiet conversations shape a desolate, melancholic road ahead.
items.description_ja: 雨の止まない大地を探索し、各地で出会う亡霊たちとの会話を通して物語を進める、探索と対話中心の幻想文学的ホラーアドベンチャー。RPGツクールMV製。
items.title: Land of Ghosts

items.description: Score goals with dungballs in Beetleball, the Greatest Online Multiplayer Class-based Dung Beetle Soccer Game TO EVER EXIST
items.description_ja: 史上最高のオンラインマルチプレイヤー・クラス制・糞虫サッカーゲームのビートルボールで糞玉のゴールを決めましょう
items.title: Beetleball

items.description: Gamble with your life in this explosive PvP game for 2-4 players. Cut wires, earn cash, use abilities and avoid the detonators. Test your luck, skills and remember to always bet on the boom!
items.description_ja: Gamble with your life in this explosive PvP game for 2-4 players. Cut wires, earn cash, use abilities and avoid the detonators. Test your luck, skills and remember to always bet on the boom!
items.title: Explosive Odds

items.description: Paint the bunny man and blend into the scene like a chameleon! 2–10 player online hide-and-seek. Sample colors, match the lighting, tune your materials — disguise yourself to perfection and slip away right under the Hunters' gaze.
items.description_ja: バニーマンに色をぬって、カメレオンみたいに風景にとけこもう！2〜10人のオンラインかくれんぼ。色をひろい、光を合わせ、マテリアルを調整して、完璧に化けきる——ハンターの視線をかいくぐり、生きのびろ。
items.title: SCRIBBLE HUNT

items.description: 【A Girl A Rain】is a short visual novel.After pushing open the door, or perhaps before, the world has transformed. Will you be able to escape this rainstorm? Or will you stay...?
items.description_ja:
雨の少女】は、2万語を超える重複のないテキストで構成された短編ビジュアルノベルです。
扉を押し開けた後、あるいはその前に、世界は完全に様変わりしていました。
彼女は無事に脱出できるのでしょうか？それとも、すべては無駄な試みの連続なのでしょうか…？
items.title: A Girl A Rain

items.description:
Sit tight: a coronation for the annals of the Hao realm. I’m Jiahao, your desktop pet—its absolute strongest, stock investing’s uncrowned king and fashion’s highest peak. What has this loneliness taught you to love?

“You misunderstand. Let me enlighten you.”
“You are the challenger.”
items.description_ja:
まったく、しょうがないな。座って。これは豪界の歴史に刻まれる戴冠だ。君のデスクトップペット、嘉豪。豪界の絶対的強者、株式投資界の無冠の王、ファッション界の最高峰。そこから生まれた孤独は、君に何を愛せと教えた？

「何か勘違いしているようだから、一応教えておこう」
「挑戦者は君のほうだ。」
items.title: Jiahao

items.description: Play solo or with up to 16 friends in a chaotic grocery store showdown! Manage, grow, and compete against rival stores in a fun, lighthearted battle of wits and strategy. Who will be the ultimate grocery tycoon? Sabotage, upgrade, and outwit your friends in this unpredictable simulator!
items.description_ja: ソロまたは最大16人の友達と一緒に、混乱したスーパーマーケットの対決を楽しもう！管理、成長、そしてライバル店舗と競い合う、ユーモアと戦略が詰まった楽しいバトル。誰が究極のスーパー大富豪になるのか？妨害、アップグレード、そして友達を出し抜こう！予測不可能なこのシミュレーターで勝利を掴もう！
items.title: Store Wars: Multiplayer Shop Simulator

items.description: Membrillo Hid My Socks is a silly point & click hidden object game about finding your missing socks after your mischievous cat went on a rampage.
items.description_ja: Membrillo Hid My Socks is a silly point & click hidden object game about finding your missing socks after your mischievous cat went on a rampage.
items.title: Membrillo Hid My Socks

items.description: A self abating husk is forcibly coerced into a suicide pact by a "perfect" girl drowning in ennui and despair. The result is unfathomable heart rending terror and confusion.
items.description_ja: A self abating husk is forcibly coerced into a suicide pact by a "perfect" girl drowning in ennui and despair. The result is unfathomable heart rending terror and confusion.
items.title: PASSENGER x PRINCESS: NO HOPE // MUST DIE

items.description: Help this girlfailure witch save her failing potion shop in this cute yuri visual novel!
items.description_ja: Help this girlfailure witch save her failing potion shop in this cute yuri visual novel!
items.title: Witch You Want

items.description: John is a detective searching for a missing colleague. He finds himself trapped in a mysterious loop where reality constantly changes. Explore eerie environments, interact with clues, and uncover the truth behind the disappearance in this third-person psychological horror experience.
items.description_ja: John is a detective searching for a missing colleague. He finds himself trapped in a mysterious loop where reality constantly changes. Explore eerie environments, interact with clues, and uncover the truth behind the disappearance in this third-person psychological horror experience.
items.title: The Lure

items.description: JJBoom is a pixel platformer for 2–4 players (local/online). Use gamepad or keyboard! 16+ free levels with spikes, traps—and your kids—to keep you on your toes!
items.description_ja: A party game that makes you laugh out loud, in the local or online games, raise everything up, throw them out, use your wisdom to blow your enemies up!
items.title: JJBoom

items.author: objetdiscret
items.description: Nonogram Exploration Adventure
items.title: Taiyaki Fabulous Test Kitchen

items.description: Dumb Ways to Build is a chaotic, physics-based co-op game. Team up with friends to assemble your crew and take-on dangerous construction jobs. With all the gear and no idea, work together to build your path forward, or die trying!
items.description_ja: 『Dumb Ways to Build』は、物理演算ベースのドタバタ協力型建築ゲーム。フレンドと協力してチームを組み、危険な建設仕事を引き受けろ。装備が一人前なだけのド素人でも、力を合わせて道を切り拓こう。さもなくば挑戦して死ぬのみ！
items.title: Dumb Ways to Build

items.description: Penguin Lifter is a game where you work as a penguin lifter. You'll work outdoors, far from civilization, surrounded by cute creatures - penguins. It's just you, the snow, and the penguins...
items.description_ja: ペンギンリフターは、ペンギンリフターとして働くゲームです。文明から遠く離れた屋外で、可愛らしい生き物たち、つまりペンギンたちに囲まれて働きます。そこにあるのは、あなたと雪とペンギンたちだけです…。
items.title: Penguin Lifter

items.description:
"Lost your halo? Report to Hell!"
Demoted from a cushy Heaven desk job to field duty in Hell, your fight for clock-out times and benefits begins! Build custom decks with opinionated office supplies, smash demon skulls, and loot your halo back. Welcome to Hell—no mercy, no overtime pay!
items.description_ja:
「ヘイロー喪失？なら地獄へ出勤してください」
新感覚のリアルタイム1人称デッキ構築カードシューター！うっかりミスで天国の快適部署から地獄の現場職へ強制異動！定時退社と福利厚生を取り戻すため、主張が激しい文房具でデッキを組み、悪魔の頭をぶち割りヘイローを奪い返せ！ここは慈悲も残業代も出ない地獄です！
items.title: Hell o’ Halo

items.description: Take a worm on a tiny adventure through this delightfully wiggly physics platformer :)
items.description_ja: Take a worm on a tiny adventure through this delightfully wiggly physics platformer :)
items.title: Wirm

items.description: Save people from terrible paranormal dangers as a support operator of a secret SCP-like organization! Ask questions, give advice and watch the consequences of your choices... multiple endings in each story ;-)
items.description_ja: Save people from terrible paranormal dangers as a support operator of a secret SCP-like organization! Ask questions, give advice and watch the consequences of your choices... multiple endings in each story ;-)
items.title: Creepy Support

items.description: King's Lynn Leisure Farm is a farm idle game with racing driver theme. Here, you can collect a variety of cute animals, play with them, feed them, and send them out to work. You can also collect various vehicles to decorate your farm. Enjoy your time on the farm with your little animal friends!
items.description_ja: King's Lynn Leisure Farm is a farm idle game with racing driver theme. Here, you can collect a variety of cute animals, play with them, feed them, and send them out to work. You can also collect various vehicles to decorate your farm. Enjoy your time on the farm with your little animal friends!
items.title: King's Lynn Leisure Farm

items.description: Meet Henry, merely half a head, yet with the peculiar ability to become any object within their reach! Discover every object’s unique abilities and cleverly combine them to take Henry through their not-so-ordinary everyday life.
items.description_ja: ハーフヘッドのヘンリーと出会おう。触れたらどんなものにも変身できる特別な力を持っている！あらゆるオブジェクトのユニークな力を引き出し、頭を使って組み合わせて、ヘンリーを日常からかけ離れた冒険に連れ出そう。
items.title: Henry Halfhead

items.description: Experience (mildly) accurate historical battles from the Napoleonic era, but from the perspective of DUCKS! Duckoleon is a multiplayer FPS/TPS with strategic elements. Exciting combat with units ranging from line infantry to cavalry and artillery, historical uniforms, cute ducks and much more!
items.description_ja: Experience (mildly) accurate historical battles from the Napoleonic era, but from the perspective of DUCKS! Duckoleon is a multiplayer FPS/TPS with strategic elements. Exciting combat with units ranging from line infantry to cavalry and artillery, historical uniforms, cute ducks and much more!
items.title: Duckoleon

items.description: Lawns are wild. Parks are buried in weeds. Streets are littered. The world needs a hero, and that’s where you come in. As the Landscaper, it’s your job to turn disorder into beauty. With your weed whacker, pressure washer, and trash vacuum, you’ll trim, wash, and restore every space to perfection.
items.description_ja: 芝生は伸び放題、公園は雑草だらけ、街はゴミであふれています。世界にはヒーローが必要ですそれがあなたです。ランドスケーパーとして草刈り機や高圧洗浄機、ゴミ吸引機を使い、空間を整え、清掃し、見違えるほど美しくよみがえらせましょう。
items.title: Landscaper Simulator

items.author: sheepolution
items.description: Screw with letters from carrier pigeons to annoy the kings
items.title: Troll the King

items.description: An FMV Choose-Your-Own-Adventure that'll leave you wanting to like and subscribe!
items.description_ja: An FMV Choose-Your-Own-Adventure that'll leave you wanting to like and subscribe!
items.title: Apology Video

items.description: Save the world with breakbeats.
items.description_ja: ブレイクビーツが、世界を救う。
items.title: BrebeMan

items.description: "771: Smile and work" is a first-person psychological horror game. An office. A night shift. Orders from your boss. What could go wrong?
items.description_ja: 『771: Smile and work』は、一人称視点の心理ホラーゲームです。オフィス。夜勤。上司からの指示。一体何が起こるというのでしょうか？
items.title: 771: Smile and work

items.description: Sneak through sunlit villages as a clumsy vampire. Move the sun with a fairy's help to cast shadows, then spare or devour the villagers.
items.description_ja: Sneak through sunlit villages as a clumsy vampire. Move the sun with a fairy's help to cast shadows, then spare or devour the villagers.
items.title: Vampy's Big Day

items.description: At soccer camp, a teacher tells two unsettling tales: a strange presence in the mountains and a body bundled in a sheet by the sea. They should be mere ghost stories—but something feels wrong. A short psychological horror visual novel, lasting about an hour.
items.description_ja:
サッカー部の合宿の日の夜。先生が語り始めたのは、山と海で起きた2つの不可解な体験談だった。
「山中で遭遇した異様な存在」「シートに詰められた遺体」
ただの怪談のはずが、語られる記憶の中には奇妙な「違和感」が潜んでいて——。
約1時間で濃厚な恐怖を味わえる、短編サイコロジカルホラーノベル。

evidence.excerpt: You are welcome to stream or record the entire game, including monetized videos and broadcasts.

items.title: Kyofu Yawa: Scary Stories at Night

items.description:
Short visual novel.
An all-too-familiar story, born from an all-too-familiar motive, on an all-too-familiar street.
items.description_ja:
短編ビジュアルノベル。
ありふれた目的を胸に、ありふれた街で起こる、ありふれた物語。
items.title: How Much for the Body in the Freezer

items.description: Big E’s back in action! Working the farm over Summer is never easy - but everyone knows you’re the best. Do your utmost to keep the product moving, the customers happy and the law at bay, and everything’ll turn out great!
items.description_ja: Big E’s back in action! Working the farm over Summer is never easy - but everyone knows you’re the best. Do your utmost to keep the product moving, the customers happy and the law at bay, and everything’ll turn out great!
items.title: Jeffrey Eggstein

items.description: What the Buck?! is a satisfying incremental game about destroying money. Shred stacks of cash, set off chain reactions across the table, prestige for permanent upgrades and automate your money destruction. Your demo progress carries over to the full game.
items.description_ja: 『What the Buck?!』は、お金を破壊する爽快なインクリメンタルゲーム。札束を裁断し、テーブル中に連鎖反応を巻き起こし、プレステージで永続的なアップグレードを手に入れ、お金の破壊を自動化しよう。体験版の進行状況を製品版に引き継ぎ可能。
items.title: What the Buck?!

items.description: Explore the moon of a gas giant with a bush plane. Do deliveries and challenges to unlock upgrades and more aircraft.
items.description_ja: Explore the moon of a gas giant with a bush plane. Do deliveries and challenges to unlock upgrades and more aircraft.
items.title: Bush 1022

items.description: You lost your coal mine job, now you're a cashier at Poland's landmark convenience store. Scan groceries, verify IDs, grill hot dogs, and try to feed your family on what's left. A dark comedy about surviving late stage capitalism, one receipt at a time.
items.description_ja: 炭鉱の仕事を失った。今はポーランドの伝説的コンビニのレジ係。商品をスキャンし、身分証を確認し、ホットドッグを焼き、残りで家族を養う。後期資本主義を生き抜くブラックコメディ。
items.title: Which Sausage, Mate?

items.description: Ecstatica is a pioneering survival-horror adventure set in the demon-cursed medieval village of Tirich. Explore a world rendered entirely from ellipsoids, sneak past or fight off nightmarish creatures, solve puzzles, and lift the curse.
items.description_ja: 『Ecstatica』は悪魔に呪われた中世の村ティリッヒを舞台とするサバイバルホラーゲームのパイオニアだ。全てが楕円体で表現されたワールドを探索し、悪夢のような怪物たちをやり過ごすか戦い、パズルを解き、呪いを打ち消そう。
items.title: Ecstatica

items.description: Three ghost stories, told in an old café on a rainy night. As a writer for an occult magazine, you listen to three people recount their experiences. Text and sound slowly build the dread in the psychological horror visual novel Kyofu Yawa: Second Night.
items.description_ja: 雨の夜、古びた純喫茶で語られる三つの怪談――。オカルト雑誌のライターである「あなた」は、三人の体験者の語りに耳を傾ける。テキストと音でじわじわと恐怖を積み重ねる、サイコロジカルホラーノベル『恐怖夜話 第二夜』。

evidence.excerpt: You are welcome to stream or record the entire game, including monetized videos and streams.

items.title: Kyofu Yawa: Second Night

items.description: Fling yourself up to the top in this “Getting Over It”-like 3D platformer! Stick your pole to walls, bend it and fling yourself with great speed! One mistake means falling all the way down. Can you reach the summit in under 2 hours and EARN that refund?!
items.description_ja: Fling yourself up to the top in this “Getting Over It”-like 3D platformer! Stick your pole to walls, bend it and fling yourself with great speed! One mistake means falling all the way down. Can you reach the summit in under 2 hours and EARN that refund?!
items.title: Refund This Game

items.description: Eradicate hordes of monsters in this survivors style roguelite set in a rotting, destructible city that hates you. Start fires, blow stuff up, electrify water, you name it. Upgrade & craft an arsenal of oddball weapons including pigeons riding boots. Unlock & upgrade offbeat characters & SURVIVE!
items.description_ja: Eradicate hordes of monsters in this survivors style roguelite set in a rotting, destructible city that hates you. Start fires, blow stuff up, electrify water, you name it. Upgrade & craft an arsenal of oddball weapons including pigeons riding boots. Unlock & upgrade offbeat characters & SURVIVE!
items.title: Beatdown City Survivors

items.description: Spider Roulette is a tense online party game where 2-4 friends take turns flipping cups, trying to avoid finding each other's spiders..
items.description_ja: スパイダー ルーレットは、2 ～ 4 人の友達が交互にカップをひっくり返し、お互いのスパイダーを見つけないようにする、緊張感のあるオンライン パーティー ゲームです。
items.title: Spider Roulette

items.description: A miraculous fuel, or a parasitic plague that spells the end of humanity? In a civilization collapsed by global war, fight for survival against the brain-controlling Emerald Flower, feral armies, and ruthless factions, each driven by their own desperate ideologies.
items.description_ja: A miraculous fuel, or a parasitic plague that spells the end of humanity? In a civilization collapsed by global war, fight for survival against the brain-controlling Emerald Flower, feral armies, and ruthless factions, each driven by their own desperate ideologies.
items.title: Emerald Flower

items.description: A modern world where humans and demons coexist—the energetic gal Mika and sharp-tongued gamer Luna are forced to stay in the human world by a 500-million debt! This free visual novel updates in anime-style chapters. Join their hilarious adventures and uncover a mysterious otherworld's truth!
items.description_ja:
人間と魔人が共存する現代——元気全開のギャル・ミカと、毒舌陰キャのゲーマー・ルナは、5億の借金のせいで人間界に留まることを余儀なくされてしまった！
本作は完全無料のビジュアルノベル。アニメのようなエピソード形式で今も更新中！
魔の姉妹が繰り広げる爆笑アドベンチャーを体感し、ファンタジーな日常の中に隠された、謎めいた異界の真実を暴け！
items.title: 非常规放送部 Mika & Luna

items.description: You are trapped at home in an endless loop. Remember your surroundings and watch out for anomalies, if you ever want to leave.
items.description_ja: あなたは家の中に閉じ込められ、無限ループに陥っています。脱出したければ、周囲の状況に注意し、異常事態に注意してください。
items.title: Forgot

items.description: A co-op horror game where you are part of a crew sheltering in a collapsed tunnel, scavenging loot across maps filled with deadly creatures born from a biological war. Feed the creature, convert its waste into fuel, and reach the radio tower
items.description_ja: 崩落したトンネルに身を潜めるクルーの一員となり、生物戦争から生まれた致命的なクリーチャーが徘徊するマップで物資を漁る協力型ホラーゲーム。クリーチャーに餌を与え、その排泄物を燃料に変換し、無線塔を目指せ。
items.title: Holey

items.description: A short psychological horror game where your friends invite you to hang out tonight — you have 7 days to think about it.
items.description_ja: サイコロジカル・ホラーの短編ゲーム。あなたは友人たちから今夜遊ぼうと誘われる。考えるために与えられた時間は7日間。
items.title: 7 Days To Think About It

items.description: Echoes in Darkness is a first-person psychological horror experience.
items.description_ja: Echoes in Darkness is a first-person psychological horror experience.
items.title: Echoes in Darkness

items.description: Ad Nauseam is a choice-heavy psych horror / thriller about trauma, identity, love, and sickness. It combines many staples of Adventure, VN, and RPG games with its own flair to create something entirely unique. Solve mysteries, form bonds, blur the line between mind and body, and keep your eyes open.
items.description_ja: Ad Nauseam is a choice-heavy psych horror / thriller about trauma, identity, love, and sickness. It combines many staples of Adventure, VN, and RPG games with its own flair to create something entirely unique. Solve mysteries, form bonds, blur the line between mind and body, and keep your eyes open.
items.title: Ad Nauseam - The Wrong Side

items.description: Flip fake trading cards for real profit in FeeBay Simulator, a comedic marketplace tycoon game. Snipe underpriced cards from clueless and scammy sellers, grade your best pulls, open mystery lots, rip packs and run your own storefront to build a reselling empire.
items.description_ja: Flip fake trading cards for real profit in FeeBay Simulator, a comedic marketplace tycoon game. Snipe underpriced cards from clueless and scammy sellers, grade your best pulls, open mystery lots, rip packs and run your own storefront to build a reselling empire.
items.title: FeeBay Simulator

items.description:
Inspect your way through dozens of unique, hilarious cards in this chilled-out papers-please-em-up!

Identify and appraise cards from The World's Most Coolest TCG!

Start your new job as an official Habubis Trading Card Inspector and uncover a tale of friendship, corporate espionage and murder?!
items.description_ja:
世界で最もクールなトレーディングカードゲームから、数十枚のユニークで笑えるカードを検査しながら進めよう！

公式トレーディングカード検査官として新たな仕事を始め、友情と企業スパイ活動、そして殺人事件にまつわる物語を暴け！
items.title: Trading Card Inspector

items.description: All About Luck is a roguelike auto battler where luck is everything. Build your formation by gacha and test your fortune. No P2W, no grinding — just pulls, rolls, and fate. Crush the boss with god-tier pulls, then ask your friends: Still not cleared it?
items.description_ja: 『運ゲー王決定戦』は、運がすべてを決めるローグライク・カードガチャバトル！課金もプレイ時間も関係なし、勝負を分けるのは純粋な「運」のみ。成長はすべてガチャの引き、つまり運命次第です。神引きのカード編成でボスをボコボコにしたら、友達にドヤ顔で聞いてやりましょう。「え、まだクリアしてないの？」
items.title: All About Luck

items.description: 1923. You owe a gangster money. The answer is buried beneath Devil Reef — if the horrors lurking in the dark don’t claim your mind first. A Lovecraftian co-op roguelite for 1–4 players where your sanity is the real final boss.
items.description_ja: 1923年。あなたはギャングに借金がある。その答えはデビルリーフの底に眠っている——闇に潜む恐怖があなたの正気を先に奪わなければ。正気度こそが真のラスボスとなる、1～4人用ラヴクラフト風協力ローグライト。
items.title: Cthulhu's Reach: Devil Reef

items.description: DAWG GAME is a comedy adventure about what Maksim does off-stream. Step into the life of a streamer: handle important tasks, take care of yourself, and try to finally go live!
items.description_ja: DAWG GAME is a comedy adventure about what Maksim does off-stream. Step into the life of a streamer: handle important tasks, take care of yourself, and try to finally go live!
items.title: Dawg Game

items.description: Explore the marvelous world of Crackheads alone or with up to 50 players. Team up, turn on your friends, make money, build your empire, scavenge trash for questionable meals, and stay high through all of it.
items.description_ja:
人でも、最大50人のプレイヤーとでも、クラックに満ちたカオスな世界を冒険しよう。
仲間を裏切るか、手を組んで金を稼ぎ、自分だけの帝国を築くかはあなた次第。盗み、暴れ、のし上がれ。そしてハイなまま、すべてを楽しもう。
items.title: Crackheads

items.author: des-harsh
items.description: DO NOT PRESS IT! A very serious job for a very unqualified person.
items.title: DO NOT PRESS IT!

items.author: mangmingyee
items.description: Candlestick-chart tower defense. Protect your seed money from the sell-off with up to 100x leverage.
items.title: HODL THE LINE

items.author: shiwans
items.description: Steal mangoes. Freeze when they look. A hold-to-sneak comedy.
items.title: Aam Chor

items.author: thinksnacksgames
items.description: A tech CEO, 12 afterparties, too many admirers. Survive until your car arrives.
items.title: OUSTED! Afterparty

items.description: Stream Racer is a racing game for   streamers. Build your own tracks, host your own races, stream it on   and have your viewers join you. Engage more with your viewers by giving them a racing car on your stream. Get ready for a hilariously chaotic time for your viewers and you!
items.description_ja: Stream Racer is a racing game for   streamers. Build your own tracks, host your own races, stream it on   and have your viewers join you. Engage more with your viewers by giving them a racing car on your stream. Get ready for a hilariously chaotic time for your viewers and you!
items.title: Stream Racer

items.description: Stranded on a desolate island with Earth's remaining researchers, you investigate a strange celestial body. The day before departure, your only means of transportation gets mysteriously damaged, leaving you stranded. Is someone sabotaging the team, or is there something more sinister going on…
items.description_ja: 狂気の超現実的ポイント&クリックホラー。君は島で目を覚まし、地球に残された数少ない研究者たちと共に島に落下した謎の天体を調査する。帰還を目前にしたある日、唯一の移動手段が故障し島に留まることを余儀なくされた。誰かが意図的に妨害しているのか――それとも、島そのものが君たちを抹殺しようとしているのか？
items.title: The Dream Of A Cockspur

items.description: ASPIS is a story-driven first-person horror game set in the late-1980s USSR. Engineer Andrey enters an experimental system to see his deceased family again. But the machine opens worlds it was never meant to find. Explore the institute and step beyond reality.
items.description_ja: 『ASPIS』は、1980年代末のソ連を舞台にした物語重視の一人称視点ホラーゲーム。技師アンドレイは、亡き家族と再会するため実験システムへ入る。しかし機械は、決して見つけてはならなかった世界への道を開く。研究所を探索し、現実の向こう側へ踏み込め。
items.title: ASPIS

items.description: In a concrete slab beneath the earth, a lone technician is sent for routine maintenance on a network of supercomputers. Each terminal operates on its own hidden rules, and the only way to escape is to learn how to speak their language.  Crack the code, unlock the truth.
items.description_ja: In a concrete slab beneath the earth, a lone technician is sent for routine maintenance on a network of supercomputers. Each terminal operates on its own hidden rules, and the only way to escape is to learn how to speak their language.  Crack the code, unlock the truth.
items.title: Terminal Lucidity

items.description: It's 3am in your childhood home. The year is 2006. Everyone's asleep, but you. Sneak out of your room and do as you're told - "T.W.I.R.L." - whatever that means.
items.description_ja: 深夜3時、子供の頃の家。皆が眠っている中、あなただけが起きている。部屋からこっそり抜け出して、いつもやっていることをする - "T.W.I.R.L." - それが何であれ。
items.title: T.W.I.R.L.

items.description:
A ritual. A festering, unrequited love.

Sink into a humid and visceral Southeast Asian horror about the pursuit of a doomed lesbian love. Is a bad ending better than no ending at all?
items.description_ja:
A ritual. A festering, unrequited love.

Sink into a humid and visceral Southeast Asian horror about the pursuit of a doomed lesbian love. Is a bad ending better than no ending at all?
items.title: Our Bad Ending

items.description:
A psychological horror descending through liminal spaces shaped by the Kübler Ross model - the five stages of grief,
where your perception and an RC car are the only tools to grasp what’s real.
items.description_ja: キューブラー＝ロスのモデル、つまり「悲嘆の五段階」──否認、怒り、取引、抑うつ、受容──によって形作られたリミナル空間を降りていく心理ホラー。現実を掴む手段は、あなたの知覚と小さなRCカーだけ。
items.title: Tape 101: Liminal Descent

items.description: Survive 30 days in this psychological horror nursing sim. Balance routine medical tasks and time management while evading terrifying anomalies in the dark wards. Manage your dropping sanity, earn your paycheck, and escape before becoming the hospital's next permanent patient.
items.description_ja: このサイコロジカルホラー・ナースシミュレーターで30日間を生き延びろ。日常的な医療タスクとタイムマネジメントをこなしつつ、暗い病棟に潜む恐ろしい異常存在（アノマリー）から逃れなければならない。低下していく正気度（SAN値）を管理し、給料を稼ぎ、病院の新たな「永久患者」になる前に脱出せよ。
items.title: 夜班护士模拟器

items.description: DERELIKT is a narrative retro FPS built for fans of claustrophobic PS1-era sci-fi horror.
items.description_ja: DERELIKT is a narrative retro FPS built for fans of claustrophobic PS1-era sci-fi horror.
items.title: DERELIKT

items.description: You log on to a computer having no clue of what lies within. Explore its files, solve puzzles to recover missing pieces, and decipher passwords to enter otherwise prohibited folders. As you delve deeper into its content, you’ll find that there is a greater mystery to be solved.
items.description_ja: You log on to a computer having no clue of what lies within. Explore its files, solve puzzles to recover missing pieces, and decipher passwords to enter otherwise prohibited folders. As you delve deeper into its content, you’ll find that there is a greater mystery to be solved.
items.title: New Folder

items.description: Explore the Poolrooms as if it were lost media from 1998.
items.description_ja: Explore the Poolrooms as if it were lost media from 1998.
items.title: Poolscape

items.author: maxdemage
items.description: Prompt sketchy AIs. Ship buggy games. Get rich, or get cancelled for AI slop
items.title: ✨ VibeStudio - Idle Vibe Coder

items.author: paperhatprojects
items.description: A totally normal captcha game
items.title: CaptchaWare

items.author: stewartgames2014
items.description: Swing through a lava city as Spooder-Man and deliver pizza before it gets cold.
items.title: Pizza Parker

items.description: Sam agrees to help his friends by staying the night in their house while they leave for urgent business. Outside, a heavy rainstorm rages, with loud thunderclaps shaking the walls and creating an oppressive atmosphere.
items.description_ja: Sam agrees to help his friends by staying the night in their house while they leave for urgent business. Outside, a heavy rainstorm rages, with loud thunderclaps shaking the walls and creating an oppressive atmosphere.
items.title: Fleshbound

items.description:
At the beginning of the 20th century, you awaken in a quiet manor where everyone calls you “Anna”, a maid. 
But there’s one problem — you’re actually a man. Soon after, a locked-room murder occurs, and the secrets of the manor begin to unfold.
items.description_ja: 20世紀初頭、静かな屋敷で働く“メイド”のアンナ。ある出来事をきっかけに、記憶の空白が彼を容赦なく襲う。異常な同僚、揺れる性認識、ぼやけた夢……戸惑うアンナの前に、謎めいた来訪者たちが屋敷にやってきて、長らく封印されていた物語が動き出す。

evidence.excerpt: Please feel free to stream all content of this game.

items.title: Elton Manor: Requiem of the Cursed Roses

items.description:
A psychological horror experience told through environmental storytelling.
Explore a house inhabited by trauma, denial, and fractured memories.
Three endings. Multiple interpretations.
This is the house that lives inside me.
items.description_ja:
環境ストーリーテリングで描かれる心理ホラー体験。
トラウマ、否認、そして砕け散った記憶に満ちた家を探索しよう。
3つのエンディング。多様な解釈
items.title: A House Inside Me

items.description: One Death at a Time is a first-person exploration game. You play as John, in the middle of a midlife crisis. A suspicious milk carton offers you a wish in exchange for 14 souls… but because you're a good person, you'll have to die yourself and explore the city in search of 14 ways to do it.
items.description_ja: 『One Death at a Time』は、一人称視点の探索ゲームです。プレイヤーは、中年期の危機を迎えているジョンという男を操作します。怪しげな牛乳パックが、14個の魂と引き換えに願いを叶えてくれると持ちかけますが、ジョンは善良な人間なので、まず一度死んでから街を探索し、14種類の異なる死に方を探さなければなりません。
items.title: One Death at a Time

items.description: Challenging co-op horror (1-4 players). You are looking for your missing friend Darvin. Do whatever it takes to stay alive. Only the patient and the clever will succeed.
items.description_ja: LockYourDoorは1〜4人用の協力型サバイバルホラーゲームです。あなたは行方不明の友人ダーヴィンを探しています。彼を見つけて、生き続けるために必要なことをすべて行ってください。忍耐強く賢い者だけが生き残れます。
items.title: LockYourDoor

items.description: A party game that supports online multiplayer for up to 8 players, where you can also create mods together. It features asymmetric gameplay with cute animals and the beloved platforming fun.
items.description_ja: 最大8人でのオンラインマルチプレイ対応パーティゲーム。MODの共同制作も可能で、主な特徴は可愛い動物たちによる非対称対戦と、定番のジャンプアクションの楽しさです。
items.title: NiuMa

items.description: Do not Wishlist this game. There is nothing here.
items.description_ja: Do not Wishlist this game. There is nothing here.
items.title: TEST RELEASE DO NOT BUY !!!

items.description: A cozy online multiplayer sandbox where you live as a customizable penguin. Slide, fish, swim underwater, decorate your home, complete quests, and hang out with friends in a snowy world full of minigames and social fun.
items.description_ja: Un sandbox multijugador online acogedor en el que vives la vida de un pingüino, totalmente personalizable. Deslízate por el hielo, pesca, nada bajo el agua, decora tu hogar, completa misiones y disfruta con amigos en un mundo nevado lleno de minijuegos.
items.title: A Game About Penguins

items.description: Investigate a murder at Grimwick’s harvest festival in this hand-drawn point-and-click mystery. Question suspicious locals, collect clues, use items, and uncover the truth behind a town that insists there was no murder.
items.description_ja: Investigate a murder at Grimwick’s harvest festival in this hand-drawn point-and-click mystery. Question suspicious locals, collect clues, use items, and uncover the truth behind a town that insists there was no murder.
items.title: No Murders in Grimwick

items.description: Quirky yet brutal run-and-gun roguelite: scavenge weapons, equipment, and artifacts, unlock powerful upgrades, and blast through procedurally generated biomes with witty dialogue and explosively satisfying combat.
items.description_ja: 風変わりでいて、かつ過酷なラン＆ガン・ローグライト：武器や装備、アーティファクトを収集し、強力なアップグレードを解除して、プロシージャル生成されたバイオームを駆け抜けよう。機知に富んだ会話と、爆発的な爽快感を味わえる戦闘が楽しめる。
items.title: Zombiehood

items.description: Operate an oil-drilling submarine while taking instructions from a mysterious voice. Fail your quota, and they’ll cut your oxygen. This is deep-sea horror. Obey or drown.
items.description_ja: 謎の声に従いながら油田を掘削する潜水艇を操作せよ。目標基準を達成できなければ酸素を奪われる。従うか、それとも窒息か…これは深海で巻き起こる恐怖。
items.title: The Oily Depths

items.description: An overworked office lady discovers a sludge girl abandoned in a box and takes her home. A poisonous and fluffy romance begins. Will your relationship be healthy? Disastrous? Completely tepid? The choice is up to you in the only visual novel to prominently feature a literal dead dove.
items.description_ja: 箱中のスライム娘が路地裏で過労なOLに拾われた話。ふわふわで毒々しいロマンスの始まり。世界一ドクまみれのラブコメを楽しんでくださいませ！
items.title: Toxic Yuri

items.description: Bounce, fall, rage, and climb together. Pogo Together is a 1-4 player physics-based precision platformer where ridiculously jacked animals attempt to conquer brutal obstacles on pogo sticks. Help each other, kick each other off, or take on the climb alone.
items.description_ja: 一緒に跳んで、落ちて、キレて、登ろう。『Pogo Together』は、ムキムキすぎる動物たちがポゴスティックで過酷な障害物へ挑む、1～4人用の物理演算ベース精密プラットフォーマー。助け合うもよし、蹴り落とすもよし。もちろん一人でも遊べます。
items.title: Pogo Together

items.description:
The P.T.A. (Parent Teacher's Association) is planning the Summer Fete but they need money to hire everything.
Selflessly serve drinks and upsell the heck out of them to gain funds. Dig deep! It's for a good cause, after all.
items.description_ja:
The P.T.A. (Parent Teacher's Association) is planning the Summer Fete but they need money to hire everything.
Selflessly serve drinks and upsell the heck out of them to gain funds. Dig deep! It's for a good cause, after all.
items.title: A stupid game about pouring drinks for the P.T.A.

items.description: Wound Man is a macabre jigsaw puzzle adventure where you reconstruct a tortured figure from centuries-old anatomical art.  Uncover hidden secrets and collect strange curiosities with every piece.
items.description_ja: 『Wound Man』は、数世紀にわたる解剖学図譜をもとに、引き裂かれた存在を再構築していく、陰鬱で不気味なジグソーパズルアドベンチャーです。ピースをはめるごとに隠された秘密が明らかになり、奇妙な収集物が手に入ります。
