Coin Tavern is not your average tavern!
In this roguelike game, you’ll wield a wild array of quirky coins to build your one-of-a-kind coin deck.
Hoard coins, refine strategies, streamline your deck, unlock hidden treasures, and land outrageous combos in randomized runs!
items.description_ja:
コインタヴァーンは、ありふれた酒場ではありません！
ローグライクな本作で、個性豊かなコインを駆使し、唯一無二のコインデッキを構築しましょう。
コインを集め、戦術を練り、デッキを整え、秘宝を解放し、ランダムな冒険で爽快なコンボを決めよう！

As you dive deeper, you'll find yourself escaping the isolation of your own world, only to discover that the lines between fantasy and reality are beginning to blur.

items.description_ja: 幽霊の出る博物館の不可解な謎を解き明かせ！レールカメラを使って、騒がしい霊を追跡し、追い払おう。最大130もの異常現象を見つけ出し、それらが襲い掛かってくる前に、写真を撮ろう。

items.description: Roguelike shooter set in a dystopian, livestreamed gameshow. Obliterate waves of deformed freaks, earn donations from your sadistic audience and gamble your earnings for upgrades. Your life is a Performance. Your Death is Content.
items.description_ja: 生配信される血塗られたデスゲームで生き残れ。高速ローグライクシューターで武器や能力を賭けろ。サディスティックな観客から投げ銭を稼ぎ、ミュータントの群れを殲滅して投資家を満足させろ。人生はショー。死はコンテンツ。

items.description:
Before you realize it, dreams have become a curse.
Wander through a darkened room and descend into the depths of her mind.
A story-driven first-person horror game that leads you into an abyss of anguish and despair.
Dedicated to those who once pursued their dreams—and to those who still do.
items.description_ja: 夢はいつしか呪いに変わる。暗闇に満ちた部屋をさまよい、彼女の精神の奥底に触れてください。苦悩と絶望の深淵へ沈んでいく、物語主導の一人称ホラーゲーム。本作は、かつて夢を追いかけていた人、そして今もなお夢を追い続けているすべての人へ捧げます。
items.title: Restless Dreams

items.description: A global catastrophe has struck the world. A small group of survivors is trapped in an isolated shelter with resources too scarce for everyone. Take your seat at the table, convince the others you deserve to stay. Lie, pressure, manipulate – and decide who gets thrown out!
items.description_ja: 世界規模の大災害が発生。少数の生存者は、全員分の資源がない隔離シェルターに閉じ込められた。席につき、自分こそ残るべきだと皆を説得しよう。嘘をつき、圧力をかけ、操り、誰を追放するか決めろ！

items.description: Petunia's Purgatory is a creepy-cute idle farming game that lives at the bottom of your screen. Grow cursed crops, feed the Elder God, and keep Petunia sane before her hallucinations invade your desktop.
items.description_ja: 『Petunia's Purgatory』は、画面下部に常駐して表示される、不気味でかわいい放置型農業ゲームです。不気味で恐ろしい作物を育て、血を得るために生き物を犠牲にし、呪われた農場を運営するための「ヘルパー」を召喚しましょう。そしてその間、ペチュニアの正気度を管理する必要もあります。注意してください。彼女の気が狂ってしまうと、ゲームがあなたのデスクトップに侵入し始めます！
items.title: Petunia's Purgatory

items.description: An extreme blogger travels to an abandoned village that, according to legend, was deserted in a single day. While exploring, he encounters rituals and entities rooted in Slavic mythology. But the truth waiting there is far more terrifying than any legend.
items.description_ja: 過激系ブロガーが、伝説によれば住民たちがたった一日で姿を消したという廃村を訪れる。探索を進める中で、彼はスラヴ神話に根ざした儀式や異形の存在と遭遇する。しかし、そこで待ち受けていた真実は、どんな伝説よりも恐ろしいものだった。
items.title: Forsaken Village

items.description: Stuck on the Queen’s royal aircraft, you have been trapped in a mystical loop fueled by dark magic. Armed with nothing but your wits, keep an eye out for anomalies, and you might just find an escape.

items.description_ja: あなたは第13号踏切の当直係員だ。線路を監視し、レールを修理し、列車や人、車を通行させろ。森の中で何かが吠え、あなたを呼んでいる。

items.description: The Wellmonts Case is a first-person psychological horror game set in 1993, Northern Maine. As a private detective, you explore the abandoned Wellmont farm, search for clues, photograph unsettling evidence, and uncover the truth behind a family's unexplained disappearance.
items.description_ja: 『The Wellmonts Case』は、1993年のメイン州北部を舞台にした一人称視点の心理ホラーゲームです。私立探偵として、放棄されたWellmont農場を探索し、手がかりを探し、不穏な証拠を撮影し、家族の謎めいた失踪の真相を明らかにします。

items.description: Entropy is a tactical turn-based RPG inspired by classic JRPGs. Assemble your party of mercenaries and forge your own path towards an expedition into hell to stop the demonic incursion. Choices you make along the way will determine the fate of your world.
items.description_ja: 『Entropy』は、名作JRPGに影響を受けた戦術的ターン制RPG。傭兵を集めてパーティを組み、デーモンの侵攻を阻止するために地獄への遠征を目指そう。旅の途中で下す選択が、この世界の運命を左右する。
items.title: Entropy

items.description: Unravel the dark secrets of Reverend Lawrence, known for his appearance in The Happyhills Homicide 2: Out For Blood. items.description_ja: Unravel the dark secrets of Reverend Lawrence, known for his appearance in The Happyhills Homicide 2: Out For Blood. items.description:
She wakes up in a mysterious castle.

"Dawn Bell" is a side-scrolling 2D horror adventure where a girl with no memory explores the castle. Use items and clues to solve puzzles and uncover her lost past.

Your choices shape the story's multiple endings. What truth awaits beyond the doors of memory?
items.description_ja:
目を覚ますと、そこは見知らぬ古城だった――。
『Dawn Bell』は、記憶を失った少女が古城を探索する横スクロール型2DホラーADV。城内に仕掛けられた謎やギミックを解き明かし、失われた過去を追っていく。選択や行動で結末が変化するマルチエンディング方式。隠された真実に辿り着けるかどうかは、あなた次第だ。
items.title: Dawn Bell

items.description: Steal $5,000 from a new apartment complex full of shady business owners while avoiding their demented landlord - The Wheelchair Man.
items.description_ja: 怪しげな事業主たちで溢れかえる新しいマンションから金を盗み出し、その狂気じみた大家「車椅子の男」をかわし抜け。

items.description: A fast paced silly cutegore FPS! Earth has been taken over by demons. A catgirl codenamed MeowMeow fights back! MEOW, GUN, CLAW and BLOW UP hordes of evil demons, zombies, and other monsters in colorful environments with tons of weapons! The game runs on the FTEQW engine.
items.description_ja: A fast paced silly cutegore FPS! Earth has been taken over by demons. A catgirl codenamed MeowMeow fights back! MEOW, GUN, CLAW and BLOW UP hordes of evil demons, zombies, and other monsters in colorful environments with tons of weapons! The game runs on the FTEQW engine.

Assemble warships with a variety of bottle caps, allowing the warships to transform and break, experiencing flexible physics that brings a refreshing maritime battle!  Fight monsters together, or engage in a battle with your friends.
items.description_ja: 1〜4人のパーティー用海戦シューティングゲーム！さまざまなビールキャップの砲台を使って戦艦を組み立て、変形、延長、切断を体験しながら、独特の柔軟な物理学を体験して爽快な海戦を楽しんでください！PVP対戦モードとPVE Roguelite協力モードをサポートしています：友達と痛快に戦ったり、協力して怒った海の怪物を撃退したりしましょう！

items.description: An unknown actress takes a job at Uncle’s Motel to make ends meet. She’s running from trouble but peace is the last thing she’ll find here. A blend of cozy simulation, horror, and psychological depth, wrapped in a dark, noir-tinged atmosphere.
items.description_ja: 夢を追いかけ続けた女優崩れが、家賃を払うために叔父のモーテルで働き始める。問題から逃げてきたはずなのに、ここで彼女を待っているのは「平穏」なんかじゃない。シミュレーション、ホラー、心理的深淵が混ざり合う、ノワールな世界。

items.description: "Consumption Line" is a short, fully free, experimental indie game about the food industry, deceptive advertising and the downsides of modern life. A sarcastic 30‑minute experience designed to make you reflect, not grind.
items.description_ja: "Consumption Line" is a short, fully free, experimental indie game about the food industry, deceptive advertising and the downsides of modern life. A sarcastic 30‑minute experience designed to make you reflect, not grind.

"I Have an Item" is a multiplayer game with a set of different game modes about risk, reward, and item manipulation.
This IS NOT about getting the most loot — it's about SURVIVAL.

「I Have an Item」は、リスク、報酬、アイテム操作をテーマにした様々なゲームモードを備えたマルチプレイヤーゲームです。
これは、最も多くの戦利品を手に入れることが目的ではありません。生き残ることが目的なのです。

眠気との戦いを軸にした、ハイテンポなFPSプラットフォーマー。
移動系アップグレードを集めつつ、コンパクトな島を探索する。
コーヒーで眠りを遅らせながら、
倒れる前に、どう脱出するかを考える。
なお、犬だらけの企業オフィスタワーがある。

items.description_ja: 【97%高評価】頭を投げ出して、頭に変身して、または仲間の頭をサッカーボールのように蹴り飛ばす。プラットフォームアクションとおバカな物理演算シミュレーションが融合した本作で、友達と一緒にドタバタ騒ぎのサイバー冒険へ繰り出そう。（本作はシングルプレイにも対応しています）

items.description: Upon buying a used computer online, I found a short romance game called “Print I Love You”. I played it once, and it’s lingered ever since. I don’t know who made it - only that it was dedicated to someone. Maybe you…
items.description_ja:
ネットで買った中古パソコンの中に、「Print I Love You」という短い恋愛ゲームが入っていた。一度プレイしただけなのに、それ以来ずっと心に残っている。作者は不明。わかっているのは、誰かに捧げられたものだということだけ。もしかしたら、あなたに...

このゲームには、すべての年齢層に適さない内容が含まれる場合があります。
items.title: Print I Love U

items.description: A platformer and dating game. Run, jump, punch and talk your way to whoever is waiting in the castle.
items.title: Save The Princess Syndrome All-Stars

items.description: A cozy MMO parody. Sit by the campfire, fish, watch sunsets, hit boars. Free, in your browser.
items.title: WOV FOREVER

items.description: Лізь на піраміду з рюкзаком на 100 кг, лови бумагу 🧻
items.title: Магу-Магу! Піраміда 3000

items.author: thezooicqueen
items.description: Find your purrfect match.
items.title: Meowder

items.description: There's only one detective to unravel this murder turned museum heist... and they're the cat's meow. Interrogate a "colorful" cast of suspects until they cough up hairballs... and the truth. Will you wrap up the case in time for an afternoon nap, and make injustice knead its last biscuit?
items.description_ja: There's only one detective to unravel this murder turned museum heist... and they're the cat's meow. Interrogate a "colorful" cast of suspects until they cough up hairballs... and the truth. Will you wrap up the case in time for an afternoon nap, and make injustice knead its last biscuit?
items.title: Feline Forensics and the Meowseum Mystery

items.description: Pursue diamond thieves and a trail of cryptic puzzles in this short ‘60s spy adventure. As Agent Epsilon you’ll choose your path as you chat with (or chat up!) suspicious contacts. Deduce the puzzle rules, decode cryptograms and decipher clues as you solve wordplay & logic puzzles across the globe!
items.description_ja: Pursue diamond thieves and a trail of cryptic puzzles in this short ‘60s spy adventure. As Agent Epsilon you’ll choose your path as you chat with (or chat up!) suspicious contacts. Deduce the puzzle rules, decode cryptograms and decipher clues as you solve wordplay & logic puzzles across the globe!
items.title: Puzzle Spy International

items.description: Become a GOD in this real-time turn-based combat RPG with non-stop brawling.
items.description_ja: リアルタイム戦闘が止まらないRPGで、神となれ。
items.title: Chainsaw

items.description: Too Many Toys! is a cozy organizing simulator where you'll sort 5,517 toys in a messy toy shop. Put every toy back in its correct place, complete rows to gain points, and spend them on upgrades that make organizing faster and more satisfying!
items.description_ja: Too Many Toys!は、散らかったおもちゃ屋さんで5,599個のおもちゃを整理する、癒やし系の整理シミュレーションゲームです。すべてのおもちゃを正しい場所に戻し、列を完成させてポイントを獲得しましょう。ポイントを使ってアップグレードを購入すれば、整理がもっと素早く、もっと気持ちよくなります！
items.title: Too Many Toys!

items.description: The town of Besmirch starves. Stave off the hunger as the latest farmhand in this survival horror farming sim, earning the trust of paranoid townsfolk under the thumb of the corrupt Baron. Tend to both your farm and the town while avoiding unholy terrors that come in the night.
items.description_ja: The town of Besmirch starves. Stave off the hunger as the latest farmhand in this survival horror farming sim, earning the trust of paranoid townsfolk under the thumb of the corrupt Baron. Tend to both your farm and the town while avoiding unholy terrors that come in the night.
items.title: Besmirch

items.description: Professor Simulator: Desktop Lab is a semi-idle desktop simulation game about academic life. Keep a tiny lab in the corner of your screen while you work, study, or relax. Recruit graduate students, apply for research projects, publish papers, purchase equipment, and build your own research team.
items.description_ja: 『教授シミュレーター：デスクトップラボ』は、研究生活をテーマにした半放置型デスクトップシミュレーションゲームです。画面の片隅に小さな研究室を置き、仕事や勉強、休憩のお供にしましょう。修士・博士課程の学生を迎え、研究プロジェクトや論文執筆、設備の導入を進めながら、自分だけの研究チームを育てていきます。
items.title: Professor Simulator: Desktop Lab

items.description: Heartbeat House: Hong Kong is a dating reality visual novel. Live with eight participants in a shared villa and make romantic choices. Your decisions are remembered, and relationships will change. If the screen flickers or something feels off—please relax and keep dating. The show is still ongoing.
items.description_ja:
恋は実験じゃない、リアルだ！
『ドキドキハウス：ラブリアリティ』では、香港の別荘で8人の若者と共同生活。食べて、話して、恋して、修羅場へ。広東語ボイスと手描きイラストで味わう、最もリアルで混沌な恋愛実境ショー！
items.title: Heartbeat House: Hong Kong

items.description: An unfamiliar room. Vague memories. Explore Luna's room through the objects inside it in this intimate narrative experience about loss, told as a classic-style graphic adventure.
items.description_ja: An unfamiliar room. Vague memories. Explore Luna's room through the objects inside it in this intimate narrative experience about loss, told as a classic-style graphic adventure.
items.title: Luna's Room

items.description: You broke into the house of a popular blogger to uncover all his secrets, but it’s not that simple! He locks you inside, and now you must do everything you can to escape. Hide, solve puzzle quests, and make your way out in this horror escape adventure!
items.description_ja: 人気ブロガーの家に忍び込み、彼のすべての秘密を暴こうとしましたが、そう簡単ではありません！彼はあなたを家の中に閉じ込めてしまいました。今や脱出するためにできることはすべてやるしかありません。隠れ、謎を解き、このホラー脱出アドベンチャーで出口を見つけましょう！
items.title: Escape from Vlogger: Runaway

items.description: Fast. Bloody. 8-Player Mayhem. Dominate. Taunt. Repeat. Free. No strings attached. Ever.
items.description_ja: 高速。流血。8人カオス。圧倒しろ。挑発しろ。繰り返せ。無料。縛りなし。永遠に。
items.title: Monday Meltdown

items.description: Dooms Hair Salon is a comedy simulation game about running a hair salon in a chaotic town. Survive by operating the salon alone or with friends!
items.description_ja: ドゥームズ・ヘアサロンは、混沌とした町で美容室を経営するコメディシミュレーションゲームです。一人で、または友達と一緒に美容室を運営して生き残りましょう！
items.title: Dooms Hair Salon

items.description: A doomsday land defense adventure in which you raise MOCHI-O, a weapon of annihilation that looks a lot like a hamster, to protect your country. Pet and raise MOCHI-O to defeat the oncoming enemies and fight through the tender post-apocalypse.
items.description_ja: ハムスターによく似た殲滅兵器「もちお」を育てて国を守る、終末国土防衛アドベンチャー。撫でて育てて迫りくる敵を撃破し、やさしい終末世界を戦い抜きましょう。
items.title: MOCHI-O

items.description: Build your audience as a content creator in this streaming simulator roleplaying game. Riskier moves bring more viewers to your channel but raise notoriety. Push the edgy content too much and you’ll be banned. Balance hype and caution to stay live, gain viewers, and become the Content King!
items.description_ja: このストリーミングシミュレーションRPGで、コンテンツクリエイターとして視聴者層を拡大しよう。リスクの高い行動はチャンネル登録者数を増やす一方で、悪評も高めてしまう。過激なコンテンツをやりすぎると、アカウント停止の危機に。注目度と慎重さのバランスを取りながら、配信を続け、視聴者を増やし、コンテンツキングを目指せ！
items.title: Content King

items.description:
A mysterious phone number on a park restroom wall leads to an unknown “voice,” quietly awakening the town’s hidden apparitions.
This is a horror text adventure with no jump scares—no loud noises or grotesque surprises—designed for a safe and tension-focused experience.
items.description_ja:
ガラケーが当たり前だった時代、公園の公衆トイレには
どこに繋がるかわからない電話番号がたくさんありました——。
本作はジャンプスケア(大きな音やグロテスクな画像での突然の驚かし)要素の無い
安心してプレイいただけるホラーテキストアドベンチャーです。
items.title: 怪異番号~20✕✕(ニーマルバツバツ)~

items.description: A super soothing coloring game! 30 levels of rich content, glass-like luminous dots + embossed 3D visuals. Auto-playback your coloring process after completing each level. Pick up anytime, put down anytime—perfect relaxation for all ages.
items.description_ja: 超癒しの塗り絵ゲーム！30段階の豊富なコンテンツ、琉璃のような光泽のある光点+立体的エンボス効果。クリアすると自動で塗り絵の過程が再生され、達成感を再び味わえます。いつでも始められて、いつでも中断可能、全年齢対応のリラックス首选。
items.title: DottyBead闪闪拼豆

items.description: The rules are simple. Dive into your opponent's mindscape and search for secrets. Turn those secrets into content and make a short video. Gain the most Likes from the audience to win.
items.description_ja: 訳ありの死刑囚たちが出演する番組『BUZZ or DIE』。相手の精神世界に潜り込み、ネタを掴んで、ショート動画を作れ！より多くの「いいね」を稼げば勝利、敗者には死と永遠の「尊厳破壊」が待ち受ける…！
items.title: BUZZ or DIE

items.description: Social deduction game for 4 to 15 players. 3 factions clash as you fortify the village and master unique roles. Uncover your enemies before the Blood Moon turns against you, or be devoured.
items.description_ja: 4～15人で遊べるソーシャル推理ゲーム。3つの陣営が激突する中、村を強化し、個性豊かな役職を使いこなそう。ブラッドムーンが訪れる前に敵の正体を暴け。さもなければ、喰われることになる。
items.title: Redhowl

items.description: A psychological first-person horror about a house that hides a disturbing truth beneath its walls. Explore, uncover fragments of the past, and decide whether to confront what lies below… or leave it buried forever.
items.description_ja: 壁の下に不穏な真実を隠している家を舞台にした一人称視点の心理ホラーゲーム。探索し、過去の断片を見つけ出し、その下にあるものと向き合うのか…それとも永遠に封じ込めるのかを選択してください。
items.title: Scream under the house

items.description: Run your own hot dog shop in the foggy town of Grimshore. Cook and serve by day, solve your meat shortage by night, and try not to ask too many questions. How far will you go to keep the grill running?
items.description_ja: 霧の町グリムショアで自分のホットドッグ店を経営しよう。昼は調理と接客、夜は肉不足の解決に奔走し、あまり多くを詮索しないように。グリルの火を絶やさないために、あなたはどこまでやれる？
items.title: Meat Grinder: Hotdog Simulator

items.description: It's 42°C and you live in Europe, so of course there is no AC. Survive a 14-day heatwave in a Paris studio: melt on camera for your remote job, riot for the last discounted AC unit, lose every fan auction to scalpers, pay rent every Sunday. The heat ends. The landlady does not. PSX survival comedy.
items.description_ja: 42°Cです。あなたはヨーロッパ在住なので、当然エアコンはありません。パリのワンルームで14日間の熱波を生き延びましょう。在宅勤務のカメラの前で溶け、最後の特売エアコンを求めて暴動に加わり、扇風機のオークションは転売ヤーに全敗し、毎週日曜に家賃を払う。熱波は終わります。大家は終わりません。PSX風サバイバルコメディ。
items.title: Europe Heatwave Simulator

items.description: Shoot a monster blockbuster on a 300-coin budget with a plush dinosaur, a cardboard castle and forced perspective.
items.title: Director, We're Over Budget!

items.description: James Sutherland fights monsters for Mary, but the real boss is his love life.

items.description: Cyberpunk SFX is a third-person sci-fi action game set in a world where artificial intelligence has been outlawed. Fight with futuristic weapons, shields, invisibility, and time manipulation to defend synthetic life's right to exist.
items.description_ja: Cyberpunk SFX is a third-person sci-fi action game set in a world where artificial intelligence has been outlawed. Fight with futuristic weapons, shields, invisibility, and time manipulation to defend synthetic life's right to exist.
items.title: Cyberpunk SFX

items.description: A short horror experience rendered with a real-time VHS filter (grain, scan lines). Freely explore the spaces of a strange yellow maze. Independently created by a 12-year-old developer using UE5, it immerses you in a purely liminal space atmosphere.
items.description_ja: 短いホラー体験で、リアルタイムVHSフィルター（粒状感、走査線）でレンダリングされています。奇妙な黄色の迷宮空間を自由に探索できます。12歳の開発者がUE5を使って独立して制作したもので、純粋なエッジスペースの雰囲気にあなたを没入させます。
items.title: The Backrooms: Liminal Space

items.description: Detective Inna Duke is a noir story-driven visual novel where you team up with lieutenant Inna Duke and her partner corporal Fernal to investigate the mysterious abduction of the popular streamer Oleh Hamston. But will you manage to track down the poor hamster in rainy city?
items.description_ja: Detective Inna Duke is a noir story-driven visual novel where you team up with lieutenant Inna Duke and her partner corporal Fernal to investigate the mysterious abduction of the popular streamer Oleh Hamston. But will you manage to track down the poor hamster in rainy city?
items.title: Detective INNA DUKE

items.description: "Unseasonable Flowering" is a first-person horror game set in Japan. After moving to a new home, the young protagonist, Mashiro, is met with eerie residents and inexplicable phenomena. Something "sprouting" everywhere quietly erodes her daily life.
items.description_ja:
『 狂い咲き 』は日本を舞台にした一人称視点のホラーゲームです。
引っ越し先で、主人公の少女・真白を待ち受けていたのは、不気味な住民と不可解な現象だった。
至るところで「芽吹いていく」何かが、彼女の日常を静かに侵食していく。
items.title: Unseasonable Flowering

items.description: The Last Letter is a short VHS-style horror game about a film student who receives mysterious letters containing coordinates that lead to a house deep in the forest, where the truth about his past awaits.
items.description_ja: The Last Letter is a short VHS-style horror game about a film student who receives mysterious letters containing coordinates that lead to a house deep in the forest, where the truth about his past awaits.
items.title: The Last Letter

items.description: The silent union of two girls begins to dissolve in an abandoned high school. A melancholic and liminal short story played in a single sitting, where the fear of collapse is felt at every moment.
items.description_ja: 廃校を舞台に、二人の少女の絆が解け始める。崩壊への恐怖が常に漂う、一度のプレイで完結する、メランコリックでリミナルな短編ストーリー。
items.title: Dissolution of the Silent Union

items.description: Renovate and manage a ruined office building🔨 Clean, repair, and furnish rooms, rent them to picky tenants, fix printers and coffee machines, enjoy an exaggerated office joke system, and survive daily chaos. Turn neglect into profit - money doesn’t print itself, even if the printer tries.
items.description_ja: 廃墟となったオフィスビルを改修・管理する。部屋を清掃・修繕し、家具を揃え、うるさい入居者に貸し出し、プリンターやコーヒーマシンを修理し、大げさなオフィスジョークを楽しみながら、日々の混沌を乗り越える。放置を利益に変える――プリンターがどんなに努力しても、お金は勝手には印刷されない。
items.title: The Dream Office

items.description: Embark on a hilarious, choice-driven adventure in MultiEnding Heroes! Guide The Priest and The Hero through multiple universes, making decisions that lead to over 75 unique endings. Every choice matters, will you lead them to glory or disaster?
items.description_ja:
MultiEnding Heroesの世界で、選択によって物語の結末が変わるコミカルな冒険へ出かけよう！
さまざまな世界線を舞台に神官と英雄を導き、あなたの決断次第で迎えられるエンディングは75種類以上。
すべての選択が運命を左右する――あなたが導いた先にあるのは、栄光か、それとも破滅か。
items.title: MultiEnding Heroes

items.description:
Introducing the New Title: “KUUKIYOMI: Consider It World”! This time, the stage is Thailand!  
Test your ability to read the room in familiar, everyday Thai scenarios, packed with cultural quirks and “That’s so true!” moments.
items.description_ja:
新シリーズ『みんなで空気読み。ワールド』が登場、舞台はタイ！ 
タイ人の「何気ない日常の“あるある”」シチュエーションで「空気読めてる度」を診断！！
items.title: KUUKIYOMI: Consider It World - Thailand Ver.

items.description: You lose forever the second the snail touches your mouse.
items.description_ja: 世界初の“アンチ癒し系”放置ゲーム。命は一度きり。カタツムリが永遠にあなたを追い続けます。触れた瞬間、二度と遊べなくなります。
items.title: Don't Touch the Snail

items.description:
A semi-idle dice clicker where the odds rarely favor you. 
Risky offers, mysterious phone calls, unexpected debts.
What are you willing to sacrifice to land nine sixes in a row?
items.description_ja:
運はほとんど味方してくれない、半放置型ダイスクリックゲーム。
危険な取引、謎の電話、突然降ってくる借金。
9回連続で「6」を出すために、あなたは何を失う覚悟がありますか？
items.title: One More 6ix

items.author: ads58791
items.description: Your AI coworker is very confident. Your production server is not.
items.title: LGTM: Survive Your AI Coworker

items.description: You were hired to film the wedding. You'd rather direct it.
items.title: SPEAK NOW: The Director's Cut

items.description: Лето 1985-го. Пацан, палка и крапива. Комедия 18+ с матом.
items.title: Отп*зди траву

items.description: An arcade revenge spree where five mini-games turn the cactus into the T-Rex's worst obstacle.
items.title: Dino Ruiner: Boogle Must Die!

items.author: juliocacko
items.description: "Sai daqui, vira-lata!"
items.title: SAI PRA LA - Vira Lata Simulator

items.description: A card game where everyone cheats. Catch them in the act, blow the whistle, and let the bouncer's hammer do the rest.
items.title: Don't Cheat Again

items.author: milkiwaey
items.description: He just wants to catch a train. The town has other plans.
items.title: NOT TODAY

items.author: nietostudio
items.description: ¡Lanza a la abuela con una catapulta, rómpele los huesos y mejóralo todo hasta llevarla a la Luna!
items.title: Abuela a la Luna

items.author: ohadianoush
items.description: Set up a movie stunt, call ACTION, and watch it go wrong.
items.title: CUT! AGAIN!

items.author: regulatornzl
items.description: Book demos, close deals, dodge PIPs. A sales roguelite where you hit your number or get fired trying.
items.title: Quota or Die

items.author: stars-en-delire
items.description: Jeu de carte à collectionner gratuit ; 573 stars parodiques, des boosters, du grading et DU FUN !
items.title: Stars en délire - Édition  Parodie

items.description: Control your hands and destroy friendships in this physics-based couch/online fighting game. Use your elastic arms to swing, slingshot, and parkour around the highly dynamic maps. Wield powerful weapons or use your bare fists to bonk your opponents!
items.description_ja: 物理ベースのオフライン/オンライン格闘ゲームで、両手をコントロールし、友情を破壊しましょう。伸縮自在の腕を使って、ぶら下がり、パチンコみたいに飛び、パルクールして、最高にダイナミックなマップを駆け回ることができます。強力な武器を振り回したり、拳を使ったりして対戦相手をやっつけましょう！
items.title: Oblin Party

items.description: Team up with a friend in this physics-based 2-player co-op adventure! Control a fragile balloon by managing the distance between you and navigate through challenging obstacles. Perfect synchronization is key to dodging traps. Can you finish the course without popping the balloon (or friendship)?
items.description_ja: 物理演算ベースの2人用協力アドベンチャーで友達とチームを組もう！二人の距離を調整して壊れやすい風船を操作し、障害物を回避せよ。完璧なシンクロが攻略の鍵。風船（と友情）を割らずにゴールできるか？
items.title: Don't Pop The Balloon

items.description: A co-op survival horror game set in a dark medieval castle. Play as one of four resurrected knights and work together to find hidden runes, unlock the ritual chamber, and escape before the Jester hunts you down. Teamwork, stealth, and survival are your only hope.
items.description_ja: 協力型サバイバルホラーゲーム。打ち捨てられた古城に蘇った4人の騎士のひとりとしてプレイしよう。隠されたルーンを探し出し、道を切り開き、道化師に狩られる前に儀式を完成させろ。
items.title: Jester: A Foolish Ritual

items.description: A found footage horror game about two sisters who often play hide and seek in their family home, recording everything with their mother's VHS camera. What begins innocently, soon turns disturbing, when it becomes clear that something is terribly wrong.
items.description_ja: A found footage horror game about two sisters who often play hide and seek in their family home, recording everything with their mother's VHS camera. What begins innocently, soon turns disturbing, when it becomes clear that something is terribly wrong.
items.title: Too Well Hidden

items.description: Run a men's hair removal salon! Zap body hair with a laser, watch the pain meter, and pitch aftercare packages for every budget. Earn good reviews to bring in new clients, then use your profits to upgrade your gear, hire staff, and make your shop the go-to spot for hairy hunks.
items.description_ja: 自分だけの最強脱毛サロンを作り上げよう！本作は、男性専用サロンを経営するシミュレーションゲーム。最新の医療用レーザーを駆使して、お客様の濃い体毛を焼き尽くそう！お客様の痛みの限界ギリギリを攻め、財布の中身を見て最適な高額ケアプランを売り込み、稼いだ金で設備を強化し、スタッフを雇用。小さな店を、漢がつるつるになる聖地へと、一歩ずつ成長させていこう！
items.title: Hair Removal Salon Simulator

items.description: Harvey's 1-dollar-a-click clicking store is open! Click him for all the money you want! But how far will you go to have money in your hands?
items.description_ja: Harvey's 1-dollar-a-click clicking store is open! Click him for all the money you want! But how far will you go to have money in your hands?
items.title: BLOODMONEY: Requiem

items.description: Guide Bunnygirl through a lab of malfunctioning robots in this RPG about self-care! Learn how to weaponize her emotions in combat and meet unhinged robots who seem to know more about her than she does. Can you protect Bunnygirl? And...who is she, anyway??
items.description_ja: Guide Bunnygirl through a lab of malfunctioning robots in this RPG about self-care! Learn how to weaponize her emotions in combat and meet unhinged robots who seem to know more about her than she does. Can you protect Bunnygirl? And...who is she, anyway??

items.title: 5 nights at Timokha 5: Island

items.description: Demons are in the forest and King Beek Eld fears for his life. His allies Kil Yu and Cleer Leeahspy are with him as rumors spread. The Demon King may be hiding as a human. Elsewhere, a man awakens with amnesia. He manages to make a best friend but doesn't yet know the shocking truth of his identity.
items.description_ja: 近くの森に悪魔が現れ、不安に怯える国王アヤメ・ラーレル。さらに「大魔王は人間に化けている」という噂が広まり、王宮は疑念と混乱に包まれていく。その一方、森で目覚めた記憶喪失の剣士は、旅を通じて仲間や親友との絆を育んでいく。だが――大魔王が化けているのは誰なのか。そして親友の真の姿とは――。
items.title: Heavy Spoilers RPG 2: Your best friend is actually the great demon king

items.description:
A silly first-person incremental game about feeding an ancient god with brains.
Grab, throw and automate their delivery as you unlock mutations, summon loyal cultists, and transform your temple into the ultimate brain-feeding machine.
items.description_ja:
邪神に脳みそを捧げる、おバカな一人称視点の放置・育成ゲーム。

脳みそを拾って投げ、自動化しよう。変異を解放し、忠実な信者を集め、神殿を究極の脳みそ供給マシンへと作り変えろ。
items.title: FEED ME MORE BRAINS

items.description: HANDS OVER is a 5-player co-op horror game where harmless challenges become cruel tests of luck and nerve. Bluff, sabotage your friends, play dirty, and stay at the table longer than anyone else.
items.description_ja: HANDS OVERは5人協力ホラーゲーム。無害に見える試練が、運と度胸を試す残酷な場に変わります。ブラフをかけ、友達を妨害し、汚く立ち回って、誰よりも長くテーブルに残りましょう。
items.title: HANDS OVER

items.description: RoboCo is a sandbox game about designing and building robots to serve the needs of squishy, hapless humans in the world of tomorrow!
items.description_ja: 『RoboCo』は、未来の世界のフニャフニャで不運な人間のニーズに応える、健全なロボット設計&構築サンドボックスゲームです！
items.title: RoboCo

items.description: Play as an angel known as Abby in this retro shooter based on flash cartoons and sprite comics of days gone by focused on interactivity, verticality and cool weapons.
items.description_ja: Play as an angel known as Abby in this retro shooter based on flash cartoons and sprite comics of days gone by focused on interactivity, verticality and cool weapons.
items.title: Project Absentia

items.description: "Messy UP" is a cute multiplayer game where pets destroy homes to grab the owner's attention. Due to the owner's busy schedule, they lack time for their pets. Players control the pets or play as the owner to catch them in this delightful mischief-filled game!
items.description_ja: "Messy Up"は、多忙な飼い主の注意を引くためにペットたちが家を荒らすマルチプレイヤーゲームです。様々なメカニクスを使用して大混乱を引き起こすか、悪戯好きなペットを捕まえるための飼い主としてプレイしてください！
items.title: Messy Up

items.description: Project Songbird is a cinematic first-person narrative horror game set in the Appalachian forest.  Take on the role of Dakota, a musician who must record their new album in a remote log cabin amidst a writer's block.  Take caution, however.  These woods were never empty...
items.description_ja: Project Songbird is a cinematic first-person narrative horror game set in the Appalachian forest.  Take on the role of Dakota, a musician who must record their new album in a remote log cabin amidst a writer's block.  Take caution, however.  These woods were never empty...
items.title: Project Songbird

items.description: A short first-person horror game. An accident cripples your submarine while trying to find the wreck of the Titanic. In the darkness, you must restore life-support systems through tense puzzles, only to discover that you are not alone.
items.description_ja: A short first-person horror game. An accident cripples your submarine while trying to find the wreck of the Titanic. In the darkness, you must restore life-support systems through tense puzzles, only to discover that you are not alone.
items.title: Watertight

items.description:
Night shift office cleaning.
All that greets you, a new hire, is a dirty floor… and a formless sense of unease.
In the silent floors above, something is unmistakably moving.
items.description_ja:
夜勤のオフィス清掃。 
新人のあなたを迎えるのは、汚れた床と……形にならない違和感だけ。
静まり返ったフロアで、確かに“何か”の気配が動いている。
items.title: The Night Cleaner

items.description: Examine and test patients for common and novel infections using sophisticated medical instrumentation. Isolate and treat infected patients. Discover the wonders, mysteries, and horrors of medical science. Rumors of mysterious diseases and human experimentation are unconfirmed.
items.description_ja: Examine and test patients for common and novel infections using sophisticated medical instrumentation. Isolate and treat infected patients. Discover the wonders, mysteries, and horrors of medical science. Rumors of mysterious diseases and human experimentation are unconfirmed.
items.title: Symptoms of Infection

items.description: Jokes end when the owl with a skipping rope appears. A cozy one-button roguelite with ridiculous builds and rope-fueled chaos. Charge jumps, stack wild upgrades, chase high scores, and try again. Just one more run. Probably.
items.description_ja: 縄跳びフクロウが出たら笑いは終わり。ボタン1つで遊ぶ、ほのぼのローグライト。ジャンプを溜め、強化を重ね、増え続ける縄を避けてハイスコアを狙おう。失敗しても即リトライ。あと1回だけ！
items.title: Owl Skips

items.author: itsbumblebear
items.description: Forced to work in corporate hell? Might as well romance your devil coworkers in the meantime.
items.title: The Devil's in the Details

items.description: Inspired by SCP-261, you play as a homeless girl struggling to survive in a distorted city using a vending machine that should not exist. Every coin dispenses impossible food that defies biology and logic, and every meal reshapes your fate. How long can you survive before you stop being human?
items.description_ja: Inspired by SCP-261, you play as a homeless girl struggling to survive in a distorted city using a vending machine that should not exist. Every coin dispenses impossible food that defies biology and logic, and every meal reshapes your fate. How long can you survive before you stop being human?
items.title: Interdimensional Vending Machine

items.description: Hearing Voices is a unique indie short horror experience where you will need to put your listening and deduction skills to the test to solve puzzles. Mistakes have consequences.
items.description_ja: Hearing Voices is a unique indie short horror experience where you will need to put your listening and deduction skills to the test to solve puzzles. Mistakes have consequences.
items.title: Hearing Voices

items.description: Welcome to the mysterious castle of spelling extraordinaire, Dr. Hoot! Explore the classroom, the lab, the library and the...detention dungeon? Put your mind to the test with spelling challenges and logic riddles as you avoid the wrath of the strict, cranky spelling teacher, Dr. Hoot.
items.description_ja: Welcome to the mysterious castle of spelling extraordinaire, Dr. Hoot! Explore the classroom, the lab, the library and the...detention dungeon? Put your mind to the test with spelling challenges and logic riddles as you avoid the wrath of the strict, cranky spelling teacher, Dr. Hoot.
items.title: The Castle of Dr. Hoot

items.description: A chilling psychological horror set in 1980s Kerala. After weeks of silence, you arrive on a remote island to search for your missing wife. Explore an abandoned house, uncover local folklore, survive haunting encounters, and unravel the island’s buried secrets.
items.description_ja: A chilling psychological horror set in 1980s Kerala. After weeks of silence, you arrive on a remote island to search for your missing wife. Explore an abandoned house, uncover local folklore, survive haunting encounters, and unravel the island’s buried secrets.
items.title: Thekku Island

items.description: Horror/thriller visual novel with RPG elements about two friends that explores guilt, co-dependency, and personal limits being pushed.
items.description_ja: Horror/thriller visual novel with RPG elements about two friends that explores guilt, co-dependency, and personal limits being pushed.
items.title: Take Care Of It.

items.description: A cozy first-person tidying sim set in a bustling alley: 5 magical shops and 6,666 items to sort. Every shop on this street is chaos, every shelf has a rule, and every misplaced wand is your problem now.
items.description_ja: 賑やかな路地を舞台にした、心地よいFPS視点の片付けシム：5つの魔法の店と6,666個のアイテムを仕分けよう。この通りのすべての店はカオスで、すべての棚にはルールがあり、すべての置き間違えた杖はあなたの問題だ。
items.title: Cluttermancer: Tidy Up the Nightmare Alley

items.description: Secure the future of the hive in this silly third-person bee experience. Explore hostile locations like the desert, underground labs, and an asteroid. Invade hornet airspace or visit your isolationist juche ant neighbors to steal their nearby resources! This is what they don't want you to know.
items.description_ja: Secure the future of the hive in this silly third-person bee experience. Explore hostile locations like the desert, underground labs, and an asteroid. Invade hornet airspace or visit your isolationist juche ant neighbors to steal their nearby resources! This is what they don't want you to know.
items.title: Hive Havoc 3D

items.description: Drawing heavily from classic survival horror tropes, Carnival Massacre takes players on a haunting quest in a cursed theme park. Explore your surroundings, manage your messy inventory, solve puzzles and kill the four ringleaders of the park!
items.description_ja: Drawing heavily from classic survival horror tropes, Carnival Massacre takes players on a haunting quest in a cursed theme park. Explore your surroundings, manage your messy inventory, solve puzzles and kill the four ringleaders of the park!
items.title: Carnival Massacre

items.description: Coffie Simulator is a coffee simulator game. Run your own café, serve 500+ unique customers, and master the art of coffee-making! Customize, upgrade, and manage your shop while handling orders with precision. Every choice matters—your reputation shapes the experience. Can you succeed?
items.description_ja: Coffie Simulatorは、カフェを経営し、500種類を超えるユニークな顧客に対応し、コーヒー作りの技術を極めるシミュレーションゲームです！カスタマイズ、アップグレード、正確な注文処理…すべての選択が重要です。あなたは成功できるでしょうか？
items.title: Coffie Simulator

items.description: Cosmic horror, through the eyes of a penguin. Rival human factions have come to your home in the Antarctic, seeking an ancient and inconceivable being. Observe their descent into insanity in this faithful re-imagining of H.P. Lovecraft’s At the Mountains of Madness, and other stories.
items.description_ja: ペンギンの視点で体験するコズミックホラー。対立する派閥に属する人間たちが、ペンギンたちの故郷である南極へやって来た。この世のものとは思えない古の存在を探し求めて——H.P.ラヴクラフトの『狂気の山脈にて』などの物語を忠実に再解釈した世界で、人々が狂気に堕ちていく姿を見届けよ。
items.title: Penguin Colony

items.description: Cats VS Zombies is a hidden object game – the player's task is to find cats hidden on the map and eliminate the zombies. The game is designed in a zombie apocalypse style, but with a touch of humor.
items.description_ja:
Cats VS Zombiesはユーモアたっぷりのアイテム探しゲームです。

汚染により疫病が発生——ゾンビが軍事基地全体を支配。
items.title: Cats vs Zombies II

items.description:
An abandoned-building exploration horror adventure set in a Japanese university. 
As a paranormal club member, investigate the forbidden "Building Zero" and uncover the truth hidden within.
items.description_ja:
『大学の地図から消された校舎―0号館』

白栄大学0号館は、日本の大学を舞台にした廃墟探索ホラーアドベンチャーです。
心霊サークル員となり、立ち入り禁止の「0号館」へ取材に行きます。
不穏な空気の中、じわじわと明らかになる0号館の真相とは…？

evidence.excerpt: We welcome video uploads and live streams of this game. You are free to monetize your content without any restrictions. We kindly ask that you include the game title and a link to the store page in y…

items.title: Building 0: Hakuei University

items.description: We Are Sisters is a psychological horror experience that takes you deep beneath the forests of Eastbane. Solve puzzles and uncover dark secrets as you venture further underground, drawing ever closer to discovering what happened to your childhood friend, Aleks
items.description_ja: We Are Sisters is a psychological horror experience that takes you deep beneath the forests of Eastbane. Solve puzzles and uncover dark secrets as you venture further underground, drawing ever closer to discovering what happened to your childhood friend, Aleks
items.title: We Are Sisters

items.author: invisiblemilk
items.description: You’ve been recruited as a Proxy and brought to the Slender Mansion. There are no rooms left. You’ll have to share.
items.title: Your New Roommate

items.description:
Time has come to celebrate Grandma’s 93rd birthday.
Everyone has gathered for this memorable family dinner, but unfortunately, it looks like Grandma is about to be served for dessert!
Inspired by the ’90s, discover a new retro point-and-click adventure game, fully hand-drawn in pixel art.
items.description_ja:
Time has come to celebrate Grandma’s 93rd birthday.
Everyone has gathered for this memorable family dinner, but unfortunately, it looks like Grandma is about to be served for dessert!
Inspired by the ’90s, discover a new retro point-and-click adventure game, fully hand-drawn in pixel art.
items.title: Who The Fuck Ate Grandma ?

items.description: As an employee of a mysterious organization your job is to monitor live surveillance camera footage and spot anomalies using your sharp eyes and good memory. Can you survive the entire night shift or will you succumb into paranoia?
items.description_ja: 謎の組織の従業員であるあなたの仕事は、監視カメラの映像を監視し、鋭い観察眼と優れた記憶力を駆使して異世界の異常を報告することです。夜勤を乗り切れるでしょうか？それとも疑心暗鬼に陥るのでしょうか？
items.title: I'm on Observation Duty 8

items.description: Monster Meals is a fast-paced cooking game where you and a friend control monster chefs in a food truck, preparing meals with exotic creatures for monstrous customers. Play solo, local co-op, or online co-op—but serve quickly, or you’ll be on the menu!
items.description_ja: 『モンスターミール』は、フードトラックでモンスターシェフを操作し、珍しい生き物を調理してモンスター客に提供するスピーディーなクッキングゲーム。ソロプレイ、ローカル協力プレイ、オンライン協力プレイに対応。でも急いで提供しないと、君が食材にされるかも!?
items.title: Monster Meals

items.description: A precision co-op platformer where the only obstacle is falling. Bring a friend along and work together as you face the brutal challenges that await you both on this climb! Can you both make it Two the Top?
items.description_ja: A precision co-op platformer where the only obstacle is falling. Bring a friend along and work together as you face the brutal challenges that await you both on this climb! Can you both make it Two the Top?
items.title: Two the Top

items.description: Feline explorers have overrun the lost city! Find 400 cleverly hidden cats across 5 lush scenes of ancient jungle ruins. A relaxing yet challenging hidden object adventure.
items.description_ja: Feline explorers have overrun the lost city! Find 400 cleverly hidden cats across 5 lush scenes of ancient jungle ruins. A relaxing yet challenging hidden object adventure.
items.title: Cats Visiting El Dorado

items.description: A cozy horror game where you craft plants for late-night customers while you manage a small plant shop. Expand your plant collection, upgrade your shop & grow your business.
items.description_ja: 小さな植物店を経営しながら、深夜のお客さんのために植物を作る、心温まるホラーゲーム。植物コレクションを増やし、店をアップグレードして、ビジネスを成長させましょう。
items.title: The Plant Shop

items.description: You head out to buy a hot dog in the dead of night… but that simple snack ends up dragging you into a web of increasingly unsettling secrets. You soon find yourself face to face with a cult that worships hot dogs, and you’ll have to do everything you can to survive and escape this nightmare.
items.description_ja: You head out to buy a hot dog in the dead of night… but that simple snack ends up dragging you into a web of increasingly unsettling secrets. You soon find yourself face to face with a cult that worships hot dogs, and you’ll have to do everything you can to survive and escape this nightmare.
items.title: Panchofobia

items.description: A classic text adventure - but you're not the one playing it. You're the game master for an idiot player named STEVE. Parse the player's enigmatic commands and decide how NPCs react to him. Who knew that running an RPG would be so frustrating?
items.description_ja: A classic text adventure - but you're not the one playing it. You're the game master for an idiot player named STEVE. Parse the player's enigmatic commands and decide how NPCs react to him. Who knew that running an RPG would be so frustrating?
items.title: Run TavernQuest

items.description: A first-person psychological horror game set in the remote countryside of South Korea in the 1990s. Over the course of just three days, you will encounter a series of mysterious events and come face-to-face with an unseen, encroaching threat
items.description_ja: 1990年代の韓国、人적 드문田舎町を舞台にした一人称視点のサイコロジカルホラーゲームです。 わずか3日間のうちに巻き起こる不可解な出来事を通じて、目に見えない恐怖の正体と対峙することになります。
items.title: The Way Home | 집으로 가는 길

items.description: 1 Teacher vs 7 Students. Hide. Prank. Survive. Up to 8-player asymmetric party chaos! Mischievous students blend into dozens of NPC classmates, secretly snacking, texting, and causing trouble, while the teacher must spot these wannabe delinquents and restore complete order to the classroom.
items.description_ja: 鬼教師1人 VS イタズラ生徒7人！最大8人で遊べる対戦パーティーゲーム。生徒は数十人のNPC生徒に紛れて、つまみ食いやスマホいじりのミッションをこっそり達成しよう。先生の目標は、隠れたイタズラ生徒を全員捕まえること。教室の平和を取り戻せ！
items.title: Worst Class Ever

items.author: pizzaparade
items.description: Sticky-cheese pizza delivery chaos. Drag the whole town along.
items.title: Pizza Parade

items.description: Lose a limb? You’ll adapt in THE LACERATOR! A titillating mix of survival horror and trashy 80’s film.
items.description_ja: Lose a limb? You’ll adapt in THE LACERATOR! A titillating mix of survival horror and trashy 80’s film.
items.title: The Lacerator

items.description:
Navigate through challenging platforming levels, testing your feline reflexes and determination — all to find your way back home.
Falling is never the end; place beds to use as checkpoints, which you may return to whenever you please.
items.description_ja:
Navigate through challenging platforming levels, testing your feline reflexes and determination — all to find your way back home.
Falling is never the end; place beds to use as checkpoints, which you may return to whenever you please.
items.title: Curiosity: A Cat Climbing Game

items.description: The original cooking horror returns in an unhinged co-op experience for 1-4 players. Grill burgers, serve customers, and hit your quota before the kitchen turns into a nightmare. When Asset Joy begins her hunt, try to escape alive and extract your hard-earned cash to survive another shift.
items.description_ja: あのクッキングホラーの原点が、1～4人で楽しめる狂気の協力プレイになって帰ってきました。ハンバーガーを焼き、お客様に料理を提供し、キッチンが悪夢と化す前にノルマを達成しましょう。アセットジョイが狩りを始めたら、生きて脱出し、苦労して稼いだお金を持ち出して、次のシフトを生き延びましょう。
items.title: Happy's Humble Burger Cult

items.description: Time travel and explore different worlds to save the universe from the evil overlord, Edgy Dave. Empty vending machines of their soda, go on various errands and evade E.D's goons as you desperately run for your life in this goofy comedy horror game!
items.description_ja: Time travel and explore different worlds to save the universe from the evil overlord, Edgy Dave. Empty vending machines of their soda, go on various errands and evade E.D's goons as you desperately run for your life in this goofy comedy horror game!
items.title: Dave.EXE

items.description: Hike through the worst forest full of the most horrible trees. Do not trust them. The trees will trick you. They will bully you. They will hurt you. If only you could find an axe...
items.description_ja: 恐ろしい木たちががうようよする最凶最悪の森の中をさまよえ。どの木もお前を騙す、いじめる、傷つける。なので絶対気を許すな。しかし斧さえ見つかれば…
items.title: Trees Hate You

items.description: A competitive board game where players vote to shape their destiny. Transform caravans into 5-star hotels, collect wonders, and earn bounties for bankrupting opponents. Use airports to outmaneuver rivals, organize World Cups to multiply your rent. Can you turn your empire into a global monopoly?
items.description_ja: プレイヤーが投票で運命を決める競争型ボードゲーム。キャラバンを5つ星ホテルに変え、ワンダーを収集し、対戦相手を破産させて報酬を獲得。空港を使ってライバルを出し抜き、ワールドカップを開催して賃料を倍増。あなたの帝国を世界的モノポリーに変えられるか？
items.title: Fortune Avenue

items.description: Travel on a wind-up boat and complete quests in the charming town of Whaleville located inside a whale.
items.description_ja: Travel on a wind-up boat and complete quests in the charming town of Whaleville located inside a whale.
items.title: A Completely Fictional Story About a City Inside a Whale

items.description:
Meet quirky characters and clean strange artifacts in this short cozy comedy game.
From an enchanted teacup to a cursed skull with a chip on its shoulder, each item and client brings new twists and surprises.
items.description_ja:
Meet quirky characters and clean strange artifacts in this short cozy comedy game.
From an enchanted teacup to a cursed skull with a chip on its shoulder, each item and client brings new twists and surprises.
items.title: WYRMHALL: Brush and Banter

items.description: Incremental physics based game about pushing levers, clicking buttons and coming to terms with obsession.
items.description_ja: Incremental physics based game about pushing levers, clicking buttons and coming to terms with obsession.
items.title: Idea Fix

items.description: Explore your decaying mind in this story driven retro survival horror FPS. Manage scarce resources, solve puzzles, and fight your way back to the living.
items.description_ja: ストーリー主導のレトロサバイバルホラーFPSで、崩壊していく自分の心を探索せよ。乏しい資源を管理し、パズルを解き、生者の世界へと戦いながら戻れ。
items.title: Comatose

items.description: An online role-playing action game that can be played by up to 16 players, offering a constantly varied gameplay experience with its different game modes.
items.description_ja: 最大16人のプレイヤーでプレイできるオンラインRPGアクションゲームで、さまざまなゲームモードにより常に変化するゲームプレイ体験を提供します。
items.title: PALS

items.description: Every grip is a rebellion against fate. The top holds the only secret method to defeat the demon king, but the path there is paved with countless falls.  We pay tribute to every challenger. Reaching the end, you win the dawn of the world; and every attempt, you have already won your own dawn.
items.description_ja: Every grip is a rebellion against fate. The top holds the only secret method to defeat the demon king, but the path there is paved with countless falls.  We pay tribute to every challenger. Reaching the end, you win the dawn of the world; and every attempt, you have already won your own dawn.
items.title: 魔王跳 《More Jump》

items.description: Erma's here and she has a.....science fair project to finish? As your project goes explosively awry, look through your hometown in this point-and-click adventure game to gather all the pieces. Figure out how to find the remains of your project to get them back in time to finish for the science fair!
items.description_ja: Erma's here and she has a.....science fair project to finish? As your project goes explosively awry, look through your hometown in this point-and-click adventure game to gather all the pieces. Figure out how to find the remains of your project to get them back in time to finish for the science fair!
items.title: Erma: The Game

items.description:
A stealth-based survival thriller where you play as an experimental rat trapped in a laboratory.
Hide, observe, and use the environment to escape without being detected.
items.description_ja:
A stealth-based survival thriller where you play as an experimental rat trapped in a laboratory.
Hide, observe, and use the environment to escape without being detected.
items.title: R.A.T#200

items.description: Escape! House of Bonds is a yandere escape-room adventure. Explore the locked home of your kind neighbor Yeon, combine items, and solve puzzles to find a way out. Her cute yet unsettling affection awaits you in every room. Will she really let you leave?
items.description_ja: 『だっしゅつ！ きずなのいえ』は、ヤンデレ脱出アドベンチャーです。優しい隣人ヨンの鍵のかかった家を探索し、アイテムを組み合わせ、謎を解いて脱出しましょう。かわいらしくも不気味な彼女の愛情が、家のあちこちであなたを待っています。果たして、ヨンは素直に帰してくれるのでしょうか？
items.title: Escape! House of Bonds

items.description: The magical misadventure of a novice wizard thrown (literally) into the unfamiliar world outside. Go on a sprawling hand-drawn adventure with spells to study, bosses to best, and a huge handcrafted world to traverse on the long journey home.
items.description_ja: The magical misadventure of a novice wizard thrown (literally) into the unfamiliar world outside. Go on a sprawling hand-drawn adventure with spells to study, bosses to best, and a huge handcrafted world to traverse on the long journey home.
items.title: Scrabdackle

items.description: Drive into a world where a Bluff and a Bomb are separated by only a small wire, tied up by a psychopath in chairs with bombs strapped to their chests, play games, vote for losers and must cut a wire, risking instant death. Test your skill. Outsmart the imposter to be the survivor.
items.description_ja: 一本のワイヤーが生死を分ける、究極の心理戦へ。あなたたちは狂気の殺人鬼に椅子へ縛り付けられ、胸には爆弾が仕掛けられている。ゲームをプレイし、敗者を投票で決め、命を懸けてワイヤーを切れ。間違えれば即死！仲間を出し抜き、Imposterを見破って最後の生存者を目指せ。
items.title: Cut That Wire

items.description: A hand-drawn hidden object game inspired by the joy of people watching and telling small stories. Shake trees, peek through windows and spin curious objects to uncover secrets and follow the lives of its charming inhabitants.
items.description_ja:
人々が数々の小さな物語を見たり語ったりする喜びに感化された、手描きイラスト風の探し物ゲーム。
木を揺らしたり、窓を覗いたり、興味をそそる物体を回転させたり。様々な秘密を明らかにつつ、魅力あふれる住人たちの生活を追いかけていこう。
items.title: Nippets: A Hidden Object Game

items.description: A 3D physics-based game where you must explore a variety of absurd levels through the mind’s eye of a budding billiards monk. Do you have what it takes to reach Billiards Nirvana?
items.description_ja: A 3D physics-based game where you must explore a variety of absurd levels through the mind’s eye of a budding billiards monk. Do you have what it takes to reach Billiards Nirvana?
items.title: Silliards

items.description: Only Good Babysitters Go To Heaven is a First-Person comedy horror game about being stuck babysitting while the news is expressing that the world around you is ending.
items.description_ja: Only Good Babysitters Go To Heaven is a First-Person comedy horror game about being stuck babysitting while the news is expressing that the world around you is ending.
items.title: Only Good Babysitters Go To Heaven

items.description: Run a snack factory together in this free prologue of Snack Factory Together. Craft tasty treats for profit, upgrade your machines, unlock new products, and fulfill massive orders. Do you have what it takes to meet the demand?
items.description_ja: Run a snack factory together in this free prologue of Snack Factory Together. Craft tasty treats for profit, upgrade your machines, unlock new products, and fulfill massive orders. Do you have what it takes to meet the demand?
items.title: Snack Factory Together - Prologue

items.description: Your end is my beginning. A short psychological visual novel with exploration and puzzle elements... it already lays shattered.
items.description_ja: Your end is my beginning. A short psychological visual novel with exploration and puzzle elements... it already lays shattered.
items.title: Contraindication

items.description: ECHOES OF RED is a fast-paced roguelite shooter where you can carry unlimited weapons at once, face endless enemies ever stronger and build your perfect custom loadout. OBLITERATE tens of thousands of enemies who dared to challenge you and MAKE THEM REGRET STANDING AGAINST YOU.
items.description_ja: ECHOES OF REDは、無限に武器を同時装備できるハイテンポなローグライトシューター。次々と強くなる無数の敵に挑み、完璧なカスタムロードアウトを構築せよ。挑んだ数万もの敵を殲滅し、逆らったことを後悔させろ。
items.title: Echoes of Red

items.description: Survive an endless horde of Boykissers. Hold out as long as you can and make it onto the leaderboard.
items.description_ja: Survive an endless horde of Boykissers. Hold out as long as you can and make it onto the leaderboard.
items.title: BONK THE BOYKISSER

items.description:
She was sent to the abandoned house in Yeongdeok as part of a viewer punishment challenge.
But the joke ended the moment the door slammed shut.
items.description_ja: 視聴者ミッションで訪れた英徳（ヨンドク）の廃屋，扉が閉まった瞬間，冗談は終わった。
items.title: The Abandoned House in Yeongdeok

items.description: A Thai anomaly-spotting horror game. In 1997, a man swore something was in his house. His psychiatrist said no. Now the case is yours. Go through his old CCTV tapes, report every anomaly, and figure out why this case never made sense.
items.description_ja: タイ発の異変探しホラーゲーム。1997年、ある男は家の中に何かがいると訴えた。だが精神科医はそれを否定した。そして今、その事件はあなたの手に委ねられた。彼の古い監視カメラのテープを調べ、すべての異変を報告し、この事件がなぜずっと腑に落ちなかったのかを突き止めよう。
items.title: Kritsana

items.description: Gather juicy worms, dodge hawks and fly home to feed your three hungry chicks before they starve.  The consummate mother.   A ridiculous 2D arcade flyer across seven wild worlds, with costumes that change how you play — and a wicked vulture that steals your babies.
items.description_ja: ジューシーなミミズを集め、鷹をかわし、飢えた3羽のヒナを救うため巣へ急げ！究極の母性。7つのクレイジーな世界を翔ける不条理2Dアーケード飛行ゲーム！遊び方が変わるコスチュームと、ヒナをさらう凶悪なハゲタカが登場。
items.title: Penis Bird

items.description:
Pink Noise is a nonlinear visual novel in the psychological horror genre, immersing you in the retro atmosphere of the '90s. It tells the tale of a group of teenagers who unknowingly set off a chain of terrifying events. 
What secrets lie within the mysterious VHS tape they should’ve never played?
items.description_ja: Pink Noiseは90年代のレトロな空気に浸れる、心理ホラーの非線形ビジュアルノベル。若者たちは知らぬ間に恐怖の連鎖を引き起こしてしまう。決して再生すべきではなかった謎のVHSテープには、どんな秘密が隠されているのか？
items.title: Pink Noise

items.description: Trapped in an abandoned asylum, survive by exploring, solving puzzles, and escaping the terrifying Doctor Viscera. Hide, fight back with limited resources, and uncover documents that reveal the way out before you become the next victim of his gruesome experiments.
items.description_ja: 廃墟となった精神病院に閉じ込められたあなたは、探索やパズルの解決を通じて恐るべきドクター・ヴィセラから逃れなければなりません。身を隠し、限られた資源で戦い、生還への手がかりとなる文書を集めましょう。彼の恐ろしい実験の次なる犠牲者になる前に、脱出への道を見つけ出してください。
items.title: DOCTOR VISCERA

items.description:
Short visual novel.
A 24-hour romance at its worst; a 24-hour escape at its sweetest.
items.description_ja:
短編ビジュアルノベル。
たった24時間の、最悪な恋と、いちばん甘い逃避行。
items.title: Mercury Elopement Syndrome

items.description: An arcade incremental where you ARE the tornado. Suck up cows, flatten cities, and spend the cash on upgrades between runs. Become fire, flood, winter or void. Start with a blade of grass. Tear Earth apart, then take your storm to an alien world. Raise cows on a farm of your own.
items.description_ja: 竜巻そのものになって暴れる、アーケード型のインクリメンタルゲーム。牛を吸い込み、街を更地にして、稼いだお金はランの合間に強化へつぎ込もう。炎・洪水・凍結・虚無の4つの災害にも変身できる。最初は草一本が精いっぱい。地球を引き裂いたら、その嵐で異星へ。自分だけの農場で、牛も育てよう。
items.title: The Big Suck

items.description:
'One last try' Violet is determined to save her broken marriage - at any cost!
Wandering through a dark forest in search of lost mementos, she finds the world around her shifting with every step.
items.description_ja:
「最後の試み」ヴァイオレットは壊れた結婚を、どんな犠牲を払ってでも救おうと決意している！
失われた記念品を探して暗い森をさまよいながら、彼女の周りの世界は一歩ごとに変化していく。
items.title: Lost in the Woods

items.description: A psychological horror game where you take the role of Jonah, an 18 year old trying out a new board game, The Ouija Board, with his friend Emily. Little did they know, it was far from a simple board game.
items.description_ja: A psychological horror game where you take the role of Jonah, an 18 year old trying out a new board game, The Ouija Board, with his friend Emily. Little did they know, it was far from a simple board game.
items.title: Forbidden Terror: Board Game

items.description: This will be one of the worst games you'll have to endure. Are you brave enough to walk down that path?
items.description_ja: This will be one of the worst games you'll have to endure. Are you brave enough to walk down that path?
items.title: Beat This Game To See Hot Lady

items.description: Run a grimy fantasy soup kitchen where you drop and link bouncing slimes to trigger messy chain reactions. Build wild combos with strange ingredients, serve bizarre customers, and turn your filthy cauldron into a chaotic score machine.
items.description_ja: Run a grimy fantasy soup kitchen where you drop and link bouncing slimes to trigger messy chain reactions. Build wild combos with strange ingredients, serve bizarre customers, and turn your filthy cauldron into a chaotic score machine.
items.title: Slime Soup

items.description: Melon Simulator™ is a chaotic, co-op (1 - 4 players), first person melee combat game.  Almost anything that isn't nailed down can be used to whack, slice, and throw at the oncoming melon horde...
items.description_ja: Melon Simulator™ is a chaotic, co-op (1 - 4 players), first person melee combat game.  Almost anything that isn't nailed down can be used to whack, slice, and throw at the oncoming melon horde...
items.title: Melon Simulator™

items.description:
8-hour Workday is an anomaly search game inspired by Exit 8 and Platform 8. The player needs to explore a creepy, ominous office where dangerous anomalies are lurking around and try to make it through the work hours.

There are 27 anomalies in the game. See if you can solve them all!
items.description_ja:
8-hour Workday is an anomaly search game inspired by Exit 8 and Platform 8. The player needs to explore a creepy, ominous office where dangerous anomalies are lurking around and try to make it through the work hours.

There are 27 anomalies in the game. See if you can solve them all!
items.title: 8-hour Workday

items.description:
Join Foxy in its little cabin in the middle of the Magical Forest as the new potion crafter!
All the inhabitants of the Forest are thrilled that you moved in to perform the art of brewing in a cauldron!
items.description_ja:
魔法の森の真ん中にある小さな小屋で、フォクシーと一緒に新しい魔法薬職人として働きませんか？
森の住人たちは皆、あなたが引っ越してきて大釜で魔法薬を調合してくれることを大喜びしています！
items.title: Foxy's Potion Shop

items.description: Armed with nothing but your camera, investigate the abandoned Gretlow House in this short, atmospheric horror game. Uncover a chilling mystery through a realistic found-footage lens.
items.description_ja: 手にはカメラだけ。打ち捨てられた「グレトロー・ハウス」を探索する、短編アトモスフェリック・ホラー。リアルなファウンド・フッテージ（発見された映像）の視点から、身の毛もよだつ謎を解き明かせ。
items.title: The Gretlow Tapes

items.description:
Hand-drawn 2D point and click Horror x Dating sim
Meet the 'Flowers' imprisoned in hell. They long for an escape to purgatory.
Your job here is simple. Listen to their stories, and break out together.
Easy, right? ...But, doesn't it seem strange?
These people... seem to be out of their mind, a bit.
items.description_ja:
ポイント・アンド・クリックの手描き2Dホラー系恋愛シミュレーション
地獄の牢獄に閉じ込められた「華」達と向い合せなさい。彼らは煉獄への脱出を願っています。
あなたの役目は単純です。彼らの話を聞き、一緒に脱出すること。
容易いことですよね？　···ところで、何か妙な感じがしませんか？
どうやら、この人達全員······　頭がおかしいようですが。
items.title: Purgatory’s Flower

items.description: STEAL THE PIG! is a cooperative game where two thieves must steal a stubborn pig and deliver it safely while overcoming traps and puzzles. Play with a friend in multiplayer, choose your difficulty level, and make sure the pig doesn’t escape!
items.description_ja: STEAL THE PIG! は協力型ゲームで、2人の泥棒が頑固な豚を盗み、トラップやパズルを乗り越えて安全に届けなければなりません。マルチプレイで友達とプレイし、難易度を選択して、豚が逃げないようにしましょう！
items.title: Steal The Pig

items.description: Bounce, blast, and out-magic your friends! Control a bubble-riding wizzo in this chaotic 4-player top-down arena shooter. Combine spells on the fly, unleash high-knockback combos, and launch your rivals off the map in fast-paced couch and online battles.
items.description_ja: 跳ねて、ぶっ放して、魔法で友達を圧倒しろ！バブルに乗ったWizzoを操る、4人対戦カオスアリーナシューター。バトル中に呪文を組み合わせ、強烈なノックバックコンボでライバルをマップ外へ吹き飛ばせ！ローカル＆オンラインで大暴れしよう！
items.title: Wizzo PopOut

items.author: thepottus
items.description: Cinco Noites com Eduardo
items.title: Cinco Noitadas com Eduardo

items.description: Fast-paced first-person platformer with character upgrading. Begin your journey across the Devilish Megastructures as a frail, armless priest and grow stronger through sacred relics.
items.description_ja: あなたは世界を救うために武器を持たないまま悪魔の住処に乗り込んだ最後の神父。美に満ちた一人称のアクションホラー・プラットフォーマー作品。
items.title: Blessed Burden

items.description: Room 404 is a first-person Chinese horror game.Players must discern anomalies within an endlessly looping corridor, make decisions,and attempts to unravel the mysteries surrounding themselves and the four floors of the apartment.
items.description_ja:
404号アパートは一人称視点の中国風ホラーゲームです。プレイヤーは無限に続く回廊内で異常を見分け、判断を行い、
自分とアパートの4階にまつわる謎を解明しようとします。
items.title: Room 404

items.description: One cucumber. One space bar. Suddenly, a collection. Make your cucumber jump, collect designs through activity in the game, combine cucumbers through crafting and display your favourites. A free meme game with optional cosmetic shop items.
items.description_ja: One cucumber. One space bar. Suddenly, a collection. Make your cucumber jump, collect designs through activity in the game, combine cucumbers through crafting and display your favourites. A free meme game with optional cosmetic shop items.
items.title: Cucumber

items.description: It's 2016. Explore through your house in the middle of the night and complete your chores before the water you put on the stove starts boiling. Sounds easy, right? If only you hadn't said things you would soon regret.
items.description_ja: It's 2016. Explore through your house in the middle of the night and complete your chores before the water you put on the stove starts boiling. Sounds easy, right? If only you hadn't said things you would soon regret.
items.title: Water Boiling Simulator

items.description: A story-driven exploration horror adventure set in a fictional modern-day Japan. Experience a quiet tale of psychological horror as two schoolgirls confront folklore, curses, and choices that lead to multiple endings.
items.description_ja: 架空の現代日本を舞台に、女子校生2人の視点で描かれるシナリオ重視・マルチエンディングの探索型ホラーADVです。物語は日本の伝承を主軸に、会話や探索を交えて進行していきます。「縁」と「呪い」をめぐる選択と、いくつかの結末に辿り着く主人公たち。静かに描かれる心理的恐怖をお楽しみください。

items.title: 糺糺縁糸（きゅうきゅうえんし）

items.description:
Traverse this never-ending hospital as you discover clues of where and who you are. 
As each day passes by, the world around you decays, and you can’t help but wonder what is real. Utilize your time and resources as you roam these collapsing halls, but be careful; you may not be alone after all...
items.description_ja:
Traverse this never-ending hospital as you discover clues of where and who you are. 
As each day passes by, the world around you decays, and you can’t help but wonder what is real. Utilize your time and resources as you roam these collapsing halls, but be careful; you may not be alone after all...
items.title: InVein

items.description: Jason and Derek are two stoners on a road trip searching for the legendary Holy Weed. But when the Poop Killer returns, they must find the mysterious Golden Fart before it's too late!
items.description_ja: Jason and Derek are two stoners on a road trip searching for the legendary Holy Weed. But when the Poop Killer returns, they must find the mysterious Golden Fart before it's too late!
items.title: Poop Killer - The Golden Fart

items.author: rixcod
items.description: Do Nothing Live More
items.title: Do Nothing

items.description: Welcome to Super Psycho Baseball, a sadistic home-run hitting roguelike in which you try to conquer a gang of pitch-slinging bosses, each more psychotic than the last. Come face five fully-realized pitchers, rack up powerups, and reach the top!
items.description_ja: Welcome to Super Psycho Baseball, a sadistic home-run hitting roguelike in which you try to conquer a gang of pitch-slinging bosses, each more psychotic than the last. Come face five fully-realized pitchers, rack up powerups, and reach the top!
items.title: Super Psycho Baseball

items.description: Bubumbu is a short and wholesome puzzle game in which you get to help lost objects find their way back to where they belong, while exploring fully hand-drawn worlds full of quirky characters!
items.description_ja: Bubumbu is a short and wholesome puzzle game in which you get to help lost objects find their way back to where they belong, while exploring fully hand-drawn worlds full of quirky characters!
items.title: Bubumbu

items.description: "Mayhemers" is a multiplayer chaos creation game for up to 8 players with a procedurally generated map. Choose your side: Will you be a Mayhemer or a Guardian? Mayhemers' task is to create chaos. Guardians' task is to stop them.
items.description_ja: Mayhemers は、最大8人のプレイヤーがプロシージャルに生成されたマップで混乱を作り出すマルチプレイヤーゲームです。あなたはどちらの側を選びますか？混沌なかガーディアンか？混沌なの任務は混乱を作り出すことです。ガーディアンの任務はそれを阻止することです。
items.title: Mayhemers

items.description: Grab, throw, eat, and UTTERLY WRECK everything using a mind-controlled spork in this quirky, story-driven, console-styled platforming dramedy. With an emphasis on variety and a grand sense of adventure, Psycutlery offers a surprising full-course meal, despite all unassuming appearances...
items.description_ja: Grab, throw, eat, and UTTERLY WRECK everything using a mind-controlled spork in this quirky, story-driven, console-styled platforming dramedy. With an emphasis on variety and a grand sense of adventure, Psycutlery offers a surprising full-course meal, despite all unassuming appearances...
items.title: Psycutlery

items.description: Paperwork is a first-person office-building incremental game where you optimize an office to generate more and more money. Step into the office of Clarity, become a productive worker and watch profits grow.
items.description_ja: Paperwork is a first-person office-building incremental game where you optimize an office to generate more and more money. Step into the office of Clarity, become a productive worker and watch profits grow.
items.title: Paperwork

items.description: Raise the Colours is a satirical 4-player co-op physics game where you race to plant flags before the timer runs out. Work together (or trip each other up) while dodging pesky council workers who’ll do anything to shut down your fun. Not allowed!
items.description_ja: Raise the Colours is a satirical 4-player co-op physics game where you race to plant flags before the timer runs out. Work together (or trip each other up) while dodging pesky council workers who’ll do anything to shut down your fun. Not allowed!
items.title: Raise the Colours

items.description: Embody your inner power-tripping TSA agent and hunt down other players attempting to blend in and smuggle contraband past you. Control the crowd and your problematic K9 with authoritative voice commands, and use "compliance devices" to apprehend smugglers making mischief or hiding in plain sight.
items.description_ja: Embody your inner power-tripping TSA agent and hunt down other players attempting to blend in and smuggle contraband past you. Control the crowd and your problematic K9 with authoritative voice commands, and use "compliance devices" to apprehend smugglers making mischief or hiding in plain sight.
items.title: Airport Security Sucks!

items.description: The year is 1998. Step into the shoes of a real estate agent, tasked with photographing a seemingly ordinary house for an upcoming sale. Explore the environment, use your camera to take pictur-- wait, what’s that in the last photo?
items.description_ja: 1998年です。不動産業者の役になり、今後の販売のために一見普通の家を撮影する仕事をしてください。環境を探索し、カメラを使って写真を撮る--- ちょっと待って、最後の写真に何かある？
items.title: For Sale

items.description: 🐸👑 Jump, climb, push others with your tongue, and reach the top to win the princess’s kiss! 🏰 (Up to 8 Players)
items.description_ja: 🐸👑 ジャンプして、登って、舌を出して、頂上を目指してプリンセスのキスをゲット！🏰 (最大8人プレイ)
items.title: Frog Jump

items.description: This is a funny movie theater where you can watch any kind of movie. I saw a movie here. It is a story of a high school boy “Sota Sakurai” until ※※※※※※.
items.description_ja: ここはどんな映画でも観ることができるおかしな映画館。ここで俺はとある映画を観た。それは、一人の男子高校生"桜井聡太"が※※※※※※までの物語。

items.description: Descend into Lovecraftian horror aboard a claustrophobic military submarine. Assign tasks as a captain’s right hand, analyze sonar signals, make hard decisions, and keep the crew from madness. Dark horrors lurk both within… and beyond the hull.
items.description_ja: 閉塞感漂う軍用潜水艦でラヴクラフト的ホラーに降り立つ。艦長の右腕として任務を割り当て、ソナー信号を解析し、過酷な決断を下し、乗組員を狂気から守れ。暗い恐怖は内部にも…船体外にも潜む。
items.title: Static Dread: The Submarine

items.description: You are a serial killer who exclusively targets men. For a fee. To afford nice things. It's legal and you're good at it.
items.description_ja: You are a serial killer who exclusively targets men. For a fee. To afford nice things. It's legal and you're good at it.
items.title: Femme Fatality

items.description: In this Game Boy styled horror game, uncover the mystery of the Roanoke Museum of History and Wonder. Get lost in its maze-like exhibits, solve peculiar puzzles, and survive being hunted by grotesque creatures from the controversial Human Body Exhibit. Can you leave the museum alive?
items.description_ja: In this Game Boy styled horror game, uncover the mystery of the Roanoke Museum of History and Wonder. Get lost in its maze-like exhibits, solve peculiar puzzles, and survive being hunted by grotesque creatures from the controversial Human Body Exhibit. Can you leave the museum alive?
items.title: The Third Shift

items.description: Fight with your whole body. If you lose an arm, it's just a scratch. If you lose the other, it's a flesh wound. If you lose your legs, headbutt them. LET'S FIGHT, FIGHT, FIGHT!
items.description_ja: 全身全霊で戦え。腕を失ってもかすり傷で済む。もう片方を失えば、肉弾戦だ。足を失ったら頭突きだ！ レッツファイト、ファイト、ファイト
items.title: Knock'Em Out

items.description: You are the lifeline supporting an expedition into the unknown. Keep both yourself and your squad alive by interpreting instrument readings, explore the facilities, and uncover something ancient and eager to be born.
items.description_ja:
地下世界へ向かう特殊部隊の生死は、あなたにかかっています。
あなたは管制室からモニターやレーダーを確認し、無線で隊員へ指示を出します。
全員を生還へ導きながら、深淵に潜む"太古の何か"の正体を暴いてください。
items.title: Below, Rusted Gods

items.description: Become a ghostwriter and write on the behalf of others--everything from love letters to apologies! There's just one catch in this crazy adventure game: the most important words in your writings are decided by roulette.
items.description_ja:
代筆屋の店員になって人のラブレターや謝罪文を代わりに書いてあげよう！
肝心の文章がルーレットで決まってしまう、ハチャメチャ代筆アドベンチャー。
developers: 秘密結社マテンロウ計画
items.title: Ghostwriter Workshop

items.description: Meet Lily, the Queen of the Underworld. She possesses incredible magic abilities, but to be honest, she's a bit of an airhead... She tried to pull a prank on an adventurer using a monster-filled pit, but fell into it herself... and now she's stuck. Just how will she get out of this one?!
items.description_ja: お散歩していたらなんか丁度ええ感じの『魔物が巣食う縦穴』を発見したクソバカ最強魔王「リリ」。特製の『呪いの超弱体化アームバインダー』を用いてその辺の冒険者を縦穴にぶち込んで遊ぶはずが……?「え？」くそバカ魔王リリが自らの罠に嵌ってアビスに落ちる…　魔王リリは縦穴から脱出できるのか？！
items.title: Abyss Runner

items.description: A claustrophobic anomaly-horror game where you can only turn, blink, and decide: is it real or not? Survive five endings and uncover Mike’s story.
items.description_ja: 閉所恐怖を感じさせるアノマリーホラーゲーム。回転し、瞬きし、そして決断するだけ──これは現実か否か？ 5つのエンディングを生き延び、マイクの物語を解き明かせ。
items.title: The Floor Above

items.description:
A vampire cursed to live with head and body separated.
Shoot blood as ammo, execute enemies with your flying head, and survive.
Overflow your HP to unleash Blood High Mode!
Dive into hardcore, over-the-top boomer shooter action soaked in blood.
items.description_ja:
首と身体を分断された呪われし吸血鬼。
血を弾丸として撃ち放ち、頭を投げて敵を処刑せよ。
HP が限界を超えると Blood High モード発動！
血しぶき舞うハードコア・ブーマーシューターアクションが始まる。
items.title: Blood High!

items.description: There's Nothing Down There is a short undersea horror exploration game. Descend into a sinkhole at the bottom of the ocean and discover the remains of a lost, yet not dead, civilization. Now available in VR!
items.description_ja: 『There's Nothing Down There』は、深海を舞台にした短編ホラー探索ゲームです。海底のシンクホールへと潜り、失われたはずの、しかし今なお息づく文明の遺構を発見しましょう。
items.title: There's Nothing Down There

items.description: The only game in the world that's more anticipated than GTA VI. Pih 2 is a one-hit-kill comedy FPS. Fight various types of enemy pihs and bosses in increasingly ridiculous situations, dodge instant death and try not to rage when everything goes wrong.
items.description_ja: 世界で唯一、GTA VI以上に待ち望まれているゲーム。Pih 2は、一撃で決着するコメディFPSだ。ますますバカげていく状況で、さまざまな敵のブタやボスと戦い、即死をかわし、すべてが台無しになってもキレないように耐えろ。
items.title: Pih 2

items.description: An open world party-based RPG with turn-based combat. Heroes of the Seven Islands is a comfy yet challenging mid-sized adventure in a vast fairytale world, inspired by 90s games.
items.description_ja: An open world party-based RPG with turn-based combat. Heroes of the Seven Islands is a comfy yet challenging mid-sized adventure in a vast fairytale world, inspired by 90s games.
items.title: Heroes of the Seven Islands

items.description: Run a market on your space station. Restore and upgrade the station, expand your services, and sell to a variety of alien customers. Experience the challenge of managing a business in space and growing your market
items.description_ja: 宇宙ステーションで市場を運営しよう。ステーションを修復・強化し、サービスを拡大して、多様なエイリアンの顧客に商品を販売しよう。宇宙でのビジネス運営の挑戦と市場拡大のスリルを体験しよう。
items.title: Alien Market Simulator

items.description: It's difficult to know how many locomotives have been swallowed by the suffocating blizzards of the Widow's Run. Cursed with creeping tales of things that lurk in the dark and overshadowed by frequent casualties, it now stands as your only path forward. Will you be able to survive?
items.description_ja: It's difficult to know how many locomotives have been swallowed by the suffocating blizzards of the Widow's Run. Cursed with creeping tales of things that lurk in the dark and overshadowed by frequent casualties, it now stands as your only path forward. Will you be able to survive?
items.title: Locomotive 115

items.description: 《Flan's BN》is the prequel to 《Flan's MS》, which combines JRPG and deckbuilder mechanics. Experience Flan's story of self-discovery
items.description_ja:
《フランの寝る前の物語》はシリーズ作品の第二作で、文学的要素、JRPG、及びデッキ構成を含む同人ゲームです。
このゲームでは新たなシリーズ物語を体験でき、彼女が出した質問 - " 'フラン' は誰?"、彼女は答えを見つけるのか？
items.title: Flan's BN

items.description:
You wake up on a cold floor in an unknown house, missing a kidney, and realize you’ve been kidnapped. Your one goal is to escape at any cost.

Choose where to go, where to hide, and how to build your path to freedom. Every decision brings you one step closer to escape.
items.description_ja:
You wake up on a cold floor in an unknown house, missing a kidney, and realize you’ve been kidnapped. Your one goal is to escape at any cost.

Choose where to go, where to hide, and how to build your path to freedom. Every decision brings you one step closer to escape.
items.title: House of Empty Names

items.description: The sequel to the Steam Awards finalist, invaders are living inside your computer again — but now their source is the mysterious interstellar object 3i Atlas. Interact with your desktop while playing, watch Youtube videos, chat with your friends and more!
items.description_ja: The sequel to the Steam Awards finalist, invaders are living inside your computer again — but now their source is the mysterious interstellar object 3i Atlas. Interact with your desktop while playing, watch Youtube videos, chat with your friends and more!
items.title: CPU Invaders - 3i Atlas

items.description: Life is tough when you're small change. Make every Cent count in this physics-based challenge and Become Savings!
items.description_ja: Life is tough when you're small change. Make every Cent count in this physics-based challenge and Become Savings!
items.title: I Am Coin

items.description: Crazy Pocket is a roguelike deckbuilder inspired by classic pocket billiards! Chain diverse ball abilities together to build game-breaking synergies, and execute the ultimate shot to clear the table in a single turn!
items.description_ja:
『Crazy Pocket』は、ポケットビリヤードに着想を得たローグライク・デッキ構築ゲームです！
多様な能力を組み合わせて強力なシナジーを生み出し、たった一撃のショットでテーブルを一掃する「最高のショット」を狙いましょう！
items.title: Crazy Pocket

items.description: Explore an mid-2000s Korean apartment complex in this short first-person psychological horror experience.
items.description_ja: Explore an mid-2000s Korean apartment complex in this short first-person psychological horror experience.
items.title: AFTERLIGHT: The Apartment

items.description: Kittens Game is game where you manage a village of kittens as they acquire resources and unlock new technologies. Build the ultimate civilization and bring them to the space!
items.description_ja: Kittens Gameは、子猫の村を管理し、資源を獲得して新しい技術をアンロックするゲームです。究極の文明を築き、彼らを宇宙へ連れて行きましょう！
items.title: Kittens Game
