items.description: Para Eyes is a spot the difference horror game. Flip through security cameras and find anomalies. But be careful not to go insane.
items.description_ja: Para Eyes is a spot the difference horror game. Flip through security cameras and find anomalies. But be careful not to go insane.
items.title: Para Eyes

items.description: Explore Dodd's local museum in this short and sweet, casual and relaxing side-scroller adventure! Visit various exhibits within the museum's four wings and talk to various characters along the way!
items.description_ja: Explore Dodd's local museum in this short and sweet, casual and relaxing side-scroller adventure! Visit various exhibits within the museum's four wings and talk to various characters along the way!
items.title: Dodd Goes to the Museum

items.description: An FMV interactive romantic comedy where your choices and timing shape the night. Try to impress Ayşil at the bar and navigate a branching story that can lead to love… or total chaos.
items.description_ja:
バーでアイシルを口説こうとしたその時、あなたは夜の暗い一面に出会うことになる。
無邪気なフリートが、思いがけない物語へと変わっていく。
あなたの選択、タイミング、そしてサイコロの出目が、このロマンスを愛へ…それとも破滅へと導くかもしれない。

evidence.excerpt: Monetization is permitted on every video and stream, including ads, memberships and sponsorships.

items.title: Love: Fall in Death

items.description:
A short, unconventional escape room experience.
You are the candidate. You must find a way out of this room. Things are not as they seem.
items.description_ja: 短くて独特な脱出ゲーム体験。あなたは候補者です。この部屋から出る方法を見つけ出さなければなりません。全てが見た目どおりではありません。
items.title: Escape from Mutation Station

items.description:
Survive, cook, and conquer!
Cook monsters to stave off hunger in this roguelike as you reach the deepest floor. With 200+ equipment items and random dungeons, every run offers endless possibilities.
items.description_ja:
生き残り、料理し、深淵を征服せよ！
モンスターを料理して空腹をしのぎながらダンジョンの最深層を攻略しよう。
200種類以上の装備が眠るランダムに生成されるダンジョンでは、プレイするたびに新鮮なチャレンジと無限の可能性が待っている。
items.title: Abyss Ring

items.description: An escape-room styled series of puzzles await in the car that seems to contain neither rhyme nor reason. See if you can solve the mysteries of the photographs, and figure out what it means to be the ONE IN THE BACK.
items.description_ja: 完全に非論理的と思われる車内では、脱出ゲーム風のパズルが待っています。
items.title: ONE IN THE BACK

items.description:
No matter how long you’re gone, there will always be a girl waiting for you in the same place.
This is a story about forgetting, and about waiting.

After countless restarts and countless memories lost…
how long will you stay with her this time?
items.description_ja:
どれだけ長い時間、あなたが離れていても、
少女はいつも同じ場所であなたを待ち続ける。
これは、忘却と待ち続ける想いの物語。

幾度となく繰り返されるやり直しと喪失。
今度こそ――あなたは彼女のそばに、どれほどいてあげられるだろうか。
items.title: Denpa Nightmares

items.description: Spend 4 days with 2 boy failures in this otome visual novel. Will you choose Julian, the lost tourist with golden retriever energy, or Riku, the quietly intense guy in a bear suit, to steal your heart in this short & sweet romance?
items.description_ja: Spend 4 days with 2 boy failures in this otome visual novel. Will you choose Julian, the lost tourist with golden retriever energy, or Riku, the quietly intense guy in a bear suit, to steal your heart in this short & sweet romance?
items.title: Heartstop Tour

items.description: Become an unstoppable demon-killing machine. Tear through hordes, stack absurd upgrades, and create builds that get completely out of hand. Choose your hero and fight through Hell’s invasion solo or with up to 3 friends in online co-op. How far can you push your build before everything falls apart?
items.description_ja: 悪魔どもが地球を狙う。いい度胸だ。ピクセルと3Dが融合したカオスなローグライクで、常識外れのぶっ壊れビルドを組み、奴らを地獄へ叩き返せ。聖なる騎士、トウモロコシ発射ロボット、猛々しい猫を連れた魔法少女などのヒーローが登場。ソロでも最大4人のオンライン協力プレイでも。殺戮の時間だ。Send Them To Hell.
items.title: Send Them to Hell

items.description: Ravenous is a psychological horror game in which you play as Louis, a child trapped in a monster's basement. Explore the mysterious abode, solve puzzles to save your little sister and survive the psychological nightmare prepared for you.
items.description_ja: Ravenous is a psychological horror game in which you play as Louis, a child trapped in a monster's basement. Explore the mysterious abode, solve puzzles to save your little sister and survive the psychological nightmare prepared for you.
items.title: RAVENOUS

items.description:
Detective Oliver Beebo has been invited to a party by an ex-Rich man in the middle of nowhere. Snacks included.

Unravel the mystery of the party, the guests, the house and the strange phenomena that's causing you to forget... something important? Surely it won't affect your love life.
items.description_ja:
Detective Oliver Beebo has been invited to a party by an ex-Rich man in the middle of nowhere. Snacks included.

Unravel the mystery of the party, the guests, the house and the strange phenomena that's causing you to forget... something important? Surely it won't affect your love life.
items.title: Detective Beebo: Night at the Mansion

items.description: A supernova, a broken telescope, Lum, and a night full of strange encounters and painful memories. Join Eli on a short, emotional point-and-click journey through the city.
items.description_ja: A supernova, a broken telescope, Lum, and a night full of strange encounters and painful memories. Join Eli on a short, emotional point-and-click journey through the city.
items.title: Vlare

items.description: Escape the open-world island infested with monster spiders while on duty as a prisoner alone or with your friends. Loot the city, destroy the caves, take some selfies on the way out in your car before you set sail.
items.description_ja: Escape the open-world island infested with monster spiders while on duty as a prisoner alone or with your friends. Loot the city, destroy the caves, take some selfies on the way out in your car before you set sail.
items.title: Odd Remedy

items.description: Brick Breaker Maker is a rich, element-based Arkanoid game in which you need to flexibly control the baffle to bounce the ball and break the bricks to win. The game provides  level editor that can be shared in the workshop to interact with other players, which is full of fun and competition.
items.description_ja: Brick Breaker Makerは、ボールを弾き返してレンガを壊し、勝利を収めるためにバッフルを柔軟に制御する必要がある、要素ベースの豊富なアルカノイドゲームです。このゲームには、他のプレーヤーと交流できるワークショップで共有可能なレベルエディターが用意されており、楽しみと競争に満ちています。
items.title: Brick Breaker Maker

items.description: As a convicted criminal in the brutal future of this lightning-paced arcade movement FPS, a government-sanctioned bloodsport is your only hope of redemption. Strategize, skate, shoot, and slay against a gauntlet of genocidal androids for the chance to win your freedom.
items.description_ja: 暴虐が支配する暗黒の未来、犯罪シンジケートが牛耳る政府公認のアリーナを舞台に、血で血を洗うブラッドスポーツに飛び込む超スピードアーケードアクションFPS。戦術を練り、レールを駆け抜け、引き金を引いて立ちふさがるアンドロイド軍団を打倒せよ。戦いの果てには贖罪と自由が待っている。
items.title: FIRESTARTERS

items.description: Beni, a loving husband to Nadia and father to Kaila, always ensured his family's needs were met with simple contentment. However, one day, an unwitting decision dragged his small family into a spiral that threatens everything.
items.description_ja: Beni, a loving husband to Nadia and father to Kaila, always ensured his family's needs were met with simple contentment. However, one day, an unwitting decision dragged his small family into a spiral that threatens everything.
items.title: Pikabuu: STOP!

items.description: An immersive FPS adventure set in a dark and surreal sci-fi world
items.description_ja: An immersive FPS adventure set in a dark and surreal sci-fi world
items.title: Blood Facsimile

items.description: Explore, Listen and Observe. LIMINAL WATERS is a liminal space exploration game. Discover a large facility with diverse rooms and themes and be enchanted by the radiant beauty of Unreal Engine 5.6. Relaxation, anxiety, confusion or familiarity? The mysterious Poolrooms are waiting for you.
items.description_ja: Explore, Listen and Observe. LIMINAL WATERS is a liminal space exploration game. Discover a large facility with diverse rooms and themes and be enchanted by the radiant beauty of Unreal Engine 5.6. Relaxation, anxiety, confusion or familiarity? The mysterious Poolrooms are waiting for you.
items.title: LIMINAL WATERS - ENHANCED EDITION

items.description: Fight through a train overtaken by monsters and survive Antarctica’s cold as paranormal special agent Doug Barker in this chilling single-player third-person survival horror roguelike.
items.description_ja: 生き残りたければ、最後尾から先頭まで薙ぎ払って突き進め！吹雪に閉ざされた車内で死角に身を潜めろ。待ち受けるのは、群れで凶暴化した血に飢えた「テディベア」。銃声は襲撃を招き、極寒は体温を奪う。弾丸を込めるか、最後の資金で車両を修理するか。情けを捨て、血肉の饗宴を生き抜け！
items.title: Fright Train

items.description: Work together to survive the night shift in this challenging co-op PvE horror game. Serve your villagers as disgraced knights by evading danger to fulfill their commands in this cursed kingdom. Reclaim your lost honor to earn your place on the watch. How long can you survive?
items.description_ja: Work together to survive the night shift in this challenging co-op PvE horror game. Serve your villagers as disgraced knights by evading danger to fulfill their commands in this cursed kingdom. Reclaim your lost honor to earn your place on the watch. How long can you survive?
items.title: Knights End

items.description: 2006. You become the new reserve caretaker. Patrol the territory in your rugged 4x4, check the phototraps, and monitor the area using surveillance cameras. But remember: you are not the only one watching.
items.description_ja: 2006. あなたは新しい自然保護区の監視員になります。頑丈な四輪駆動車で領地を巡回し、トレイルカメラを確認し、監視カメラを通じて秩序を監視します。ただし、覚えておいてください：あなたは唯一の観察者ではありません。
items.title: Uncanny Tales: The Watcher

items.description: One wet sock. A wildly unreasonable response. Fill puddles, lakes and entire oceans with sand, garden gnomes and increasingly ridiculous machinery in this simple, funny incremental game.
items.description_ja: One wet sock. A wildly unreasonable response. Fill puddles, lakes and entire oceans with sand, garden gnomes and increasingly ridiculous machinery in this simple, funny incremental game.
items.title: Fuck the Ocean

items.description: Cute Survivor where you play as Kitty the cat aboard her flying cat-saucer🛸 created by her distraught human.
items.description_ja: 空飛ぶ猫サウザー🛸に乗り、取り乱した人間によって作られた猫のキティとしてプレイするキュート・サバイバー。
items.title: Kitty's Last Adventure

items.description: She continues to dream. A first-person dream simulator where you explore a corner of a dream.
items.description_ja: 「彼女」は夢を見続ける。夢の一端を探索する一人称ドリームシミュレーター。
items.title: NIDANA

items.description: ECCHI / EROTIC (Single route/linear) Visual Novel about a bizarre GIANT WOMAN. Discover all the mysteries behind her and enjoy her company, if you can.
items.description_ja: ECCHI / EROTIC (Single route/linear) Visual Novel about a bizarre GIANT WOMAN. Discover all the mysteries behind her and enjoy her company, if you can.
items.title: Beneath Her Gaze

items.description: Explore a mysterious place and an atmospheric world filled with horrifying and unusual environments in this first-person psychological horror game. Find hidden objects, solve puzzles, hide from darkness, and enjoy a unique experience in the horror genre.
items.description_ja: Explore a mysterious place and an atmospheric world filled with horrifying and unusual environments in this first-person psychological horror game. Find hidden objects, solve puzzles, hide from darkness, and enjoy a unique experience in the horror genre.
items.title: A Hole In My Room

items.description: A psychological home-invasion horror set in the bleak year of 1992, focusing on tension, atmosphere, and an immersive soundtrack. The story involves elements of a cult, rituals meant to reach the dead, and the haunting presence of those who should have remained in the past.
items.description_ja: 1992年の暗いポストソビエト時代を舞台にした、家庭侵入をテーマとする心理ホラーゲーム。リアルなグラフィックを特徴としています。
items.title: New Face On The Block

items.description: KUNKUN Defender 2 is a hybrid TPS and tower defense game where players must fend off waves of zombies in virus-infected zones, holding their ground until a helicopter arrives for extraction.
items.description_ja: 『KUNKUNディフェンダー2』は、TPSとタワーディフェンスを融合させたハイブリッドゲームです。プレイヤーはウイルスに感染したゾーンでゾンビの波を食い止め、ヘリコプターが救出に来るまで持ちこたえなければなりません。
items.title: KUNKUN Defender 2

items.description: A short, single-sitting VHS-style psychological horror game. Work the night shift at a remote gas station, return home to uncover disturbing clues, and reach one of three endings.
items.description_ja:
短時間で一気に遊べる、VHS風サイコロジカルホラー。
人里離れたガソリンスタンドで夜勤をこなし、家に戻って不穏な手がかりを追い、3つのエンディングのいずれかへ辿り着きます。
items.title: Empty Gauge

items.description: Loser Named Hana is a friendship-building visual novel. You respond to an ad advertising $100 a week to be the lonely college student, Hana, friend.
items.description_ja: Loser Named Hana is a friendship-building visual novel. You respond to an ad advertising $100 a week to be the lonely college student, Hana, friend.
items.title: Loser Named Hana

items.description: The Pale Mimic is an atmospheric horror set in the untamed Alaskan wilderness. As a high profile fugitive on the run, it’s just you and your dog surviving in the chilling forests, until something else shows up uninvited.
items.description_ja: 『The Pale Mimic』は、アラスカの荒野を舞台にした大気感漂うホラーゲーム。指名手配犯として逃亡中の身であるあなたと愛犬は、凍てつく森で必死に生き延びていた。そこに「招かれざる客」が現れるまでは。
items.title: The Pale Mimic

items.description: Martin has been given an urgent assignment at work. However, for this he had to go to the house of his Boss. And so Martin found himself alone at home, in the middle of a vast field of sunflowers. Everything was going well until there was a knock on the window.
items.description_ja: マーティンは仕事で急な仕事を任された。しかし、そのためには上司の家に行かなければならない。ひまわり畑の真ん中で、マーティンは一人で家にいた。窓をノックする音がするまで、すべてがうまくいっていた。
items.title: Knock On The Window

items.description: Brew potions, create monstrosities, and commit atrocities... Fulfill the collector's sick fantasies by experimenting on goblins with wacky potion ingredients that can modify bodies in grotesque ways. If a goblin seems sad that you turned him into an abomination, just drop him into the meatgrinder!
items.description_ja: Brew potions, create monstrosities, and commit atrocities... Fulfill the collector's sick fantasies by experimenting on goblins with wacky potion ingredients that can modify bodies in grotesque ways. If a goblin seems sad that you turned him into an abomination, just drop him into the meatgrinder!
items.title: Goblin Goopmaxxing

items.description: Why is there a giant egg in this lab? Your job is simple: crack it open. Don't ask questions. CRACK is a 1-4 player co-op incremental adventure about uncovering what's inside a mysterious giant egg.
items.description_ja: なぜこの研究所に巨大な卵があるのか？ ミッションはいたってシンプルだ。卵を割ること。 余計なことは考えるな。 『CRACK』は、1～4人用の協力型インクリメンタル・アドベンチャーゲーム。 目的はただひとつ――謎の巨大な卵を割り、その中に何が隠されているのかを突き止めることだ。
items.title: CRACK

items.description: The rise and fall of a rock n' roll star.
items.description_ja: The rise and fall of a rock n' roll star.
items.title: A Chamber of Stars

items.description:
Hotline Miami x Dark Souls. Greatswords, demons, miniguns; up to 4 players.
You are not prepared.
items.description_ja: Hotline Miami x Dark Souls。大剣、悪魔、機関銃、最大4人プレイ。備えなし。
items.title: INTO EVIL

items.description: Door Game Deluxe is a (very) short, satirical RPG. An expansion of the original and the pinnacle of human artistic expression, this version offers original art and music on top of new endings.
items.description_ja: Door Game Deluxe is a (very) short, satirical RPG. An expansion of the original and the pinnacle of human artistic expression, this version offers original art and music on top of new endings.
items.title: Door Game Deluxe

items.description: Death Drive is a road trip visual novel inspired by classic American Gothic fiction.
items.description_ja: Death Drive is a road trip visual novel inspired by classic American Gothic fiction.
items.title: Death Drive

items.description: High up in a Rio de Janeiro favela, a young man lives a quiet life running a hot dog stand. But his routine takes a dark turn when a series of murders—linked to a mysterious cult—begins to shake the community.
items.description_ja: リオのファヴェラの高台で、青年はホットドッグ屋を営み平穏に暮らしていた。だが、謎のカルトに関わる連続殺人が町を揺るがし始める。
items.title: Serra de Deus

items.description: Escape from a laboratory house in this unique puzzling platformer with a twist! All important objects are randomly placed in the world before the start of the game. Each playthrough will take a different path through the house, but can always be completed. A perfect introduction to Randomizers.
items.description_ja: Randomiceは戦闘のない愛らしいメトロイドヴァニアです。ランダムに見つかるアイテムを駆使し、自分だけの道を進み、風変わりなネズミたちと出会います。手描きで描かれた家からの脱出は決して同じ展開になりません。臨機応変に対応し、出口を探し出そう！
items.title: Randomice

items.description: Social welfare survival horror based on real events. Endure emotional pain and societal pressure. Stay entertained. Survive the routine and become the hero of your studio apartment—battle inner demons, hide skeletons in the closet, and most importantly… keep the bathroom clean.
items.description_ja: 実話に基づいた社会派サバイバルホラー。情緒的な苦痛と社会的圧力に耐えよ。退屈をしのげ。日常を生き延び、ワンルームの主人公となれ——内なる悪魔と戦い、クローゼットに骸骨を隠し、何よりも……バスルームを清潔に保て。
items.title: Unemployment Simulator 2018

items.description: A short horror about exploring abandoned space stations and collecting junk in order to pay off your S.R.P.O debt.
items.description_ja: A short horror about exploring abandoned space stations and collecting junk in order to pay off your S.R.P.O debt.
items.title: Salvage Protocol

items.description: Light caresses every corner of the home, and the clock marks the first heartbeats of the morning. It’s just another typical day in the wonderful life of the Evans family… right?
items.description_ja: Light caresses every corner of the home, and the clock marks the first heartbeats of the morning. It’s just another typical day in the wonderful life of the Evans family… right?
items.title: Family Manners

items.description: BLOOD VIAL is a retro-inspired micro-FPS with a leaking health bar. Swim through the spilled blood of your fallen enemies to keep your vial full. Grow increasingly powerful with new upgrades and weapons. Navigate an ever-shifting labyrinth of crypts, catacombs and cathedrals.
items.description_ja: BLOOD VIAL is a retro-inspired micro-FPS with a leaking health bar. Swim through the spilled blood of your fallen enemies to keep your vial full. Grow increasingly powerful with new upgrades and weapons. Navigate an ever-shifting labyrinth of crypts, catacombs and cathedrals.
items.title: Blood Vial

items.description: Binding of Isaac meets Crypt of the Necrodancer in this adorable Action-Puzzle Roguelike! Are you clever enough to survive the evil wizard Bobo's traps?
items.description_ja: Binding of Isaac meets Crypt of the Necrodancer in this adorable Action-Puzzle Roguelike! Are you clever enough to survive the evil wizard Bobo's traps?
items.title: Bobo's Big Tower

items.description: Welcome to Red Hives, a lovely Midwestern town infested with demons. You're a little spirit stuck in a time loop, your only way to interact with the world is by possessing people and whispering into their ears. Explore timelines, solve mysteries, and please, try to keep your hosts alive...
items.description_ja: Welcome to Red Hives, a lovely Midwestern town infested with demons. You're a little spirit stuck in a time loop, your only way to interact with the world is by possessing people and whispering into their ears. Explore timelines, solve mysteries, and please, try to keep your hosts alive...
items.title: The Demons Told Me to Make This Game

items.description: A dark conversation with a girl during a nightly car trip. A short multi-ending novel game where you try to understand this girl and her pain.
items.description_ja: 夜のドライブと陰鬱とした少女との対話。不安定な夜と心を見つめる、短編マルチエンディングADV。彼女のことを、できるだけ理解してあげよう。
items.title: Everything Will Be Fine!

items.description: PSYCHOLOGICAL HORROR // ANTI-DATING SIM about learning to say NO.
items.description_ja: 心理ホラー // アンチ恋愛シミュレーション。『NO』と言えるようになる物語。
items.title: [Bober Bros] No Means Nothing

items.description: Push boxes, slink through pipes, pinpoint the blast spot, and blow through maze walls! Guide kitten Coco through the Cat God Trial, where endless dried fish await—in a cozy hand-drawn puzzle world. A tiny mouse pal squeaks tips along the way.
items.description_ja: 箱を押し、パイプをくぐり、爆破ポイントを見極めて迷宮の壁を破壊せよ！子猫ココは食べきれない小魚を求め、猫神の試練へ。手描きの優しい世界で、小さなネズミの相棒に導かれながら、歯応えあるパズルに挑む。
items.title: Cat Squeeze

items.description: Hollowbrook is a stylized horror experience told through multiple episodes. Each chapter immerses you in the life of a new character, blending personal backstories with chilling encounters that react to your decisions.
items.description_ja: Hollowbrook is a stylized horror experience told through multiple episodes. Each chapter immerses you in the life of a new character, blending personal backstories with chilling encounters that react to your decisions.
items.title: Hollowbrook - Apartments

items.description: Unlucky Mummy is an incremental clicker where your task is to open a sarcophagus with a curse on it. Starting with a tiny chance of success, can you find 12 relics in a row to resurrect the mummy?
items.description_ja: 『Unlucky Mummy』は、呪いのかかった石棺を開けていく放置系タップゲームです。最初の成功率は、なんと25%。12個のレリックを連続で見つけ出し、ミイラを復活させることはできるだろうか？
items.title: Unlucky Mummy

items.description: Open packs, collect absurd Grombos, and build your own card shop. Hunt rare and shiny cards, complete your collection, and decide which treasures to keep or sell. Decorate your store, deal with peculiar customers, and hire staff to keep business running.
items.description_ja: パックを開け、ヘンテコなGromboを集めて、自分だけのカードショップを作ろう。レアカードや色違いのカードを探し、コレクションを完成させよう。手に入れたお宝は売る？それとも自分用に取っておく？店を飾り、個性的なお客さんを接客し、スタッフを雇ってお店を大きくしよう。
items.title: Grombo Card Shop Tycoon

items.description: Spot anomalies and uncover hidden clues to escape an office where overwork turns strange and experiments happen more often than coffee breaks.
items.description_ja: アノマリーを見つけ、隠された手がかりを探して、過労が奇妙な形に変わり、実験がコーヒーブレイクより頻繁に行われるオフィスから脱出しよう。
items.title: Office After Hours

items.description:
🚨 Emergency Alert 🚨
 New security protocols have been activated.
 Remain indoors. Do not open your doors under any circumstance.

 Isolation is safety.
 Isolation is truth.

 Or is it?
items.description_ja:
🚨 Emergency Alert 🚨
 New security protocols have been activated.
 Remain indoors. Do not open your doors under any circumstance.

 Isolation is safety.
 Isolation is truth.

 Or is it?
items.title: Mycopsychosys: Remastered

items.description: Leap, climb, and launch your friends in this chaotic co-op extraction platformer for up to 6 players! Use your drill-wrench to build your way across a vibrant post-apocalyptic world, find replacement parts, and fix broken machines. And if you lose your head, don’t worry: it’s all part of the job.
items.description_ja: 飛んで、登って、仲間をぶっ飛ばせ！最大6人で遊べる、ハチャメチャな協力型脱出プラットフォーマー！ドリルレンチで足場を作りながら、にぎやかなポストアポカリプス世界を進み、交換用パーツを探して壊れた機械を修理しよう。
items.title: FixForce

items.description: "Hariti" is a first-person psychological horror game. You will play as a mother searching for her missing daughter in a crisis-ridden hospital. Experience an atmosphere of extreme dread within the halls of this abandoned Chinese-style medical facility.
items.description_ja: 『鬼子母 Hariti』は、一人称視点のサイコロジカルホラーゲームです。プレイヤーは一人の母親となり、危機の迫る病院の中で行方不明の娘を捜索します。廃墟となった中国式の病院で、極限の恐怖と重苦しい雰囲気を体験することになります。
items.title: Hariti

items.description: BLOOD MALL: RETAPED is a short first-person dinosaur horror game inspired by creature features of the 80s, and the works of Puppet Combo. Take control of a big game hunter-turned-rookie cop, sent to deal with a prehistoric threat that has turned the Dayton County Mall into a blood-soaked hell.
items.description_ja: BLOOD MALL: RETAPED is a short first-person dinosaur horror game inspired by creature features of the 80s, and the works of Puppet Combo. Take control of a big game hunter-turned-rookie cop, sent to deal with a prehistoric threat that has turned the Dayton County Mall into a blood-soaked hell.
items.title: BLOOD MALL: RETAPED

items.description:
Step into a world where dreams and reality mix.
You find yourself in a dream-like world, and explore a different traumatic experience each day. Your choice determines if the boy accepts these moments and moves on, or stays in the past.
items.description_ja:
Step into a world where dreams and reality mix.
You find yourself in a dream-like world, and explore a different traumatic experience each day. Your choice determines if the boy accepts these moments and moves on, or stays in the past.
items.title: 7 Days

items.description: No instructions, no manual, no help of any kind. Just you and a polar exploration vehicle. Are you capable of completing the mission, or will you be buried forever in Antarctica?
items.description_ja: 指示なし。マニュアルなし。いかなる助けもない。あるのは、あなたと一台の極地探査車だけ。果たしてミッションを遂行できるか。それとも、南極に永遠に埋もれることになるのか？
items.title: ANTARTIDA

items.description: The Metaverse, NFT's, Virtual Reality, Augmented Reality, Web3. Come See My Hole is none of these things. In Come See My Hole, you stand next to a hole in the ground.
items.description_ja: The Metaverse, NFT's, Virtual Reality, Augmented Reality, Web3. Come See My Hole is none of these things. In Come See My Hole, you stand next to a hole in the ground.
items.title: Come See My Hole

items.description: 『Letters of Bernard Thorne』 is a story-driven psychological horror game about trauma. Take a seat in Bernard's motorized wheelchair. Roam around the old man's house. Discover his scarred past. Flee from his sins. Climb up the attic.
items.description_ja: 『バーナード・ソーンの手紙』は、トラウマをテーマにしたストーリー重視の心理ホラーゲーム。バーナードの電動車イスに座り、この年老いた男の家の中を探ろう。バーナードの傷ついた過去を暴き、罪から逃れ、屋根裏へと上がろう。
items.title: Letters of Bernard Thorne

items.description: A short parody visual novel about romance with a tsundere girl... Or not?
items.description_ja: A short parody visual novel about romance with a tsundere girl... Or not?
items.title: I Will Never Fall For My Tsundere Classmate, So I Will Just Date A Background Character Instead!

items.description: Forget all those other cooperative horror games. You never know who's going to win in this 4v1 game where teams and roles can change. The hunter can be the prey, and the prey can be the hunter. Complete the ritual and become a vampire or die as prey to cursed creatures.
items.description_ja: 他の協力型ホラーゲームはすべて忘れよう。この4対1のゲームでは、チームや役割が変わることがあり、誰が勝つかわからない。ハンターが獲物になることもあれば、獲物がハンターになることもある。儀式を終えてヴァンパイアになるか、呪われたクリーチャーの餌食となって死ぬか。
items.title: Cursed Deal

items.description:
Dusty Derby is a large online multiplayer party royal game with 32 players. 
Cute Dusts Compete to be King of Dusts in various places in the house!
items.description_ja:
ダスティーダービーは、32人という大規模のマルチプレイヤー・パーティー・ロイヤルゲームです。
家の中のいろんな場所で、可愛いホコリの王になるために競争しましょう！
items.title: Dusty Derby

items.description: Investigate the Pyramid of Charaon, a giant puzzle where every room can be rotated to open new paths. Solve challenging puzzles, uncover well-hidden secrets, and slowly piece together the truth behind this forgotten place.
items.description_ja: Charaonのピラミッドを調査しよう。そこは、すべての部屋を回転させて新たな道を開ける巨大なパズルそのもの。手ごわいパズルを解き、巧妙に隠された秘密を見つけ出し、この忘れられた場所に眠る真実を少しずつ解き明かそう。
items.title: HAMSTERMIND

items.description: You, a normal working Joe, decide to try to solve the mystery of the missing girl... Will you make it out alive? A horror game filled with mystery!
items.description_ja: You, a normal working Joe, decide to try to solve the mystery of the missing girl... Will you make it out alive? A horror game filled with mystery!
items.title: Unusual Tales: Deep Below

items.description: Local VR+PC horror: as a VR player, escape an underground facility full of giant alien monkeys. Up to 2 PC players can help you out controlling friendly drones... or crush you by playing as the enemy Mandrillians.
items.description_ja: Local VR+PC horror: as a VR player, escape an underground facility full of giant alien monkeys. Up to 2 PC players can help you out controlling friendly drones... or crush you by playing as the enemy Mandrillians.
items.title: Escape From Mandrillia: Local Asymmetric VR+PC

items.description: Once upon a time, there was a fly. A hungry fly. A fly with razor-sharp teeth, with a taste for dead things. This is the tale of its adventure to find something dead to devour, in a swamp where nothing dies, everything is grotesque, and every choice matters, no matter how surreal.
items.description_ja: むかしむかしあるところに、一匹のハエがいました。ハエは腹ペコでした。鋭い歯を持つハエは死んだものが大好物。これは死骸を貪るために冒険に出かけたハエの物語。舞台は不死の沼、見るもの全てグロテスク、そして非現実的な選択全てが運命のわかれ道になります。
items.title: The Hungry Fly

items.description: A dark and surreal puzzle adventure set in a decaying town where veins pulse through ruined structures and the night hums with unfamiliar life.
items.description_ja: A dark and surreal puzzle adventure set in a decaying town where veins pulse through ruined structures and the night hums with unfamiliar life.
items.title: Navicula Meatus

items.description: Christmas Story is a horror game filled with Christmas warmth and coziness, where every festive light hides darkness, and the sense of comfort fades with every step you take.
items.description_ja: Christmas Story is a horror game filled with Christmas warmth and coziness, where every festive light hides darkness, and the sense of comfort fades with every step you take.
items.title: Christmas Story

items.description:
《Back3:Spooky》 is a moderately horror-themed FMV.
As the third game in the Back series, the story unfolds after protagonists Ren Xing and Gao Yan survive their escape from the strange realm in the previous Back2. embarking on a brand-new adventure.
items.description_ja:
《Back3:Spooky》 is a moderately horror-themed FMV.
As the third game in the Back series, the story unfolds after protagonists Ren Xing and Gao Yan survive their escape from the strange realm in the previous Back2. embarking on a brand-new adventure.
items.title: 背后3:阴戏

items.description: Psychological single-player first-person horror. Explore dark environments, fight with melee and guns, and solve puzzles in this retro 2000s-inspired nightmare where the truth is more terrifying than the monsters.
items.description_ja:
心理ホラー · 一人称シングルプレイ · サバイバルナイトメア
闇の奥底へ潜り込み、武器と素手で戦い、謎に縛られながら生き延びろ。
これは2000年代ホラーへの敬意とともに蘇る、レトロな悪夢——
真実は、怪物よりも恐ろしい。
items.title: Saint of Chains

items.description: A dark comedy horror game with a N64 aesthetic.
items.description_ja: A dark comedy horror game with a N64 aesthetic.
items.title: Uktena 64 - Ultimate

items.description: Take control of three capybaras infiltrating a fashion event in this stealth puzzle game. Stack under a disguise to blend in among humans, split up to solve puzzles, avoid suspicion, and steal a legendary jewel. But be careful: one wrong move could reveal what’s really under the coat!
items.description_ja: Take control of three capybaras infiltrating a fashion event in this stealth puzzle game. Stack under a disguise to blend in among humans, split up to solve puzzles, avoid suspicion, and steal a legendary jewel. But be careful: one wrong move could reveal what’s really under the coat!
items.title: WOBBLY HEIST

items.description: An observation-driven psychological horror set inside an endless furniture superstore. Spot anomalies, choose the correct path, complete your shopping list — and escape the loop.
items.description_ja: 終わりのない家具スーパーを舞台にした観察型サイコロジカルホラー。異常を見つけ、正しい道を選び、買い物リストを完成させて — ループから脱出しましょう。
items.title: SCP-3008: Infinite Store

items.description: Explore the scenes, find clues, and sort out people, pets, and belongings in this cozy slice-of-life detective puzzle game. Fans of Little Problems and The Case of the Worst Day Ever will enjoy this new deduction game for all ages.
items.description_ja: Explore the scenes, find clues, and sort out people, pets, and belongings in this cozy slice-of-life detective puzzle game. Fans of Little Problems and The Case of the Worst Day Ever will enjoy this new deduction game for all ages.
items.title: Deductopia

items.description: Go on heists through Midnight City alone or with up to four players to fulfill tasks as a hacker for various organizations. Improve your reputation, earn money, and uncover the secrets of shady companies all while being hunted by terrifying entities.
items.description_ja: Go on heists through Midnight City alone or with up to four players to fulfill tasks as a hacker for various organizations. Improve your reputation, earn money, and uncover the secrets of shady companies all while being hunted by terrifying entities.
items.title: Midnight Heist

items.description:
CardBurners is a chaotic fast-paced, solo or online versus card game. You must play your cards quickly before they burn in your hand!
Mix and match completely different sets of cards and rules to create unique action packed games.
items.description_ja:
CardBurners は、ソロでもオンライン対戦でも楽しめる混沌とした高速カードゲーム！
手札が燃える前に素早くプレイせよ！
この体験版では、2種類のカードパックをオンラインで遊び、ソロモードの最初の相手に挑戦できます。
items.title: Cardburners

items.description: consume WHITE CHOCOLATE to escape this pitch black facility. share it with that vile creature that survived alongside you. or dont, be an nuisance, it's always profitable to be an nuisance.
items.description_ja: consume WHITE CHOCOLATE to escape this pitch black facility. share it with that vile creature that survived alongside you. or dont, be an nuisance, it's always profitable to be an nuisance.
items.title: WHITE CHOCOLATE

items.description: HOUSE CALL is a short 20 to 30-minute experience heavily inspired by Adobe Flash point-and-click games of the late 2000s, including THE HOUSE by Sinthai. Use your mouse to explore the environment, solve puzzles, and proceed through the house to find what lies within.
items.description_ja: HOUSE CALL is a short 20 to 30-minute experience heavily inspired by Adobe Flash point-and-click games of the late 2000s, including THE HOUSE by Sinthai. Use your mouse to explore the environment, solve puzzles, and proceed through the house to find what lies within.
items.title: HOUSE CALL

items.description: Cat Chaos is a physics destruction simulator where you're a mischievous house cat destroying everything in sight. Topple items off the tables, whirlwind-spin through shelves, demolish furniture, upgrade your spin, and watch the damage bill skyrocket. Then take a good nap while your human crumbles.
items.description_ja: 『Cat Chaos』は、いたずら好きの猫になって目に入るものを全部破壊する物理破壊シミュレーター。テーブルの物を落とし、旋風スピンで棚をなぎ倒し、家具を破壊、スピンを強化して、損害額が跳ね上がるのを眺めよう。最後は何事もなかったかのようにお昼寝、飼い主は真っ青。
items.title: Cat Chaos

items.description: Congratulations on your new career at B.A.N.K.! Go it alone or with friends (1-4) — serve customers, uphold the bank's reputation, climb the corporate ladder, and find success in your work. It's all up to you!
items.description_ja: B.A.N.K.への就職、おめでとうございます！ 一人でも、友達とでも、顧客に対応し、B.A.N.K.の評判を守り、キャリアの階段を上り、仕事で成功を収めましょう。すべてはあなた次第です！
items.title: B.A.N.K.

items.description: A co-op survival horror game where you and your closest friends must work together to survive in an upside down world crawling with the infected.
items.description_ja: A co-op survival horror game where you and your closest friends must work together to survive in an upside down world crawling with the infected.
items.title: PONE

items.description: 1999. The protagonist, a boy named Akira, finds himself lost in the TOKOYO Building—an indoor amusement park filled with secrets and eerie rumors. There, he begins living and working alongside its peculiar staff, but... did you know? People disappear in the TOKOYO Building.
items.description_ja: 1999年。主人公の少年・灯良が迷い込んだのは、秘密と怪しい噂がいっぱいの屋内遊園地「トコヨビル」。そこで働く奇妙な仲間たちと共に、灯良も住み込みで働くことになったが......？――知ってる？「トコヨビル」では、人が消えるらしいよ。
items.title: 1999TOKOYO Building

items.description:
BABULYA – that’s what grandchildren affectionately call their beloved grandmother.
But what if your BABULYA is no longer human, but a bloodthirsty monster?
You came to taste her pies… and she wants to taste you instead…
items.description_ja:
BABULYA – that’s what grandchildren affectionately call their beloved grandmother.
But what if your BABULYA is no longer human, but a bloodthirsty monster?
You came to taste her pies… and she wants to taste you instead…
items.title: BABULYA

items.description: A short medical simulation horror game with multiple endings where the imperfect are made HAPPY. Perform tasks and operations on sedated patients to fix their defects before submitting your files to the Ministry of Happiness & Peace!
items.description_ja: A short medical simulation horror game with multiple endings where the imperfect are made HAPPY. Perform tasks and operations on sedated patients to fix their defects before submitting your files to the Ministry of Happiness & Peace!
items.title: Smile More

items.description: Comedy horror set in Somerset. You're on the night shift again. Look lively, you get all sorts turning up round these parts. Let the right ones in, send the wronguns on their way and try not to make any enemies— there are strange folk about.
items.description_ja: Comedy horror set in Somerset. You're on the night shift again. Look lively, you get all sorts turning up round these parts. Let the right ones in, send the wronguns on their way and try not to make any enemies— there are strange folk about.
items.title: Evenin' Shift

items.description: Junkster is a 3D action platformer with an awesome building mechanic. Plucky little construction bot, UM-13 (or Um for short), has crash-landed on a dangerous junkyard planet. Armed only with his trusty robo-wrench, Um must repair his ship and recover his lost cargo of precious human artifacts.
items.description_ja: Junkster は優れた建築メカニクスを備えた3Dアクションプラットフォーマーです。勇敢な小型建設ロボUM-13は危険なスクラップ惑星に不時着しました。UMは船を修理し、失われた貴重な人類の遺物を回収しなければなりません。
items.title: Junkster

items.description: Cultivate a thriving farm to survive in this peaceful horror farming game! Play online with up to 16 players in the same lobby. Work together with your fellow farmers to repair your tractor and escape the farm, try not to fall victim to the eerie and mysterious creatures that lurk nearby.
items.description_ja: Cultivate a thriving farm to survive in this peaceful horror farming game! Play online with up to 16 players in the same lobby. Work together with your fellow farmers to repair your tractor and escape the farm, try not to fall victim to the eerie and mysterious creatures that lurk nearby.
items.title: Cryptid Farm

items.description: Find My Frogs is a cozy hidden object game where you search for frogs and toads in a peaceful, hand-drawn village. Explore charming spots, uncover secrets, and help Uncle Froger gather everyone for a family photo.
items.description_ja: Find My Frogs は、のどかな手描きの村でカエルやヒキガエルを探す、居心地の良い隠しオブジェクトゲームです。魅力的なスポットを探検して秘密を暴き、カエルおじさんがみんなを集めて家族写真を撮るのを手伝おう。
items.title: Find My Frogs

items.description: Stranded in the desert, your only hope of escaping rests in a strange Catman. His one request: hunt down surreal creatures, skin them, and chop them up so he can keep them as trophies.
items.description_ja: 砂漠で立ち往生したあなたの唯一の脱出手段は、奇妙なネコ男。彼のただひとつの願いは、シュールなクリーチャーを狩り、剥ぎ、刻み、トロフィーとして持ち帰ること。この不気味な世界では、“死”がすぐそばにある存在になる。
items.title: Cat Named Mojave

items.description: Bite Night: Dine or Die is a First-Person horror thriller where you play as a diner worker trying to solve the murders of your customers along side your best friend Vamp.
items.description_ja: Bite Night: Dine or Die is a First-Person horror thriller where you play as a diner worker trying to solve the murders of your customers along side your best friend Vamp.
items.title: Bite Night: Dine or Die

items.description: BOOST and JUMP with momentum! A platforming and semi-Foddian climber. Make your way to the TOP of the Dark Tower! You could say it's a documentary of the Salmon's natural instincts to swim upstream...
items.description_ja: 勢いをつけてブースト＆ジャンプ！プラットフォーマー＆半「壺おじ」ライクなクライミングゲーム。ダークタワーの頂上を目指せ！これはサケが川を遡る自然の直感を描いたドキュメンタリーと言えるかもしれない…
items.title: Salmon Tower

items.description:
何気なく頼んだ「アイスコーヒー」の注文が、奥の部屋への「合言葉」になっちゃってる喫茶店。
1周5分の、ちょっとおかしくて怪しいマルチエンドADV。
items.description_ja: 何気なく頼んだ「アイスコーヒー」の注文が、奥の部屋への「合言葉」になっちゃってる喫茶店。一周5分の、ちょっとおかしくて怪しいマルチエンドADV。
developers: 麺屋すぱいす 東京支店
items.title: アイアイ喫茶店

items.description: Renting a small shop and opening a barber shop, Vito meets a woman who works alone next to his shop and he feels like he's falling in love with her, but... is she okay?
items.description_ja: Renting a small shop and opening a barber shop, Vito meets a woman who works alone next to his shop and he feels like he's falling in love with her, but... is she okay?
items.title: I Fell for Her

items.description: Billion Egg Farm is a first-person automation game where you put chickens to work laying eggs and build production lines for eggs, meat, and processed goods.
items.description_ja:
Billion Egg Farmは、ニワトリに卵を産ませ、卵や肉の生産ラインを構築する一人称オートメーションゲームです。

コンベアや建築物を設置し、自分だけの養鶏場を作りましょう。ただし、卵や肉など生産物は物理ベースで動いているので、思い通りにいくとは限りません。
items.title: Billion Egg Farm

items.description: You thought your job was to educate the youth? Think again. You are here to keep them in line. These brats have no intention of doing the exam the right way, instead they will just cheat, cheat, cheat! You are the last line of defense and must catch every cheating student.
items.description_ja: You thought your job was to educate the youth? Think again. You are here to keep them in line. These brats have no intention of doing the exam the right way, instead they will just cheat, cheat, cheat! You are the last line of defense and must catch every cheating student.
items.title: Damn Exam

items.description: Catch exotic fish and fight comical sea-monsters as you chase after The One That Got Away in this fishing-centric boss rush!
items.description_ja: Catch exotic fish and fight comical sea-monsters as you chase after The One That Got Away in this fishing-centric boss rush!
items.title: Bait & Tackle

items.description: Trapped in a sinking submarine, two players must communicate through walkie-talkies to solve puzzles, complete tasks, navigate the depths, and escape before time runs out.
items.description_ja: Trapped in a sinking submarine, two players must communicate through walkie-talkies to solve puzzles, complete tasks, navigate the depths, and escape before time runs out.
items.title: Sync Or Sink

items.description: Go Ape Ship! is a frantic co-op multiplayer game for one to eight players. Work with your crew of daring Astrochimps to master an expanding collection of tasks, respond to emergencies, unlock new rooms and upgrades for your spaceship, and safely reach the stars. Survive together. Or not at all.
items.description_ja: Go Ape Ship!「ゴー・エイプ・シップ 」は、1人から8人で遊べるハチャメチャな協力型マルチプレイヤーゲームです。勇敢なアストロチンプのクルーと協力して、次々と増えるタスクをこなし、緊急事態に対応しましょう。宇宙船の新しい部屋やアップグレードをアンロックして、星を目指して安全に航行してください。みんなで生き残るか…それとも全滅か。
items.title: Go Ape Ship!

items.description: A bite-sized psychological horror game about a wayward soul who seeks transformation through a sinister ritual.
items.description_ja: A bite-sized psychological horror game about a wayward soul who seeks transformation through a sinister ritual.
items.title: Channel 4 Midnight

items.description:
One holiday, the father Haruma came to the park with his daughter Naori.
But in that park, strange things began to happen—.
Carry out the holiday mission “Playing House” for your beloved daughter!
items.description_ja:
休日、父親・春馬は娘のなおりと公園にやってきた。
しかし、その公園で異様なことが起き始める——。
可愛い娘のために休日任務「おままごと」を遂行せよ！
items.title: Playing House

items.description:
Letherfall is a first-person horror video game with Lovecraftian elements: the player must make their way through monstrous entities and intricate puzzles while exploring the abandoned village of Letherfall.
Some nightmares don’t fade. They’re just waiting for you to open the wrong door.
items.description_ja: 『Letherfall』は、ラブクラフト的な要素を取り入れた一人称視点のホラーゲームです。プレイヤーは、廃村となったレザーフォールを探索しながら、怪物の群れや複雑なパズルを乗り越えていかなければなりません。悪夢の中には、決して消え去らないものもあります。それらは、あなたが間違った扉を開けるのをただ待ち構えているのです。
items.title: Letherfall

items.description: Spend one last afternoon exploring your childhood neighborhood before the world ends at 6:38 PM.
items.description_ja: Spend one last afternoon exploring your childhood neighborhood before the world ends at 6:38 PM.
items.title: Eternal Afternoon

items.description: A story-driven psychological horror game where you must balance cooking authentic Vietnamese Pho with surviving chilling, unexpected events in a quiet, mysterious village.
items.description_ja: A story-driven psychological horror game where you must balance cooking authentic Vietnamese Pho with surviving chilling, unexpected events in a quiet, mysterious village.
items.title: Brother Hai's Pho Restaurant

items.description:
The roads are comfortably quiet at night. The only sound to keep you company is the medical equipment rattling behind you. You turn on the radio, but instead of music you hear a growl behind you. A strange being has appeared in the back, eyes pleading for help.

It reminds you of someone.
items.description_ja:
The roads are comfortably quiet at night. The only sound to keep you company is the medical equipment rattling behind you. You turn on the radio, but instead of music you hear a growl behind you. A strange being has appeared in the back, eyes pleading for help.

It reminds you of someone.
items.title: Stay With Me

items.description: An existential horror game in which you are tasked with keeping a sleeper colony ship intact. No enemies or NPCs share the ship with you - only creaking metal echoes and endless dark. Overcome random events, system failures, and the downward spiral of your sanity to see your mission through.
items.description_ja: An existential horror game in which you are tasked with keeping a sleeper colony ship intact. No enemies or NPCs share the ship with you - only creaking metal echoes and endless dark. Overcome random events, system failures, and the downward spiral of your sanity to see your mission through.
items.title: Endless Dark

items.description: A bomb-throwing rabbit defends her floating fortress from her former friend turned foe.
items.description_ja: かつての友から空中要塞を守れ！　ボム投げウサギの爆裂爽快3Dジャンプアクション！
items.title: Bombun

items.description: Experience Harry's story of battling multiple personalities and his severe case of schizophrenia. In this First-person horror game, you battle the hallucinations and illusions your mind creates. You misjudge reality and quickly lose control over yourself.
items.description_ja: Experience Harry's story of battling multiple personalities and his severe case of schizophrenia. In this First-person horror game, you battle the hallucinations and illusions your mind creates. You misjudge reality and quickly lose control over yourself.
items.title: Silent Residence

items.description: A large brown shadow lurks in the abandoned factory; the night hides her form.Something terrifyingly massive is concealed within this town.I think of her, and of the days I can never go back to.“KUMASAMA” is a horror adventure set in the present day.
items.description_ja: 廃工場に潜む大きな茶色の影、夜は彼女を隠す。この街には何か恐ろしく巨大な何かが潜んでいる。私は彼女と戻れない日々たちを想う。『KUMASAMA』は現代を舞台にしたホラーアドベンチャーだ。
items.title: KUMASAMA

items.description: This is a short, first-person psychological horror game with VHS effects. Be careful, you are facing a terrifying being.
items.description_ja: これは、VHS風の演出が特徴的な、一人称視点の短編心理ホラーゲームです。恐ろしい存在と対峙することになるため、くれぐれもご注意ください。
items.title: Unwilling Host

items.description: A romantic storm is brewing at Ayanohara Academy! A princely trap and a delinquent one... two unlikely he-iresses are destined to become lovers. Who will sweep the other into the tempest of love first? A cross-dressing yuri VN packed with humor, heart, and outrageous twists!
items.description_ja: 男の娘だらけのお嬢様学園が、恋愛ブームで大混乱！ 王子様系男の娘×ヤンキー系男の娘、最も似つかわしくない二人が恋人に！ はたして、メス堕ちするのはどっちだ！？――あなたの価値観を粉砕する女装百合ノベルゲーム。波乱に次ぐ波乱の『嵐の章』！
items.title: Trap Yuri Tempest

items.description: Fight through a moving train in a stylish rhythm-combat boss rush where timed four-button inputs become your attacks. Defeat absurd bosses, survive relationship chaos, and help August Wiseman get his phone back.
items.description_ja: Fight through a moving train in a stylish rhythm-combat boss rush where timed four-button inputs become your attacks. Defeat absurd bosses, survive relationship chaos, and help August Wiseman get his phone back.
items.title: Wiseman: No More Breakups

items.description: Defend the Oval Office from an endless alien invasion by harnessing the abilities of your favorite (or least favorite) U.S. Presidents.
items.description_ja: Defend the Oval Office from an endless alien invasion by harnessing the abilities of your favorite (or least favorite) U.S. Presidents.
items.title: Presidents Tower Defense

items.description: You are wetware, working a mysterious job.
items.description_ja: You are wetware, working a mysterious job.
items.title: PAGER

items.description: Team up with up to 8 players and take on endless waves of Nasty Zombies in a high-intensity, movement-focused boomer shooter. Use agility and smart positioning to survive semi-procedural maps and unlock permanent upgrades like Blessings, Miracles, Invocations, and cosmetics.
items.description_ja: Team up with up to 8 players and take on endless waves of Nasty Zombies in a high-intensity, movement-focused boomer shooter. Use agility and smart positioning to survive semi-procedural maps and unlock permanent upgrades like Blessings, Miracles, Invocations, and cosmetics.
items.title: Nasty Zombies

items.description:
In the magical land of Marsia, the most important day in the last 1000 years is approaching - the election of a new ruler! You have to vote for the right candidate or you will be sent to the front to fight for the survival of the great empire!
Immerse yourself in a wonderful world with your shotgun!
items.description_ja:
In the magical land of Marsia, the most important day in the last 1000 years is approaching - the election of a new ruler! You have to vote for the right candidate or you will be sent to the front to fight for the survival of the great empire!
Immerse yourself in a wonderful world with your shotgun!
items.title: GOSDOOMA

items.description: A medieval mystery, 4 to 12 players, where villagers scheme and werewolves hunt. Sharpen your wits, trust no one, and see who makes it through the night.
items.description_ja: 3～11人で遊べる中世ミステリー。昼は村人たちが策略を練り、夜には人狼が狩りを行う。知恵を絞り、誰も信用せず、夜を生き延びる者は誰か？
items.title: Werewolf Party

items.description: A 3D linear collect-a-thon platformer about a frog. Collect golden flies, unlock new worlds, and interact with a variety of mechanics and powerups. Finally, discover what lies behind the great gate.
items.description_ja: カエルを主人公にした3Dリニアコレクト・ア・ソン・プラットフォームゲーム。金色のハエを集め、新たな世界をアンロックし、様々なメカニクスやパワーアップを駆使して、ついに大門の向こうに何があるのかを解き明かしましょう。
items.title: Sapo 3D

items.description: Raise Your Own Ghost Girl+Deckbuilding+Zuma-Style Match-3!Exorcism Agency is an innovative roguelike that finds joy in thrills.Ghosts are back,the human world is like hell,and you,as a top-tier exorcist,will venture into ghost-infested zones,using all kinds of mystical techniques to capture ghosts
items.description_ja: 女鬼育成＋デッキ構築＋ズーマ三消！『除霊事務所』は、スリルを楽しむ新感覚ローグライク。怪異復活、人間界は地獄。君は除霊師として女鬼の巣窟を探索し、法術で悪霊を制し、奇怪な事件を生き延びれば――後宮が開かれる！
items.title: Exorcism Agency

items.description:
Speak not of love untouched by passion's fire, as it's a torturous journey.
 If lovers would remain faithful evermore,On Peony Pavilion’s road they’ll meet for three lives more.
Paper Bride 7: Lethal Bond is a Chinese horror puzzle game, and the 7th title of the Paper Bride series.
items.description_ja:
風流無き者語る勿れ 渺渺たるや情の一字
相思い合い背かずは 二世の契り結ばれん
『紙装束7 死の絆』は中国民俗怪談アドベンチャーゲーム『紙装束』シリーズの第7作目です。
今回は新たな主人公とともに、謎に満ちた両間口村で恋人の魂を探し求めます。物語の中には『紙装束3 愛の咎』の申墨卿や王娇彤、他にも懐かしの人物が多く登場します。
items.title: Paper Bride 7 Lethal Bond

items.description: You’ve been trapped in a school by a mysterious God. Memorize your surroundings, spot the anomalies, and reach floor 0 to earn your escape.
items.description_ja: 謎めいた神によって学校に閉じ込められた。 周囲を覚え、異常を見つけ、0階に到達して脱出しよう。
items.title: Last Term

items.description: Let your girlfriend know (or not) about the culprit who ate her ice cream.
items.description_ja: 彼女のアイスを食べた犯人、正直に言う？ それとも黙ってる？
items.title: The Ice Cream Culprit

items.description: A horror-meets-cute puzzle game with a twist-filled Yuri romance story.
items.description_ja: A horror-meets-cute puzzle game with a twist-filled Yuri romance story.
items.title: The Angel's Devil Tail - One More Question 2

items.description: In this game, you’ll encounter puzzles which require you to use your environment in order to solve them. Take note of every detail, they can help you in uncovering Sofia’s story.
items.description_ja: In this game, you’ll encounter puzzles which require you to use your environment in order to solve them. Take note of every detail, they can help you in uncovering Sofia’s story.
items.title: Murmurs of the Mist

items.description: A short, linear story game of a random demon guy's life.
items.description_ja: A short, linear story game of a random demon guy's life.
items.title: Everyday Devil

items.description: A short incremental relaxing game about fishing across diverse ocean biomes and upgrading your ship.
items.description_ja: A short incremental relaxing game about fishing across diverse ocean biomes and upgrading your ship.
items.title: Incremental Fishing

items.description: Your wife is dead, but you can hear her voice on the phone. Follow the coordinates, explore abandoned locations, answer calls from the phone booth, and make your way deeper and deeper into the abyss. Every new call brings you closer to the truth... but you may not be ready to hear it.
items.description_ja: 妻は死んだ。それでも電話から彼女の声が聞こえる。座標を追い、廃墟を探索し、電話ボックスからの着信に応え、深淵へと進め。新たな電話が鳴るたび、あなたは真実へ近づいていく……だが、それを聞く準備はできていないかもしれない。
items.title: Five Signals

items.description: Tidy Up meets NPC Management Sim in a co-optional Horror setting. Every tape is a real-time voiced article from the official fandom wikis. Learn about the backrooms whilst tidying the backrooms! Transform a chaotic mess into a neatly organized archive. But be careful - you are not alone!
items.description_ja: バックルーム（The Backrooms）から回収されたビデオテープを仕分ける整理整頓シミュレーター。奇妙な映像を見つけ、アノマリーを分類し、不穏な秘密を暴きながら、混沌とした山を整然としたアーカイブへと変えていこう。ただし気をつけて――普通のビデオとは違う振る舞いをする記録もある…
items.title: Tidy Up The Backrooms

items.description: Game Keeper: Somebody Messed Up My Shop! is a single-player organizing game set in a chaotic video game store. Sort 4,290 cases by genre and order, fill 96 racks, progress and unlock powerful abilities, and complete 650 parody-filled series - with questionable help from Jeff, the coolest cat ever.
items.description_ja: 『Game Keeper: Somebody Messed Up My Shop!』は、大混乱に陥ったゲームショップを舞台にしたシングルプレイの整理整頓ゲーム。4,290個のゲームケースをジャンルと順番どおりに並べ、96台の棚を埋め、強力なスキルを解放し、650のパロディシリーズをコンプリートしよう。宇宙一クールな猫 Jeff の、きわめて怪しい手助け付きで。
items.title: Game Keeper: Somebody Messed Up My Shop!

items.description: Play as a Turtle and duke it out in a game of Football. Use your gun to fly around the field or even shoot the ball.
items.description_ja: Play as a Turtle and duke it out in a game of Football. Use your gun to fly around the field or even shoot the ball.
items.title: Turtle Champs

items.description: You’ve wandered into a strange dimension while shopping.A mysterious monster is chasing you.You must escape."Backmooms" is a first-person adventure game.
items.description_ja: あなたは買い物の途中で異質な空間に迷い込んでしまった。謎の怪物があなたを追いかけてくる。この場所から脱出しなければならない。『Backmooms』は１人称視点のアドベンチャーゲームです。
items.title: Backmooms

items.description: You are John Appleby, game historian. Your shadow twin "Evil John" has been doing some evil business and is causing genres to collide! Only you have the power to restore peace and save gaming...
items.description_ja: 君はジョン・アップルビーというゲーム歴史家だ。君の影の双子である「エビル・ジョン」が悪しき行動をふるまい、様々なゲームジャンルを合体させている！この状況から平和を取り戻し、ゲーム世界を救うことができるのは君一人なのだ...
items.title: John's Quest

items.description: BANG! BANG! Totally Accurate Redneck Simulator is a silly and super tough physics based shooter puzzler in which you attempt to help a drunken redneck hit targets without accidentally shooting himself with a ricochet.
items.description_ja: BANG! BANG! Totally Accurate Redneck Simulator is a silly and super tough physics based shooter puzzler in which you attempt to help a drunken redneck hit targets without accidentally shooting himself with a ricochet.
items.title: BANG! BANG! Totally Accurate Redneck Simulator

items.description: Ready to play some ball? Grab a team, suit up, and climb inside your human! Prep its thrusters, lower the all-terrain wheels, and spin up that flailing magnet-arm. It's time to play Regular Human Basketball!
items.description_ja: Ready to play some ball? Grab a team, suit up, and climb inside your human! Prep its thrusters, lower the all-terrain wheels, and spin up that flailing magnet-arm. It's time to play Regular Human Basketball!
items.title: Regular Human Basketball

items.description: Explore the dungeons Below the Crown, in this love letter to Roguelikes, Dungeon Crawlers, and Chess. Prepare for strategy, game-changing spells, psychological tests, and challenges from your fellow players. From the award-winning creators of Duskers & A Virus Named TOM.
items.description_ja: 斬新な戦略ローグライクチェスゲーム『Below the Crown』の世界に飛び込み、地下に広がるダンジョンを探索せよ。奥深い戦略、ゲームを一変させる魔法、心理テスト、そして、他のプレイヤーからの挑戦が待ち受けている。
items.title: Below the Crown

items.description: A dark lesbian horror/romance story so toxic it's emitting spores. Ethel, a shy university student, ventures into the wintry woods late at night, where she meets an enchanting femme fatale — but all is not as it seems.
items.description_ja: A dark lesbian horror/romance story so toxic it's emitting spores. Ethel, a shy university student, ventures into the wintry woods late at night, where she meets an enchanting femme fatale — but all is not as it seems.
items.title: Her Love, Like Poison

items.description: Fragments of Dread is an episodic psychological horror series. Each episode tells a self-contained story of dread, fear, and survival.
items.description_ja: Fragments of Dread はエピソード形式の心理ホラーシリーズです。各エピソードは恐怖とサバイバルの独立した物語を描きます。
items.title: Fragments of Dread - False Haven

items.description: Play as the ancient automaton Cecilia Immergreen as you explore the world for secrets, solve puzzles, delve into dungeons, fight other Hololive members as powerful bosses, help other members with side quests, and find powerful items to explore previously unavailable locations.
items.description_ja:
古代自動人形「セシリア・イマーグリーン」となって世界を冒険しよう。
ダンジョンの謎を解き、ボスとして立ちはだかるメンバーたちと対決せよ！サイドクエストで仲間を助け、強力なアイテムを手に入れ、未踏の地への道を切り拓け。
items.title: An Automaton's Journey

items.description: Can you tell the difference between truth and tale? Experience three short horror stories and gather clues as to which are true and which are just part of our imagination. Immerse yourself in the protagonist's perspective and discover eerie tales from around the world.
items.description_ja: あなたは現実と作り話の違いを見分けることができますか？3つの短いホラーストーリーを体験し、どれが真実で、どれが単なる想像の一部なのかについての手がかりを集めてください。主人公の視点に没入し、世界中の不気味な物語を発見しましょう。
items.title: Tales of Fear - Episode Zero

items.description: The factory chip began to malfunction. Your horrible headaches don’t bother anyone in this dystopian world. “Black Whale”, the attractive white powder, is the only thing that can stop the pain. And show you the life without the horrors of harsh reality.
items.description_ja: The factory chip began to malfunction. Your horrible headaches don’t bother anyone in this dystopian world. “Black Whale”, the attractive white powder, is the only thing that can stop the pain. And show you the life without the horrors of harsh reality.
items.title: The Black Whale

items.description: Explore a frozen, mysterious land in this top-down survival adventure. Gather resources, craft tools, and fight to stay alive as you uncover a story of memory and redemption. Try to escape The Hollow.
items.description_ja: 氷に閉ざされた謎の地を探索するトップダウン型サバイバルアドベンチャー。資源を集め、道具を作り、記憶と贖罪の物語を解き明かしながら生き延びろ。Hollow からの脱出を試みよう。
items.title: ANGST: A TALE OF SURVIVAL

items.description:
"イカスミ"でポーションをつくる！？
怪しいポーション屋さんのイカ『スミミ』と共に、
個性豊かな人外キャラクター達にポーションを売るアドベンチャーゲーム！
items.description_ja:
"イカスミ"でポーションをつくる！？
怪しいポーション屋さんのイカ『スミミ』と共に、
個性豊かな人外キャラクター達にポーションを売るアドベンチャーゲーム！
items.title: イカスミポーション

items.description: Beth returns to her estranged sister’s house in 1963. Explore chilling, richly detailed levels, solve puzzles, and uncover haunting family secrets. Face intense scares and heart-pounding chases, with your choice shaping multiple endings.
items.description_ja: Beth returns to her estranged sister’s house in 1963. Explore chilling, richly detailed levels, solve puzzles, and uncover haunting family secrets. Face intense scares and heart-pounding chases, with your choice shaping multiple endings.
items.title: Claire

items.description: Manage your very own comic book store! You can unlock over 70+ unique comic licenses, each having 5 volumes for you to sell to your customers! Upgrade your tools, hire staffs, and expand your store so you can have the best comic book store in the world!
items.description_ja: 自分だけのコミックブックストアを経営しよう！70種類以上のユニークな作品をアンロック可能。各シリーズ全5巻をお客さんに販売できます。設備を強化し、スタッフを雇って店を大きくし、世界一のコミックストアを目指そう！
items.title: Comic Book Store Simulator

items.description: A long-form, choice-driven psychological horror and depression game in which the protagonist’s ending changes based on the choices made by “you,” the voice he hears in his head.
items.description_ja:
主人公の幻聴である「あなた」の選択によって、
主人公の結末が変わるサイコホラー長編選択型鬱ゲーム
items.title: YAMIKKO TROUBLEMAKER

items.description:
Virtual group - PLAVE doujin game, set against the backdrop of winter school ghost stories.
Experience the Night Patrol Rules of the Seven Mysteries through the eyes of all five band members, uncovering the unsettling truth hidden behind the mystery through your investigation and choices.
items.description_ja:
Virtual group - PLAVE doujin game, set against the backdrop of winter school ghost stories.
Experience the Night Patrol Rules of the Seven Mysteries through the eyes of all five band members, uncovering the unsettling truth hidden behind the mystery through your investigation and choices.
items.title: Night Patrol Rules

items.description: After a sudden rent hike, you move into a suspiciously cheap house deep in the woods. The price is absurdly low and there’s work nearby-it seems like a stroke of luck. But you soon realize something is seriously wrong with the place...
items.description_ja: 家賃が急に上がったため、森の奥にある驚くほど安い家へ引っ越すことになった。破格の家賃に職場も近い——幸運だと思ったが、まもなくこの家には何かおかしいところがあると気づく…。
items.title: Coincidences?

items.description: Face your fears in realistic VR spelunking. Explore fictional and real-life caves recreated in VR, including the infamous Nutty Putty cave guided by a real-life rescuer. Tackle steep climbs and narrow tunnels with physical tools and authentic techniques.
items.description_ja: リアルなVR洞窟探検で恐怖に挑め。VRで再現された架空・実在の洞窟を探索。悪名高いナッティ・パティ洞窟も収録され、現役の救助隊員がガイド。物理ツールと本格的な技術を駆使し、険しい崖や極狭の通路を攻略しよう。
items.title: Cave Crave VR

items.description: "A taste of home" is a short 3D exploration horror game set in the Japanese countryside.
items.description_ja: 『いえのあじ A taste of home』は日本の田舎町を舞台にした、短編の3D探索ホラーゲームです。
items.title: A taste of home

items.description: Tidy Up History is a cozy cleaning sim where you inherit a chaotic museum. Tidy messy rooms, unlock new abilities, and find hidden keys to open new wings. Uncover historical knowledge to properly identify and showcase artifacts, returning the museum to its former glory.
items.description_ja: Tidy Up History は、散らかった博物館を受け継いで再建していく、癒やし系のお片付けシミュレーションゲームです。乱雑な展示室を整理し、新たな能力を解放しながら、隠された鍵を見つけて新しいエリアを開放しましょう。歴史の知識を学び、遺物を正しく鑑定・展示して、博物館をかつての栄光へと取り戻してください。
items.title: Tidy Up History

items.description: Bunn awakens in a surreal world with no memories of what happened. Bunny Hop through this colorful surreal landscape, explore hidden locations, and uncover the troubling truth about your identity in this 3D platformer.
items.description_ja: Bunn awakens in a surreal world with no memories of what happened. Bunny Hop through this colorful surreal landscape, explore hidden locations, and uncover the troubling truth about your identity in this 3D platformer.
items.title: FUNKYHEART

items.description: Your girlfriend’s sleepwalking is getting worse each night. Find her and bring her back to bed safely.
items.description_ja: Your girlfriend’s sleepwalking is getting worse each night. Find her and bring her back to bed safely.
items.title: My Sleeping Girlfriend

items.description: Tomb of the Bloodletter is a strategic word roguelike where your keyboard becomes your arsenal. Use your wit to unleash deadly words through tactical combinations of your letters to defeat the denizens of this dingy tomb and claim the Bloodletter for yourself...
items.description_ja: Tomb of the Bloodletter is a strategic word roguelike where your keyboard becomes your arsenal. Use your wit to unleash deadly words through tactical combinations of your letters to defeat the denizens of this dingy tomb and claim the Bloodletter for yourself...
items.title: Tomb of the Bloodletter

items.description: An open-world exploration, puzzle game made from my 4-year-old daughter's drawings. Step into a vibrant, hand-drawn world and help the princess find all her magical candies.
items.description_ja: 4歳の娘の絵から生まれた、オープンワールド探索型パズルゲーム。色鮮やかで手描きの世界に足を踏み入れ、プリンセスがすべての魔法のキャンディを見つける手助けをしましょう。
items.title: Odd Dorable

items.description: A hilarious and weird hand-drawn 2D point-and-click comedy adventure game where you're Bru on a ridiculous quest to get milk for your morning coffee.
items.description_ja: A hilarious and weird hand-drawn 2D point-and-click comedy adventure game where you're Bru on a ridiculous quest to get milk for your morning coffee.
items.title: Bru & Boegie: Episode 1 - Get da MILK!

items.description:
Not that far away, in a galaxy…

A diner with questionable hygiene, bubbling with dark secrets and darker humor, in the middle of cosmic nothingness.

Welcome to Space Savory. Don’t be fooled by appearances, the best flavor in the universe is cooked right here.

(Only within the observable part.)
items.description_ja:
それほど遠くない銀河で...
衛生状態が疑わしいダイナー、暗い秘密とブラックユーモアに満ち、宇宙の虚無の中心にあります。
Space Savoryへようこそ。見た目に騙されないでください — 宇宙で最高の味がここで調理されています。
(観測可能な部分のみ。)
items.title: Space Savory

items.description: Survive. Run. Look for answers.
items.description_ja: Survive. Run. Look for answers.
items.title: Jeff The Killer: Horror Game

items.description: Fight through procedurally generated levels - from haunted dungeons to futuristic space stations. Choose from 14 unique characters, crush your enemies, gather loot, face deadly bosses, and return to a growing village hub where permanent upgrades await. The demons watch. The angels wait. You fight.
items.description_ja: 自動生成されるステージを戦い抜けよ - 呪われたダンジョンから未来的な宇宙ステーションまで。14人のユニークなキャラクターから選び、敵を粉砕し、戦利品を集め、致命的なボスに挑め。勝利の後は拡大していく村に戻り、永続的な強化を手に入れよう。悪魔は見つめ、天使は待つ。戦うのはお前だ。
items.title: Gah!

items.description:
"Do you think a house can dream?"

Ritual Static is a surreal first-person photography horror game following a young man in his childhood home the day before a big move. 

Surf the television, sink into static, and rot in the dark.
items.description_ja:
"Do you think a house can dream?"

Ritual Static is a surreal first-person photography horror game following a young man in his childhood home the day before a big move. 

Surf the television, sink into static, and rot in the dark.
items.title: Ritual Static

items.description: The first live-action visual novel with an anime flair! Gamer 'Eggy' turns into a girl. Join bro Monkey and his gf to uncover why the school belle hides a tough guy soul. Seek a cure or embrace your new life. Your choice drives this adventure!
items.description_ja: The first live-action visual novel with an anime flair! Gamer 'Eggy' turns into a girl. Join bro Monkey and his gf to uncover why the school belle hides a tough guy soul. Seek a cure or embrace your new life. Your choice drives this adventure!
items.title: Ballshit

items.description: 2 Bows 1 Arrow is a true co-op adventure for 2 players! You can test the strength of your connection on numerous levels by shooting a bow, BUT you share ONE arrow for TWO. Levels that require coordination of actions and logic to defeat enemis and solve numerous puzzles, await you.
items.description_ja: 『2 Bows 1 Arrow』は、2人用の本格的な協力型アドベンチャーゲームです！弓を射るという共通のアクションを通じて、数多くのステージで二人の絆を試すことができますが、矢はたった1本しかありません。敵を倒し、数々のパズルを解くためには、息の合った連携と論理的思考が求められるステージが、あなたを待っています。
items.title: 2 Bows 1 Arrow

items.description: Blend fragrances in your cozy perfume atelier! 🌸 Craft unique scents by mixing essences, design beautiful bottles, and try to sell your creations to curious customers. Decorate your workshop, unlock new recipes, and grow your reputation in the art of fragrance.
items.description_ja: 香水工房へようこそ！プレイヤーは調香師として、小さな癒やしの香水店を経営する。お客を持て成し、香水を調合し、パッケージをデザインして販売。お店をアップグレードしながら新たなレシピを解放していく。ここでは香りを通して物語や感情を紡ぎ、穏やかで安らかな調香のひと時を過ごせる。
items.title: Perfume Atelier

items.description: Vice Signalling is a short narrative game where you infiltrate a secret society of the rich and powerful. Decipher secret signals and use them to uncover a conspiracy against the Emperor.
items.description_ja: Vice Signalling is a short narrative game where you infiltrate a secret society of the rich and powerful. Decipher secret signals and use them to uncover a conspiracy against the Emperor.
items.title: Vice Signalling

items.description: You are shopping on a major online store when strange listings gradually begin to appear. The more you look into them, the more clearly the whole picture of a crime comes into view…
items.description_ja: 主人公が大手通販サイト『NOROIショッピング』で買い物を楽しんでいると、段々と奇妙な商品たちが並び始める。その商品のことを調べていくと、とある事件の全貌が見えてくる…
items.title: 呪ショッピング

items.description: In The Good Dog: Chasing Shadows, play as a dog defending your family from paranormal creatures. Explore the world and solve environmental puzzles to save your loved ones and uncover the mystery.
items.description_ja: In The Good Dog: Chasing Shadows, play as a dog defending your family from paranormal creatures. Explore the world and solve environmental puzzles to save your loved ones and uncover the mystery.
items.title: The Good Dog: Chasing Shadows

items.description: Restore an abandoned post office by order of the Royal Postal Academy! Welcome customers, send packages, hire cute little roach-workers and pass Inspectors’ checks in an incredibly addictive roguelite puzzle Roach Post!
items.description_ja: Restore an abandoned post office by order of the Royal Postal Academy! Welcome customers, send packages, hire cute little roach-workers and pass Inspectors’ checks in an incredibly addictive roguelite puzzle Roach Post!
items.title: Roach Post

items.description: Out of curiosity, I’m walking toward the "town where all the residents disappeared." Suddenly, I hear a noise and turn in that direction, just in time to see a small animal scurrying away. That was... a fox! Come to think of it, what sound do foxes make again?"KONKONKON" is an adventure game.
items.description_ja: 不意に物音がする方向を向くと、小動物が走り去るのが見えた。あれは…『キツネ』だ！そういえば、キツネはなんて鳴くんだっけ…？『KONKONKON』はアドベンチャーゲームです。
items.title: KONKONKON

items.description: A psychological horror spin-off of the acclaimed game Claire. You play as Deacon, a man searching for his missing father, but the deeper you dug, the darker the truths you uncovered, secrets you wish you’d never found, and that will haunt you forever.
items.description_ja: A psychological horror spin-off of the acclaimed game Claire. You play as Deacon, a man searching for his missing father, but the deeper you dug, the darker the truths you uncovered, secrets you wish you’d never found, and that will haunt you forever.
items.title: The Butler

items.description: Beneath the shadowed sea of trees below the volcanic mountain lies a mysterious facility probing the afterlife, as omens of the world’s end approach. A loved one missing, reality twisting, a volcano stirring below. Once more you enter the maze, seeking the exit hidden in spectral forest shadows.
items.description_ja: 富士山麓の樹海、来世探究の宗教施設、迫りくる世界終焉の兆候。愛する人の失踪、現実構造の歪曲、そして噴火予兆が蠢く火山深層……。再び迷路へ踏み入り、幽き樹影に潜む深淵の出口を探るほかない。
items.title: Jukai Maze

items.description: A single move to carve a path through blood.Use the information on the grid to avoid, fight, and devour unseen enemies in this Minesweeper-style puzzle adventure.
items.description_ja: 血路を開く一手。グリッドの情報を手掛かりに、見えない敵を避け、戦い、そして喰らうマインスイーパ型パズルアドベンチャー。
items.title: Bloody Grids

items.description:
DEATH MOMOTARO is a ridiculous horror-action comedy game based on the classic Japanese folktale Momotaro. 
Recommended for streamers who are good at witty comebacks!
items.description_ja: 『デス桃太郎』は、日本昔話「桃太郎」をベースにしたホラーアクションコメディです。ツッコミが得意な実況者さんにオススメっす
items.title: Death Momotaro

items.description: Dynamic tower defence with an ever-scaling battlefield and unexpected twists!
items.description_ja: Dynamic tower defence with an ever-scaling battlefield and unexpected twists!
items.title: Yap Wizards Tower Defence

items.description: A trivia quiz set in the middle of the ocean.
items.description_ja: A trivia quiz set in the middle of the ocean.
items.title: Not Sure About That

items.description: Steal donuts to feed your fat cryptid wife or die trying! Donuts for Deer Teeth is a top-down, roguelite brawler where your only goal is to steal whatever you can get your grubby little raccoon paws on before shoving it in the face of some weird deer-faced skull thing.
items.description_ja: Steal donuts to feed your fat cryptid wife or die trying! Donuts for Deer Teeth is a top-down, roguelite brawler where your only goal is to steal whatever you can get your grubby little raccoon paws on before shoving it in the face of some weird deer-faced skull thing.
items.title: Donuts for Deer Teeth

items.description:
Join the Crafting Club, where the glue is strong and the feelings stronger!
Craft chaos, flirt fearlessly, and make some very bad romantic decisions!
Find your project partner in this elimination-based Dating Sim!
items.description_ja:
Join the Crafting Club, where the glue is strong and the feelings stronger!
Craft chaos, flirt fearlessly, and make some very bad romantic decisions!
Find your project partner in this elimination-based Dating Sim!
items.title: Love Craft

items.description: A unique puzzle-adventure set in the secret YogLabs research facility. As a newly created clone, you’ll face a series of challenges while disaster threatens to consume the laboratory.
items.description_ja: A unique puzzle-adventure set in the secret YogLabs research facility. As a newly created clone, you’ll face a series of challenges while disaster threatens to consume the laboratory.
items.title: YogLabs: Testing Initiative

items.description: Your blind date invades Earth!?
items.description_ja: Your blind date invades Earth!?
items.title: Love Limit

items.description: A goofy party game built for weekend sessions, online play with friends, or couch co-op with your partner. No fiddly controls: just use your voice to herd the ducks to the finish line and you win. Or watch one badly timed yell send the whole hapless flock straight off a cliff.
items.description_ja: 週末に友達と遊ぶ、協力プレイを楽しむ、カップルでも盛り上がれる、おバカ系パーティーゲームです。複雑な操作は一切不要。マイクに向かって声を出し、ダックたちをゴールへ導くだけのシンプルなゲームです。――ただし、誰かの大声ひとつで、ダックたちが崖へ落ちてしまうこともあるので注意しましょう。
items.title: Quack Quack Up

items.description: The Skin Stapler is a retro-styled PSX grindhouse horror adventure set in the rotting, crime-soaked sprawl of Carrion City. Players follow jaded detective Dick Slater and his eager rookie partner Robbie Knox as they hunt a mysterious serial killer known only as The Skin Stapler.
items.description_ja: The Skin Stapler is a retro-styled PSX grindhouse horror adventure set in the rotting, crime-soaked sprawl of Carrion City. Players follow jaded detective Dick Slater and his eager rookie partner Robbie Knox as they hunt a mysterious serial killer known only as The Skin Stapler.
items.title: The Skin Stapler

items.description: Pluck them. Pluck them all. You are an Australian Magpie on a mission. That mission: Spread havoc, cause mayhem, and grab the occasional unattended piece of food. Menace, rob, and terrify humans, enjoying old-school action arcade gameplay rendered in glorious retro PS2 graphics.
items.description_ja: Pluck them. Pluck them all. You are an Australian Magpie on a mission. That mission: Spread havoc, cause mayhem, and grab the occasional unattended piece of food. Menace, rob, and terrify humans, enjoying old-school action arcade gameplay rendered in glorious retro PS2 graphics.
items.title: Pie in the Sky

items.description: A cozy idle aquarium overlay that brings your desktop to life with pixel-art fish. You can hatch, breed, and collect fishes in thousands of genetic combinations. Dress them up with accessories, watch them grow from eggs to adults, and unlock playful upgrades through a skill tree.
items.description_ja: ちょっと疲れた時は、魚を育てて癒されてみよう。仕事や勉強、ゲームの合間に、自分だけのピクセル水族館をのんびり作っていく。個性に満ちた魚が、なんと千種類以上。飾って、エサをあげて、マウスひとつでふれあいも。難しいことはいっさいなし。デスクトップに広がる、水の世界を楽しもう！
items.title: Desktop Fishes

items.description: An incremental dino-park builder where every exhibit is stolen from the past. Send scientists on time-travel raids, capture prehistoric beasts, and grow a money-printing park through upgrades, research and the occasional carnivore breakout.
items.description_ja: 時を超えて恐竜を捕獲し、利益に変えろ。混沌としたミッションを指揮し、太古の生物を確保し、究極の恐竜パークを築き上げよう。研究、アップグレード、そして災害管理まですべては科学と自由市場のために。
items.title: Dino Time Raiders

items.description: the cabin game is a 1-4 player, chaotic horror game where you are trapped inside a cabin and the only way out is through a game of cards. Just beware, as the cards you play have a surprising twist on this humble abode...
items.description_ja: the cabin game is a 1-4 player, chaotic horror game where you are trapped inside a cabin and the only way out is through a game of cards. Just beware, as the cards you play have a surprising twist on this humble abode...
items.title: the cabin game

items.description: Trapped in a mysterious space shrouded in an unsettling atmosphere, a unknown presence creeps up from behind— "it" doesn't move while you're watching. But the moment you look away, it closes in without a sound. Can you escape "it" and find your way out of this enigmatic space?
items.description_ja: 不気味な雰囲気に包まれた謎の空間の中、背後から迫る謎の存在—— "それ" はあなたが見ている間は動かない。しかし、一瞬でも目を離せば、音もなく近づいてくる。あなたは "それ" から逃げ切り、謎の空間から脱出することはできるのか。

items.description: Don’t get caught farting in the meeting! In this stealth-comedy game, you must strategically vent your mounting "pressure" by timing farts around office distractions.
items.description_ja: Don’t get caught farting in the meeting! In this stealth-comedy game, you must strategically vent your mounting "pressure" by timing farts around office distractions.
items.title: The Great Release

items.description: The Quiet Flat is a first-person psychological horror game set in an atmospheric Soviet apartment. Uncover the mystery of your father’s death as your familiar home slowly transforms into a nightmare
items.description_ja: The Quiet Flatは、雰囲気あふれるソ連時代のアパートを舞台にした一人称視点のサイコロジカルホラーです。父親の死に隠された謎を解き明かし、見慣れたはずのアパートが徐々に悪夢へと変わっていく様子を目の当たりにしてください。
items.title: The Quiet Flat

items.description: Bring light to the darkness as you color each scene by finding over 1200 hidden objects across 12 levels in the Spooky Village!
