Discover heroic feline hunters of spooky creatures, collect special cards, unlock bonus levels, and explore haunting yet cozy locations filled with mystery and charm.
items.description_ja: Bring light to the darkness as you color each scene by finding over 1200 hidden objects across 12 levels in the Spooky Village! Discover heroic feline hunters of spooky creatures, collect special cards, unlock bonus levels, and explore haunting yet cozy locations filled with mystery and charm.
items.title: Hidden Cats in Spooky Village

items.description: Carnival is an atmospheric folk horror point-&-click featuring low-resolution pixel art graphics, locations drawn from Venice itself, and developing relationships with NPCs, allowing the player to influence events in the game and achieve multiple different endings.
items.description_ja: Carnival is an atmospheric folk horror point-&-click featuring low-resolution pixel art graphics, locations drawn from Venice itself, and developing relationships with NPCs, allowing the player to influence events in the game and achieve multiple different endings.
items.title: Carnival

items.description: A farm and shop simulator featuring adult goods - alcohol, tobacco, energy drinks, and more. Play as a raccoon living in a trailer park full of outcasts, thugs, and a few charming, friendly neighbors.
items.description_ja: あなたはクールなアライグマ。アウトサイダーたちが集まるトレーラーパークで暮らしている。そして、自分の裏ビジネスを展開中。違法な品物を製造・販売しながら、生計を立てている。ゴミ箱を漁ることもできるが、デメリットは？…そんなもの、あるのか？
items.title: Trailer Park Tycoon: Raccoon Ranch

items.description: Step into the boots of Major Axel Vex in this survival horror descent into deep space. You embark on a mission to investigate a distress signal coming from Cengona Base. What starts off as a simple mission quickly turns into a terrifying, action-packed fight for survival.
items.description_ja: 暗闇に包まれた宇宙基地でウイルスが静かに拡散し、残された物資は少しずつ枯渇する。荒涼とした静寂の通路では未知生物が全ての生命を屠り尽くそうとしている。君は終焉の啓示者であり、事件の真相を解き明かす最後の希望だ。調査員ヴェックス少佐、君の任務はただ一つ――生き延びることだ！
items.title: HELL OF FEAR: Mind Breach

items.description: Welcome to Kimochii Classroom! A slice-of-life visual novel with stunning visuals, a beautiful soundtrack, and an immersive story. Who will you meet first?
items.description_ja: Welcome to Kimochii Classroom! A slice-of-life visual novel with stunning visuals, a beautiful soundtrack, and an immersive story. Who will you meet first?
items.title: Kimochii Classroom

items.description: A cute and comedic yuri visual novel about a demon queen who just can't catch a break.
items.description_ja: A cute and comedic yuri visual novel about a demon queen who just can't catch a break.
items.title: The Demon Queen's Dire Dilemma

items.description: An FMV horror-thriller. A famous fitness influencer must fight for survival when she's hunted by killers. Your decisions determine whether she lives or dies.
items.description_ja: ＦＭＶスリラー。有名なフィットネスのインフルエンサーが殺人鬼に追われ生存を賭け戦う。プレーヤーの選択で彼女が生き残れるか死を迎えてしまうのか決まる。
items.title: The Run

items.description: You are locked inside a cinema. Your only way to escape is to follow the instructions of your task: Watch the same film clip repeatedly and search for flaws to break free. But this may sound easier than it is, every wrong decision or death will set you back. So be careful!
items.description_ja: あなたは映画館に閉じ込められた。脱出する唯一の方法は、与えられた任務の指示に従うことだ：同じ映像を繰り返し見て、矛盾点を探し出せ。しかし、これは思ったより難しい。間違った判断や死は、あなたを後退させる。気をつけろ！
items.title: One Last Clip

items.description: A hero rescues a princess without violence. Weapon: microphone
items.description_ja: 魔王にさらわれたお姫様を救う勇者。しかし彼は暴力を拒み、武器としてマイクを手にしている。
items.title: Non-violent Hero 非暴力系勇者！

items.description: What, you don’t know Toilet 8 🚽💩? The most immature parody anomaly game ever made? You’re stuck in a loop of public toilets where you must spot what’s wrong each time. Absurd surprises and plenty of poop-fart humor designed to make you laugh.
items.description_ja: え、Toilet 8 🚽💩を知らない？世界一くだらないパロディ系異変ゲーム。公衆トイレのループに閉じ込められ、毎回どこがおかしいかを見抜く。バカバカしい驚きと下品なトイレ系ユーモア満載。
items.title: Toilet 8

items.description: A murky point-and-click puzzle game where a straightforward repair job gets stranger the deeper you go. Solve 2D and 3D puzzles, meet weird characters, and figure out what is happening below the sludge.
items.description_ja: A murky point-and-click puzzle game where a straightforward repair job gets stranger the deeper you go. Solve 2D and 3D puzzles, meet weird characters, and figure out what is happening below the sludge.
items.title: Sludge Department

items.description: JOHN GLEEP is a tiny alien with a big problem. His casino is a failure and he owes the mob a galaxy. Solution? Fly from planet to planet and forcibly abduct gamblers to boost business, pay off your debt, and fix your failed marriage in this unexplainable intergalactic action-roguelike mashup.
items.description_ja: ジョン・グリープは、小さな宇宙人。しかし抱えている問題はとてつもなく大きい。 経営するカジノは大失敗、しかも宇宙マフィアに銀河ひとつ分の借金をしている。解決策は？ 惑星から惑星へ飛び回り、住民たちをさらうことで客を増やし、借金を返済し、そして破綻した結婚生活を立て直すこと。これが何でもありの銀河規模のアクション × ローグライクゲームの組み合わせ！
items.title: JOHN GLEEP

items.description: Rip Current is a horror game set in a cryptic research facility where genetic experiments, in a bid to strengthen aquatic ecosystems, have spiraled out of control. Navigate flooded corridors, uncover the fate of the scientists, and survive the prehistoric apex predators stalking the depths.
items.description_ja: Rip Current is a horror game set in a cryptic research facility where genetic experiments, in a bid to strengthen aquatic ecosystems, have spiraled out of control. Navigate flooded corridors, uncover the fate of the scientists, and survive the prehistoric apex predators stalking the depths.
items.title: Rip Current

items.description: A short, single-player horror action game starring Carl, the suburban house frog. Will you be able to conquer arcade challenges, solve puzzles, and Ribbit and Tear your way back to the life you once knew?
items.description_ja: A short, single-player horror action game starring Carl, the suburban house frog. Will you be able to conquer arcade challenges, solve puzzles, and Ribbit and Tear your way back to the life you once knew?
items.title: Frog Legs

items.description: Blueman — a grim intern simulator set inside a hellish corporation. On each floor, a new mini-game awaits you, reflecting everyday office life.
items.description_ja: Blueman — 地獄のような巨大企業に放り込まれたインターンを描く、ダークなシミュレーター。各フロアごとに、日常のオフィスライフを反映した新しいミニゲームが待っています。
items.title: Blueman

items.description: A psychological interactive novel about a floppy disk with a mysterious program. Help Elliot cope with his mental issues and uncover the secret of the floppy disk.
items.description_ja: A psychological interactive novel about a floppy disk with a mysterious program. Help Elliot cope with his mental issues and uncover the secret of the floppy disk.
items.title: Snowfall's Mystery

items.description: Treasure Hunters: Raid Together is an intense CO-OP treasure-hunting game for up to 4 players, set in mysterious dungeons filled with puzzles, platforms, and deadly creatures, where your goal is to find and steal the most valuable treasures in the world.
items.description_ja: トレジャー・ハンターズ: 共にレイドへは、パズル、プラットフォーム、致命的な生き物でいっぱいの神秘的なダンジョンを舞台に、最も貴重な宝物を見つけて盗むことを目的とした、激しいCO-OP宝探しゲームです。
items.title: Treasure Hunters: Raid Together

items.description:
Fearbonding is a Yandere x Demon BL Horror Visual Novel.
Play as Hinata, a demon, and try to tame the deranged Kosuke. Will you get to satisfy your hunger for fear through your new hunting dog or will you be the one to get devoured?
items.description_ja:
Fearbonding is a Yandere x Demon BL Horror Visual Novel.
Play as Hinata, a demon, and try to tame the deranged Kosuke. Will you get to satisfy your hunger for fear through your new hunting dog or will you be the one to get devoured?
items.title: Fearbonding

items.description: Share the same body with a friend in Split Brain. One of you controls, the other one sees, but the decisions are made together! Face the illusion and uncover the truth to find your way out of Hexarture.
items.description_ja: 友達と同じキャラクターを操作して、「Split Brain」で協力しよう。一方が操作を担当し、もう一方が視覚を担当。しかし、決断は二人で協力して下す！幻影に立ち向かい、真実を明らかにしてHexartureからの脱出を目指そう。
items.title: Split Brain

items.description: Become a sewage disposal worker and help Petrovich cope with all the difficulties of this difficult profession!
items.description_ja: Become a sewage disposal worker and help Petrovich cope with all the difficulties of this difficult profession!
items.title: Assenizator

items.description: A handcrafted two player adventure set in low gravity. Solve intricate asymmetric puzzles and escape Moontella’s extremely profitable slime empire through chaos, laughter, and unforgettable true co-op moments with your partner.
items.description_ja:
低重力の世界を舞台にした、手作り感あふれる2人協力アドベンチャー。
非対称の複雑なパズルを解き明かし、混沌と笑い、そして忘れられない真の協力プレイの瞬間を通じて、パートナーと共にムーンテラ社の超高収益スライム帝国から脱出せよ。
items.title: Together: Moon Escape

items.description: Sneak into an all-girls campus. Talk to girls, complete missions, and don't get caught by the principal. Asymmetrical anime chaos for up to 5 players.
items.description_ja: Sneak into an all-girls campus. Talk to girls, complete missions, and don't get caught by the principal. Asymmetrical anime chaos for up to 5 players.
items.title: School Crisis

items.description: You are a streamer who entered an abandoned building for hype. But the game quickly turns into a real nightmare — the chat and donations influence what’s happening, and you try to survive and understand what’s going on.
items.description_ja: You are a streamer who entered an abandoned building for hype. But the game quickly turns into a real nightmare — the chat and donations influence what’s happening, and you try to survive and understand what’s going on.
items.title: LiveStream: Chapter One

items.description: Spiritus Sancti is a first-person psychological horror where your voice is your weapon. Speak sacred rites through your microphone to repel, stun, and exorcise the forces of darkness. Every encounter is real-time, every word a test of faith. An experience like no other.
items.description_ja: Spiritus Sancti is a first-person psychological horror where your voice is your weapon. Speak sacred rites through your microphone to repel, stun, and exorcise the forces of darkness. Every encounter is real-time, every word a test of faith. An experience like no other.
items.title: Spiritus Sancti

items.description: Rage Quit is a first-person melee game where the player uses only the sledgehammer for combat, traversal, and defense against hordes of office-bots. Use a fluid variety of light, heavy, dash-based, and reflective attacks to smash your way through your foes and enact revenge!
items.description_ja: Rage Quit is a first-person melee game where the player uses only the sledgehammer for combat, traversal, and defense against hordes of office-bots. Use a fluid variety of light, heavy, dash-based, and reflective attacks to smash your way through your foes and enact revenge!
items.title: Rage Quit

items.description: A yuri denpa tale about the cursed pariah of a rural cult, Mercy, and her fateful meeting with the Holy Maiden Auma. Bloody, bold, and bone-chilling, this visual novel explores the complexities of the cycle of abuse and the violence in playing by the rules.
items.description_ja: A yuri denpa tale about the cursed pariah of a rural cult, Mercy, and her fateful meeting with the Holy Maiden Auma. Bloody, bold, and bone-chilling, this visual novel explores the complexities of the cycle of abuse and the violence in playing by the rules.
items.title: soundless - A MODERN SALEM IN REMOTE AREA -

items.description: A slow-burn folk farming horror. You bought an isolated farm to start a new life. Your peaceful routine is shattered when the former owner's terrible secrets rise from beneath the ground.
items.description_ja: あなたは人里離れた農場を買い、新たな生活を始める。しかし、過去の所有者の恐るべき秘密が地の底から蘇り、平穏な日常は崩れ去っていく。ジワジワと盛り上がる田舎ホラー作品。
items.title: Dread Fields

items.description: ZOO PROTOCOL is a co-op sci-fi horror for 1–5 players with a dark story about escaping an abandoned energy facility. Outsmart the system or be scrapped.
items.description_ja: ZOO PROTOCOL is a co-op sci-fi horror for 1–5 players with a dark story about escaping an abandoned energy facility. Outsmart the system or be scrapped.
items.title: Zoo Protocol

items.description: A tiny corgi has moved onto your desktop. Watch it explore your screens, develop needs and moods, and gradually grow into a companion shaped by the way you interact with it.
items.description_ja: 小さなコーギーがあなたのデスクトップにやってきました。画面を冒険し、さまざまな欲求や気分を見せながら、あなたとの触れ合いによって少しずつ個性豊かな相棒へと成長していきます。
items.title: Corgi Corgi Cor!

items.description: All your coworkers are gone and the halls are quiet, except for the pitter-patter of rain on the window. Explore a desolate laboratory as a creature stalks you, always watching. Run and hide as you solve puzzles and learn more about what happened to the facility and its secrets.
items.description_ja: All your coworkers are gone and the halls are quiet, except for the pitter-patter of rain on the window. Explore a desolate laboratory as a creature stalks you, always watching. Run and hide as you solve puzzles and learn more about what happened to the facility and its secrets.
items.title: Quiet is the Eyes

items.description: Trapped in a prison hell, a desperate orange will play a deadly game in the hopes of getting shipped to safer markets. Can he survive what his captors have freshly squeezed for him?
items.description_ja: Trapped in a prison hell, a desperate orange will play a deadly game in the hopes of getting shipped to safer markets. Can he survive what his captors have freshly squeezed for him?
items.title: Orange Roulette

items.description: A brand‑new bundle from the creators of the short‑form horror hit Violent Horror Stories. This time the collection revolves around one chilling theme: confinement.
items.description_ja: A brand‑new bundle from the creators of the short‑form horror hit Violent Horror Stories. This time the collection revolves around one chilling theme: confinement.
items.title: Violent Horror Stories 2

items.description: Service With a Shotgun [SWAS] is a mash up of visual novel storytelling and chaotic wave game shooting. You're the last poor soul manning a beat-up roadside shop in the middle of the zombie apocalypse. Shoot straight. Talk fast. Surely nothing can go wrong. Right?
items.description_ja: Service With a Shotgun [SWAS] is a mash up of visual novel storytelling and chaotic wave game shooting. You're the last poor soul manning a beat-up roadside shop in the middle of the zombie apocalypse. Shoot straight. Talk fast. Surely nothing can go wrong. Right?
items.title: Service with a Shotgun

items.description: Deluge is a horror-centric JRPG where you play as the resurrected warrior Hudson, a corpse tasked with infiltrating a battered community. Bound to a tyrant’s will, yet haunted by your own past, you must make choices and battle your path forward to either redemption or ruin.
items.description_ja: Deluge is a horror-centric JRPG where you play as the resurrected warrior Hudson, a corpse tasked with infiltrating a battered community. Bound to a tyrant’s will, yet haunted by your own past, you must make choices and battle your path forward to either redemption or ruin.
items.title: Deluge

items.description: alternatively: caring romantic partner or delicious confectionery dessert?
items.description_ja: alternatively: caring romantic partner or delicious confectionery dessert?
items.title: boyfriend or cake??

items.description: Singleplayer psychological horror game about bird watching. Explore the mountains, find and observe all the birds. Seek their help. Be honest. Be ruthless. They are watching.
items.description_ja: あなたは地球上で最後の人類です。毎日、鳥を観察して過ごしています。山には、あなた以外にも何かがいます。
items.title: Birds Watching

items.description: Play through three VHS tapes, uncovering the mystery of a decrepit facility, eluding tormented beasts, and discovering the truth of the chosen one.
items.description_ja: Play through three VHS tapes, uncovering the mystery of a decrepit facility, eluding tormented beasts, and discovering the truth of the chosen one.
items.title: Uh Oh!

items.description: A fast-paced brick-breaking roguelite starring Buster Ball, where the walls are your greatest threat. Upgrade your build, smuggle in powerful contraband, and climb to freedom.
items.description_ja: バスター・ボールが主役のハイスピードなブロック崩しローグライト。奇想天外なボールのシナジーを組み上げ、強力な禁制品を持ち込み、5人の看守を倒して自由を目指そう。
items.title: Buster Breaks Out

items.description:
DWARF COMBAT! Stonewards is a 1-4 player co-op first-person roguelite defense game. Lead a crew of stubborn
dwarves from your base camp to aid nearby kingdoms, mine deep for resources, forge powerful
upgrades, and hold the line against relentless monster attacks.
items.description_ja: ドワーフたちよ、戦いへ！Stonewardsは、1〜4人協力プレイ対応の一人称視点ローグライト防衛ゲームです。拠点キャンプから頑固なドワーフたちを率いて近隣の王国を助け、地中深くで資源を採掘し、強力なアップグレードを鍛造し、容赦ないモンスターの襲撃に立ち向かいましょう。
items.title: Stonewards

items.description: At the end of Earth, Nilus, the God of Gore re-incarnate, lays waste to the last standing battalion - A corrupt oppression with ties to his past. Annihilate everything.
items.description_ja: At the end of Earth, Nilus, the God of Gore re-incarnate, lays waste to the last standing battalion - A corrupt oppression with ties to his past. Annihilate everything.
items.title: REINCARNAGE

items.description: Adventure as Geralt through the ballads of Dandelion. Swipe right, swipe left, seek glory, find death! Will you hunt monsters, upset the locals, or run a hot bath? Compose an inspiring epic to claim immortality.
items.description_ja: ダンディリオンの詩を通して、ゲラルトとして生きよ。右に、左にスワイプし、栄光を探し求め、死を探し当てろ。魔物を狩り、人々の肝をつぶさせ、そして熱い風呂を楽しもう。不朽の名声を手にするため、心震わす叙事詩をつむげ。
items.title: Reigns: The Witcher

items.description: The choice has been made, and now there is no turning back - they must find and stop him. The final chapter in the adventure of our heroes.
items.description_ja: The choice has been made, and now there is no turning back - they must find and stop him. The final chapter in the adventure of our heroes.
items.title: My Furry Protogen 3 🐾

items.description: URLate is a short and free point & click adventure that immerses you in a hand-drawn world filled with puzzles and mysteries to solve.
items.description_ja: URLate is a short and free point & click adventure that immerses you in a hand-drawn world filled with puzzles and mysteries to solve.
items.title: URLate

items.description: Cute rats in deadly mazes... Cyber Rats is a dark and brutal action game. Escape sadistic horrifying death mazes, Improve your rats with upgrades, and find your way out of this sinister facility.
items.description_ja: 死の迷路にいる可愛いネズミたち... 『Cyber Rats』は、ダークで残酷なアクションゲームです。サディスティックで恐ろしい死の迷路から脱出し、アップグレードでネズミを強化して、この邪悪な施設からの出口を見つけ出そう。
items.title: Cyber Rats

items.description: A game for players who adore humorous fantasy adventures. A sprawling turn-based JRPG offering 50 hours of meticulously crafted plot, engaging quests, and no unnecessary grind. Four gorgeous yet utterly misguided heroines set out on perilous yet wildly entertaining adventures.
items.description_ja:
ユーモア溢れるファンタジー冒険譚を愛するプレイヤーへ贈る。緻密に練り込まれた50時間のストーリーと魅力的なクエストが詰まった、ボリューム満点のターン制JRPG。無意味なレベル上げ作業は一切なし！
美しくも、どうしようもなく「ポンコツ」な4人のヒロインたちが、危険で、そして最高に愉快な冒険へと旅立ちます。
items.title: Heroines of Swords & Spells 2

items.description: Truckin’ It is a fast-paced online co-op delivery game where two players struggle to deliver cargo quickly without losing it. Choose risky shortcuts or safer long routes, trust your partner, and enjoy the chaotic, silly world as you work together for the best score.
items.description_ja: Truckin’ It is a fast-paced online co-op delivery game where two players struggle to deliver cargo quickly without losing it. Choose risky shortcuts or safer long routes, trust your partner, and enjoy the chaotic, silly world as you work together for the best score.
items.title: Truckin It

items.description: Welcome to the fantastic party on the adorable planet of chicks! Feather Party is a multiplayer party game for up to 8 players. Engage in a diverse array of fun mini-games with friends or against rivals to be the winner of this party!  Enjoy the exciting Board Game Mode.🐣
items.description_ja: Welcome to the fantastic party on the adorable planet of chicks! Feather Party is a multiplayer party game for up to 8 players. Engage in a diverse array of fun mini-games with friends or against rivals to be the winner of this party!  Enjoy the exciting Board Game Mode.🐣
items.title: Feather Party

items.description: In this online horror co-op, you play as a scrappy goblin, scavenging dungeons, dodging traps, and fleeing monsters to feed the Goblin King-Queen. Team up with goblin pals, or go rogue, as you dive deep and cause chaos! Fail to feed them, and you might be the next meal!
items.description_ja: このオンラインホラーCo-opで、ケンカっ早いゴブリンとなって、ダンジョンを探索し、罠を回避し、モンスターから逃げ、ゴブリンのキングクイーンに食事を提供しよう。ゴブリン仲間とチームを組むもよし、一匹ゴブリンで行くもよし。ピットの深部へ潜り、混乱を引き起こせ！ 食事提供に失敗すれば、次に食べられるのは君かもしれない！
items.title: PIT OF GOBLIN

items.description: Red button and blue button. Your choice determines everything.
items.description_ja: 赤いボタンと青いボタン。あなたの選択がすべてを決定します。
items.title: Red or Blue

items.description: Depart on a life-changing turn-based adventure to save the President!
items.description_ja: Depart on a life-changing turn-based adventure to save the President!
items.title: SuperQuest

items.description: Smoke Break! is a lighthearted 3D stealth puzzle game where you play as Applewood — a living puff of smoke. By breaking machinery, dashing past bakers, and using smoke to grow, you can hunt down the ultimate, yet elusive, burnt pie!
items.description_ja: Smoke Break! is a lighthearted 3D stealth puzzle game where you play as Applewood — a living puff of smoke. By breaking machinery, dashing past bakers, and using smoke to grow, you can hunt down the ultimate, yet elusive, burnt pie!
items.title: Smoke Break!

items.description:
A first-person parody horror. College goofballs are partying hard in the great outdoors - booze, boobs, and bad decisions.
What's gonna kill 'em first? Cheap vodka, ancient memes, dirty jokes… or a bloodthirsty Yeti from the woods?
items.description_ja:
A first-person parody horror. College goofballs are partying hard in the great outdoors - booze, boobs, and bad decisions.
What's gonna kill 'em first? Cheap vodka, ancient memes, dirty jokes… or a bloodthirsty Yeti from the woods?
items.title: YetiParty

items.description: This is a horror type anomaly finding game, where you accidentally enter a strange room where a demon Kun Kun lives for two and a half years. Kun Kun likes to tease people who enter its room. It is capricious, sometimes dancing happily, sometimes crying sadly, sometimes hunting with anger, and sometimes making you laugh. If you want to escape from here, you can only judge if there is any abnormality in this infinite loop room. You can escape from here by making 8 consecutive judgments.
items.description_ja: うっかり坤坤の巣に入り込んでしまったあなた、そこには非常に恐ろしい悪魔坤坤がいて、獲物を驚かせるのが大好きです。部屋に異変を感じたら、すぐに逃げ出してください。
items.title: KunKunNest

items.description: A 20‑minute playable thriller that will blow your mind.
items.description_ja: 20分で遊べる、あなたの脳を揺さぶるスリラー。
items.title: BRAVO

items.description: A 1-4 player co-op survival horror where the horror begins when the shift starts. Clean, organize, and contain dangerous creatures using CCTV, motion sensors, and more. Earn your paycheck, upgrade your tools, and capture them. New game mode available!
items.description_ja: 1～4人協力プレイのサバイバルホラーゲーム。恐怖はシフトが始まるとともに訪れる。監視カメラ、モーションセンサーを駆使し、清掃・整理・危険なクリーチャーの封じ込めを行え。給料を稼ぎ、ツールを強化し、捕獲せよ—誰も助けてはくれない。
items.title: Hired 2 Die

items.description: A puzzle game starring mischievous fairies. Complete levels by working as a team, operating dangerous machinery and manipulating local wildlife.
items.description_ja: A puzzle game starring mischievous fairies. Complete levels by working as a team, operating dangerous machinery and manipulating local wildlife.
items.title: Poke ALL Toads

items.description: Tank controls. Fixed cameras. Pure Terror. Set in a haunting world of twisted experiments and occult nightmares, this game brings back the survival horror mechanics you know and love while pushing the genre into terrifying new depths.
items.description_ja: Tank controls. Fixed cameras. Pure Terror. Set in a haunting world of twisted experiments and occult nightmares, this game brings back the survival horror mechanics you know and love while pushing the genre into terrifying new depths.
items.title: Flesh Made Fear

items.description:
A new life begins in a low-cost apartment.
Strange occurrences at night and the suspicious behavior of neighbors gradually push the protagonist to the edge.
items.description_ja:
格安アパートで始まる新生活。
夜中の奇妙な現象と隣人の不審な行動が主人公を追い詰めていく。
items.title: Haunted Property

items.description: In this festive standalone addition to the satirical dating chatsim Killer Chat! series, journey through the serial killer server’s past, present & future to learn more about the gang and find the true meaning of Christmas. What's the worst that could happen?
items.description_ja: In this festive standalone addition to the satirical dating chatsim Killer Chat! series, journey through the serial killer server’s past, present & future to learn more about the gang and find the true meaning of Christmas. What's the worst that could happen?
items.title: A Killer Chat! Christmas

items.description: Who says that work and play don’t mix? Not us! Play Pocket Boss, the game where you handle lots of fun data and one not-so-fun boss.
items.description_ja: Who says that work and play don’t mix? Not us! Play Pocket Boss, the game where you handle lots of fun data and one not-so-fun boss.
items.title: Pocket Boss

items.description: “Going against the grain is just another form of rebellion.” That's what high school student Yuta Nozaki believes, living by the principle of following the trend. Through his classmate Misaki Miyoshi, who constantly goes against the grain, Yuta begins to confront his true feelings.
items.description_ja: 「逆張りなんて反抗期の一種でしかない」そういって順張りで生きることを信条とする高校生の野崎優太は、それによって毎日平穏な日々を送っていた。しかし何に対しても逆張りばかりするクラスメイトの三好岬を通じて本当の自分の気持ちへと向き合っていく。
items.title: 片腕のザリガニ - one-armed crayfish

items.description: 《Gem and Tarot》 is a strategy game that blends match-3 puzzles with deck-building. Build your deck, upgrade your abilities, and conquer challenging stages. Unlock new gems with unique powers by meeting certain conditions, making every run unique!
items.description_ja: 『ジェムズ＆タロット』は、マッチ3の楽しさとデッキ構築を深く融合させたストラテジーゲームです。自分だけのデッキを組み立て、基礎能力を強化し、難易度が上がり続けるステージに立ち向かいましょう。さらに特定の条件を達成すると、様々な特殊能力を持つ新しいジェムを解放でき、あなたの冒険に無限の可能性をもたらします！
items.title: Gem and Tarot

items.description: Steve's Warehouse is a melting pot of Suika game, rogue-like and deckbuiling. Purchase objects, combine them but don't make any falls!
items.description_ja: Steve's Warehouseはスイカゲームとデッキ構築ローグライクのいいとこ取りです　アイテムを手に入れて失敗しないようにうまく合体させよう！
items.title: Steve's Warehouse: Physics. Roguelike. Chaos.

items.description: Bring your own avatar file and wear it in minutes, no Unity needed. A free social game where VR and desktop players hang out, fight bots, take daily dares and explore worlds built on the Steam Workshop. Meet everyone Saturdays at 3 PM Pacific.
items.description_ja: 自分のアバターファイルを持ち込んで、数分で身にまとえます。Unityは不要です。VRとデスクトップのプレイヤーが一緒に過ごし、ボットと戦い、毎日のチャレンジに挑み、Steam ワークショップで作られたワールドを探索する無料のソーシャルゲーム。毎週土曜日、太平洋時間の午後3時にみんなに会いに来てください。
items.title: VR Realms

items.description:
Your duty as a South Korean army officer just began.
You must check out mysterious anomalies to finish this endless night.
items.description_ja:
韓国陸軍部隊の当直士官として、あなたは終わらない見回りを続ける。
この永遠の夜を終わらせるために「異変」を見つけ出し、千切れた物語を元に戻そう。
items.title: A Night Duty

items.description:
The little ghost that appeared before your eyes seems to want to become a proper evil spirit.
He'll scare you in a variety of ways, so rate him on whether he was scary or not.
items.description_ja:
あなたの目の前に現れた小さなお化けは、立派な悪霊になりたいようです。
色々なパターンで驚かせてくるので、怖かったかどうか採点してあげましょう。
items.title: Score the Fear

items.description: In a game show starring only criminals, you must gamble against rival players to prove yourself worthy of being pardoned for your wrong deeds— But is the show really about proving your innocence? Jackpot Crash Course is a death game visual novel about crime, luck and spectacle.
items.description_ja: そのショーに出演できるのは犯罪者だけ。ライバル相手に賭けへ挑み、自らが罪の赦しに値すると証明しなければならない――だが、このショーは本当に無実を証明するためのものなのか？『Jackpot Crash Course』、犯罪・運・見世物がテーマのデスゲーム・ビジュアルノベル。
items.title: Jackpot Crash Course

items.description: The Test: Reimagined is a masterful mix of Personality Test Psychology and Dark Tarot. Answer a series of fully-narrated questions to receive a personalized, unique ending based on your choices. Dive deep into your own psyche and join millions in a social experiment that you will NOT want to miss!
items.description_ja: The Test: Reimagined is a masterful mix of Personality Test Psychology and Dark Tarot. Answer a series of fully-narrated questions to receive a personalized, unique ending based on your choices. Dive deep into your own psyche and join millions in a social experiment that you will NOT want to miss!
items.title: The Test: Reimagined

items.description:
The Fable: Manga Build Roguelike combines manga, tactical puzzles, and roguelike gameplay into one thrilling experience.
Enjoy stylish pixel-art action while testing your flexible thinking and precise strategy!
items.description_ja: 『ザ・ファブル Manga Build Roguelike』はマンガと戦術パズルとローグライクが融合した、柔軟な思考力、緻密な戦略、ドット絵で描かれたキャラのスタイリッシュなアクションを楽しめるゲームです。
items.title: The Fable: Manga Build Roguelike

items.description: Puttler is a mini-golf puzzle game featuring wacky obstacles and a charming backstory. Build contraptions to score the golf ball under par across 15 courses and over 250 unique holes to solve.
items.description_ja: Puttler is a mini-golf puzzle game featuring wacky obstacles and a charming backstory. Build contraptions to score the golf ball under par across 15 courses and over 250 unique holes to solve.
items.title: Puttler

items.description: You are hunted by a rogue computer program. Avoid the bot either by yourself or cooperate with others while attempting to collect electrical components around the world to activate beacons to open the escape hatch.
items.description_ja: You are hunted by a rogue computer program. Avoid the bot either by yourself or cooperate with others while attempting to collect electrical components around the world to activate beacons to open the escape hatch.
items.title: Hex Bots

items.description: Become the hottest exorcist star and save a cursed haunted house! The most annoyingly clingy ghost is about to awaken.
items.description_ja: 今話題のスター除霊師となり、呪われたお化け屋敷を救え！史上最悪の背後霊が、いま目覚める。
items.title: The Clingy Ghost

items.description: One of the last humans in the universe calls your company to get some food, deliver it, and don't look back. Remember, customer is always right.
items.description_ja: One of the last humans in the universe calls your company to get some food, deliver it, and don't look back. Remember, customer is always right.
items.title: Who's Hungry?

items.description: Collectible cards meets tactical strategy! Collect cards, build decks, and challenge players head to head on a Tactical Game Board. Play as Vikings, Pirates, Ninjas and more!
items.description_ja: 収集可能なカードと戦術的な戦略が融合!デッキを構築してバトル!
items.title: Cards and Castles Ultimate

items.description: Find out who's been messing up your home with this troublesome witch!
items.description_ja: Find out who's been messing up your home with this troublesome witch!
items.title: Pippa and Your Phantasmal Problem

items.description: A psychological horror anthology inspired by real-life cases. In Route 86, a group of friends ends up in a remote nightmare. Explore, hide, and survive in this first-person experience with multiple playable characters and rising tension.
items.description_ja: A psychological horror anthology inspired by real-life cases. In Route 86, a group of friends ends up in a remote nightmare. Explore, hide, and survive in this first-person experience with multiple playable characters and rising tension.
items.title: Tales Beyond The Tomb - Route 86

items.description: A digital comic set in the Beholder universe, presented as a handbook for the ever-watchful landlord. Discover the fine art of minding everyone else's business through dark humor, suspicious tenants, and the absurd rules of the Great State that never stops watching.
items.description_ja: A digital comic set in the Beholder universe, presented as a handbook for the ever-watchful landlord. Discover the fine art of minding everyone else's business through dark humor, suspicious tenants, and the absurd rules of the Great State that never stops watching.
items.title: Beholder: The Landlord's Handbook - Digital Comic

items.description: Mean Beans is a FREE Battle Royale FPS where being the last bean alive isn't the only way to win! Play multiple rounds and collect points by not only being the last player standing, but killing other players as well! The bean with the most points at the end wins!
items.description_ja: Mean Beans is a FREE Battle Royale FPS where being the last bean alive isn't the only way to win! Play multiple rounds and collect points by not only being the last player standing, but killing other players as well! The bean with the most points at the end wins!
items.title: Mean Beans

items.description: Trapped in the haunting realm of an artist's twisted nightmare, engage in intense combat with grotesque enemies and monsters, experience unpredictable horror events that unfold dynamically, seamlessly blends classic retro FPS elements with modern elements.
items.description_ja: Trapped in the haunting realm of an artist's twisted nightmare, engage in intense combat with grotesque enemies and monsters, experience unpredictable horror events that unfold dynamically, seamlessly blends classic retro FPS elements with modern elements.
items.title: Painted In Blood

items.description: Until Oblivion is an atmospheric narrative game that follows 17 year old nobody Emma Wilson as she tries to rekindle a dying relationship in a dying world. Join her in an increasingly nightmarish Halloween party and find out if anything (or anyone) is worth anything at all.
items.description_ja: Until Oblivion is an atmospheric narrative game that follows 17 year old nobody Emma Wilson as she tries to rekindle a dying relationship in a dying world. Join her in an increasingly nightmarish Halloween party and find out if anything (or anyone) is worth anything at all.
items.title: Until Oblivion

items.description: Boxville 2 continues the adventure of cans living in a box city. Two friends were setting up fireworks for the city celebration, but a mistake caused chaos and one friend went missing. Now our hero must explore Boxville and beyond to fix everything and find his friend.
items.description_ja: Triomatica Games の Boxville 2 は、箱の街に住む缶たちの冒険の続きです。2 人の友達が街のお祝いに花火を打ち上げていましたが、手違いで大混乱に陥り、友達の 1 人が行方不明になりました。赤い缶は Boxville とその先を探索し、すべてを直し、友達を見つけなければなりません。
items.title: Boxville 2

items.description: Buy, upgrade, and dominate in this fast-paced multiplayer board game! Compete with quirky characters, strategize your moves, and outsmart rivals in unpredictable matches filled with fun and surprises. Climb the leaderboard and become the ultimate tycoon! The dice are in your hands! 🎲
items.description_ja: Buy, upgrade, and dominate in this fast-paced multiplayer board game! Compete with quirky characters, strategize your moves, and outsmart rivals in unpredictable matches filled with fun and surprises. Climb the leaderboard and become the ultimate tycoon! The dice are in your hands! 🎲
items.title: Investour

items.description: A heartfelt game where you run a night market stall, cooking kaolengmian (grilled cold noodles). Customers come and go, stopping by to chat and share bits of their lives, joys, frustrations, and everyday struggles. At this little stall, you cook, listen, and keep living an ordinary person’s life.
items.description_ja: 夜市の暮らしと普通の人々の物語を描く経営シミュレーションゲーム。あなたは屋台の店主として、鉄板で焼冷麺を手際よく焼き上げる。夜の街を行き交う人々が足を止め、何気ない会話を交わす。仕事の愚痴、夢の話、ほんの少しの寂しさ、それらが煙と灯りに溶けていく。この小さな屋台で、あなたは料理をし、人に触れ、そして自分の人生を静かに生きていく。
items.title: Chinese Street Food Legend

items.description: Escape a dangerous dungeon with your friends as royal babies. Solve puzzles, dodge traps and laugh through chaotic co-op action for 2–8 players!
items.description_ja: 友達と一緒に「王族の赤ちゃん」となって危険なダンジョンから脱出！ パズルを解き、罠をかわし、2〜8人のドタバタ協力プレイで大笑いしよう！
items.title: Baby Kings

items.description:
Catch falling allies and dominate the battlefield!
Control your flying platform to catch characters and auto-attack enemies.
Build your team, link skills, and shape your own strategy in this evolving arcade action game.
items.description_ja:
空から降ってくる仲間をキャッチして、戦場を支配しよう。
飛行体を操作してキャラクターを受け止めると、自動で敵を攻撃します。
さまざまなキャラクターを組み合わせ、スキルを連携させて自分だけの戦略を完成させましょう。
強化と成長により、戦い方が進化していくアーケードアクションがあなたを待っています。
items.title: Maru Expedition: We can fly

items.description: A city under curfew. A killer on the loose. You’re a delivery driver racing to finish your last run before 9 PM in a decaying apartment complex where every knock could be your last, in this PSX-style psychological horror.
items.description_ja: A city under curfew. A killer on the loose. You’re a delivery driver racing to finish your last run before 9 PM in a decaying apartment complex where every knock could be your last, in this PSX-style psychological horror.
items.title: Jaden Williams' The Stalking Stairs

items.description: “Worthy or Not” is an FMV about Dating Agency. Players make choices across diverse in-game topics, which modify target characters’ latent attributes. The final matchmaking phase, based on accumulated latent value changes, unlocks multiple endings. You play as a matchmaking agency owner faced girls
items.description_ja: “Worthy or Not” is an FMV about Dating Agency. Players make choices across diverse in-game topics, which modify target characters’ latent attributes. The final matchmaking phase, based on accumulated latent value changes, unlocks multiple endings. You play as a matchmaking agency owner faced girls
items.title: Worthy or Not

items.description: A narrative courtroom adventure all about VTubers! Players will take the role of prosecutor Justin Truth and investigate a murder at a VTuber agency, doing their best to uncover the identity of both the killer and VTuber's real face.
items.description_ja: VTuberをテーマにした法廷ミステリーゲーム！プレイヤーは検察官となり、VTuber事務所で発生した殺人事件に挑みます。「中の人」と「犯人」──二重の謎を解き明かせ！
items.title: The Real Face of a VTuber

items.description: Jupiter Hell Classic is a old-school true Roguelike shooter with turn-based tactics, permadeath, procedural levels, and 90s sci-fi carnage in its purest form. Rip and Tear!
items.description_ja: Jupiter Hell Classic is a old-school true Roguelike shooter with turn-based tactics, permadeath, procedural levels, and 90s sci-fi carnage in its purest form. Rip and Tear!
items.title: Jupiter Hell Classic

items.description: Islets Defense is a turn-based tower defense game in which you build a small village to gather resources and defend your castle. Carefully plan your actions, as each move brings the enemy waves closer! Strategize building placements and play your cards wisely, as timing and order are key.
items.description_ja: 『Islets Defense』は、資源を集めて城を守るために村を築いていく、ターン制のタワーディフェンスゲームです。行動は慎重に計画しましょう――動くたびに敵の波が迫ってきます！建物を戦略的に配置し、カードを賢く使って勝利を目指しましょう。タイミングと行動順がカギを握ります。
items.title: Islets Defense

items.description: An incremental game with meta-unveiling secrets and a bangin' soundtrack. Race along an obstacle-ridden track to gain resources, then spend them to level up and purchase upgrades. Drive to reunite with your true love- if the entire world doesn't fall apart before then...
items.description_ja: 障害物だらけのコースをオート前進で駆け抜け、走行距離を稼ぎ、ステータスやプレイスタイルに合わせたアップグレードを手に入れよう。いつかは走りで意中の「あの子」を救えるかも。
items.title: Progress Racer RPG

items.description: Build a top-tier business solo or in co-op (1–6 players). Start from scratch, keep the slot machines spinning and deal with chaotic events like vandals and alien invasions. Grow your fortune and show everyone why the house always wins.
items.description_ja: ソロまたは協力プレイ（1～6人）で一流ビジネスを築こう。ゼロから始め、ゲストを楽しませ、破壊行為やトラブル、さらには宇宙からの訪問者まで、あらゆる混乱に対処せよ。
items.title: The House Always Wins

items.description: You're now the lead writer for Juno's World, a perfectly normal sitcom in which nothing strange or horrible happens, ever! Choose your scripts, decide what characters to build relationships with, and keep those audience ratings high -- or get cancelled in more ways than one! Welcome to Must See TV.
items.description_ja: You're now the lead writer for Juno's World, a perfectly normal sitcom in which nothing strange or horrible happens, ever! Choose your scripts, decide what characters to build relationships with, and keep those audience ratings high -- or get cancelled in more ways than one! Welcome to Must See TV.
items.title: Laugh Track

items.description: A short narrative-driven horror game made in RPGmaker featuring hand-drawn graphics and animated cutscenes. Players navigate the house and its backyard, interacting with the environment and collecting key items to progress the story.
items.description_ja: A short narrative-driven horror game made in RPGmaker featuring hand-drawn graphics and animated cutscenes. Players navigate the house and its backyard, interacting with the environment and collecting key items to progress the story.
items.title: BIRDHOUSE

items.description: The Roach Hotel is a first person analog horror game that drags you into its halls, where every shadow hides a question and every corner dares you to keep following its path.
items.description_ja: The Roach Hotel is a first person analog horror game that drags you into its halls, where every shadow hides a question and every corner dares you to keep following its path.
items.title: The Roach Hotel

items.description: Sort forms, get to know your mysterious new collegues & unravel mysteries they're trying to cover up as you step in to replace the previous RH at this mysterious pharmaceutical company.
items.description_ja: Sort forms, get to know your mysterious new collegues & unravel mysteries they're trying to cover up as you step in to replace the previous RH at this mysterious pharmaceutical company.
items.title: Office Hours

items.description: An atmospheric horror micro-game that touches on topics of anxiety, isolation, body image and obsessive habits with a surreal PSX aesthetic.
items.description_ja: An atmospheric horror micro-game that touches on topics of anxiety, isolation, body image and obsessive habits with a surreal PSX aesthetic.
items.title: Barbotine

items.description: Fusing Battling tops and Roguelike Deckbuilding together to create an unlimited source of battling tops fun! Collect new tops, combine them together, pair 'em up with synergistic relic and go on a short adventure, From the Top!
items.description_ja: Fusing Battling tops and Roguelike Deckbuilding together to create an unlimited source of battling tops fun! Collect new tops, combine them together, pair 'em up with synergistic relic and go on a short adventure, From the Top!
items.title: From The Top

items.description: You find yourself trapped in the endless maze of Kyoto's backstreets, trying to reach the temple of Hōkan-ji before the main tourist rush. Inspect the street for anomalies, choose the right path, and reach your destination... or be trapped forever.
items.description_ja: 京都の裏路地に迷い込んだあなたは、観光客が来る前に法観寺へたどり着かなければならない。異変を見つけ、正しい道を選べ。さもなければ、永遠に閉じ込められる。
items.title: Kyoto Anomaly

items.description:
Why play this? You could read, run, or stare at a wall.

But if you do, expect fast and unpredictable retro FPS action.
items.description_ja:
なぜこれを遊ぶの？ 本を読んだり、走ったり、壁を見つめたりもできるよ。
でももし遊ぶなら、速くて予測不能なレトロFPSアクションを期待してね。
items.title: WTF AM I PLAYING?!

items.description: You wake up on the beach, with water crashing against your body. You don't remember anything, you don't know where you are, and everything hurts. The meaningless mass of flesh and metal seems to be breathing... It doesn't make sense, but it's breathing...
items.description_ja: You wake up on the beach, with water crashing against your body. You don't remember anything, you don't know where you are, and everything hurts. The meaningless mass of flesh and metal seems to be breathing... It doesn't make sense, but it's breathing...
items.title: Carmencarmen

items.description: First-person horror game where you work the night shift at a Mexican convenience store, handling daily tasks while facing eerie and unexpected events.
items.description_ja: First-person horror game where you work the night shift at a Mexican convenience store, handling daily tasks while facing eerie and unexpected events.
items.title: NIGHT SHIFT NIGHTMARE

items.description: Hello, I'm Noah. I'm 28 years old and still haven't got a single date in my life, I'm looking for a life coach who can help me figure out the hard choices in my day to day life, you know? I'm sad and single, I have some friends online, but that's it.
items.description_ja: Hello, I'm Noah. I'm 28 years old and still haven't got a single date in my life, I'm looking for a life coach who can help me figure out the hard choices in my day to day life, you know? I'm sad and single, I have some friends online, but that's it.
items.title: I'm in Love With Your Dead Grandmother

items.description: What happens when historical and fictional icons find an arsenal of crazy weapons? TOTAL CHAOS! Build a team with legends from fiction or history, discover unexpected builds and synergies, take on solo challenges or beat your friends in PvP battles in this absurd and hilarious auto-battler.
items.description_ja:
カオスな布陣で戦え！カートゥーン調オートバトラーで、理不尽だけどクセになる快感！
古今東西の個性的な英雄を集め、奇想天外な装備を持たせ、強力なシナジーと予測不能なイベントを発動。フレンドと対戦、ソロ挑戦、ローカルプレイに対応。突飛な戦略で、狂気のバトルを制覇せよ！
items.title: Who Gave Them Weapons

items.description: A first-person psychological horror game set over five days in a Korean postpartum care center. The nurse was replaced overnight, and the new one always seems to be holding your baby.
items.description_ja: 韓国の産後ケアセンターで過ごす5日間を描く、一人称視点のサイコロジカルホラー。看護師は一晩で入れ替わった。新しい看護師は、いつもあなたの赤ちゃんを抱いている。
items.title: Postpartum | 산후조리원

items.description: The Definitive Political Debating Simulator. A wacky third-person multiplayer arena shooter inspired by Countryball memes - a game encouraging you to smash each others balls until someone finishes victoriously. Now includes an online co-op zombie mode!
items.description_ja: The Definitive Political Debating Simulator. A wacky third-person multiplayer arena shooter inspired by Countryball memes - a game encouraging you to smash each others balls until someone finishes victoriously. Now includes an online co-op zombie mode!
items.title: Countryballs: Modern Ballfare

items.description: Touhou Drunken Rebellion is a classic top-down danmaku shooting roguelike game. Set in the world of Touhou Project, players take on the role of various lesser youkai living in Gensokyo and set out on a journey of rebellion against the powerful figures who rule over it.
items.description_ja:
**『東方醉游稽伝 ~ Touhou Drunken Rebellion』**は、王道の見下ろし型弾幕シューティング・ローグライクゲームです。
本作は東方Projectの世界観をもとにしており、プレイヤーは幻想郷に暮らすさまざまな小妖怪となって、幻想郷の強者たちに下克上を挑む旅へと出発します。
items.title: 东方醉游稽传~Touhou Drunken Rebellion

items.description: Mosaic of the Strange is a picross/minesweeper hybrid featuring ENORMOUS interlocking puzzles. Help Special Agents Cullen and Brady investigate a bizarre murder, while discovering 144 real-world paranormal case files.
items.description_ja: Mosaic of the Strangeは、巨大な相互接続されたパズルを特徴とするピクロス/マインスイーパーハイブリッドです。特別捜査官カレンとブレイディが奇妙な殺人事件を調査するのを助けながら、144の実在する超常現象ケースファイルを発見してください。
items.title: Mosaic of the Strange

items.description: Kollywood: The Game is a stop motion video, comedy game with quick-time event fight scenes inspired by Tamil Cinema.
items.description_ja: Kollywood: The Game is a stop motion video, comedy game with quick-time event fight scenes inspired by Tamil Cinema.
items.title: Kollywood: The Game

items.description: Arm yourself with sticky boots, a smart-pistol, and the titular 'Goosthetic' grappling prosthetic to swing, slide, jump, boost, and shoot your way out of a twisted and abandoned scientific facility! Escape captivity and evade slime mutations in this fast-paced action-platformer FPS.
items.description_ja: Arm yourself with sticky boots, a smart-pistol, and the titular 'Goosthetic' grappling prosthetic to swing, slide, jump, boost, and shoot your way out of a twisted and abandoned scientific facility! Escape captivity and evade slime mutations in this fast-paced action-platformer FPS.
items.title: Goosthetic

items.description: A PSX Inspired horror game where you must work and cook at a shop late at night and the horrors that comes with it.
items.description_ja: PSXにインスパイアされたホラーゲーム。深夜に店で働き料理をしなければならず、それに伴う恐怖が待ち受ける。
items.title: Obsessed : Night Shift

items.description: Choice of Life: Floors is a psychological horror detective game where every choice shapes your story. An elevator descends through the endless floors of your own home, leading you into a game against your own mind. Each step brings you closer to escape… or to madness
items.description_ja: Choice of Life: Floors - 継続的なストーリー展開選択が鍵となるサイコロジカルホラー探偵ゲーム。エレベーターはあなたを自身の家の無限のフロアへと運び、そこで自分の精神と対峙することになる。一歩一歩が出口に近づく…あるいは狂気へ。
items.title: Choice of Life: Floors

items.description: Digital ED Treatment Center is a random launcher for players in a gaming slump. We help you rediscover the joy of play and unearth hidden gems buried in your library. Click to start your treatment and reignite your gaming vigor!
items.description_ja: 《デジタルED治療センター》はゲーム難民のためのランダムランチャー。埋もれた名作を掘り起こし、ゲームの喜びを再発見。今すぐ「治療」をクリックして、プレイヤーの雄姿を取り戻そう！
items.title: Gaming Burnout Treatment Center

items.description: It's Christmas time! The Santa's Icy Realm is in full steam!! Join the fun and search for all the Hidden Cats one by one among the elves to reveal the final colored art. More than 970 hidden objects! This time with an extra bonus level, SNOWBALL FIGHT!
items.description_ja: クリスマスがやってきた！サンタさんが住む氷の世界はフル稼働！エルフたちと一緒に隠れたネコを1匹ずつ見つけて、最後に色のついた絵を明らかにしよう。隠されたオブジェクトは970個以上！追加のボーナスステージ、雪合戦も登場！
items.title: Hidden Cats in Santa's Realm

items.description: Return to the blacktop with your favorite Backyard athletes! The original Backyard Basketball 2001 is back and now enhanced to run on Steam. Dribble, shoot, and take that ball to the hoop!
items.description_ja: Return to the blacktop with your favorite Backyard athletes! The original Backyard Basketball 2001 is back and now enhanced to run on Steam. Dribble, shoot, and take that ball to the hoop!
items.title: Backyard Basketball '01

items.description: MOONROT is a short horror game about piloting a rover across a distant alien moon. Take grainy photos, record crackly signals, keep your battery charged, and uncover the source of the anomaly that led you here.
items.description_ja: MOONROT is a short horror game about piloting a rover across a distant alien moon. Take grainy photos, record crackly signals, keep your battery charged, and uncover the source of the anomaly that led you here.
items.title: MOONROT

items.description: Strap in, floor it, and deliver the goods... before the bomb goes off. Play as Carl, a monkey driving a wildly unstable mail truck through a difficult race against the clock.
items.description_ja: シートベルトを締めて、アクセル全開で荷物を届けろ……爆弾が爆発する前に。ぐらぐらと不安定な配達トラックを運転し、時間との厳しいレースに挑むサルのカールとしてプレイしよう。
items.title: DEADLINE DELIVERY

items.description:
You are a bird. You have a nest. Other birds want your eggs.

Birds of War is a team-based aerial PvP game. Raid nests, steal eggs, fight beak-to-beak in fast, chaotic matches built around flight and combat.

Your mic is always hot. Your enemies can hear you. Plan accordingly.
items.description_ja:
あなたは鳥。巣がある。他の鳥はあなたの卵を狙っている。

Birds of War はチーム制の空中PvPゲーム。巣を襲い、卵を奪い、くちばし同士で戦う、飛行と戦闘を軸にした高速でカオスなマッチ。

マイクは常にオン。敵には聞こえている。覚悟して動け。

evidence.excerpt: You are free to record, stream, upload, and monetize any and all Birds of War content.

items.title: Birds of War

items.description: You are Inspector 8821-A of Structural Core Services. Unit 47 has four reported concerns, each marked with a sticker by the child who lives there. Peel it. Inspect it. Tick the box. The report on your clipboard knows more than you do.
items.description_ja: あなたはStructural Core Servicesの検査官8821-A。47号室には4件の申告があり、そのすべてに、そこに住む子どもがシールを貼っている。はがす。調べる。チェックを入れる。クリップボードの報告書は、あなたより多くを知っている。
items.title: PROPERTY INSPECTION

items.description: A horror game about a needy female ghost. A trio of close-knit occult club girls gather late at night to enjoy telling ghost stories. Little do they know that Miss Choker, a ghost that targets girls, is just dying to appear...
items.description_ja: 闇が深い女幽霊のホラーADV。オカ研の仲良し三人娘が深夜に集まり、怪談話に興じる。まさか自分たちの前に女の子を狙う「首絞め女」が現れるとは思いもせずに……
developers: MaouCat Studio / 魔王貓工作室
items.title: Blood Lily Ghoststories

items.description: Explore quiet liminal spaces that feel familiar, yet strangely wrong. Walk, climb, and swim through five handcrafted stages, then build worlds of your own in a powerful sandbox. Publish them through LIMSCAPERS, visit other creators’ spaces, and explore together in Multiplay Beta.
items.description_ja: 見覚えがあるのに、どこかおかしい――静かで不気味なリミナルスペースを歩き、登り、泳いで、5つの公式ステージに隠された出口と物語を探す一人称探索ゲーム。旅の先では、サンドボックスで自分だけの空間をつくり、LIMSCAPERSで公開・共有。誰かの世界を訪れ、Multiplay Betaで一緒に探索することもできます。
items.title: LIMSCAPE : THE LIMINAL SPACE EXPLORER

items.description:
You're driving away on a forest road, late at night, under a heavy storm. Your car breaks down. Luckily, there might be a gas station nearby. 

But a misfortune never comes alone. The storm has brought something else, something otherworldly that oddly smells of spilled diesel oil.
items.description_ja: 深夜、激しい嵐の中、あなたは林道を車で走っていた。車が故障した。幸い、近くにガソリンスタンドがあるかもしれない。
items.title: AUTO-CRISIS

items.description: The most EXPLOSIVE roguelike boomer shooter. Fully packed with serious action, wicked humor, and good old bloody fun. Blast hordes of bastards, stack insane perks, and unlock new stuff. Survive…or get shredded trying!.. And try again.

items.description: You're trapped in an apartment with ever-changing rooms. Capture anomalies on camera, survive deadly entities and escape an endless nightmare.
items.description_ja: あなたは、部屋が絶えず変化するアパートに閉じ込められています。カメラで異常を記録し、致命的な存在から生き延び、終わりのない悪夢から脱出しましょう。
items.title: CAPTURED 2

items.description: The dead find peace through sacred burial rites, washed, wrapped, and prepared for their final journey. As a burial washer, it is your duty to perform them with precision and respect. But with no one to guide you, how well can you fulfill this sacred task?
items.description_ja: 死者は神聖な埋葬の儀式によって安らぎを得る——洗浄され、包まれ、最後の旅へと送り出される。納棺師として、あなたの務めはそれを正確かつ敬意をもって行うこと。しかし、誰の導きもない中で、あなたはこの神聖な務めを果たせるだろうか？
items.title: The Gassal

items.description: Patch me if you can is a puzzle adventure where you dive into a game world and manipulate objects however you want. Equip blocks to shrink boulders, move the sun, and thwart Lord's conspiracy. This broken world needs your 'patch'!
items.description_ja: 『Patch me if you can』は、ゲームの世界に飛び込み、思いのままにオブジェクトを操作するパズルアドベンチャーです。ブロックを装備して岩を小さくしたり、太陽を動かしたり、領主の陰謀を阻止しましょう。この壊れた世界にはあなたの「パッチ」が必要です！
items.title: Patch me if you can

items.description: A gothic roguelike shopkeeping game where you sell antiques, read the tarot, and manage your inventory to survive crushing rent increases. Match strange customers with the relics they crave, unlock powerful cards, and gamble your way out of debt, one deal at a time.
items.description_ja: ゴシック調のローグライクな店番ゲーム。骨董品を売ったり、タロットを読んだり、在庫を管理したりして、押しつぶされそうな家賃の値上げを乗り越えましょう。奇妙な客が欲しがる遺物とマッチさせ、強力なカードをアンロックし、一度にひとつの取引で借金から抜け出すためにギャンブルをしましょう。
items.title: Fortune Seller

items.description: DJ Bunny is a 2D music-puzzle adventure where you craft songs by solving grid-based challenges. Take requests from quirky townsfolk, build beats, and help DJ Bunny chase her dream of performing at the legendary Hippity Hop Music Festival!

items.description: Play solo or with up to 16 friends in a chaotic grocery store prologue! Manage, grow, and compete against rival stores in a fun, lighthearted battle of wits and strategy. Who will be the ultimate grocery tycoon? Store Wars: Prologue - Multiplayer Shop Simulator is a limited version of the full game.

items.title: Store Wars: Prologue - Multiplayer Shop Simulator

items.description: A girl at the bottom of the ladder with bad luck finds a cleaning job, but she mistakenly enters a cleaning company that is in the business of exorcising ghosts. items.description_ja: Step into a liminal, cosmic horror experience set in an abandoned amusement park. Uncover the haunting narrative behind its twisted rides and empty tunnels to discover what lurks within a reality that shouldn't exist…

items.description_ja: 2～4人で遊べるカオスなパーティーゲーム！登って、投げて、生き残れ！

items.description: The most troublesome RTS returns, free forever. Easy to pick up, tough to put down. Play as Vikings or Natives, build your tribe, and battle across randomly generated islands with up to 12 players online. A community-driven revival of a cult classic. Come cause some trouble!

items.description:
A short interactive novel.
There is no "truth" in this game.
This is not an armchair detective story—it is simply about a girl in a stall.
You will advise the protagonist, determine how she perceives everything around her, and witness her ending.
items.description_ja:
軽量インタラクティブノベル。
このゲームに「真実」は存在しない。
これは安楽椅子探偵の物語ではない。ただ、一つの個室にいる少女の物語だ。
あなたは主人公に助言を与え、彼女が周囲のすべてをどのように見るかを決定し、その結末を見届ける。
items.title: Ceramic · Stainless Steel · Neurotransmitter

items.description: A cozy first-person organizing game set in an art shop of rare and beautiful things. Sort 3022 fine art supplies and artisan pieces in dozens of distinct forms, shelf by shelf, color by color, and unlock skills as the shop becomes a gallery of perfect order.
items.description_ja: A cozy first-person organizing game set in an art shop of rare and beautiful things. Sort 3022 fine art supplies and artisan pieces in dozens of distinct forms, shelf by shelf, color by color, and unlock skills as the shop becomes a gallery of perfect order.

items.description: CashGrab is a game which redefines the asymmetric horror genre. Grab some friends and get ready for a trip to #ScaryTown! This is literally the best game you'll ever play.
items.description_ja: CashGrab is a game which redefines the asymmetric horror genre. Grab some friends and get ready for a trip to #ScaryTown! This is literally the best game you'll ever play.

items.description: Damned 2 is an asymmetrical multiplayer horror game where up to four survivors must work together to survive an unrelenting monster - either player or computer-controlled - while scavenging and solving puzzles in an attempt to escape.
items.description_ja: 『Damned 2』は、最大4人の生存者が協力して、プレイヤーまたはAIによって操作される容赦ないモンスターからの生存を目指す、非対称型マルチプレイヤー・ホラーゲームです。脱出を試みながら、探索し、パズルを解いていきます。
items.title: Damned 2

items.description: Eggstraction is a multiplayer (4vs1) game where a group of chickens must steal their eggs back from a furious farmer. Dodge dangerous traps, blast down barricades and make use of whacky abilities to avoid ending up back in the cage.
items.description_ja: Eggstractionはマルチプレイヤーゲーム（4対1）で、怒った農夫から卵を取り戻すために、鶏のグループが挑みます。危険な罠を避け、バリケードを破壊し、奇抜な能力を駆使して再び檻に戻らないようにしましょう。
items.title: Eggstraction

items.description: An online co-op horror game with up to 6 players. Use fully physics-based objects and fluid movement to grab some cash and escape The Grind. Use cash to buy items and equipment and fund community goals. Create your Grabba and get rich or die trying.
items.description_ja: An online co-op horror game with up to 6 players. Use fully physics-based objects and fluid movement to grab some cash and escape The Grind. Use cash to buy items and equipment and fund community goals. Create your Grabba and get rich or die trying.

items.description: Blasfemia is a first-person horror game. You are trapped in a seemingly normal apartment but realize early on that you're not alone. Explore a handcrafted, detail rich environment in a tense and terrifying atmosphere and try to find a way out before an ominous entity gets to you.
items.description_ja: Blasfemiaは一人称視点のホラーゲームです。一見普通のアパートに閉じ込められたプレイヤーですが、すぐに一人ではないことに気づきます。緊迫感と恐怖に満ちた雰囲気の中、細部まで作り込まれた緻密な世界を探索し、不吉な存在に襲われる前に脱出方法を見つけ出しましょう
items.title: Blasfemia

items.description: Lead adorable warriors to form an adventure team to work and adventure on the computer desktop. Defeat the warriors to save the world. Rich nurturing and collection elements, idle and slack off to earn money and fight monsters!
items.description_ja: 可愛い勇者たちを率いてデスクトップ上で仕事や冒険を！魔王を倒して世界を救え。育成と収集要素が豊富で、放置しながらお金を稼いでモンスターと戦おう！
items.title: Book of Fei

items.description: A B-horror mystery comedy adventure game. Having a crush on your bestie is hard enough without serial killers in the way! Lily's vacay plan to romance her crush Sally goes wrong when killers keep cropping up and ruining the mood. And that means war. "How dare you come between Sally and me!"
items.description_ja: B級ホラー風ミステリコメディADV。リリは親友のスイに片思い中。告白を決意してスイを旅行に誘ったものの、複数の殺人鬼の襲来で計画は台無し。憤慨したリリは宣戦布告するのであった──スイちゃんとわたくしの間に割って入らないで！
developers: MaouCat Studio / 魔王貓工作室
items.title: Blood Lily: Killers Can't Sink a Yuri Ship

items.description_ja: Welcome to WendyQuest - a well-done 2D adventure RPG from Wendy’s packed with crispy combat, handcrafted pixel art, and fresh, never frozen puzzles. Play as redheaded warrior Wendy & battle evil mech-monsters to save a culinary kingdom in peril.

items.description: My grandmother went to space—and came back.After that, the world began to spin, round and round...What was this country, this society, meant to be?We simply process the things that come our way.What was the world supposed to be like?I don’t know.SAYONALAIKA is an adventure game.
items.description_ja: わたしの祖母は宇宙へ行った、そして帰還した。それから世界が回りだす、ぐるぐると……。この国は、この社会は、どうあるべきだったのだろう？わたしたちは、ただ流れてくる物体を処理していく。世界は本来どうあるべきだったのだろう？わからない、わからないまま過ぎていく。『SAYONALAIKA』はアドベンチャーゲームです。
items.title: SAYONALAIKA

items.description: Dive into a fortress labyrinth crawling with monsters, defending yourself with your... tongue? As a frog, it's your best bet to traverse this retro-inspired 2D metroidvania title. Collect treasures to gain permanent upgrades, discovering new areas of the massive interconnected map with them!
items.description_ja: Dive into a fortress labyrinth crawling with monsters, defending yourself with your... tongue? Harvest resources, construct robots, befriend a dragon, and help a creepy witch get even creepier in this update of the classic 2010 city-building adventure.
items.description_ja: ケフリングは小さいかもしれませんが、彼らの王国建設の冒険は巨大です。A World of Keflings で友達と一緒に世界を構築しましょう。2010 年の古典的な都市建設アドベンチャーのこのアップデートで、資源を収穫し、ロボットを組み立て、ドラゴンと友達になり、不気味な魔女がさらに不気味になるのを手伝ってください。

items.description: Time to clock in at DE NILE SHIPPING, the world’s “most efficient” warehouse! Work together in online co-op with up to 4 players to fulfill orders of increasingly chaotic, physics-based boxes. Time is money, and safety is no concern… just try not to crash out!
items.description_ja: 世界で「最も効率的」な倉庫、DE NILE SHIPPINGで働こう。注文はカオスになっていくばかり。最大4人のオンライン協力プレイで、物理演算ベースで動く貨物箱をさばき切れ。時は金なり、安全性は二の次なり…ただし、クラッシュアウトはしないように！

items.description: A thrilling retro-styled shooter with survival-horror elements, inspired by the design of Resident Evil and the atmosphere of Bioshock. Spend an hour delving deep into a seaside bunker in an uncanny land, uncovering its secrets and surviving against the cosmic terrors which dwell within.

Unnatural anomalies creep into the office as you complete your tasks. Can you make it to the end of your shift alive.

しかし、今日はいつもと何かが違う
オフィスで起こる“異変”…あなたは無事に退勤できるのか…
異変を対処し退勤を目指す3Dホラーゲーム。

You are trapped in a familiar-feeling space, exploring and escaping… only to return to the start.

Can you break free from the loop?

『Backroom Loop』は一人称視点の心理ホラー（エンターテインメント）ゲームです。

あなたは見慣れたようで見知らぬ空間に閉じ込められ、探索と脱出を繰り返す…しかし再びスタート地点へ戻される。

このループから抜け出せますか？

亡くなった少女の記憶に潜り、死の真相を解き明かせ。
その死の裏に、三人の女子生徒のうち誰かが関わっているのかもしれない──。

爆笑必至の会話とコミカルな出会い！
スリル満点、爽快アクション満載！

Meet strange neighbours, make bad trades, learn about them. Everytime you fail, the building stays the same. What changes is what you know.
