items.description: Witchtastic is a challenging 2-4 player coop game about brewing and delivering magic potions as fast as possible. Take on the role of aspiring witches and experience charming adventures. Need a break from all the yelling of your friends? You can practice in a single player campaign as well!
items.description_ja: 『ウィッチタスティック』は魔法の秘薬をできるだけ早く作り届ける2～4人で遊べるチャレンジングな協力プレイゲーム。高みを目指す魔女たちになりきって、魅惑の冒険を体験しましょう。え？今は友だち同士で叫び声を浴びせたい気分じゃない？それなら1人用のキャンペーンモードでプレイの練習もできますよ！
items.title: Witchtastic

items.description: THIS IS THE POWER OF THE KEI TRUCK!
items.description_ja: これが軽トラの力だ！
items.title: DriveCrazy

items.description: An eerie liminal game that explores just how far an angel can fall. Play as sapphic Lucifer and corrupt angels into falling... in love with you.
items.description_ja: An eerie liminal game that explores just how far an angel can fall. Play as sapphic Lucifer and corrupt angels into falling... in love with you.
items.title: Seraphim Slum

items.description: This Curse Is Metal as Hell! is a first-person horror comedy game. As the game’s child protagonist, master the special powers hidden within your dad’s MP3 player to rush your way through a world of pure terror. Do you have what it takes to defeat the curse that plagued your family for generations?
items.description_ja: 「クソデカ囃子(ばやし) | Kusodeka Bayashi」は、一人称視点のホラーコメディゲームです。主人公であるボクは、特殊な力を秘めたMP3プレーヤーを使いこなし、恐怖の中を駆け抜ける。果たして、ボクは一族の呪いに打ち勝つことができるのだろうか…？
items.title: This Curse Is Metal as Hell! | Kusodeka Bayashi

items.description: Do you hear the doorbell, Stewie? Your first guest is here...and something tells me they’ll never leave the motel...
items.description_ja: Do you hear the doorbell, Stewie? Your first guest is here...and something tells me they’ll never leave the motel...
items.title: The Supper: New Blood

items.description: We are recruiting a large number of testers from around the world to participate in an unprecedented secret experiment.. Join us and embark on this journey of exploration that is crucial to survival. In this unknown experiment, your choices will determine the fate of the Earth.
items.description_ja: 私たちは世界中から試験員を大量に募集し、これまでにない秘密の試験に参加しています。私たちに参加して、この存亡にかかわる探索の旅に出て、あなたの選択は、地球の運命を決定します。この未知の実験の中で、あなたは、変化の力です！
items.title: A Simple Garbage Sorting Game

items.description:
Welcome to Cattlehorse Corp! Here, deadlines are brutal and backstabbers abound.
Start missions with up to 10 staffers. Facing high - risk tasks? We’ll assign helper bots! 
Use wacky gear, bluff, or double - cross. Watch out—drones and hostile bots attack. Only the survivors get ahead!
items.description_ja:
Welcome to Cattlehorse Corp! Here, deadlines are brutal and backstabbers abound.
Start missions with up to 10 staffers. Facing high - risk tasks? We’ll assign helper bots! 
Use wacky gear, bluff, or double - cross. Watch out—drones and hostile bots attack. Only the survivors get ahead!
items.title: I'm Truely a Good Guy!

items.description: A first-person psychological horror game about the life of a K-pop idol. Explore a luxury apartment, Korean streets, and your agency building as you confront the unsettling truth hidden beneath the surface.
items.description_ja:
K-POPアイドルをテーマにした一人称視点の心理ホラーゲームです。
高級マンション、韓国の街、そして芸能事務所を探索しながら、次第に明らかになる不穏な真実と向き合うことになります。
items.title: Sasaeng | 사생

items.description: It’s an indie horror game where John, a forensic photographer, after an unexpected and exhausting shift, is forced to spend the night away from home. What seemed like a temporary rest soon begins to turn unsettling.
items.description_ja: これはインディーホラーゲームで、ジョンという法医学写真家が、予期せぬ過酷な勤務の後、家から離れて一晩を過ごさざるを得なくなる物語です。一時的な休息に思えたものが、やがて不気味なものへと変わっていきます。
items.title: Unseen

items.description:
Riley Adams moves to Ashburg for a new teaching job and rents a house to get settled.
She expected silence. She didn’t expect company.
items.description_ja:
Riley Adams moves to Ashburg for a new teaching job and rents a house to get settled.
She expected silence. She didn’t expect company.
items.title: Within of Static - Ashburg Rental

items.description: A chaotic co-op cooking game for 1–6 players. Run a fake fine dining restaurant bought with mafia money: cook badly, serve picky guests, lie your way out of complaints, put out fires and survive the health inspector – all while the Don comes to collect.
items.description_ja: 1〜6人で遊べるドタバタ協力料理ゲーム。マフィアの金で買った偽物の高級レストランを切り盛りしよう。料理はヘタ、客はうるさい、クレームはウソで切り抜け、火事を消して衛生検査を乗り切れ。その間にもDonが取り立てにやってくる。
items.title: Fine Dining Fraud

items.description: The Repairing Mantis is a narrative horror game that lets you experience the disturbing, violent (yet absurdly poetic) story of a mantis on a mission to repair a bridge made of flying squirrel flesh.
items.description_ja: The Repairing Mantis is a narrative horror game that lets you experience the disturbing, violent (yet absurdly poetic) story of a mantis on a mission to repair a bridge made of flying squirrel flesh.
items.title: The Repairing Mantis

items.description: In the facility, each step, each shot, each mistake costs precious energy. Rendered entirely in black and white, this mystery can be unravelled. The puzzle can be solved. Don't ask who tried to solve it before. Do the job. Find oxygen and sleep. Go deeper. And don't ask about Aaron.
items.description_ja: この施設では、移動の1歩、弾丸の1発、ミスの1つ、全てに貴重なエネルギーを消費する。完全モノクロの世界で、酸素を探し、眠る。それが仕事だ。それから、アーロンのことは口にしてはいけない。
items.title: REPOSE

items.description: Free-to-play 30-player party royale where every round switches genres! Sprint, slide-hop, and shove rivals across 35+ modes and 60+ maps—from Kart Racing, Prop Hunt, and FPS Deathmatch to Glass Bridges and Mingle. With 3D proximity voice, custom lobbies, and cross-play!
items.description_ja: 毎ラウンドジャンルが変わる基本無料の30人対戦パーティーロイヤル！スライディングや突き落としで35種以上のモードと60種以上のマップを制覇せよ。カートレース、プロップハント、ガラスの橋など満載！3D近接ボイスチャット、カスタムマッチ、クロスプレイ対応！
items.title: Nexus Rumble: The Ultimate Showdown

items.description: It’s all over if mom catches you playing video games past bedtime. Pretend to sleep through this nightmare, avoid mother’s surveillance, and complete the game at hand.【Genre: First-person horror stealth game】
items.description_ja: 夜ふかしがお母さんにバレたら、一瞬で全てが終わる──。あなたは悪夢の中で寝たフリをしながらお母さんの監視をやり過ごし、手元のゲームをクリアしなければいけません。【ジャンル：一人称視点ホラーステルスゲーム】
items.title: Time for Bed

items.description: Dive into a realistic experience of the Backrooms, without jumpscares, getting lost in impossible spaces and feeling like something is watching you. The uncertainty of not knowing where you're going will make you want to quit… Will you be able to make it to the end?
items.description_ja: ジャンプスケアなしで、現実的なBackroomsの体験に飛び込み、不可能な空間で迷子になり、何かに見られていると感じる。どこに向かっているのかわからない不確実性が、あなたを辞めたくさせるでしょう…最後までたどり着けますか？
items.title: Hotel 188

items.description: This is Interesting is a psychological horror mystery based game with roguelite elements. You are being watched, and you aren't really sure why. Delve through the depths of memory to uncover the mystery behind the gray purgatory you find yourself in.
items.description_ja: This is Interesting is a psychological horror mystery based game with roguelite elements. You are being watched, and you aren't really sure why. Delve through the depths of memory to uncover the mystery behind the gray purgatory you find yourself in.
items.title: This is Interesting

items.description: Step into Inky’s sleep — a haunting yet enchanting 2D horror-adventure with surreal touches, led by an endearing little cat. Explore dark dreams, unravel uncanny puzzles, and evade otherworldly creatures.
items.description_ja: インキーの夢の世界に飛び込もう。シュルレアリスムの要素が散りばめられた、暗くも魅惑的な2Dホラーアドベンチャー。かわいいネコが主人公となり、秘密を嗅ぎ出し、パズルを解き明かし、夢に侵入してきた招かれざるクリーチャーから身を隠そう。
items.title: Inky's Sleep

items.description: The Citadel Project is a first-person stealth game with lite RPG/Adventure elements, inspired by Thief and Dark Messiah and set in a dark fantasy world. Use your tools and surroundings wisely, stay hidden in the shadows, and uncover the dark secrets behind the Citadel's downfall.
items.description_ja: The Citadel Project is a first-person stealth game with lite RPG/Adventure elements, inspired by Thief and Dark Messiah and set in a dark fantasy world. Use your tools and surroundings wisely, stay hidden in the shadows, and uncover the dark secrets behind the Citadel's downfall.
items.title: The Citadel Project

items.description: Rian and Febi thought they found their dream home at a cheap price, unaware of its dark history. Experience their daily life from dual perspectives in this psychological horror game. Face relentless terror, make critical choices, and uncover the truth: are they truly the only ones inside?
items.description_ja: Rian and Febi thought they found their dream home at a cheap price, unaware of its dark history. Experience their daily life from dual perspectives in this psychological horror game. Face relentless terror, make critical choices, and uncover the truth: are they truly the only ones inside?
items.title: Pikabuu: Home

items.description: Oh hello dearie.. Babushka needs to clean up her big magical cellar. Use hag magic, or just hit stuff with your broom.
items.description_ja: こんにちは！あなたは大きな魔法のセラーを掃除しないといけない老婆。カラフルで難しい魔法を習得して、いろんな物をほうきでたたいてみよう。
items.title: Babushka's Glitch Dungeon

items.description: In this pixel-art dystopian block-pushing puzzler, a shadowy client has hired you to navigate a network of hazardous secret labs. Find a way to clean the scene and destroy the ███████. Take the money, do the job, don’t ask questions.
items.description_ja: このディストピア世界を舞台にしたピクセルアートのブロック押しパズルゲームで、あなたは謎めいた依頼人に雇われ、危険な極秘研究施設群へと送り込まれる。現場を片付け、███████を処分しろ。報酬を受け取り、仕事をこなし、余計な詮索はするな。
items.title: Hazard Pay

items.description: Scam Line is a 4–8 player social deception game where your party will face different challenges. Become a liar, a manipulator, a cheater, or find your own path to victory
items.description_ja: Scam Lineは4～8人向けのソーシャル・デセプションゲームです。あなたのパーティーはさまざまな試練に直面します。嘘つきになるもよし、策略家になるもよし、イカサマ師になるもよし。あるいは、自分だけの勝利への道を見つけてください
items.title: Scam Line

items.description:
This is a small free prequel to the Is this Game Trying to Kill Me?. 
An old cabin deep in the dense forest, a strange computer, and a game that's trying to kill you!
items.description_ja:
This is a small free prequel to the Is this Game Trying to Kill Me?. 
An old cabin deep in the dense forest, a strange computer, and a game that's trying to kill you!
items.title: Is this Game Trying to Kill Me? Preface

items.description: Play a Go Fish-style card game with Boo, the “Are you scared?” cat. Ask for cards, collect four of a kind and beat him to five sets. His questions offer clues about his hand, and he remembers what you ask for, too.
items.description_ja: Play a Go Fish-style card game with Boo, the “Are you scared?” cat. Ask for cards, collect four of a kind and beat him to five sets. His questions offer clues about his hand, and he remembers what you ask for, too.
items.title: Boo! Are you scared? The Chests Game

items.description: An arcade full of secrets, a sentient virtual pet in the prize cabinet, a stealth shooter roguelite arcade machine and one way to escape: win tickets.
items.description_ja: 謎だらけのゲームセンター、景品キャビネットの中の感情を持つバーチャルペット、アーケードマシンによるローグライトステルスシューティング。これらから逃れる唯一の手段、それはチケットを得ること。
items.title: Unshine Arcade

items.description: BLEMO! It’s a super-short, casual interactive story. You can talk to NPCs, walk across the tiny map, or try to solve our secret puzzle. We wanted to create a tiny, living world so let us know how we did! Soak in the five minutes of gameplay for as long as you like.
items.description_ja: BLEMO! It’s a super-short, casual interactive story. You can talk to NPCs, walk across the tiny map, or try to solve our secret puzzle. We wanted to create a tiny, living world so let us know how we did! Soak in the five minutes of gameplay for as long as you like.
items.title: Blemo

items.description: Your father needs a beer, and it's your job to get it. He doesn't care what it takes, so do what you must. Be quick though - it's not so safe in the dark.
items.description_ja: Your father needs a beer, and it's your job to get it. He doesn't care what it takes, so do what you must. Be quick though - it's not so safe in the dark.
items.title: Beer Machine

items.description: "Mourningwood Lodge2:Hidden Voice" is a  Chinese folk horror FMV mystery about a forbidden ghost marriage, a cursed nursery rhyme, and a string of fear-stricken deaths. Investigate a haunted mansion, uncover buried sins, and face multiple endings.
items.description_ja: "Mourningwood Lodge2:Hidden Voice" is a  Chinese folk horror FMV mystery about a forbidden ghost marriage, a cursed nursery rhyme, and a string of fear-stricken deaths. Investigate a haunted mansion, uncover buried sins, and face multiple endings.
items.title: 林葬屋前传：冥声

items.description: Dig, fight, and sabotage your way to victory in a fast-paced multiplayer party brawler! Battle other moles in wild, random caves, build your loadout, and deposit your minerals to win.
items.description_ja:
掘って、戦って、妨害して勝利をつかめ！最大8人のモグラたちが、ランダムに生成されるワイルドな洞窟でドタバタ対戦。お気に入りの装備を選んで、鉱石をゴールに届けよう！
ゲームについて
items.title: Mineral Madness

items.description: Invasion of The Halloween Fiends is a First-Person Retro horror game that takes place on Halloween Night. Strangers keep visiting you looking for candy. Some of them may not be so friendly. Will you be able to survive Halloween Night?
items.description_ja: Invasion of The Halloween Fiends is a First-Person Retro horror game that takes place on Halloween Night. Strangers keep visiting you looking for candy. Some of them may not be so friendly. Will you be able to survive Halloween Night?
items.title: Invasion of The Halloween Fiends

items.description: Nostalgia is a two-player cooperative indie game that escapes from enemies in a dark labyrinth. After waking up in the deep, dark forest, the two follow an unidentified girl into the labyrinth. Avoid enemies in the labyrinth, find a diary, reveal the hidden past, and escape.
items.description_ja: 郷愁は、暗い迷宮から敵を避けて脱出する 2 人用の協同インディー ゲームです。 深く暗い森の中で気がついた二人は、正体不明の女の子について迷宮入りします。 迷宮の中で敵を避け、日記を探して隠された過去を明らかにして脱出してください。
items.title: Nostalgia

items.description:
A Point and Click work simulator where you juggle 7 jobs to pay your debt.
Start by doing simple spreadsheet and progress to more important job like overseeing a nuclear bomb.
items.description_ja:
A Point and Click work simulator where you juggle 7 jobs to pay your debt.
Start by doing simple spreadsheet and progress to more important job like overseeing a nuclear bomb.
items.title: 7 Jobs at the Same Time

items.description: You’ve got five nights to strike it rich and save your future. All you have to do is spin, survive, and keep the windows shut. Treasure Tiger is out there — grinning, watching, waiting. He says it’s all about luck… but he’s not here to play fair.
items.description_ja:
あなたには、未来を救い、大金を手にするための5つの夜がある。
スピンして、生き残り、窓を閉め続けろ。
Treasure Tigerは外にいる──笑いながら、見つめながら、待っている。
「運がすべてだ」とやつは言う…だが、やつに公正なルールなどない。
items.title: Treasure Tiger

items.description: eat, sleep, work, repeat.
items.description_ja: eat, sleep, work, repeat.
items.title: blank_01

items.description: Make pizzas and deliver them. The hardest part of running the shop alone is that the delivery destinations are "liminal spaces." A story-driven 3D horror game. There is a kind of worst possible outcome that can only be born in infinite space. Once you understand it, it is already too late.
items.description_ja: ピザを作って、配達する。ワンオペ業務のつらいところは、配達先が「リミナルスペース」だってことだ…！ストーリー重視の3Dホラーゲーム。無限の空間でしか誕生しない「最悪」がある――なんだか分かる？分かった時には、何もかも遅いけど。
items.title: Liminal Sick Pizza Blue

items.description: Mini Mart Survivors is a bullet heaven roguelite set in the mysterious SHIFT24 convenience store chain. Survive the night shift using convenience store items like cup noodles, snacks and coffee as weapons to fight off waves of strange customers.
items.description_ja: コンビニサバイバーズ(Mini Mart Survivors)は、怪しいコンビニチェーン「シフト24」を舞台にしたサバイバー系ローグライトです。カップ麺やお菓子、コーヒーなどのコンビニ商品を武器に、押し寄せる奇妙なお客さんを撃退し、夜勤を生き抜きましょう！
items.title: Mini Mart Survivors

items.description: The Capybaras with Orange are back! Find them all in the fantastic library. Search for them between books and on the stained glass windows. Light them up at night with amazing colors.
items.description_ja: The Capybaras with Orange are back! Find them all in the fantastic library. Search for them between books and on the stained glass windows. Light them up at night with amazing colors.
items.title: Hidden Capybaras with Orange in the Whimsical Library

items.description: "Laser Tag Massacre" is a narrative-driven horror game inspired by 80s slasher movies, with a PS1-style aesthetic. On Halloween night, five friends throw a party in an abandoned arcade deep in rural Campinas, Brazil. What begins as a fun game of laser tag quickly spirals into their worst nightmare.
items.description_ja: 「Laser Tag Massacre」は、80年代のスラッシャー映画にインスパイアされたPS1風の物語重視ホラーゲームです。ハロウィンの夜、5人の友人がブラジル・カンピナス郊外の廃アーケードでパーティーを開き、楽しいレーザータグがやがて最悪の悪夢に変わります。
items.title: Laser Tag Massacre

items.description: A grotesque retro-style FPP horror set in a typical Polish apartment block from the 90s. A pixelated shader blends with Lumen’s realistic lighting to create a one-of-a-kind atmosphere. Absurd humor intertwines with macabre moments and choices you’d never want to make.
items.description_ja: A grotesque retro-style FPP horror set in a typical Polish apartment block from the 90s. A pixelated shader blends with Lumen’s realistic lighting to create a one-of-a-kind atmosphere. Absurd humor intertwines with macabre moments and choices you’d never want to make.
items.title: POHMIELISKO

items.description:
"Curse of the Shadow" is a BL-themed horror visual novel.
Cursed by a "ghost", protagonist Xu  finds eerie dark shadows in every photo he takes.Once escaping reality, he’s forced by fate to face fears   uncover the curse’s truth, he and two friends embark on a terrifying, unknown journey.
items.description_ja:
"Curse of the Shadow" is a BL-themed horror visual novel.
Cursed by a "ghost", protagonist Xu  finds eerie dark shadows in every photo he takes.Once escaping reality, he’s forced by fate to face fears   uncover the curse’s truth, he and two friends embark on a terrifying, unknown journey.
items.title: 咒影  Curse of the Shadow

items.description: Beanman is the coolest cat in town until he loses his glasses after a night of beango with his good pal Granny Smith. Talk with the townspeople of Beantown, learn, live, and laugh through their life journey's as you decipher the mystery of who took your glasses so you can get your cool back!
items.description_ja: Beanman is the coolest cat in town until he loses his glasses after a night of beango with his good pal Granny Smith. Talk with the townspeople of Beantown, learn, live, and laugh through their life journey's as you decipher the mystery of who took your glasses so you can get your cool back!
items.title: Beanman Gets His Cool Back

items.description: Experience an immersive terminal management simulator. Manage passengers, organize schedules, inspect luggage, catch smugglers, and prevent illegal activities. Not every passenger is innocent — some will try to trick you or smuggle illegal items. Stay alert and run your terminal efficiently.
items.description_ja: 没入型ターミナル管理シミュレーターを体験しよう。乗客を管理し、スケジュールを整理し、手荷物を検査し、密輸者を捕まえ、違法行為を防ごう。すべての乗客が善意ではありません。中にはあなたを騙したり、違法な物品を運ぼうとする者もいます。注意深くターミナルを効率的に運営してください。
items.title: Bus Terminal Simulator: Prologue

items.description:
Ever wonder what the little sisters of famous idols get up to in their free time?

Get ready for an adventure full of headpats and wish-driven insanity! Discover 12+ endings in this visual novel that pushes the genre beyond its limits.
items.description_ja:
Ever wonder what the little sisters of famous idols get up to in their free time?

Get ready for an adventure full of headpats and wish-driven insanity! Discover 12+ endings in this visual novel that pushes the genre beyond its limits.
items.title: Three Wishes

items.description: Survive the treacherous sea in this quirky multiplayer shooter game! Play solo or team up and fight off Cthulhu's minions. Master a unique recoil-based mechanic to blast enemies and chart your course. Mix and match upgrades to craft the perfect sea-surviving strategy!
items.description_ja: 危険が潜む死の海で、謎の怪異を迎え撃つのは...まさかのマメ粒？！仲間と一緒に立ち向かえ——1〜4人のローカル＆オンライン協力プレイ対応。
items.title: Bang Bang Barrage

items.description: "Illusion Box" is the first virtual reality entertainment project of the 21st century. However, malicious rumors and computer virus infections forced the company to shut down the project. Now, the long-abandoned "Illusion Box" devices are being reactivated...
items.description_ja: イリュージョンボックスとは21世紀初期のヴァーチャルプロジェクトであり、ユーザーにもたらす想像力溢れる体験が、2000年以降爆発的に流行した。しかし、噂やウイルス感染などの原因により、やむなくこのプロジェクトは中止となった。そして今、廃れたイリュージョンボックスのデバイスが、再び起動する……
items.title: Illusion Box

items.description: Explore a haunted mansion, uncover a killers madness, and enter surreal paintings to relive the twisted mind of a killer. Danger and mystery are lurking behind the screaming walls of this fascinating and frightening horror adventure.
items.description_ja: Explore a haunted mansion, uncover a killers madness, and enter surreal paintings to relive the twisted mind of a killer. Danger and mystery are lurking behind the screaming walls of this fascinating and frightening horror adventure.
items.title: Death Frame

items.description: Where Sound Becomes Sight, Style Meets Violence. Step into the world of darkness as a blind protagonist who sees through sound in this stylish 2D top-down shooter where every kill matters and style is everything.
items.description_ja: Where Sound Becomes Sight, Style Meets Violence. Step into the world of darkness as a blind protagonist who sees through sound in this stylish 2D top-down shooter where every kill matters and style is everything.
items.title: Big Blind

items.description: In this survival horror, you're surrounded by sea and a towering gate ahead. Walk into the maze, hunt, gather, and run to survive, alone or with friends. Remember: You're not the only one starving...
items.description_ja: このサバイバルホラーでは、あなたは海に囲まれ、目の前にはそびえ立つ門があります。迷路に入り、狩り、採集し、生き延びるために走り抜けてください。一人でも、仲間と一緒でも。忘れないで…飢えているのはあなただけではありません。
items.title: MAZEBOUND: Hunt, Gather, Run!

items.description: HorrorVale: A grand Spooktacular adventure about a girl, her dog, and her long journey to save him in a strange and horrifying Underworld.
items.description_ja: HorrorVale: A grand Spooktacular adventure about a girl, her dog, and her long journey to save him in a strange and horrifying Underworld.
items.title: HorrorVale

items.description: Gnomdom is a point & click puzzle game where you find little gnomes stuck in various places and help them return to their home.
items.description_ja: Gnomdom は、さまざまな場所に閉じ込められた小さなノームを見つけて、彼らを家に帰す手助けをするポイントアンドクリックパズルゲームです。
items.title: Gnomdom

items.description: Rusted Awakening is a brutal, one-hour horror FPS with classic combat and a deeply atmospheric world. Fight your way out of a decaying underground facility where humanity is kept asleep by those who never sleep. Battle enemies, survive traps, and explore surreal environments that shift around you.
items.description_ja: Rusted Awakening is a brutal, one-hour horror FPS with classic combat and a deeply atmospheric world. Fight your way out of a decaying underground facility where humanity is kept asleep by those who never sleep. Battle enemies, survive traps, and explore surreal environments that shift around you.
items.title: Rusted Awakening

items.description: A collection of dozens of Aether-flavored microgames! Dive into the Dreams of Aether, where everyone is trapped in a never-ending nightmare! Meet some of the strangest characters Aether has to offer!
items.description_ja: 「Aether」シリーズを題材としたミニゲームが大集合！ 終わらない悪夢に捕らわれてしまったエーテル大陸のライバルたち。どこかヘンなキャラクターたちと共に、悪夢から抜け出そう！
items.title: Dreams of Aether

items.description: Command two armies and resolve the continental turmoil in this traditional, robust, and highly authentic simultaneous turn-based strategy.
items.description_ja: 2つの部隊を指揮し、大陸の争乱を解決していく伝統的で骨太な手ごたえがある超本格派同時ターン制ストラテジー
items.title: Dragon's Chronicles~暗黒大魔王と北斗の剣(つるぎ)~

items.description: We’ve got a deal for you: solve the puzzle, and unlock an unforgettable encounter with a stunning beauty. Start with a flirtatious introduction and work your way to the first (but far from the last) night together. Build your own seductive harem!
items.description_ja: パズルを解くと、ムラムラするようなセクシーな女性との出会いをお楽しみいただけます。デートから最初の夜まで、ハーレムを築き上げましょう！
items.title: Milf Collection

items.description: A psychological horror game where you spend a night in the shoes of an arcade worker named Marcus. Win prizes on the crane machine and shoot some hoops. Just make sure to keep the doors locked.
items.description_ja: マーカスというアーケードの従業員の視点で、一晩を過ごす心理的ホラーゲーム。クレーンゲームで景品を獲得し、バスケットボールをシュートしよう。ただし、ドアの施錠は忘れずに。
items.title: Midnight Crane

items.description: Skewer Squad is a cute yet chaotic tower defense roguelite. Step into the apron of a Grillmaster, draft random ingredients, mix wild seasonings, and build a squad of skewers that are both delicious and powerful to defend your grill.
items.description_ja:
『ひっぱるなよ、串焼きマスター！』は、可愛くて少しカオスな、ローグライク×タワーディフェンスゲームである。
串焼きマスターとしてランダムに食材を引き当て、調味料を組み合わせながら「おいしくて強力な串焼きチーム」を作り上げ、
迫りくる敵から焼き台を守り抜きましょう！
items.title: Skewer Squad

items.description: An exploration Survival Horror game set in the idyllic town of Lucenille. Explore every single crevice and find what happened to your friends. BRING THEM BACK. MAKE THEM UNDERSTAND
items.description_ja: のどかなルセニールの町を舞台にした、探索型サバイバルホラーゲーム。あらゆる隙間を探索し、仲間に何が起こったのかを突き止めよう。
items.title: Tache Noire

items.description: Absorb, split, survive—the 2016 cell-devouring classic is back! Battle in Free-for-All, Random Teams, Guild War & Tournaments. Reach level 59, open unlimited accounts, and dominate the arena in Mitos.is: The Game OG.
items.description_ja: Absorb, split, survive—the 2016 cell-devouring classic is back! Battle in Free-for-All, Random Teams, Guild War & Tournaments. Reach level 59, open unlimited accounts, and dominate the arena in Mitos.is: The Game OG.
items.title: Mitos.is: OG

items.description: Welcome to the world of The Coma 3: Bloodlines. In this realm of shadows rumors and urban legends become reality, and danger lurks around every corner. If a living intruder dies here, their body will be severed from their spirit and never wake again ...
items.description_ja: 『The Coma 3: Bloodlines』（ザ・コーマ3：ブラッドラインズ）の世界へようこそ。この影の領域では噂と都市伝説が現実と化し、あらゆる場所に危険が潜む。侵入した生者はここで死ぬと、その身体は魂から切り離され、二度と目覚めることはない……
items.title: The Coma 3: Bloodlines

items.description:
Up to four guinea pigs. One balloon. Endless chaos.
Work together or get nowhere in this physics-based co-op parkour challenge!
items.description_ja:
最大4匹のモルモット。1つの風船。終わりなきカオス。
この物理ベースの協力パルクールで、力を合わせなければどこにも進めない！
items.title: Guinea Pig Runaway Together

items.description: The "Debating Sim" returns! Engage famous philosophers of all stripes, challenge their ideas, and change the world— or just tell everyone they smell terrible. NONSENSE!
items.description_ja: The "Debating Sim" returns! Engage famous philosophers of all stripes, challenge their ideas, and change the world— or just tell everyone they smell terrible. NONSENSE!
items.title: Pro Philosopher 2: Governments & Grievances

items.description: What happens when you make a VR game only about Pressure Washers? From cleaning any object imaginable, playing soccer or volleyball up to flying - Under Pressure is a multiplayer playground that’s all around what you can do with a power washer in your hands.
items.description_ja: What happens when you make a VR game only about Pressure Washers? From cleaning any object imaginable, playing soccer or volleyball up to flying - Under Pressure is a multiplayer playground that’s all around what you can do with a power washer in your hands.
items.title: Under Pressure

items.description: Go on a rampage in this endless arcade Boomer-Shooter! Gain the weirdest weapons and destroy all the monsters in the never-ending temple of GRUEL!
items.description_ja: Go on a rampage in this endless arcade Boomer-Shooter! Gain the weirdest weapons and destroy all the monsters in the never-ending temple of GRUEL!
items.title: GRUEL

items.description: Wander a castle built of bitter memories in LOVE ETERNAL, a psychological horror platformer with devious trials and an unsettling, experimental narrative. Find a way out - or live in Shelter forever more.
items.description_ja:
重力を反転させ、忌まわしき記憶が築きし城を行け。正確な操作と瞬時の判断で、100以上のステージを踏破せよ。
家族から引き離された孤独な少女マヤを待ち受けるのは、不気味で鮮烈な世界、そして恐るべき秘密－－。走り、跳び、重力を反転させる中で、この世界もまた、理解を超えてねじれていく。
items.title: LOVE ETERNAL

items.description: You have been assigned to guard a dragon girl set to be executed at the end of 5 days and have the ability to kill her instantly at any time with the push of a button in this multi-ending visual novel.
items.description_ja:
『イツカノヨル』は「即処刑出来るボタン」を前に
5日後に処刑される死刑囚である竜族の少女と過ごす
マルチエンド方式のノベルゲームです。
items.title: 5omeday

items.description: Crawl through pipes, navigate the maze, listen carefully and get out before Rodland finds you.
items.description_ja: Crawl through pipes, navigate the maze, listen carefully and get out before Rodland finds you.
items.title: Rodland of Pipes

items.description:
JOIN THE SOCIETY in this story-driven, investigative horror game. Hunt down wealthy humans in a deadly forest in order to Feed The Pit.

Act 1 is available at launch. Acts 2 & 3 will release as free updates in the coming months!
items.description_ja:
JOIN THE SOCIETY in this story-driven, investigative horror game. Hunt down wealthy humans in a deadly forest in order to Feed The Pit.

Act 1 is available at launch. Acts 2 & 3 will release as free updates in the coming months!
items.title: Feed The Pit

items.description: Sub Terra is a first person psychological horror game set deep underground. As a maintenance worker, your job is to fix a broken water line at the end of tunnel 04-R. Enter the tunnel, repair the pipe, and get out.
items.description_ja: Sub Terra is a first person psychological horror game set deep underground. As a maintenance worker, your job is to fix a broken water line at the end of tunnel 04-R. Enter the tunnel, repair the pipe, and get out.
items.title: Sub Terra

items.description: Pumpkin Simulator is a game in which you can become a pumpkin.
items.description_ja: Pumpkin Simulator is a game in which you can become a pumpkin.
items.title: Pumpkin Simulator

items.description: Angel's Dreams — a roguelike game with horror elements, where your nightmare awaits you at home! Wake up, Explore, Survive, Escape!
items.description_ja: Angel's Dreams — a roguelike game with horror elements, where your nightmare awaits you at home! Wake up, Explore, Survive, Escape!
items.title: Angel's Dreams

items.description:
「宝姉妹 | スクラッチシミュレーター」は、ヤングガンガンで連載中のハートフルマネーコメディ漫画『宝姉妹』のキャラクターたちと一緒に、スクラッチくじ気分を味わえるシミュレーションゲームです。スクラッチを削って当たりマスをチェック。
タテ・ヨコ・ナナメのいずれか一列に同じ絵柄が3個並ぶと当たり！そろった絵柄に応じて当選金が受け取れます。
1等100万円当選を目指していっぱい削ろう！

※本作はゲーム内のみで完結するスクラッチ風シミュレーションです。
現実のお金の売買・賭け行為・実在のくじとは一切関係ありません。
ゲーム内で当選しても、現金や実物の賞品がもらえることはありません。
items.description_ja:
「宝姉妹 | スクラッチシミュレーター」は、ヤングガンガンで連載中のハートフルマネーコメディ漫画『宝姉妹』のキャラクターたちと一緒に、スクラッチくじ気分を味わえるシミュレーションゲームです。スクラッチを削って当たりマスをチェック。
タテ・ヨコ・ナナメのいずれか一列に同じ絵柄が3個並ぶと当たり！そろった絵柄に応じて当選金が受け取れます。
1等100万円当選を目指していっぱい削ろう！

※本作はゲーム内のみで完結するスクラッチ風シミュレーションです。
現実のお金の売買・賭け行為・実在のくじとは一切関係ありません。
ゲーム内で当選しても、現金や実物の賞品がもらえることはありません。
items.title: 宝姉妹 | スクラッチシミュレーター

items.description: Run your own home goods store! Sell sofas, refrigerators, TVs and more. Purchase products, set your prices, take payments, design your layout, handle shoplifters, and expand your store to build a successful retail business.
items.description_ja: 自分だけのホームグッズストアを経営しよう！ソファや冷蔵庫、テレビなどを販売し、商品を仕入れ、価格を設定し、支払いを受け取り、レイアウトをデザインし、万引き犯に対処し、店舗を拡張して成功する小売ビジネスを築こう。
items.title: Home Store Simulator

items.description: An incremental horror game about loving your job a little too much. Hire workers to automate the line, then recycle them once they've stopped being useful. A short, dense shift: around two hours, two endings, and updates still coming.
items.description_ja: An incremental horror game about loving your job a little too much. Hire workers to automate the line, then recycle them once they've stopped being useful. A short, dense shift: around two hours, two endings, and updates still coming.
items.title: Company is watching

items.description: Play as 25yo writer Jian Xun in a 5-min deadline loop. Your script is alive! In this thriller puzzle, use "keyframe sorting" to piece stories. Fight AI, break the 4th wall & escape the nightmare!
items.description_ja: 25歳の脚本家・間尋となり、残り5分のループに挑め。画面の文字が自我を持った！「キーフレームの並べ替え」で物語を繋ぐホラー解謎ゲーム。AIから主導権を奪い、パラドックスで対抗し、第四の壁を破って悪夢から脱出せよ！
items.title: INFINITY DEADLINE

items.description: Feel the horror and fear of the dark, unlock the exits to escape!
items.description_ja: 暗闇の恐怖と戦慄を肌で感じ、出口を解放して脱出せよ！
items.title: Specimen Zero

items.description:
Your next job awaits in Karisvale, detective. Will you fulfill your duty? Or become lost in the mystery... 
Explore a retro top-down world, question its citizens, and collect hidden items to uncover Karisvale's dark secret.
items.description_ja:
次の仕事は Karisvale です。 あなたはあなたの義務を果たしますか？ または謎に迷う...
レトロなトップダウンの世界を探索し、市民に質問し、隠されたアイテムを集めて Karisvale の暗い秘密を明らかにしてください。
items.title: Karisvale

items.description: 《SUFFOCATE》is a realistic 3D first-person survival horror game. The plot revolves around family relationships, cult, and the greed that permeates human nature. The game doesn't shy away from violence, gore, and faith in this one-of-a-kind survival horror experience, Taiwanese style.
items.description_ja: 《窒愛SUFFOCATE》 は、リアルな雰囲気がある一人称視点の3Dサバイバルホラーゲーム。ストーリーは現代を舞台に、家族の関係、謎の宗教、人間の欲を軸に展開していく。本作はグロ、暴力、信仰、エロ等の要素を取り入れており、これまでにないような台湾式のサバイバルホラーゲームに仕上げられている。 探索、謎解き、潜伏を行うことでストーリーは進んでいく。主人公と共に一家を中心に巻き起こる恐怖の物語を味わってみよう。
items.title: SUFFOCATE

items.description: Ninza is a free multiplayer game like no other! Instead of directly attacking your opponents, you crush them by pushing pieces of the level. Embrace chaos and dive into an entirely new level of frenzied and creative gameplay, where the environment itself becomes both your weapon and your enemy.
items.description_ja: Ninza は他に類を見ないマルチプレイヤー格闘ゲームです。敵を直接攻撃するのではなく、レベルのピースを動かせて、敵を潰してください。混沌を受け入れながら、まったく新しいレベルのクレイジーでクリエイティブなゲームプレイに飛び込みましょう。 環境そのものがあなたの武器にもなり、敵にもなります。
items.title: Ninza

items.description: A slow burn walking sim with an interactive soundtrack and horror vibes. You explore abstract locations and create your own unique sound for each of them by moving around and using Monoliths.
items.description_ja: インタラクティブなサウンドトラックとホラーな雰囲気を供えた、徐々に高まりを見せるウォーキングシミュレーター。抽象的なロケーションを探索し、移動したりモノリスを使ってあなただけのユニークな音を作りましょう。
items.title: Museum of Monoliths

items.description:
The deckbuilder where cards are plants, animals, and insects that can synergize and prey on each other.
Place your cards on an expanding board to trigger satisfying chain reactions and shape an interconnected ecosystem.
items.description_ja:
カードが植物、動物、昆虫で、互いに相乗効果を持ち、捕食することができるデッキビルダー。
拡大するボードにカードを配置して、満足のいく連鎖反応を起こし、つながった生態系を形作ってください。
items.title: Wild City

items.description: Return to the ice with your favorite Backyard athletes! The original Backyard Hockey 2002 is back and now enhanced to run on Steam. Skate, pass, shoot, and score in this classic game!
items.description_ja: Return to the ice with your favorite Backyard athletes! The original Backyard Hockey 2002 is back and now enhanced to run on Steam. Skate, pass, shoot, and score in this classic game!
items.title: Backyard Hockey '02

items.description: Splinter and Shredder are dead. Help the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles tackle deadly new threats and the approach of adulthood in this fast-paced turn-based beat-em-up!
items.description_ja: Splinter and Shredder are dead. Help the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles tackle deadly new threats and the approach of adulthood in this fast-paced turn-based beat-em-up!
items.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Tactical Takedown

items.description: Master the art of flips in this quirky arcade challenge! Press, hold, and release to jump, spin, and stick perfect landings. Chain flips, unlock silly accessories, and beat your high score in this endlessly addictive, physics-based game with cute minimalist graphics and one-button controls!
items.description_ja: Master the art of flips in this quirky arcade challenge! Press, hold, and release to jump, spin, and stick perfect landings. Chain flips, unlock silly accessories, and beat your high score in this endlessly addictive, physics-based game with cute minimalist graphics and one-button controls!
items.title: Flip Flop XL

items.description: Ethan Cross hasn’t heard from his mother in weeks. He decides to check on her at the family home but what he finds is silence, locked doors, and rooms that feel wrong. Trapped in a decaying house bound to a cursed clock. Explore, survive, and uncover what time has forgotten.
items.description_ja: Ethan Cross hasn’t heard from his mother in weeks. He decides to check on her at the family home but what he finds is silence, locked doors, and rooms that feel wrong. Trapped in a decaying house bound to a cursed clock. Explore, survive, and uncover what time has forgotten.
items.title: Absum

items.description: A deadly Chicken Plague has destroyed the world. As a guard of humanity’s last safe zone, you must inspect survivors seeking refuge and identify the infected. One mistake could doom the entire community, so examine everyone carefully before allowing them inside.
items.description_ja: 致命的な鶏疫病が世界を破壊した。人類の最後の安全保障地域の防衛として、あなたは庇護を求める生存者を検査しなければならなくて、1つの誤りはコミュニティ全体を破壊するかもしれなくて、彼らが入ることを許可する前に、すべての人を注意深く検査しなければなりません。
items.title: ChickenPlaguePolice

items.description: Tune in to paranoia! Broadcast Paranoia is an anthology of 7 short horror games about radio and conspiracy theories. Decode signals, seek the truth, and try not to lose your mind. Each story takes 15–30 minutes to complete.
items.description_ja: Tune in to paranoia! Broadcast Paranoia is an anthology of 7 short horror games about radio and conspiracy theories. Decode signals, seek the truth, and try not to lose your mind. Each story takes 15–30 minutes to complete.
items.title: Broadcast Paranoia: a horror anthology

items.description: FROGGONIT was trying to be the best explorer but accidentally covered the island with darkness! Hop into this comedy adventure game full of secrets and help your animal friends restore the light!
items.description_ja: FROGGONIT was trying to be the best explorer but accidentally covered the island with darkness! Hop into this comedy adventure game full of secrets and help your animal friends restore the light!
items.title: FROGGONIT

items.description:
A sinking ship.
Too many SpongeBob references.
Not enough explanations.

Escape the ship.
Collect bugs (actual insects).
items.description_ja:
沈みゆく船。
SpongeBobのネタが多すぎる。
説明が足りない。

船から脱出しろ。
虫を集めろ。
items.title: Sea Chronicles

items.description: The sequel to the physics-based puzzle game 'Q REMASTERED,' titled 'Q2 HUMANITY,' introduces characters or 'humans' that now appear in the game. These 'humans' can jump, bounce, throw things, and sometimes even exhibit special abilities. 'Q2' can be played solo or with up to 4 players.
items.description_ja:
物理演算ゲーム『Q REMASTERED』の続編『Q2 HUMANITY』は、“描く”だけではなく”人間 ”が登場。
“人間”が飛んだり跳ねたり投げたり、時には特殊能力を発揮したり。『Q2』は、1人はもちろん、最大4人まで遊ぶことができます。描いて人間を操って数多のステージに挑戦しよう！
items.title: Q2 HUMANITY

items.description: A grid-based action roguelike with autobattler-inspired synergy systems. Break the game and become a TENNIS GOD.
items.description_ja: A grid-based action roguelike with autobattler-inspired synergy systems. Break the game and become a TENNIS GOD.
items.title: TORSO TENNIS

items.description: Make Cute Animal Friends in this 8-bit Gameboy-inspired adventure!  But there's something lurking in the woods, with DARK SECRETS you'll need to uncover!
items.description_ja: Make Cute Animal Friends in this 8-bit Gameboy-inspired adventure!  But there's something lurking in the woods, with DARK SECRETS you'll need to uncover!
items.title: Storm the Swan - And the Power of FRIENDSHIP and IMAGINATION

items.description: You receive a dinner invite from an awkward new neighbor and things go great.
items.description_ja: You receive a dinner invite from an awkward new neighbor and things go great.
items.title: Discussion Over Dinner

items.description:
This is a game where you can learn about chopsticks while challenging physics-based puzzles with handling chopsticks. 
Inspired by 'Getting Over It with Bennett Foddy'.
items.description_ja:
箸の扱いを題材にした物理パズルに挑みながら、お箸について学べるゲームです。
『Getting Over It with Bennett Foddy』にインスピレーションを受けています。
items.title: All About Chopsticks

items.description: Secretly playing your Generic-90s-Handheld-Video-Game-Console during a first date? Shame on you!
items.description_ja: Secretly playing your Generic-90s-Handheld-Video-Game-Console during a first date? Shame on you!
items.title: DateBoy

items.description: A dungeon-crawler-rail-shooter-action hybrid for sickos. Blast FREAKS into pieces with juicy non-traditional FPS gameplay!
items.description_ja: A dungeon-crawler-rail-shooter-action hybrid for sickos. Blast FREAKS into pieces with juicy non-traditional FPS gameplay!
items.title: FREAKHUNTER

items.description:
This is Cafe "DReAMLAND". 
Grant your "customers'" wishes by serving them drinks mixed with a hint of blasphemy!
Cafe simulation x Exploration x Multiple endings Let your choices decide the final outcome.
items.description_ja:
不思議で冒涜的なクトゥルフ神話リスペクトADV。
願いを叶えるちょっぴり冒涜的なドリンクを作って、"お客様"の望みを叶えよう！
カフェシミュレーション×探索×マルチエンディングシステムで、あなたの求める物語の結末に辿り着こう。
items.title: Cafe DReAMLAND

items.description: Bob and Case just wanted a quiet night… but fate (and a clogged toilet) had other plans. When a clueless friend ignores an important warning and decides to take a dump in a broken toilet, the nightmare begins.
items.description_ja: Bob and Case just wanted a quiet night… but fate (and a clogged toilet) had other plans. When a clueless friend ignores an important warning and decides to take a dump in a broken toilet, the nightmare begins.
items.title: Poop Killer - Flush or Die

items.description: Cycle of Struggle: Ardengrad is a visual novel about politics, love, and the cost of historical choices in an alternate world. You are a student drawn into events that will soon erupt into civil war. Here, ideologies are not just words—they define people’s fates. Every decision leaves a mark.
items.description_ja: 『闘争のサイクル：アルデングラード』は、政治と愛、そして歴史的な選択の代償を描くビジュアルノベルです。あなたは一人の学生として、やがて内戦へと発展していく激動の渦中へと巻き込まれていきます。ここでイデオロギーとは、空虚な言葉ではなく、人々の運命そのものです。そして、あなたが下すすべての選択は、消えることのない爪痕を残していきます。
items.title: Cycle of Struggle: Ardengrad

items.description: The inheritance following his mother’s death turns into a series of mysterious events for Sam. Neighbors are complaining about strange noises and unexplained phenomena in the empty apartment. Intrigued, he decides to investigate what’s going on there himself.
items.description_ja: The inheritance following his mother’s death turns into a series of mysterious events for Sam. Neighbors are complaining about strange noises and unexplained phenomena in the empty apartment. Intrigued, he decides to investigate what’s going on there himself.
items.title: Lost Luminosity

items.description: Wasteland Bites is a horror-based food truck sim. Cooking up questionable cuisine in your post-apocalyptic food truck is tough. Fending off mutants, UFOs, rabid dogs, and things lurking in the dark? That's the real challenge. A chaotic mix of cooking and survival in a long gone world.
items.description_ja: Wasteland Bites is a horror-based food truck sim. Cooking up questionable cuisine in your post-apocalyptic food truck is tough. Fending off mutants, UFOs, rabid dogs, and things lurking in the dark? That's the real challenge. A chaotic mix of cooking and survival in a long gone world.
items.title: Wasteland Bites

items.description: It's been so long. You've tried to forget, however tonight you must walk through the park again. Now there are two men in the park. Will you help one, or both? Who will you trust?
items.description_ja: It's been so long. You've tried to forget, however tonight you must walk through the park again. Now there are two men in the park. Will you help one, or both? Who will you trust?
items.title: The Man in the Park 2: The Second Man in the Park

items.description: Grandma hasn’t been the same since Grandpa passed. A night in her house spirals into a battle with the Devil. Recover family heirlooms and perform the ritual to save her soul. But whatever you do… DON’T LOOK AT GRANDMA.
items.description_ja: Grandma hasn’t been the same since Grandpa passed. A night in her house spirals into a battle with the Devil. Recover family heirlooms and perform the ritual to save her soul. But whatever you do… DON’T LOOK AT GRANDMA.
items.title: DON'T LOOK AT GRANDMA

items.description: Scarecrow: 90s Crime Story blends narrative adventure with brutal top-down action. In a crime-ridden town of humans and animals, you're a resident by day and a hitman by night. Uncover your buried past before it catches up with you.
items.description_ja: 『Scarecrow: 90s Crime Story』は、物語重視のアドベンチャーと容赦ないトップダウンアクションを融合させた作品。人間と動物が暮らす犯罪のはびこる街で、あなたは昼は街の住人、夜は殺し屋。葬られた過去に追いつかれる前に、その真実を掘り起こせ。
items.title: Scarecrow: 90s Crime Story

items.description: You have no weapons. You have no means of defending yourself. Some will chase you, some will outsmart you. If you are in danger, run and hide.
items.description_ja: You have no weapons. You have no means of defending yourself. Some will chase you, some will outsmart you. If you are in danger, run and hide.
items.title: Very Scary Backrooms Game

items.description: A survival horror mixed with found footage elements. Unveil the secrets of a dark satanic cult and solve the Solomon Manor puzzles while hiding from the deadly Goat Face.
items.description_ja: サバイバルホラーとファウンドフッテージ要素の融合。ソロモンマナーの謎を解きながら、死のゴートフェイスから隠れつつ、暗い悪魔崇拝の秘密を暴け。
items.title: The Fear Business

items.description: "ZAKO NO AHIRU" is an exasperating climbing action game where you aim for the summit with a peculiar-behaving duck while being taunted by the cheeky girl, Sugaki Mary.
items.description_ja: 『ざこのあひる』は、生意気なメスガキの須垣メアリーに煽られながら、クセの強い挙動のあひるで踏破を目指す、イライラ登山アクションゲームです。
items.title: ZAKO NO AHIRU

items.description: BE THE VILLAIN and slay any hero who dares enter your dark domain! Deck out your castle with traps and minions as the ultimate diabolical dungeon keeper in this strategy / TD puzzler. Includes the original Castle Doombad game, rebuilt and remastered, plus brand new content.
items.description_ja: 悪の主役となり、あなたの邪悪な城に侵入する勇者たちを撃退せよ！罠と手下で要塞を強化し、戦略TDパズルで最凶のダンジョンキーパーに！リマスターされたオリジナル版に加え、新コンテンツも収録！
items.title: Castle Doombad Classic

items.description: Welcome to the survival horror clicker! Try to save a chicken egg and at the same time your life.
items.description_ja: 生存ホラークリッカーへようこそ！鶏の卵を救い、そして己の命も守れ。
items.title: Ells Tales: Egg

items.description: Gamble, survive, and outplay your debt! In Bling Bling Bankruptcy, you’re deep in the red, and the only way out is through high-stakes gambling. Play Poker, Blackjack, Roulette, Plinko, and more, buy items for bonuses, and survive as many days as possible!
items.description_ja: Gamble, survive, and outplay your debt! In Bling Bling Bankruptcy, you’re deep in the red, and the only way out is through high-stakes gambling. Play Poker, Blackjack, Roulette, Plinko, and more, buy items for bonuses, and survive as many days as possible!
items.title: Bling Bling Bankruptcy

items.description: Would your girlfriend really stay faithful for... five days? Follow Karl and Heather as they discover just how strong their relationship is in this hard NTR Visual Novel of 100k words in length. Featuring voice acting, animated sex scenes, and lots and lots of cheating sex... maybe!
items.description_ja: 君の彼女は本当に……5日間も忠実でいられるかな？KarlとHeatherを追って、二人の関係がどれだけ強いかを確かめよう。この10万語のハードNTRビジュアルノベルで。フルボイス、animated Hシーン、そして大量の浮気セックス……かもよ！
items.title: His Bet, Her Loss

items.description: A roguelike royalelike about warriors from across space and time, fighting to claim a wish from the Star of Aestheta. Strategize your tactics, enhance your troops, and outwit your opponents to rise to the top!
items.description_ja: A roguelike royalelike about warriors from across space and time, fighting to claim a wish from the Star of Aestheta. Strategize your tactics, enhance your troops, and outwit your opponents to rise to the top!
items.title: Aestheta

items.description: An exhilarating visual novel blending thriller and dark comedy. A tale of a train, money, greedy people, and bears.
items.description_ja: スリラーとブラックコメディの境界線を行くビジュアルノベル。列車とお金、貪欲な人間たち...そしてクマたちの物語。
items.title: DEATH TRAIN!!! Samara – Voronezh.

items.description: A simulator where, under a strange suggestion triggered by moving water, you must keep serving water to customers during your shift.
items.description_ja: 『揺れる水に反応する奇妙な暗示』をかけられたあなたが、アルバイト中にお客さんへ水を運ぶシミュレーターです。
items.title: Yuremizu: Hold It Through the Shift

items.description:
見知らぬ密室で目を覚ました主人公。
頼れるものは、手元に残された一台のスマートフォンだけ。

通話、メッセージ、アプリなどに残された痕跡をたどりながら、脱出の手がかりを探していく。

しかし、情報を集めるほどに、
この事件の裏に隠された異様な真実が浮かび上がっていく。

スマートフォンを操作して進める、サイコロジカル・ホラーADV。
items.description_ja:
見知らぬ密室で目を覚ました主人公。
頼れるものは、手元に残された一台のスマートフォンだけ。

通話、メッセージ、アプリなどに残された痕跡をたどりながら、脱出の手がかりを探していく。

スマートフォンを操作して進める、サイコロジカル・ホラーADV。

items.description:
A gothic arena brawler combining hazard-filled stages with MOBA-style abilities. 
Battle as unique misfits in a cursed city teetering on the edge of ruin.
items.description_ja:
A gothic arena brawler combining hazard-filled stages with MOBA-style abilities. 
Battle as unique misfits in a cursed city teetering on the edge of ruin.
items.title: Brimstone Brawlers - Early Access

items.description: EXIT 2 is a free multiplayer horror game in which a team of players must collect and deliver keys and then escape, while another player must stop them as a monster.
items.description_ja: EXIT 2 is a free multiplayer horror game in which a team of players must collect and deliver keys and then escape, while another player must stop them as a monster.
items.title: EXIT 2

items.description:
This is a physics puzzle game in which you build Hokkaido by piling up prefectures of Japan.
You become a "big person" and drop prefectures into a box.
Connected same prefectures will evolve into a larger prefecture!
Create the largest prefecture in Japan, Hokkaido, before the box overflows!
items.description_ja:
都道府県を積み上げて北海道を作る物理演算パズルゲームです。
あなたは”大きな人”となり、都道府県を箱に落とします。
同じ都道府県がくっつくと大きな都道府県に進化！
箱があふれる前に、日本最大の都道府県、北海道を作ろう！
items.title: Hokkaido Game

items.description: Rougelite + Russian Roulette, but using a more powerful cannon. Survive and take all the prizes!
items.description_ja: ローグライト+ロシアンルーレットですが、使用するのはより強力なキャノン砲です。生き残って、すべての賞金を手に入れましょう！やばい！クンクンは小黒子の屈辱に耐えられず、牢大にバスケットボールの技術を学びに行った。牢大の試練は爆発するバスケットボールを見つけることだ。
items.title: KUNKUN League

items.description:
Ghoulscrapers is a precision platformer where you play as Eggroll, the new employee at Ghoulscrapers.
You owe the government one gazillion dollars and it's your job to pay the debt before it's too late!
items.description_ja:
Ghoulscrapers is a precision platformer where you play as Eggroll, the new employee at Ghoulscrapers.
You owe the government one gazillion dollars and it's your job to pay the debt before it's too late!
items.title: GhoulScrapers

items.description: Step into the shoes of a supermarket cashier in this cute point-and-click game. Scan and bag over 300 unique products to earn as many points as you can before your shift ends! Between shifts, unwind by getting to know a cast of quirky coworkers.
items.description_ja: Step into the shoes of a supermarket cashier in this cute point-and-click game. Scan and bag over 300 unique products to earn as many points as you can before your shift ends! Between shifts, unwind by getting to know a cast of quirky coworkers.
items.title: Checkout: Cashier Simulator

items.description: Return to the soccer field with your favorite Backyard athletes! The original Backyard Soccer 1998 is back and now enhanced to run on Steam. Build your roster from among the iconic Backyard Kids. Kick, pass, and score in this classic game that made soccer fun for everyone!
items.description_ja: Return to the soccer field with your favorite Backyard athletes! The original Backyard Soccer 1998 is back and now enhanced to run on Steam. Build your roster from among the iconic Backyard Kids. Kick, pass, and score in this classic game that made soccer fun for everyone!
items.title: Backyard Soccer '98

items.description: Wizards in Shorts is a fast-paced online arena shooter. Blast your friends with fireballs, electricity, puffer fish, and mysterious blue orbs.
items.description_ja: Wizards in Shorts is a fast-paced online arena shooter. Blast your friends with fireballs, electricity, puffer fish, and mysterious blue orbs.
items.title: Wizards in Shorts

items.description: A chaotic adventure game packed with minigames and meme references, where you deliver pizzas, fight robots, pull pranks and take on an AI trying to wipe out the fun.
items.description_ja: カオスな冒険ゲームで、ミニゲーム満載。ピザを配達し、ロボットと戦い、いたずらをしながら、ユーモアを消そうとするAIに立ち向かう。
items.title: Natural Unintelligence: Zueirama 2

items.description: Uncover the purr-fect challenge in Apartment Filled With Cats! Explore charming, hand-drawn apartment filled with whimsical details as you search for cleverly hidden cats. Can you find them all? A relaxing, delightful journey awaits!
items.description_ja: Uncover the purr-fect challenge in Apartment Filled With Cats! Explore charming, hand-drawn apartment filled with whimsical details as you search for cleverly hidden cats. Can you find them all? A relaxing, delightful journey awaits!
items.title: Apartment Filled With Cats

items.description:
"Xi" is a horror puzzle game set in the context of modern Chinese folklore. 
The story takes place in an long-abandoned mountain mansion. This immersive escape room experience feels a bit too real, with eerie and strange elements everywhere—an empty banquet, an endless corridor.
items.description_ja:
『喜』は、中国近代の民俗をテーマにしたホラーパズルゲームです。
物語は、長い間廃墟となっていた山奥の古い屋敷で繰り広げられます。今回の没入型脱出ゲームは少し現実的すぎて、至る所に不気味で奇妙な雰囲気が漂っています。誰もいない宴席、抜け出せない回廊、誤って幽霊屋敷に入り込んだ「あなた」は本当に逃げ出せるのでしょうか？幸いなことに、この屋敷には他にも人がいますが、不幸なことに、その「人」は人間ではないようです...
items.title: Xi

items.description: Remote work simulator where you are a worm :)
items.description_ja: ミミズ視点で体験するリモートワークシミュレーター :)
items.title: Worming from Home

items.description: "Touhou Crawl" is a Touhou derivative roguelike game. Conquer the dungeon-ified Gensokyo using items, faith, and tactics!
items.description_ja:
「Touhou Crawl」は、東方Projectの二次創作ローグライクゲームです。
ダンジョンと化した幻想郷を、アイテム・信仰・戦術を駆使して突破しましょう！
items.title: Touhou Crawl

items.description: Count Dracula is going Down
items.description_ja: Count Dracula is going Down
items.title: Count Down

items.description: Two pairs of twins war for love, life, and limb beneath the curtain of a dark Tokyo night. From the artisans at CRAFTWORK comes a visual novel lush with art, action, and mystery; a story of GEMINISM—deformity and divinity.
items.description_ja: Two pairs of twins war for love, life, and limb beneath the curtain of a dark Tokyo night. From the artisans at CRAFTWORK comes a visual novel lush with art, action, and mystery; a story of GEMINISM—deformity and divinity.
items.title: Geminism

items.description: Immerse yourself in the enigmatic world of Nauris, where enchanting landscapes hide terrifying secrets: the strange behavior of elders, sinister rituals of priests, and the disappearance of citizens. Madness lurks everywhere – will you master it or become its victim? The choice is yours.
items.description_ja: アバターにインスパイアされたバイオパンクの世界を舞台にした、ゾッとするようなホラー・ビジュアル・ノベル「エネリア」で、闇の奥へと分け入ってみよう。
items.title: Enelia: Dawn of Madness

items.description: An atmospheric, arcade first-person horror game where your sole job is to root out the Veils who take on the identity of humans. Interrogate and execute monsters that hide within people, and protect yourself while managing your ammunition and transfers.
items.description_ja: An atmospheric, arcade first-person horror game where your sole job is to root out the Veils who take on the identity of humans. Interrogate and execute monsters that hide within people, and protect yourself while managing your ammunition and transfers.
items.title: Veil Transfer

items.description: An occult social‑deduction card game for 4 to 8 players. Play your cards in secret, find and eliminate the opposing team and avoid the DEATHMARK!
items.description_ja: An occult social‑deduction card game for 4 to 8 players. Play your cards in secret, find and eliminate the opposing team and avoid the DEATHMARK!
items.title: DEATHMARK

items.description: BAKU is a single-player spot-the-difference game. Save the troubled animals by eating their nightmares. However, there is a secret to this story.
items.description_ja: 『BAKU -バク-』は、シングルプレイ専用まちがい探しゲームです。悪夢を食べて悩める動物たちを救ってあげましょう。ただし、この物語には秘密があります。
items.title: BAKU -バク-

items.description: Aqua Catholicism; Explore Man's Original Sin Under The Sea
items.description_ja: Aqua Catholicism; Explore Man's Original Sin Under The Sea
items.title: Water Womb World

items.description:
Yandere · Monster Romance · Y/N game · Philosophical · Sci-Fi · Visual Novel

Shipwrecked and stripped of memory, you awaken on a fog-shrouded island with nothing but the aid of two sirens
— so, what's the price?
items.description_ja:
Yandere · Monster Romance · Y/N game · Philosophical · Sci-Fi · Visual Novel

Shipwrecked and stripped of memory, you awaken on a fog-shrouded island with nothing but the aid of two sirens
— so, what's the price?
items.title: Escape Line

items.description: As a newly appointed Judge, you will rule over Space Court and its denizens to keep the universe safe. Or possibly blow it all up. Either way, you’re tenured.
items.description_ja: As a newly appointed Judge, you will rule over Space Court and its denizens to keep the universe safe. Or possibly blow it all up. Either way, you’re tenured.
items.title: Space Court

items.description: A unique platforming experience where the protagonist, story, and mechanics are constantly changing. Take control of legendary warriors, giant worms, greedy kings, and lazy demons, each with their own purpose.
items.description_ja: 『俺が勇者！？』は、ひと味違うアクションアドベンチャーゲームです。プレイの中で物語の視点やゲーム体験、さらには操作するキャラクターまでもが次々と変化していきます。複数の視点が交差する中で、あなたはこの物語の真実にたどり着けるでしょうか？
items.title: The Warrior

items.description: The Event is a first-person psychological horror game that offers immersive gameplay and a rich narrative. Find yourself stuck in mystery and struggle in the dark against paranormal activities, demons from other worlds and much more. Will you be able to find out the truth and return home?
items.description_ja: The Event is a first-person psychological horror game that offers immersive gameplay and a rich narrative. Find yourself stuck in mystery and struggle in the dark against paranormal activities, demons from other worlds and much more. Will you be able to find out the truth and return home?
items.title: The Event

items.description:
Forgotten Polish town, Incident at a soviet military base and hellish monsters...
This is a horror investigation story...
Will you stop the relentless fight, or give into it?
items.description_ja:
Forgotten Polish town, Incident at a soviet military base and hellish monsters...
This is a horror investigation story...
Will you stop the relentless fight, or give into it?
items.title: Restless Grounds

items.description: The Campsite is a short, modern point-and-click adventure that retains the spirit of classic graphic adventures. With around 60 minutes of gameplay, it’s perfect for casual players and newcomers alike, offering an accessible and enjoyable experience that’s easy to pick up and play anytime.
items.description_ja: The Campsite is a short, modern point-and-click adventure that retains the spirit of classic graphic adventures. With around 60 minutes of gameplay, it’s perfect for casual players and newcomers alike, offering an accessible and enjoyable experience that’s easy to pick up and play anytime.
items.title: The Campsite

items.description: Travel back to 16th-century France and delve into the mysterious depths of a seemingly abandoned alchemist's tower. Do you dare brave the horrors that beckon you below... deeper still?
items.description_ja: 16世紀のフランスへとタイムスリップし、廃墟と化した錬金術師の塔の深き謎に挑んでみよう。恐怖に立ち向かい奥へ、さらに奥へと進み行く勇気が果たしてあなたにはあるか？
items.title: Caput Mortum

items.description: Ticking Together is a 1-4 player co-op platformer set in a high-stakes cyberpunk world. Carry a bomb through deadly obstacle courses, reset its timer with a hand scan every 15 seconds, and work together to prevent a catastrophic city-wide explosion.
items.description_ja: 『Ticking Together』は、最大4人で協力プレイが可能な高難易度のサイバーパンク系プラットフォーマーです。危険な障害コースを爆弾を抱えて突破し、15秒ごとに手のスキャンでタイマーをリセットしながら、壊滅的な都市全体の爆発を防ぐために仲間と力を合わせよう。
items.title: Ticking Together

items.description: Play the ancient and thrilling game of Chess but with... cats! Lead your furry friends to the Purrfect battle of brains and whiskers!
items.description_ja:
古代のスリリングなチェスを…今度はネコと一緒に！  
モフモフの仲間たちを、ひげと知恵のパーフェクトな戦いへ導け！
items.title: Cat Chess

items.description: You will go blind in 291 days. Decide who gets a "Commutator" to survive in the new world. Four endings. Three are pure hell.
items.description_ja: You will go blind in 291 days. Decide who gets a "Commutator" to survive in the new world. Four endings. Three are pure hell.
items.title: Did you visit CommutatorApply

items.description:
"Life sometimes feels like it’s going in circles."
Little Girl On Earth Asking Why She Asking Why is a short pixel art Visual Novel
about a girl who tell herself this, forever.
Maybe you can try to help her ?
items.description_ja:
「時々、人生は同じ場所をぐるぐる回っているように感じる。」
Little Girl On Earth Asking Why She Asking Why は短いピクセルアートのビジュアルノベルで、
一人の少女がこの言葉を永遠に自分に言い聞かせる物語です。
もしかしたら、あなたが彼女を助けられるかもしれません？
items.title: Little Girl On Earth Asking Why She Asking Why

items.description: Wired from the ashes of twin stick Shooters, Arksync evolves the genre with breakneck player movement and combat. Survive and buy weapons, utilities, and upgrades; then risk it all as you fight to survive, and take a toy bear home.
items.description_ja: Wired from the ashes of twin stick Shooters, Arksync evolves the genre with breakneck player movement and combat. Survive and buy weapons, utilities, and upgrades; then risk it all as you fight to survive, and take a toy bear home.
items.title: Arksync

items.description:
In a final attempt to guarantee your place on the nice list, you decide to try and do some chores before midnight.
Will Krampus take you? Take the test and find out.
items.description_ja:
In a final attempt to guarantee your place on the nice list, you decide to try and do some chores before midnight.
Will Krampus take you? Take the test and find out.
items.title: For Goodness Sake

items.description: You are a girl with a demonic heart, trapped with a group of suspicious individuals. A demonspawn arrives, setting off a chain of mysterious murders. Can you trust any of your fellow captives and find love in the chaos? Or will you fight for your life alone?
items.description_ja: You are a girl with a demonic heart, trapped with a group of suspicious individuals. A demonspawn arrives, setting off a chain of mysterious murders. Can you trust any of your fellow captives and find love in the chaos? Or will you fight for your life alone?
items.title: Demonheart: The Cursed Trial

items.description: You are Octodad, a dapper octopus masquerading as a human, as he goes about a day of his life. His existence is a constant struggle, as he must master mundane tasks with his unwieldy boneless tentacles while simultaneously keeping his cephalopodan nature a secret from his human family!
items.description_ja: You are Octodad, a dapper octopus masquerading as a human, as he goes about a day of his life. His existence is a constant struggle, as he must master mundane tasks with his unwieldy boneless tentacles while simultaneously keeping his cephalopodan nature a secret from his human family!
items.title: Octodad (Student Edition)

items.description: Made by one person, an open world adventure game filled with silly characters and terrible secrets. Explore the woods, find hidden paths, hack and slash through strange monsters, and try very, very hard not to break reality. Or don't. You do you.
items.description_ja: ワンマン開発者が手がける、オープンワールド・アドベンチャーゲーム。愉快でひょうきんに見える登場人物たち――それぞれが隠し持つおぞましい秘密とは…？森を探索して隠しルートを見つけ出し、奇妙な怪物たちを倒しながら先へ進みましょう！最も重要なカギは「現実を絶対に壊さない」こと！？…とはいえ、最終的にどうするかはプレイヤー次第。壊したければ、それを止める者はいません。
items.title: Afterplace

items.description: Interacting with the unidentified life form “Kuon”, we move forward with the pain. A surreal, mysterious fancy adventure.
items.description_ja: 正体不明の生命体「クオン」と交流をしながら、痛みと共に進んでいく。超現実的、不可思議ファンシーアドベンチャー。
items.title: MORSOMNIA:0

items.description: Wake up inside an abandoned mansion. Uncover the dark fate of a missing family. Survive the presence that stalks you within these walls.
items.description_ja: Echoes Of Dreadは一人称視点の心理ホラーです。陰鬱な邸宅を探索し、謎を解き、この家に隠された秘密を明らかにしてください。不意のジャンプスケアと恐ろしい存在との遭遇に備えてください。
items.title: Echoes of Dread

items.description: Is Bubsy a celebrated icon from the mascot wars of the early 90s or a platforming punchline? Bubsy in: The Purrfect Collection explores the franchise's troubled history and enduring popularity. A playable history that includes games, artifacts and interviews. What could possibly go wrong?
items.description_ja: やまねこバブジーとは、90年代初めのマスコット戦争で有名になった象徴的キャラなのでしょうか、それともプラットホームのキャッチフレーズなのでしょうか。『やまねこバブジーのパーフェクトコレクション』は、このフランチャイズの苦難の歴史と不朽の人気を探求します。ゲームだけでなくアーティファクトやインタビューもプレイアブル化コンテンツに含まれています。どうってことねえよ。
items.title: Bubsy in: The Purrfect Collection

items.description: You are trapped in a world that appears peaceful, but a dark reality festers just beneath the surface. To survive, you must master the art of fractured vision.
items.description_ja: You are trapped in a world that appears peaceful, but a dark reality festers just beneath the surface. To survive, you must master the art of fractured vision.
items.title: Either Eye

items.description: Handyman needed - ASAP! The investor’s coming in the morning, and the house still isn’t ready! Take on an extra shift where horror meets simulation. Tackle the chaos, uncover dark secrets, and finish everything before dawn.
items.description_ja: 修理工募集—至急！ 投資家は明日の朝に来るのに、家はまだ準備ができていません！ホラーとシミュレーションが交わる追加のシフトを引き受けてください。混乱を解決し、暗い秘密を暴き、夜明け前にすべてを終わらせましょう。
items.title: Creepy Shift: House For Sale

items.description: The one true multiplayer goblin simulator. Play Goblin Tag and acquire power ups that let you leap across the entire map. Play Hide and Seek and annoy your friends with ‘REEEES’ when they cant find you. Stay alive in Death Run without being trapped. Be a goblin and do goblin things!
items.description_ja: The one true multiplayer goblin simulator. Play Goblin Tag and acquire power ups that let you leap across the entire map. Play Hide and Seek and annoy your friends with ‘REEEES’ when they cant find you. Stay alive in Death Run without being trapped. Be a goblin and do goblin things!
items.title: Goblin Summer Camp

items.description: Become a master strategist in this physics-based Real-Time Tactics game! Command minifig-inspired armies and customize strategies with hand-drawn formations. Conquer unique campaigns for all five armies and unleash massive battles in both single-player and multiplayer modes. Victory awaits!
items.description_ja: 栄光への究極の探求。戦場に陣形を描き、おもちゃの軍隊を指揮してライバルを包囲し、欺き、出し抜こう。でも気をつけて！ライバルとぶつかり合えば、物理学にしたがって兜は飛び散るぞ！最もグラグラするストラテジーゲームで軍隊を勝利に導こう！シングルプレイヤーとマルチプレイヤーモードの両方で大規模なバトルを作成します。
items.title: Toy Tactics

items.description: Carve your way through a twisted and demonic manor in this fast paced roguelike. Devil Peach Soda combines quick arcade gameplay and RPG mechanics, featuring a variety of ways to build and customize your character each run.
items.description_ja: Carve your way through a twisted and demonic manor in this fast paced roguelike. Devil Peach Soda combines quick arcade gameplay and RPG mechanics, featuring a variety of ways to build and customize your character each run.
items.title: Devil Peach Soda

items.description: MATCH DNA BUBBLES IN AN UNDERGROUND LAB TO KEEP YOUR PSYCHIC CLONE FROM INVADING YOUR MIND AND TURNING YOU INTO A CANNIBAL. This is the match-3 survival horror comedy RPG metroidvania you didn't know you needed.
items.description_ja: 地下研究所でDNAなバブルをマッチさせて、自らの霊的クローンから自身を守れ。心を侵略されてしまえば、キミは人食いとなってしまうだろう。これは、まさかこんなゲームがこの世に必要だなんて誰も思ってもみなかった、マッチ3でホラーでコメディなRPGメトロイドヴァニアだ。
items.title: Creepy Redneck Dinosaur Mansion 3

items.description: One-Handed Rage-Inducing 3D Platformer! Use only a mouse. Bounce off platforms and even the walls to reach the next checkpoint. Go on a linear adventure through an interconnected world, or quickly test your skills in challenge mode.
items.description_ja: One-Handed Rage-Inducing 3D Platformer! Use only a mouse. Bounce off platforms and even the walls to reach the next checkpoint. Go on a linear adventure through an interconnected world, or quickly test your skills in challenge mode.
items.title: Pogo3D

items.description: A co-op horror game where you must scavenge for loot and maintain the bunker to keep it standing
items.description_ja: A co-op horror game where you must scavenge for loot and maintain the bunker to keep it standing
items.title: Bunker Invaders

items.description: The rats told me to make this game. Run and gun alongside your troops in the Great Rat War against the vile TechnoRat armies. Recruit units, build structures, collect gear and upgrade your weapons to turn the tide of battle in your favor. The TechnoRat is all consuming!
items.description_ja: The rats told me to make this game. Run and gun alongside your troops in the Great Rat War against the vile TechnoRat armies. Recruit units, build structures, collect gear and upgrade your weapons to turn the tide of battle in your favor. The TechnoRat is all consuming!
items.title: WAR RATS: The Rat em Up

items.description: A brave, vigilant, young boy - broken by the sin of his father, decides to stand up against his very own creator. NEODITRONIX is a rhythm adventure experience about one's "sins" and how to become human. RECOLLECT and HEAR.
items.description_ja: A brave, vigilant, young boy - broken by the sin of his father, decides to stand up against his very own creator. NEODITRONIX is a rhythm adventure experience about one's "sins" and how to become human. RECOLLECT and HEAR.
items.title: NEODITRONIX

items.description: A beautiful Dark Knightess from another world enlisted me in her quest to slay a rogue wizard, and now we're dating! But what if she finds out I have no idea who the Gray Wizard is?!
items.description_ja: A beautiful Dark Knightess from another world enlisted me in her quest to slay a rogue wizard, and now we're dating! But what if she finds out I have no idea who the Gray Wizard is?!
items.title: taking my Dark Knight Girlfriend to the corner store

items.description: You can wish for anything, all you need to do is climb this mountain... By throwing a ball that teleports you... Maybe try climbing too, I don't know I'm not the expert here.
items.description_ja: You can wish for anything, all you need to do is climb this mountain... By throwing a ball that teleports you... Maybe try climbing too, I don't know I'm not the expert here.
items.title: Crack Mountain

items.description: You have only one chance to beat the 5 puzzles. Once you lose, you can't play the game again.
items.description_ja: You have only one chance to beat the 5 puzzles. Once you lose, you can't play the game again.
items.title: krizgame

items.description: A short visual novel about queer love and art. Follow Maya, a once-celebrated painter now paralyzed, as she struggles to accept her new reality and its effects on her relationship. Argue with your Prefrontal Cortex, insult an art critic, befriend the elderly.
items.description_ja: A short visual novel about queer love and art. Follow Maya, a once-celebrated painter now paralyzed, as she struggles to accept her new reality and its effects on her relationship. Argue with your Prefrontal Cortex, insult an art critic, befriend the elderly.
items.title: A Hint of Purple

items.description: EX VITRO is a dark sci-fi 2D platformer where you delve into the ruins of a military research facility and discover the horrors within. Whether machine, creature, or something else entirely, you’ll face the violent legacy of the last survivors of humanity.
items.description_ja: EX VITRO is a dark sci-fi 2D platformer where you delve into the ruins of a military research facility and discover the horrors within. Whether machine, creature, or something else entirely, you’ll face the violent legacy of the last survivors of humanity.
items.title: Ex Vitro

items.description:
HALLO! Our cats are now in the awesome city of Berlin! Let's search for them.
A short and pleasant experience in a big and lovely illustration! Start with a Beautiful monochromatic scenario, relax, and find all the cats to reveal the final colored art.
items.description_ja: こんにちは！ネコたちは素敵な都市、ベルリンにいるよ。探しに行こう。最初は美しいモノクロのイラストから始めて、最後に色がついた絵を明らかにしよう。さまざまなモードをプレイして、特別なネコを見つけ、ボーナスステージをアンロックしよう！隠されたオブジェクトは970個以上！追加のボーナスステージ、アンダーグラウンドパーティーも登場！
items.title: Hidden Cats in Berlin

items.description: GOKA Street is a multiplayer street football game built for fast-paced action & endless replayability. It combines arcade-style gameplay with real football mechanics. With battle royale-flavored unique modes, it invites up to 6 players to kick up the dust on the streets. Just show ’em what you got!
items.description_ja: GOKAストリートは、ハイスピードなアクションと無限のリプレイ性を追求したマルチプレイヤー・ストリートサッカーゲームです。アーケードスタイルのゲームプレイとリアルなサッカーのメカニズムを融合。バトルロイヤル風のユニークなモードで、最大6人のプレイヤーがストリートで暴れまわれます。誰が一番か見せてやれ！
items.title: GOKA Street

items.description: Wakey Wakey is a Puzzle Platformer with a unique world-bending twist. Navigate your everchanging bedroom, take control of new household objects, and overcome surprising obstacles to help this sleepy guy get a good night's rest.
items.description_ja: Wakey Wakey is a Puzzle Platformer with a unique world-bending twist. Navigate your everchanging bedroom, take control of new household objects, and overcome surprising obstacles to help this sleepy guy get a good night's rest.
items.title: Wakey Wakey

items.description: 🦁 Indica Macjones and the brave furry heroes embark on an epic journey to find the legendary Holy Grail. Solve diverse puzzles and explore mysterious locations!
items.description_ja: Furry Adventure Club and the Holy Grail（毛皮の冒険クラブと聖杯）で毛皮の勇者たちが伝説の黄金の聖杯を探す壮大な冒険に出発。さまざまなパズルを解いて、神秘的な場所を探検しよう。
items.title: Furry Adventure Club and the Holy Grail 🦁

items.description: I came to know "her." Since then, I've felt someone's gaze from somewhere. Memories of the place I reached while searching for a lost dog in the past. I'm not sure if it's connected, but I did something. "NAGAISAN" is an adventure game based on urban legends.
items.description_ja: 私は『彼女』を知ってしまった。それ以来、どこからか誰かの視線を感じている。昔、迷子になった犬を探して辿り着いた場所の記憶。それが関係しているのかはわからないが。私は何かをしてしまった。『ナガイサン』はどこからでも入ってくる、たとえ夢の中でも。『NAGAISAN』は都市伝説を題材としたアドベンチャーゲームです。
items.title: NAGAISAN

items.description: A story about a dead lamb walking.
items.description_ja: A story about a dead lamb walking.
items.title: DEAD LAMB WALKING

items.description: Confronted with fragmented narratives and deceptive persons of interest, you must isolate crucial evidence. Shatter logical loopholes from testimonies and reconstruct the crime scene from subtle clues. Can you survive this immersive battle of wits?
items.description_ja: 断片的に語られる物語と、それぞれに思惑を抱えた事情聴取の相手たち。膨大な情報の中から証拠を選り分け、わずかな言葉から論理の綻びを見抜き、かすかな手掛かりをつなぎ合わせて真実の全貌を再構築せよ。先入観を捨て、推理の力でこのハードコアな難題に挑め。この没入型の頭脳戦を、あなたは最後まで勝ち抜けるか？
items.title: CaseCracker 3

items.description: Jumpscare Simulator is a sci-fi horror game featuring a story-driven main game and two additional game modes. Pass through doors carefully, battle the simulation, and try to fall from your seat as little as possible!
items.description_ja: Jumpscare Simulatorは、ストーリー主導のメインゲームと2つの追加ゲームモードを備えた、SFホラーゲームです。ドアを慎重に通り抜け、シミュレーションと戦い、できるだけ椅子から落ちないように頑張りましょう！
items.title: Jumpscare Simulator: System Breach

items.description:
Be the weapon! Swing like an axe, thrust like a spear, and soar like an arrow in this physics-based platformer. 
Flip, throw, and carve your path to the peak! Rage burns, revenge awaits... Are you up to the challenge?
items.description_ja: 物理ベースの高難度アクション。投げて、登って、斧を極めよ。武器を解放し、峻険な地形を攻略せよ。覚悟はあるか？
items.title: Hack And Climb

items.description: In this short first-person psychological horror game, falling asleep on the subway takes you to the final station, abandoned and eerie. Explore the area and try to survive the entity chasing you in the darkness. Who is it? Its face looks strangely familiar...
items.description_ja:
この短編一人称視点のサイコロジカルホラーゲームでは、地下鉄でうたた寝をすると、不気味に廃墟と化した終着駅にたどり着きます。
暗闇の中であなたを追ってくる存在から逃れながら、探索し、生き残る方法を見つけてください。
それは誰なのか？ その顔には見覚えがあるような気がする…。
items.title: THE LAST TRAIN: Baquedano

items.description: A roguelite action platformer in a vibrant glitch-ridden world. Amass a huge arsenal from over 150 weapon options and face hordes of enemies and tough boss fights. Jump into multiplayer (up to 4 player co-op online or local) to collect, unlock, and upgrade for endless replayability.
items.description_ja: グリッチだらけの色鮮やかな世界で繰り広げられる、ローグライト・アクション・プラットフォーマー。150種類以上の武器を駆使し、敵の大群や強力なボスに立ち向かおう。リプレイ性は無限。マルチプレイ（オンラインまたはローカル、最大4人での協力プレイ）で収集、アンロック、アップグレードを行おう。
items.title: Rogue Glitch Ultra

items.description: Prepare a meal for the Vietnamese Lunar New Year dinner. But hurry, your guests are arriving soon! A short hand-drawn experience full of delicious surprises.
items.description_ja: Prepare a meal for the Vietnamese Lunar New Year dinner. But hurry, your guests are arriving soon! A short hand-drawn experience full of delicious surprises.
items.title: TET

items.description:
A short visual novel presented with pixel art and cute animations. 
Chasing after a rabbit, Alice found herself in a land of talking plants. 
Now, it's time to go on a tiny little adventure.
items.description_ja:
ピクセルアートとアニメーションで描かれる短編ビジュアルノベル。
ウサギを追ってアリスが迷い込んだのは、喋る植物たちの国でした。
さあ、アリスと一緒に小さな小さな冒険の旅へ。

evidence.excerpt: Monetization is also allowed without any issues.

items.title: Slay the Alice

items.description: Speedily solve Reimu's problems by skillfully stopping slot reels to pick two words to create items to give to her!
items.description_ja: 言葉が流れてくる2つのスロットを上手に止めて言葉を組み合わせてアイテムを完成させ、霊夢さんの困りごとをスピーディに解決に導こう！
items.title: Reimu Needs Help!? Aunn-chan to the Rescue!

items.description: You wake up in a house, alone with two beautiful girls... But no one is allowed to leave until one of you DIES. Why is this happening? What is the purpose of this “killing game”? But most importantly...WHO SHOULD DIE?!
items.description_ja: 目覚めると、美少女ふたりと見知らぬ家の中… ただし、ひとりが死ぬまで誰も出られない。なぜこんなことに？　この「デスゲーム」の目的は？　だけど何より…誰が死ぬ！？
items.title: Yet Another Killing Game

items.description: SnaPaul is a first-person psychological horror game where you explore a dark, mysterious house. With 30 minutes of intense gameplay and 4 unique achievements to unlock, every step brings you closer to a chilling finale.
