Face your fears and uncover hidden secrets in this unforgettable experience.
items.description_ja: SnaPaul is a first-person psychological horror game where you explore a dark, mysterious house. With 30 minutes of intense gameplay and 4 unique achievements to unlock, every step brings you closer to a chilling finale. Face your fears and uncover hidden secrets in this unforgettable experience.
items.title: SnaPaul

items.description: Explore serene forests, sparkling river, and rustic rural houses in *Hidden Tomatoes 3*! Find 100 cleverly hidden tomatoes in a peaceful yet challenging hidden object adventure. With stunning visuals and relaxing gameplay, it's fun for all ages. Can you uncover them all?
items.description_ja: Explore serene forests, sparkling river, and rustic rural houses in *Hidden Tomatoes 3*! Find 100 cleverly hidden tomatoes in a peaceful yet challenging hidden object adventure. With stunning visuals and relaxing gameplay, it's fun for all ages. Can you uncover them all?
items.title: Hidden Tomatoes 3

items.description: To save money, you rent an unusually cheap apartment, believing you could coexist with “them” as you always have. But you soon discover that the disturbances here run far deeper—and are far more dangerous—than anything you’ve encountered before.
items.description_ja: あなたは生まれつき霊的感知能力を持つ青年。節約のため、異様に安いアパートを借りることにした。これまでのように「彼ら」と平和に共存できると思っていたが、ここで起こる異変はこれまでよりも深く、そして危険だった…
items.title: Haunted Room : 205

items.description: A first-person psychological horror game about the crushing weight of guilt. Live through the aftermath of a devastating tragedy: your wife is dead, and it’s your fault. But when her casket is brought home, something inexplicable and terrifying begins to warp your reality...
items.description_ja: 罪悪感の重さについての心理的な恐怖。 壊滅的な悲劇の余波を生きてください：あなたの妻は死んでいます、そしてそれはあなたのせいです。 しかし、彼女の棺が家に持ち帰られると、不可解で恐ろしい何かがあなたの現実を歪め始めます。。。
items.title: Forgive Me My Love

items.description: Hi there! I'm NEKO, your tiny typing buddy - a super fast keyboard companion. Every time you type, I type along. I don't just type for fun, I'm here to bring a bit of cuteness and energy to your workspace. Keep typing, and together we'll create every line, every idea ♥
items.description_ja:
やっほ～！ ボクはNEKOだよ！あなたの小さなタイピング仲間、スーパー速いキーボードコンパニオンだよ！！！ ദ്ദി/ᐠ｡‸｡ᐟ
あなたがタイプするたびに、ボクも一緒にカタカタ♪　一生けんめい練習中の子猫みたいにね。ただ遊んでるだけじゃなくて、あなたの作業スペースにちょっぴりかわいさと元気を届けたいんだ！どんどんタイプしてね、一緒にすてきな文章やアイデアを作ろう！あなたのキーの音は、ボクの心臓の鼓動なんだよ♡♡♡   ฅ^>⩊<^ ฅ
items.title: Nekotype Keyboard Cat Simulator

items.description: Pain to Satisfaction is a partygame that is progressively challenging. Free every patient on Earth from suffering using newly developed spiritual healing methods. Play solo or share a controller with friends to see who can hold out the longest!
items.description_ja: Pain to Satisfaction is a partygame that is progressively challenging. Free every patient on Earth from suffering using newly developed spiritual healing methods. Play solo or share a controller with friends to see who can hold out the longest!
items.title: Pain to Satisfaction

items.description: Package Piles: Tidy Up The Warehouse! is a relaxing placement simulation where you organize a huge warehouse full of boxes. Stack packages on pallets, use transport vehicles to place them on shelves, and enjoy turning a messy space into a perfectly organized warehouse step by step.
items.description_ja: パッケージ・パイルズ：倉庫を片づけよう！ は、ゆったり楽しめる整理シミュレーションゲームです。箱でいっぱいの大きな倉庫を整理していきます。パッケージをパレットに積み、運搬車両を使って棚に置き、散らかった倉庫が少しずつきれいで整った空間へ変わっていく過程を楽しめます。
items.title: Package Piles: Tidy Up The Warehouse!

items.description:
Play as the Cat Detective Albert Wilde. 
Walk, talk, interrogate, joke, solve a mystery, and experience an old film noir setting with humanoid animal characters.
A story of quantum theory and parallel universes served with a lot of humour.
items.description_ja:
Play as the Cat Detective Albert Wilde. 
Walk, talk, interrogate, joke, solve a mystery, and experience an old film noir setting with humanoid animal characters.
A story of quantum theory and parallel universes served with a lot of humour.
items.title: Cat Detective Albert Wilde

items.description: Entertain the god-like Bella’s thirst for blood in this absurd bite-sized roguelike terror defense game.
items.description_ja: この不条理に満ちたお手軽ローグライク "テラー" ディフェンスゲームで、血に飢えた神のような存在である "ベラ" と楽しく遊びましょう！
items.title: Bella Wants Blood

items.description: What's more American than Fast Food? How about cooking it with guns! Switch between individual weapons to move ingredients, cook and deliver them to your customers before they lose their patience.
items.description_ja: What's more American than Fast Food? How about cooking it with guns! Switch between individual weapons to move ingredients, cook and deliver them to your customers before they lose their patience.
items.title: ACS

items.description: A fast, cute and bouncy, fully 3D anime action looter inspired by arcade games! Jump, stomp, loot, power up, and defeat monsters before time runs out, then prove your might by dethroning the castle's owner!
items.description_ja: スピーディーでキュートでポップ！　『Ecrazeus Castle』はアーケードゲームに着想を得たフル3Dアニメのルータースラッシャー。跳んで、踏みつけて、アイテムを集めて、パワーアップ！　制限時間内にモンスターを蹴散らし、城の主を打ち倒して強さを見せつけよう！
items.title: Ecrazeus Castle

items.description: Haunted by loss and guilt, Arya is lost between reality and delusion as he tries to uncover the truth behind the disappearance of Valeria, the daughter of his late friend that worked at his shop
items.description_ja: Haunted by loss and guilt, Arya is lost between reality and delusion as he tries to uncover the truth behind the disappearance of Valeria, the daughter of his late friend that worked at his shop
items.title: Obsessed : Trace

items.description: The Christmas Cackler is a first-person Christmas-themed Comedic Horror game where you play as little Jimmy, lying in bed on the night before Christmas, trying to finish drawing his mother's present and avoid getting grabbed by the Christmas Cackler!
items.description_ja: The Christmas Cackler is a first-person Christmas-themed Comedic Horror game where you play as little Jimmy, lying in bed on the night before Christmas, trying to finish drawing his mother's present and avoid getting grabbed by the Christmas Cackler!
items.title: The Christmas Cackler

items.description: You've almost died, you lost your body. Gladly, you were saved by your old friend Xena, a genius engineer who lives on a desolate planet. Now it's time to recover and find a new goal in your life!
items.description_ja: You've almost died, you lost your body. Gladly, you were saved by your old friend Xena, a genius engineer who lives on a desolate planet. Now it's time to recover and find a new goal in your life!
items.title: My Protogen Engineer ⚙️

items.description: Find your missing daughter in the Hospital of Madness. Collect items, fight enemies, and do whatever it takes to reach her!
items.description_ja: ストーリー駆動型のホラーゲームに没入しましょう！狂気の病院で隠れるか戦うことで生き残ることを試みてください。
items.title: 7th Floor

items.description: You have wandered into an infinite looping shopping mall in Japan. If you notice changes within the mall, you might be able to escape.
items.description_ja: あなたは無限にループするショッピングモールに迷い込んでしまいました。モール内の変化に気づくことができれば、外に脱出できるかもしれません。
items.title: False Mall

items.description: Take the role of a painter struggling to finish his masterpiece in this short Gothic horror visual novel about art, pain and love.
items.description_ja: Take the role of a painter struggling to finish his masterpiece in this short Gothic horror visual novel about art, pain and love.
items.title: It Paints Me

items.description: In an infinite-looping space, find the traces of the modifications made by kun and break them. You can safely leave by reaching the 2.5th level. There is also an endless mode available, allowing you to push beyond your own limits and see how many levels you can reach.
items.description_ja: In an infinite-looping space, find the traces of the modifications made by kun and break them. You can safely leave by reaching the 2.5th level. There is also an endless mode available, allowing you to push beyond your own limits and see how many levels you can reach.
items.title: KunSpace

items.description: A chaotic virtual desktop cat that spins when you type, screams "OiiAi," tracks your word count, and rewards your keyboard fury with meme-powered madness.
items.description_ja: A chaotic virtual desktop cat that spins when you type, screams "OiiAi," tracks your word count, and rewards your keyboard fury with meme-powered madness.
items.title: OiiAi Cat

items.description: "There are things better left unknown" — The hidden paranormal horror ADV by ImCyan, creator of "Tsugunohi", is now on Steam. Detective Teru and his sister Luna investigate cases in spirits' dream worlds. Enjoy mystery, comedy, and horror across 9 episodes and 10+ hours of content.
items.description_ja: 「人は知りすぎてはいけない」――『つぐのひ』作者ImCyanによる怪奇探偵ホラーADVがSteam登場。特殊能力「ドリームリンク」を持つ探偵テルと妹ルナが、霊の夢世界で心霊事件に挑む。探索、推理、ギャグとホラーが融合した独特な物語を全9話・総10時間超の大ボリュームで体験せよ。
items.title: SHIKIYOKU -Teru Yumemi in the Nightmare-

items.description: Immerse yourself in the winter forest and help a lost soul to find a piece of itself. What is awaiting you there.. or who?
items.description_ja: Immerse yourself in the winter forest and help a lost soul to find a piece of itself. What is awaiting you there.. or who?
items.title: KRAMPEN

items.description: Take on an exciting stealth mission as Roberto the Lizard, a cunning thief. Use special abilities to avoid enemies while you steal valuable treasures in a museum full of challenges.
items.description_ja: Take on an exciting stealth mission as Roberto the Lizard, a cunning thief. Use special abilities to avoid enemies while you steal valuable treasures in a museum full of challenges.
items.title: Roberto el Lagarto

items.description:
『Japanese House Exploration』is a first-person puzzle horror adventure game set in a traditional Japanese house.
You explore a house that is both eerie and nostalgic. To find a dear friend.
items.description_ja:
『家屋探索 -Japanese House Exploration-』は、日本家屋を舞台にした1人視点の謎解きホラーアドベンチャーゲームです。
どこか不気味で懐かしい、そんな家をあなたは探索します。大切な友達を見つけるために...。
items.title: 家屋探索 -Japanese House Exploration-

items.description:
You have been invited to the popular “Penguin Hotel”.
There, you get caught up in a terrifying event.
Solve puzzles and battle with a special camera! Experience a very strange penguin horror.
items.description_ja:
大人気の施設『ペンギンホテル』に招待されたあなた
そこで恐ろしい出来事にまきこまれる。
特殊なカメラで謎解きや戦闘！とっても奇妙なペンギンホラーを体感しよう。
items.title: PENGUIN HOTEL -Chapter 1-

items.description:
This is a point-and-click, command-selection style adventure game where the protagonist is a girl who has become a ghost.
The objective is to fulfill her desires by speaking to her beloved "him" causing poltergeists, visiting in dreams, or even cursing.
items.description_ja:
あなたは ユーレイだ。
どうにかして だいすきな「きみ」を こっちがわへ つれてこよう。
items.title: Decollate Decoration

items.description: The Derailed is a first-person psychological horror game. Beneath the dusty arches of a nearly forgotten depot, shadows of the past tremble. Whether you want to or not, you will have to uncover the dark secrets of this place.
items.description_ja:
The Derailed - 一人称視点の心理ホラー
埃にまみれた半ば忘れ去られた車庫の天井の下、かつての影が震えている。
望むと望まざるとにかかわらず、あなたはこの場所に眠る暗い秘密を解き明かさねばならない。
items.title: The Derailed

items.description: If you are looking for weird dark version of Alice in Wonderland with creepy twist, AMEN is your next terrifying journey down the rabbit hole. This surreal hand-drawn psychological horror transforms the classic fairy tale into a grotesque manifestation of neurosis and mental illness.
items.description_ja: アリス メズメライジング エピソード オブ ニューロシス (AMEN) は、隠しオブジェクト ゲームです。プレイヤーのタスクは、マップ上に隠されたものを見つけることです。
items.title: Alice Mesmerizing Episodes of Neurosis (AMEN)

items.description: Explore an abandoned school where memories linger longer than the living. Uncover the mystery of your best friend’s disappearance. Dodge bullets.
items.description_ja: Explore an abandoned school where memories linger longer than the living. Uncover the mystery of your best friend’s disappearance. Dodge bullets.
items.title: Yuki「清醒梦」

items.description: A psychological horror job simulator. Serve coffee at a lonely drive-thru. But when a mysterious email arrives, your shift changes. Watch the cars. Check the plates. Someone in line is hiding a dark secret, and something else is watching you from the dark.
items.description_ja: 心理ホラーの仕事シミュレーター。孤独なドライブスルーでコーヒーを提供する。しかし、謎のメールが届いた瞬間、夜勤は一変する。車を監視し、ナンバープレートを確認しろ。誰かが闇の秘密を隠し、何かが暗闇からあなたを見ている。
items.title: Is Guilty

items.description: It is a very funny, fast and easy game which can be played by adults as well as children.
items.description_ja: It is a very funny, fast and easy game which can be played by adults as well as children.
items.title: Snowballs

items.description:
New situations added.
A game that determines whether you have the skills to be considerate in this new world.
items.description_ja:
新シチュぞくぞく。
新時代を生き抜くためのKY度診断ゲーム。
items.title: KUUKIYOMI 2: Consider It More! - New Era

items.description:
That fragile but brave egg has come back with new powers.
A hard action adventure game about the fragility, bravery, and sometimes friendship of raw eggs. 
Aim for the frying pan at the end of rolling through various stages with sad and touching melody.
items.description_ja:
あの儚くも勇敢な卵が、新たな力を手に入れて帰ってきた。
生卵の儚さと、勇敢さと、ときどき友情を描いたハードアクションアドベンチャーゲーム。 
様々なステージを、切ない音楽とともに転がり抜けた先にあるフライパンを目指す。
items.title: LOST EGG 2: Be together

items.description: Trapped in the depths of a frozen Soviet bunker, geophysicist Anna must survive deadly cold, horrifying abominations, and the trauma of a buried past. A third-person survival horror blending psychological storytelling with hand-drawn static cameras.
items.description_ja: ソ連の凍った地下壕の奥深くに閉じ込められた地球物理学者アンナは、恐ろしい寒さ、恐ろしい忌まわしい出来事、そして埋もれた過去のトラウマから生き延びなければなりません。心理的なストーリーテリングと手描きの静止カメラを組み合わせた三人称視点のサバイバル ホラーです。
items.title: Kriophobia

items.description:
Simple Fish Adventure is an unusual short physics-based platformer. Jump like a fish, think like a fish, be a fish! Overcome obstacles and suffer.
Also includes co-op for up to 4 players.
items.description_ja:
Simple Fish Adventure is an unusual short physics-based platformer. Jump like a fish, think like a fish, be a fish! Overcome obstacles and suffer.
Also includes co-op for up to 4 players.
items.title: Simple Fish Adventure

items.description: Dead of Darkness is a 2D survival-horror action-adventure. Investigate a mysterious island and unravel its disturbing secret. You’ll have to face grotesque creatures, hurdle deadly traps, solve puzzles, and most importantly, survive.
items.description_ja: Dead of Darknessは2Dサバイバルホラーアクションアドベンチャーです。神秘的な島を調査し、その不穏な秘密を解き明かしましょう。グロテスクな生き物に立ち向かい、致命的な罠を避け、パズルを解き、そして何よりも生き残ることを目指してください。
items.title: Dead of Darkness

items.description: Set out on your destined quest in this narrative-focused turn-based tactics game. Issue commands, light Beacons, exercise compassion. Take heed, for your roles shall constrict, and your tale was always meant to be bittersweet. Who will the stars dictate we be?
items.description_ja: Set out on your destined quest in this narrative-focused turn-based tactics game. Issue commands, light Beacons, exercise compassion. Take heed, for your roles shall constrict, and your tale was always meant to be bittersweet. Who will the stars dictate we be?
items.title: STARWEAVE

items.description: Hidden Cats in Tokyo is a hidden object adventure game where you must vaccinate all the cats in Tokyo before they turn into dangerous monsters. Collect cards of heroes, monsters, and cat things. Join the adventure and fight the huge monster with your giant robot in this fun hidden object game!
items.description_ja: Hidden Cats in Tokyoは、東京にいるにゃんこたちをすべて見つけ出し、彼らが危険なモンスターとなる前にワクチンを打つ、探し物アドベンチャーゲームです。ヒーローやモンスター、猫用品のカードを集めましょう。さあ冒険に乗り出し、大型ロボットを操って巨大なモンスターと戦うのです！
items.title: Hidden Cats in Tokyo

items.description:
A horror pool roguelite with upgradable cues, guns and procedural rituals.
Shoot some balls. Unleash horrors from beyond. Go insane. Try again.
items.description_ja:
アップグレード可能なキュー、銃、手順が必要な儀式的ホラー系ローグライトビリヤード。
ボールを撃ち、深淵から湧き出る恐怖を解き放て。狂気に我を忘れて、何度でも挑戦しよう。
items.title: Pool of Madness

items.description: You are being hunted for your misdeeds. With blood on your hands and weight on your conscience, you must collect the relics of your past, and confront your demons once and for all...
items.description_ja: You are being hunted for your misdeeds. With blood on your hands and weight on your conscience, you must collect the relics of your past, and confront your demons once and for all...
items.title: Slaughter Me Street: 1999

items.description:
You have the briefcase. Now it's after you. It's not going to stop. Be careful—it may take the form of someone else.
A short horror game by NIGHT DIAL.
items.description_ja:
You have the briefcase. Now it's after you. It's not going to stop. Be careful—it may take the form of someone else.
A short horror game by NIGHT DIAL.
items.title: CROWDED. FOLLOWED.

items.description: Fight your way to the capital and slay the emperor! Choose from a variety of characters with unique spells and skills! Featuring permadeath, interactable terrain, distinct builds, wild combos, and endless replayability.
items.description_ja: Fight your way to the capital and slay the emperor! Choose from a variety of characters with unique spells and skills! Featuring permadeath, interactable terrain, distinct builds, wild combos, and endless replayability.
items.title: Break the Empire

items.description: Escape from the looping office. Observe the office carefully and look for any anomaly to reach the main entrance.
items.description_ja: ループするホロライブ仮事務所から脱出しましょう。事務所をよく観察し、異変を見つけましょう。
items.title: holo8

items.description: Skin Off is an analog horror game where you play as a teenager spending a summer night alone at your uncle’s house. As you wait for your friends to arrive the next day, a strange message is broadcasted on national television, signaling the start of a nightmare you can’t escape.
items.description_ja: Skin Off is an analog horror game where you play as a teenager spending a summer night alone at your uncle’s house. As you wait for your friends to arrive the next day, a strange message is broadcasted on national television, signaling the start of a nightmare you can’t escape.
items.title: Analog - Skin off

items.description: Dog Witch is a roguelike deckbuilder where your spells are fueled by enchanted dice. Combine over 150 unique items to forge ever-evolving strategies, perfect synergy combos, summon minions, and tackle an endless range of foes so bizarre, they’ll leave your tail wagging in disbelief!
items.description_ja: 魔法のダイスが紡ぐ戦略ローグライク！『Dog Witch』は、ダイスで発動する呪文と150種以上のユニークアイテムを組み合わせ、無限に進化する戦略を構築するローグライク・デッキビルダー。型破りな敵と白熱のバトルを繰り広げ、召喚した仲間たちとともに、狂気に満ちた冒険へ飛び込め！
items.title: DOG WITCH

items.description: Pay your debt to the Pie Federation or RUN AWAY!
items.description_ja: Pay your debt to the Pie Federation or RUN AWAY!
items.title: ESCAPE FROM TIMOKHA 2: ARMY

items.description:
Rhythm + Rich Story & Characters. You play as a new student in Concordia Academy of Music, facing a crisis on your first day joining the Cajon Club.
Music dueling, co-op jamming, or even play with a real cajon!
items.description_ja:
本作は演奏シミュレーションと学園ADVを組み合わせた音楽学園シミュレーターです。
コンコルディア音楽学園のカホンクラブに入部した初日に直面する廃部の危機を回避するために奔走する中で、アンサンブルパートナーと出会うことになります。
ストーリーモードとフリープレイモードのほかに、パートナーとの会話を通じて互いへの理解を深めながら音楽知識を学べます。また、ゲームセンターでのリズムゲーム、プレゼント交換や音楽に関する読み物も楽しめます。最大4人でのアンサンブル演奏では、それぞれが異なるパート、異なる譜面を担当する本格的な合奏が楽しめます！
items.title: Concerto on White: Cajon Story

items.description: CRUSH DEPTH is first-person sci-fi horror game set at the bottom of the ocean. A salvage operation that would set you up for life goes sideways when you realize you're not alone down there. You'll solve puzzles and run from danger as you uncover the mysterious fate of Eclipse Station.
items.description_ja: CRUSH DEPTH is first-person sci-fi horror game set at the bottom of the ocean. A salvage operation that would set you up for life goes sideways when you realize you're not alone down there. You'll solve puzzles and run from danger as you uncover the mysterious fate of Eclipse Station.
items.title: CRUSH DEPTH

items.description: In Milaneseria, you'll have to manage your own Milanese restaurant. Your mission is super simple: cook the coolest Milanese in the neighborhood, make sure you always have stock, and leave your customers more than satisfied.
items.description_ja: ミラネーゼリアでは、あなた自身のミラネーゼ店を経営することになります。あなたの使命は極めてシンプルです。街で一番美味しいミラネーゼを作り、常に在庫を確保し、お客様を大満足させることです。
items.title: Milanesería

items.description: Catch cats in this cozy adventure game! After falling into Catworld through an interdimensional portal, you must find your missing cat by completing errands for Ponpon, the local Cat Café owner. Chase, catch and collect until you can find your way home! This game is made by students.
items.description_ja: Catch cats in this cozy adventure game! After falling into Catworld through an interdimensional portal, you must find your missing cat by completing errands for Ponpon, the local Cat Café owner. Chase, catch and collect until you can find your way home! This game is made by students.
items.title: Chasing Whiskers

items.description: Driven by a rare neurological affliction plaguing his family, Joshua has to recover his memories by exploring parallel realities through déjà vu. Facing the innermost depths of his past – moments both joyous and painful – seems to be the only way to get his life and family back together.
items.description_ja: 家族を蝕む稀な神経疾患。 ジョシュアはその病に抗うため、デジャヴを通じて並行世界を巡り、失われた記憶を取り戻さなければならない。喜びと苦悩に満ちた過去の深淵に立ち向かうこと──それだけが、彼の人生と、引き裂かれた家族を取り戻すための、唯一の道となる。
items.title: The Gap

items.description: A crazy, explosive fighting game with an expressive combo system and a diverse character roster! Play as superhumans, skeletons, aliens, and even stick figures! Battle dangerous foes, take part in lots of exciting singleplayer modes, throw your opponents into the sun, and so much more!
items.description_ja: A crazy, explosive fighting game with an expressive combo system and a diverse character roster! Play as superhumans, skeletons, aliens, and even stick figures! Battle dangerous foes, take part in lots of exciting singleplayer modes, throw your opponents into the sun, and so much more!
items.title: Duels of Fortune

items.description: You are alone in a deserted station. Or are you? Take pictures of strange anomalies around the station and you might find a way out.
items.description_ja: You are alone in a deserted station. Or are you? Take pictures of strange anomalies around the station and you might find a way out.
items.title: The Anomalous Hour

items.description: As the latest prey of a deranged serial killer, you must use your wits and resources to survive in this atmospheric first-person escape room-style horror game. Explore, uncover secrets, and plan your escape... but be quiet, or you'll be his next victim. Inspired by true events.
items.description_ja: As the latest prey of a deranged serial killer, you must use your wits and resources to survive in this atmospheric first-person escape room-style horror game. Explore, uncover secrets, and plan your escape... but be quiet, or you'll be his next victim. Inspired by true events.
items.title: SLACKJAW

items.description: An emo-inspired narrative rhythm game exploring growing pains, addiction, romance and music. Scream with Ash as he makes the transition from baby bat to elder emo, guide him through his crash outs and help him navigate his (teenage) dirtbag life through music.
items.description_ja: 成長の痛み、依存症、恋愛、そして音楽—エモに根ざした手描きビジュアルノベル＆リズムゲーム。主人公アッシュと共に叫び、歌い、彼が「ベビーバット」から「古参エモ」へと成長を遂げる姿を見届けよう。アッシュの痛みに寄り添い、音楽を奏で、冴えない人生に光をもたらす手助けができるのは、あなただけ。
items.title: I Write Games Not Tragedies

items.description: Overvåkerne (The Monitors) is an old school comedy/satire point-and-click game set in a fictive office environment. You play as Henriksen, a regular office worker who realizes he has been treated badly by his colleagues, and sets out on a revenge spree. Full english and norwegian voice acting.
items.description_ja: Overvåkerne (The Monitors) is an old school comedy/satire point-and-click game set in a fictive office environment. You play as Henriksen, a regular office worker who realizes he has been treated badly by his colleagues, and sets out on a revenge spree. Full english and norwegian voice acting.
items.title: The Monitors

items.description:
GONE Fishing is a 1-8 player survival horror game where you and your friends must work together to stay alive, by fishing. The only way to survive is to keep feeding the lake’s insatiable hunger before it feeds on you.

Can you satisfy the hunger... or will you become the next offering?
items.description_ja:
GONE Fishing は、1〜8人で遊べるサバイバルホラーです。仲間と力を合わせ、釣りで生き延びましょう。生き残る唯一の方法は、湖の底なしの飢えを満たし続けること。さもなければ、喰われるのはあなたです。

あなたはその飢えを満たせるか……それとも、次の生贄になるか？
items.title: GONE Fishing

items.description: A fantasy curse-casting adventure. Make curses that can only be undone by true love's kiss!
items.description_ja: 呪いをかけながら物語を楽しむ異世界ノベルゲーム。魔法のお店の店長になって真実の愛のキスでしか解けない呪いをかけよう！
items.title: TRUE LOVE'S CURSE

items.description: A Prologue to Almost My Floor, an upcoming horror-themed point'n'click adventure. Alex is a real fan of creepy stuff and horror movies, but he never expected to experience it himself just by taking the elevator back home! Can he avoid the madness and deal with the evil he's up against?
items.description_ja: A Prologue to Almost My Floor, an upcoming horror-themed point'n'click adventure. Alex is a real fan of creepy stuff and horror movies, but he never expected to experience it himself just by taking the elevator back home! Can he avoid the madness and deal with the evil he's up against?
items.title: Almost My Floor: Prologue

items.description: Puppet House is a puzzle-adventure horror with escape room elements. A freak ritual creates a killer puppet, murdering anyone who enters the ventriloquist’s mansion. Detective Rick, seeking missing locals, will soon face his greatest horror.
items.description_ja: Puppet House is a puzzle-adventure horror with escape room elements. A freak ritual creates a killer puppet, murdering anyone who enters the ventriloquist’s mansion. Detective Rick, seeking missing locals, will soon face his greatest horror.
items.title: Puppet House

items.description: Be The TOFU. The one and only Tofu action game created by a real Tofu Meister. You choose one of three varieties, and in its endless journey it gradually softens, crumbles, stews, and acquires bittern to become TOFU.
items.description_ja: とうふになれ。とうふになれ。とうふになれ。本物のとうふマイスターが制作した、唯一無二のとうふアクションゲーム。
items.title: The Strongest TOFU

items.description: Have you ever wanted to collect oil floating in a bowl of ramen by pulling it with chopsticks? This game will completely satisfy your desire to do so!
items.description_ja: ラーメンの器に浮いた油をお箸で引っ張って集めたいことって、ありますよね？　このゲームでは、そんなあなたの欲求を完全に満たします！
items.title: Ramen Oil Pecking Simulator

items.description: There’s no R.I.P at E-Lich Corp! Explore the afterlife in this roguelite bullet heaven that is all about humor, insane power-levels, replayability and awful office jokes. Reap souls along your undead coworkers in a company that values your life. And death. Literally.
items.description_ja: There’s no R.I.P at E-Lich Corp! Explore the afterlife in this roguelite bullet heaven that is all about humor, insane power-levels, replayability and awful office jokes. Reap souls along your undead coworkers in a company that values your life. And death. Literally.
items.title: E-Lich: Corporate Souls

items.description: Short atmospheric first person horror game with elements of quest and shooter about being lost in the middle of nowhere, surrounded by weird mist.
items.description_ja: Short atmospheric first person horror game with elements of quest and shooter about being lost in the middle of nowhere, surrounded by weird mist.
items.title: Mist

items.description: Set out on an adventurous journey, searching for capybaras with orange during both day and night in this exceptional hidden object game.
items.description_ja: Set out on an adventurous journey, searching for capybaras with orange during both day and night in this exceptional hidden object game.
items.title: Hidden Capybaras with Orange

items.description: Chase high scores in a series of breakneck typing minigames! Keep up with keyboard-mashing cats, banana-wielding monkey-cowboys and more as you QWERTY your way to new heights!
items.description_ja: Chase high scores in a series of breakneck typing minigames! Keep up with keyboard-mashing cats, banana-wielding monkey-cowboys and more as you QWERTY your way to new heights!
items.title: Many Mini Typing Games

items.description: Observe every corner of your apartment by moving your camera along a rail that runs through the rooms. Find and take pictures of paranormal anomalies to exorcise them. Locked in your surveillance room, will you survive tonight's 8 rounds?
items.description_ja: 部屋に設置されているレールに沿ってカメラを動かし、アパートの隅々まで監視しよう。超常的なアノマリー（異常）を見つけて写真を撮り、悪魔祓いをしよう。監視室に閉じ込められたあなたは、今夜の8ラウンドを乗り切れるだろうか？
items.title: Paragnosia

items.description: White Wool & Snow is the second visual novel in the Misericorde series.
items.description_ja: White Wool & Snow is the second visual novel in the Misericorde series.
items.title: Misericorde Volume Two: White Wool & Snow

items.description: Explore a surreal handcrafted world in Hidden Kitties Memories. Find lost souls of kitties and help them remember their favorite moments with their humans. Each discovery transforms the kitty and reveals its touching memory. Immerse yourself in this unique hidden object adventure.
items.description_ja: Explore a surreal handcrafted world in Hidden Kitties Memories. Find lost souls of kitties and help them remember their favorite moments with their humans. Each discovery transforms the kitty and reveals its touching memory. Immerse yourself in this unique hidden object adventure.
items.title: Cat Memories - Find the Hidden Stories

items.description: Faced with the threat of a wave of toxic fumes, embark on an expedition to save yourself from certain death. Gobble up obstacles on your path to allow your caterpillar to move along and board survivors who also seek asylum!
items.description_ja: Faced with the threat of a wave of toxic fumes, embark on an expedition to save yourself from certain death. Gobble up obstacles on your path to allow your caterpillar to move along and board survivors who also seek asylum!
items.title: All Abug!

items.description: Alone in the dead of night, you find yourself sent on a simple errand to check on a quiet gas station on the outskirts of town. But nothing here feels right. You can’t outrun this place. It wants you. And it will keep you.
items.description_ja: 主人公の心の最深部を探る、常に変化する物語を持つユニークな心理ホラー視覚小説。 現実を疑問視させる暗い秘密を持つキャラクターたちに出会い、すべてが引き込まれるレトロサウンドトラックで彩られています
items.title: Loop//Error

items.description: The old Lily Flash Games are being recompiled for modern systems! In Lily's Lil Video help Lily learn to be the best worker at the Happy Video Store! Sort through VHS tapes, stock up the shelves, and pick up after messy customers. Strive for perfection every day so Lily can be the best employee!
items.description_ja: The old Lily Flash Games are being recompiled for modern systems! In Lily's Lil Video help Lily learn to be the best worker at the Happy Video Store! Sort through VHS tapes, stock up the shelves, and pick up after messy customers. Strive for perfection every day so Lily can be the best employee!
items.title: Lily's Lil Video Shop!

items.description:
Toxic Yuri VN between a mad scientist, and her spectral lover who haunts the living.

It has been far too long since you passed.
You have been gone for so long.
But no longer.
I will bring you back my love.
No matter the cost.
items.description_ja:
Toxic Yuri VN between a mad scientist, and her spectral lover who haunts the living.

It has been far too long since you passed.
You have been gone for so long.
But no longer.
I will bring you back my love.
No matter the cost.
items.title: We Belong Dead

items.description: Work the late-night shift at The Motel, an old roadside stop near Oakhill Grove. Complete simple tasks until a news broadcast reveals a dangerous killer is nearby. Can you survive the night?
items.description_ja: Work the late-night shift at The Motel, an old roadside stop near Oakhill Grove. Complete simple tasks until a news broadcast reveals a dangerous killer is nearby. Can you survive the night?
items.title: The motel

items.description: A 2-4 player online party game about risking your life for the thrill of high-stakes gambling. Use your items wisely to gain an edge over chance and play until you are the last person standing.
items.description_ja: A 2-4 player online party game about risking your life for the thrill of high-stakes gambling. Use your items wisely to gain an edge over chance and play until you are the last person standing.
items.title: FINAL SPIN

items.description: Abnormal1999: Sector 49 is a challenging mystery puzzle game. You play as Sam, searching for your daughter in the abandoned Sector 49. Collect 10 consciousnesses to open the portal and escape.
items.description_ja: Abnormal1999: Sector 49は、高難易度なミステリーパズルゲームです。あなたはサムとなり、廃墟と化したセクター49で娘を探します。10個の意識を集めてポータルを開き、脱出しましょう。
items.title: Abnormal1999:Sector 49

items.description: "Bone To Gather" is a synergy-building action roguelike. Embark on an epic journey with a team of puny skeletons determined to revenge the Demon King. Recruit skeletons with unique synergies to create a powerful team and battle through monsters on your way to the final showdown.
items.description_ja: "Bone To Gather" is a synergy-building action roguelike. Embark on an epic journey with a team of puny skeletons determined to revenge the Demon King. Recruit skeletons with unique synergies to create a powerful team and battle through monsters on your way to the final showdown.
items.title: Bone To Gather

items.description: You step into a street both strange and familiar, where eerie events unfold one after another. The air is thick with lingering spirits and overwhelming resentment, as if something in the shadows is waiting to drag you into the abyss…
items.description_ja: You step into a street both strange and familiar, where eerie events unfold one after another. The air is thick with lingering spirits and overwhelming resentment, as if something in the shadows is waiting to drag you into the abyss…
items.title: 见诡录：阴魂街 Haunting Record: Phantom Street

items.description: In a dystopian future, Agent Seth investigates a corporate geological facility where a biological gas turned people into bloodthirsty monsters. Fight through enemy hordes, uncover a dark corporate conspiracy, and face Lovecraftian nightmares in this tense retro FPS with survival horror!
items.description_ja: ディストピアの未来で、セス捜査官は企業の地質施設を調査。生物ガスが人を血に飢えた怪物に変えた。敵を突破し、陰謀を暴き、クトゥルフの悪夢と対峙！緊張感あふれるレトロFPSでサバイバルホラーを体験！
items.title: Deep Sheol

items.description: A short 70–90 minute hand-drawn cozy-gothic puzzle adventure with easy, relaxing puzzles, where color slowly returns to a cursed town as you uncover its secrets.
items.description_ja: A short 70–90 minute hand-drawn cozy-gothic puzzle adventure with easy, relaxing puzzles, where color slowly returns to a cursed town as you uncover its secrets.
items.title: The Curse We Made

items.description: David Lagani is an ordinary Filipino worker whose quiet life turns to dread when a mysterious figure begins breaking into homes and making people disappear. Each night feels longer, every sound closer, and all he can do is pray the footsteps don’t reach his door.
items.description_ja: David Lagani is an ordinary Filipino worker whose quiet life turns to dread when a mysterious figure begins breaking into homes and making people disappear. Each night feels longer, every sound closer, and all he can do is pray the footsteps don’t reach his door.
items.title: Taguan

items.description: A video you must never play. What happened to the influencer who vanished?
items.description_ja: 再生してはいけない動画、失踪したインフルエンサーに何が起きたのか。
items.title: TARO IS BACK

items.description: Hapunan is a story-driven psychological horror game steeped in Filipino urban legends. Facing eviction, a teenager and his father turn to late-night street vending to survive. But as dark secrets uncoil behind the trade and the name Penduko, every choice you make dictates who eats—and who survives.
items.description_ja: Hapunan is a story-driven psychological horror game steeped in Filipino urban legends. Facing eviction, a teenager and his father turn to late-night street vending to survive. But as dark secrets uncoil behind the trade and the name Penduko, every choice you make dictates who eats—and who survives.
items.title: Hapunan

items.description:
"Dr." Trigger, a man with no experience whatsoever, starts a therapy clinic. Will he cave under the pressure, or can he fake it till he makes it? 

Become the worst therapist ever (on purpose)! An interactive FMV comedy experience with dozens of choices, branching paths, and over 90 total endings!
items.description_ja:
"Dr." Trigger, a man with no experience whatsoever, starts a therapy clinic. Will he cave under the pressure, or can he fake it till he makes it? 

Become the worst therapist ever (on purpose)! An interactive FMV comedy experience with dozens of choices, branching paths, and over 90 total endings!
items.title: The Therapist Impostor

items.description: A dark murder mistery game combined with a visual novel revolving around a disturbing plot. Embark on the frightening adventure of a young priest entangled in a forbidden affair with a beautiful lady who meets a gruesome end. Lust, wrath, murder, despair.
items.description_ja: 恐ろしいスキャンダルが、若い神父の住居で女性の遺体が発見されたとき、カトリック教会に脅威をもたらします。
items.title: What have you done, Father?

items.description: A fast-paced action platformer doubling as the most realistic chair simulator money can buy! Have you ever wondered what your chair thinks? What it believes? What it desires? Learn the answers and destroy some dimensions along the way!
items.description_ja: A fast-paced action platformer doubling as the most realistic chair simulator money can buy! Have you ever wondered what your chair thinks? What it believes? What it desires? Learn the answers and destroy some dimensions along the way!
items.title: CHAIRS

items.description: Slash Quest is a quirky action adventure with unconventional controls and unlikely heroes. Spin a magic talking sword through exotic lands, fight nasty creatures, overcome puzzles and make friends on your way to reunite it with its rightful wielder, the Queen.
items.description_ja: Slash Questは非伝統的なコントロールと考えられないようなヒーローを持つアクションアドベンチャーゲームです。魔法の話す剣をエキゾチックな土地で回転させ、不快な生物と戦い、パズルを解き、友達を作りながら、それを正当な持ち主である女王と再会させるための道のりを進んでください。
items.title: Slash Quest

items.description: Damn! The old man has been kidnapped by aliens, what to do? Finished! The aliens are conducting inhuman experiments on the old man, how to solve it? Click "Add to Cart" to complete the purchase and get the solution!
items.description_ja: やばい！おじいちゃんが宇宙人に誘拐された、どうしよう？終わった！宇宙人がおじいちゃんに非道な実験をしている、どう解決する？「カートに追加」をクリックして購入を完了し、解決策を手に入れよう！
items.title: Get Up In The Night

items.description: Dive into Brainrot Battle Royale! Fight to the death in Ohio with the greatest brainrot characters in the ultimate Gen Z showdown. Join the fight now, aurafarmer!
items.description_ja: Dive into Brainrot Battle Royale! Fight to the death in Ohio with the greatest brainrot characters in the ultimate Gen Z showdown. Join the fight now, aurafarmer!
items.title: Brainrot Battle Royale

items.description: In the Regulatory Realm, human beliefs manifest as bizarre bureaucracies. Venture to the human world to deliver Unsent letters in this whimsical platform-adventure game.
items.description_ja: In the Regulatory Realm, human beliefs manifest as bizarre bureaucracies. Venture to the human world to deliver Unsent letters in this whimsical platform-adventure game.
items.title: Unsent

items.description: STREET DOG LEGEND is a flash-game inspired cooking simulator with a satirical storyline and multiple endings. Manage your street cart, meet interesting characters, play minigames, and more!
items.description_ja: STREET DOG LEGEND is a flash-game inspired cooking simulator with a satirical storyline and multiple endings. Manage your street cart, meet interesting characters, play minigames, and more!
items.title: Street Dog Legend

items.description: Stikbold is a glorious and intense sport which will put your friendships to the test with fast-paced, hard-hitting and occasionally hilariously unfair action! Or play the co-op story mode to unlock the full roster of quirky sporting heroes and earn achievements.
items.description_ja: Stikbold is a glorious and intense sport which will put your friendships to the test with fast-paced, hard-hitting and occasionally hilariously unfair action! Or play the co-op story mode to unlock the full roster of quirky sporting heroes and earn achievements.
items.title: Stikbold! A Dodgeball Adventure DELUXE

items.description: A social deduction party game where players parkour to school, answer trivia, and hunt down a hidden Class Clown who is sabotaging to try and make the entire group fail!
items.description_ja: A social deduction party game where players parkour to school, answer trivia, and hunt down a hidden Class Clown who is sabotaging to try and make the entire group fail!
items.title: Stick Scholars

items.description: James, a freelance journalist, breaks into the notorious "Lobotomy" asylum to expose decades of brutal experiments. Armed with a camera and flashlight, he must navigate the suffocating darkness. Record the truth, survive the shadows, and escape before the asylum’s dark history claims you next.
items.description_ja: James, a freelance journalist, breaks into the notorious "Lobotomy" asylum to expose decades of brutal experiments. Armed with a camera and flashlight, he must navigate the suffocating darkness. Record the truth, survive the shadows, and escape before the asylum’s dark history claims you next.
items.title: Lobotomy

items.description: Thousands of balls are scattered throughout the playrooms. Someone should put them away, and there's no one here but you. Almost no one.
items.description_ja: Thousands of balls are scattered throughout the playrooms. Someone should put them away, and there's no one here but you. Almost no one.
items.title: Playrooms

items.description: Half game. Half album. All awesome! A colourful art-punk adventure towards the best night of your life. Guaranteed to cheer you up in half an hour or your money back!
items.description_ja: 半分ゲーム。半分アルバム。全部最高！ Team LazerbeamとThe Superweaksが贈るユニークなスプリットリリース。人生最高の夜に向けたカラフルなアートパンクアドベンチャー！
items.title: Teenage Blob

items.description: The somewhat hateful and slightly charming tumbleweed is the star of the game. This game is a tumbleweed life simulator that depicts the fate of tumbleweeds in my own imagination.
items.description_ja:
"荒野とか西部劇とかで転がってるコロコロのあの子"
そう、どことなく可愛らしいあの子です。あの子がタンブルウィードです。
この作品は、タンブルウィードの宿命(さだめ)を勝手な想像で描いたタンブルライフシミュレーターです。
items.title: Tumbleweed Destiny

items.description: I taught myself how to drive by making this game.
items.description_ja: I taught myself how to drive by making this game.
items.title: DMVR

items.description:
VFurrika! is an addictive puzzle game that combines the charm of your favourite VFur streamers with strategic gameplay.
Drop your favorite furry VTuber into a glass and witness them merging into other VTubers upon contact!
items.description_ja:
VFurrika! is an addictive puzzle game that combines the charm of your favourite VFur streamers with strategic gameplay.
Drop your favorite furry VTuber into a glass and witness them merging into other VTubers upon contact!
items.title: VFurrika!

items.description: Tree Hugging ❤ 🎄
items.description_ja: Tree Hugging ❤ 🎄
items.title: Tree Hugging Simulator

items.description: After your brothers are killed by Mr. Wolf and a mysterious associate you wake up to find yourself trapped in your own home and must use your wits and determination to escape. Do you have what it takes to escape?
items.description_ja: 兄たちがミスター・ウルフと謎の協力者に殺害された後、目を覚ますと自分の家に閉じ込められていることに気づきます。脱出するためには、知恵と決意が試されます。あなたには脱出する力があるでしょうか？
items.title: The Third Pig

items.description:
They See Us is a multiplayer horror game built for creepy vibes, scream-worthy jump scares and hilarious co-op tension.

Work together to spot terrifying anomalies lurking in familiar places – before they find you!
items.description_ja:
They See Us is a multiplayer horror game built for creepy vibes, scream-worthy jump scares and hilarious co-op tension.

Work together to spot terrifying anomalies lurking in familiar places – before they find you!
items.title: They See Us

items.description: Splatter slimes, massacre mutants, and assemble your perfect Gunbot! Survive the wasteland in this top-down shooter roguelite by customizing your weapons on the unique upgrade grid, and pick from tons of build-defining modules and wacky bots for a new experience every run. Prologue teaser build.
items.description_ja: 終末世界の荒廃した大地で、破壊的なバトルメカとなれ！押し寄せるエイリアンの大軍を相手に、戦いながら武器モジュールを回収し、最強の武器を作り上げ、敵の包囲網を突破しろ！最終的には動く死神タイタンに進化して、戦場に名を刻め！
items.title: Gunbot Diplomacy: Blast Off

items.description: Take control of a bush and challenge your friends in a hide and seek game up to 4 players. Move at night and use the day as an opportunity to observe and beat your opponents. Use the secrets of nature to trap them. Get ready to laugh!
items.description_ja: Take control of a bush and challenge your friends in a hide and seek game up to 4 players. Move at night and use the day as an opportunity to observe and beat your opponents. Use the secrets of nature to trap them. Get ready to laugh!
items.title: Buissons

items.description: INPUT6 is a short, fast-paced, first-person horror game. Search through the abandoned robot factory avoiding malfunctioning robot by instantly switching between playing in separate sections of the facility. Figure out what led to the company's collapse. Be quick! You don’t have much time.
items.description_ja: INPUT6 is a short, fast-paced, first-person horror game. Search through the abandoned robot factory avoiding malfunctioning robot by instantly switching between playing in separate sections of the facility. Figure out what led to the company's collapse. Be quick! You don’t have much time.
items.title: INPUT6

items.description: Hodgepodge Hunch is a who-done-it game where everyone chips in to make a hotpot dish. Collaborate with your buddies to collect ingredients in the dungeons and whip up a delicious feast. There's just one problem... A backstabber may be lurking among you who'll throw your dinner plans awry...
items.description_ja: 闇鍋人狼は皆で鍋を作る正体隠匿ゲームです。仲間同士で相談してダンジョンで食材を集め、おいしい鍋を作ります。ただし、中には裏切り者が紛れていて鍋を作るのを邪魔してくるかも……。お互いの正体を隠しながら理想の鍋を作ろう！
items.title: Hodgepodge Hunch

items.description: Live the perfect day, break the cycle, and discover the truth about yourself in this short, quirky sci-fi mystery about freedom, choice, and loneliness.
items.description_ja: Live the perfect day, break the cycle, and discover the truth about yourself in this short, quirky sci-fi mystery about freedom, choice, and loneliness.
items.title: ENDLING

items.description: Phil's life has crumbled to dust. The four walls of his room have become his safe haven. He yearns for sleep...but terrible nightmares haunt him. Welcome to a new dimension of horror. Welcome to Midnight Scenes.
items.description_ja: Phil's life has crumbled to dust. The four walls of his room have become his safe haven. He yearns for sleep...but terrible nightmares haunt him. Welcome to a new dimension of horror. Welcome to Midnight Scenes.
items.title: Midnight Scenes: A Safe Place

items.description: An avid bird watching simulator with realistic watching mechanics. Grab your binoculars and build your attention span, Bird Watching Simulator is an unbelievably relaxing and interactive game that draws you so close to nature, it feels like you're apart of it.
items.description_ja: An avid bird watching simulator with realistic watching mechanics. Grab your binoculars and build your attention span, Bird Watching Simulator is an unbelievably relaxing and interactive game that draws you so close to nature, it feels like you're apart of it.
items.title: Bird Watching Simulator

items.description: Live out your school days as you navigate the rocky world of game development! Can you make an amazing game, or will something get in the way?
items.description_ja: Live out your school days as you navigate the rocky world of game development! Can you make an amazing game, or will something get in the way?
items.title: I Wanna Be A Game Dev!

items.description:
Flan's MS is a 2D story game with some puzzles and gameplay systems.
After escaping from everything she is familiar with, Flan needs to retrieve her lost dream diary and find the answers she needs.
items.description_ja: この物語は何の答えも出せません。
items.title: Flan's MS

items.description: I'M STILL HERE - is a realistic horror game with an interesting plot and horrific screamers.
items.description_ja: I'M STILL HERE - is a realistic horror game with an interesting plot and horrific screamers.
items.title: I'm Still Here

items.description:
You only have 3 months left to live.
Gamble for extra time in Alice-sama’s life-or-death game.
Be careful — she wants to steal your heart. 🔪🔪🔪💜
items.description_ja:
残された寿命は3ヶ月。
生死を賭けて、アリス様と命懸けのギャンブルをどうぞ。
ただし要注意。彼女の狙いは、あなたのハート。🔪🔪🔪💜
items.title: Deadly Heart Gambit

items.description: Beaver Lyolik ate too many mushrooms and became a KURWA! Only the chosen ones can survive these 5 nights!
items.description_ja: Beaver Lyolik ate too many mushrooms and became a KURWA! Only the chosen ones can survive these 5 nights!
items.title: 5 NIGHTS AT BOBR KURWA

items.description: This is a minimalist-style tower defense game that is easy-going and relaxing, with a moderate level of difficulty. Build your tower formations to fend off enemies. It also supports online multiplayer, allowing you to team up and experience an unprecedented level of tower defense fun!
items.description_ja: ミニマリストスタイルのタワーディフェンスゲーム。気軽にリラックスしてプレイでき、難易度も中程度です。タワーフォーメーションを構築して敵を撃退しましょう。オンラインマルチプレイヤーにも対応しているので、チームを組んでかつてないレベルのタワーディフェンスの楽しさを体験できます！
items.title: Graphic Tower Defense

items.description: Find hidden objects in famous paintings… then eat them. Decode bizarre cravings, rip chunks out of Renaissance masterpieces, and snack your way through art history like the absolute menace you are.
items.description_ja: Find hidden objects in famous paintings… then eat them. Decode bizarre cravings, rip chunks out of Renaissance masterpieces, and snack your way through art history like the absolute menace you are.
items.title: I Eat Paintings When Guards Aren't Looking

items.description: Cook traditional 19th-century Italian recipes in a kitchen haunted by hunger. A short psychological horror where gastronomy, ritual and cosmic appetite share the same table.
items.description_ja: 19世紀イタリアの伝統料理を調理。飢餓に取り憑かれた厨房で。美食、儀式、宇宙的食欲が食卓で一堂に会す短編サイコロジカルホラー。
items.title: Cucina Stellata

items.description: Optimal stat allocation, creative equipment combos, and tactics that exploit your enemy's weaknesses—your choices define the battlefield! GladiMaker is a whimsical Auto-battler RPG that packs a punch with deep strategy and the thrill of infinite growth.
items.description_ja: 最適なステータス割り当て、クリエイティブな機器の組み合わせ、および敵の弱点を悪用する戦術 - あなたの選択が戦場を決定します！ GladiMakerは、深い戦略と無限の成長のスリルを備えたパンチを詰め込んだ気まぐれなオートバトラーRPGです。
items.title: GLADIMAKER : Auto Battle RPG

items.description: Run your own property rental business with friends! Renovate and furnish rundown homes, take photos, and list them for rent. Welcome unpredictable guests, earn five-star reviews, and deal with the chaos when they wreck the place. From tiny studios to seaside villas, explore 500+ homes!
items.description_ja: 友だちと一緒に、自分だけの賃貸ビジネスを始めよう！ボロボロの家をリフォームして家具を置き、写真を撮って貸し出そう。予測できないゲストを迎え、五つ星レビューを集め、家をめちゃくちゃにされたら後片づけ。小さなワンルームから海辺のヴィラまで、500軒以上の家が待っています！
items.title: Rent Out Together

items.description: A first-person lost-item exploration simulator set in a Japanese high school baseball club. Search for missing baseballs while enduring the strict hierarchy and unreasonable treatment from coaches and upperclassmen.
items.description_ja: 日本の高校野球部を舞台にした一人称視点の落とし物探索シミュレーター。監督や先輩の理不尽な上下関係に耐えながら、校内に散らばったボールを探します。
items.title: BALL BOY Simulator

items.description: Gamble your fingers against the devil and his bloodthirsty saw in this turn-based strategy game. Outsmart your opponent with special abilities, or test your luck as you defy the odds to escape eternal damnation!
items.description_ja: Gamble your fingers against the devil and his bloodthirsty saw in this turn-based strategy game. Outsmart your opponent with special abilities, or test your luck as you defy the odds to escape eternal damnation!
items.title: Bonesaw

items.description: Cast into an ancient crypt, survive the horrors that dwell below, and ascend from despair with your unexpected companion in this short 2D puzzle platformer. Take risks to evade the petrifying gaze from beyond the dark.
items.description_ja: Cast into an ancient crypt, survive the horrors that dwell below, and ascend from despair with your unexpected companion in this short 2D puzzle platformer. Take risks to evade the petrifying gaze from beyond the dark.
items.title: We're Tethered Together

items.description: Explore abandoned biospheres at the bottom of the ocean, alone or with up to 4 friends.
items.description_ja: Explore abandoned biospheres at the bottom of the ocean, alone or with up to 4 friends.
items.title: Subterror

items.description: A broke young man takes on the night shift at a roadside diner. In the glow of the blood moon, routine tasks turn into a fight for survival. First-person horror based on a dark creepypasta with a set of rescue rules.
items.description_ja: 手持ちのない若い男性が路上のダイナーで夜勤を引き受けます。血の月の輝きの中で、日常のタスクが生存の戦いに変わります。救助ルールを基にしたダーククリーピーパスタに基づく一人称ホラー。
items.title: Creepy Shift: Roadside Diner

items.description: Join Mr. Gaffer on his mission to protect the peace of his home in this dynamic strategy game. Test your wits and reflexes as you face intense waves of enemies, and compete in thrilling mini-games against other players.
items.description_ja: Join Mr. Gaffer on his mission to protect the peace of his home in this dynamic strategy game. Test your wits and reflexes as you face intense waves of enemies, and compete in thrilling mini-games against other players.
items.title: Grumpy Gaffer

items.description: You wake up tied to an office chair in the middle of an empty room. A mysterious device with a 10-minute timer is attached to you. Explore the office floors, try not to tip over, and find a way to escape!
items.description_ja: 空っぽの部屋の真ん中、オフィスチェアに縛られて目覚める。10分のタイマーが刻む謎の装置が仕掛けられている。オフィスフロアを探索し、体勢を崩すな！脱出への道を見出せ！
items.title: Ells Tales: Chairbound

items.description: Step into the shoes of Agent Kim, drawn into a chilling mystery deep in the wilderness. Find hidden clues, solve intricate puzzles, and outsmart the relentless zombies that roam the estate. Will you make it out alive, or will you too vanish without a trace?
items.description_ja: キム捜査官の役割を担い、深い森の中で恐ろしい謎に引き込まれます。隠された手がかりを見つけ、複雑なパズルを解き、館をさまようしつこいゾンビを出し抜くことができるでしょうか。あなたは生き延びることができるのか、それとも跡形もなく消えてしまうのか？
items.title: Mansion of the Dead

items.description: A cheerful man excitedly arrives at a popular burger shop in town. However, it turns out to be a terrifying facility controlled by the evil Emperor "Pattypatine"! Ravenous, rampaging burgers are everywhere... Fight back with the shining fries, the "Potato Saber"!
items.description_ja: 街で人気のハンバーガーショップにウキウキでやってきた男。しかしそこは悪の皇帝「パティパティーン」が支配する恐怖の施設だった！暴れまわる人食いハンバーガーたち...光り輝くポテト、「ポテトセイバー」で戦うのだ！
items.title: DEATH BURGER

items.description: A rebellious chaos sandbox where you weaponize junk, disrupt highway traffic, and engineer outrageous physics disasters to turn the morning commute into pure, glorious mayhem.
items.description_ja: A rebellious chaos sandbox where you weaponize junk, disrupt highway traffic, and engineer outrageous physics disasters to turn the morning commute into pure, glorious mayhem.
items.title: C.A.R.S. - Creating A Ridiculous Shitshow

items.description: A relaxed and casual tower defense battle between geese. 16 parallel spaces, 108 civilizations, and confrontations between different troops.
items.description_ja: 気軽でリラックスしたガチョウ対ガチョウのタワーディフェンス対戦。16のパラレル空間、108の文明、異なる兵種同士の対抗。
items.title: Goose Evolution

items.description: A horror co-op extraction builder set in a scorched wasteland where everything burns. Descend with your friends into shifting ruins, rip out furniture, and scavenge for loot before the Corrupted close in. Make it back alive, then rebuild the Outpost to better your chances for the next run.
items.description_ja: 協力型ホラー脱出系建築ゲーム、爆誕。全てが燃える焦土の荒野でフレンドを道連れに、形を変えていく遺跡へと降り立ち、家具をもぎ取って、戦利品を漁り、「腐敗」が迫る前に脱出だ。生還したら前哨基地を再建して、次の遺跡潜りの成功率を高めよう。
items.title: GRAIN ROT

items.description: Lead your own DnD-like adventuring party on an epic adventure narrated by Laura Bailey. Invite your friends for free to the group with the Friends Pass, or strike out on your own. Cooperation, betrayal, and the luck of the dice… what wild escapades will you and your teammates get up to?
items.description_ja: 自分だけの冒険者一行を率いて、テーブルトークRPGにインスパイアされた壮大な冒険に乗り出そう。フレンドパスを使ってフレンドを招待するもよし、単身で挑むもよし。協力、裏切り、ダイス運….キミたちを待ち受ける運命や、いかに。
items.title: Worlds of Aria

items.description: Control the strings of fate and embark on a grand adventure with Drev and Nieve. A magical, story-driven 2.5D puzzle-platformer where puppeteering mechanics and a whimsical, theater-inspired world intertwine.
items.description_ja: 運命の糸を操り、ドレフやニーヴと一緒に大冒険を繰り広げよう。操り人形の仕組みと、劇場にインスパイアされた風変わりな世界が絡み合う、ストーリー重視のマジカルな2.5Dパズルプラットフォーマー。
items.title: Once Upon A Puppet

items.description: Physically simulated claw machine! Win over 200 unique prizes in the Fun or Realistic difficulty mode.
items.description_ja: 物理的に正確なクロー・マシン・シミュレーター！200のユニークな賞品を獲得しよう。楽しい難易度モードと現実的な難易度モードを選択できます。
items.title: Claw Machine Sim

items.description: Tormenture is a psychological horror game where you play as a child trapped in a cursed 8-bit game with a dark secret. To survive, you must find four relics and solve reality-blurring puzzles. But beware—some creatures may escape the game and haunt you in the real world. A game within a game.
items.description_ja: 『Tormenture』は暗い秘密を持った呪いの8ビットゲームに閉じ込められた子どもとなってプレイを進める、サイコロジカル・ホラーゲーム。無事に生還するには、4つの秘宝を集め、現実との境界が曖昧になったパズルを解かなければならない。しかしご注意を――中にはゲームから逃げだし、現実世界のあなたを襲ってくるクリーチャーも存在する。ゲームの中のゲームを心ゆくまで堪能しよう。
items.title: Tormenture

items.description: In Tobla - Divine Path, creative puzzle gameplay, a story inspired by classics like Portal™, and impressive 3D graphics come together. Step into the role of Mort and tackle the challenging puzzles and cynical comments of the cunning goddess Tobla to find your way home.
items.description_ja: Tobla - Divine Path は、Portal™のようなクラシックにインスパイアされたストーリーとクリエイティブなパズル、魅力的なビジュアルを提供します。Mortとして、物理ベースのパズルを解き、狡猾な女神Toblaの計画を阻止しましょう。
items.title: Tobla - Divine Path

items.description: As an adventurer, you have unintentionally uncovered a horrifying secret hidden in the town for years. Every choice you make will shape the story and become part of your personality test. Will you be the hero who saves the villagers, or will you sacrifice them to create your own legend?
items.description_ja:
記憶を失った冒険者が、記憶を取り戻す過程で、町に長く隠されていた恐ろしい秘密を偶然にも明らかにする。
プレイヤーの選択は、物語の展開を形作るだけでなく、性格診断の一部にもなる。
果たして、英雄として村人たちを血まみれの危機から救い出すのか？それとも、自分の冒険を成し遂げるために彼らを犠牲にするのか？すべてはあなた次第……
items.title: The Apocalypse Sacrifice

items.description: Tidy Backpack is a relaxing puzzle game where you must organize found fantasy loot in your backpack in a tidy way. Find forgotten artifacts and learn details about the old world... at least supposedly!
items.description_ja: Tidy Backpackは手に入れたファンタジーのアイテムをきれいにインベントリにしまうリラックスしたパズルゲームです。失われたアーティファクトを見つけて古代の秘密を解き明かす... ことができるはず！
items.title: Tidy Backpack

items.description: The combo based incremental! Play crazy builds and pump those numbers! Find legendary items, cast wacky magical spells, and unlock hundreds of upgrades. Decide the fate of your studio and go INFINITE!
items.description_ja: 自分だけのゲームスタジオを経営しよう。インクリメンタル戦略デッキビルダー。強力なコンボで巨大な数字を生み出せ。レアな施設、レジェンダリーアイテム、アップグレードを発見しよう。自分の道を選び、物語を形作り、世界を手に入れろ。
items.title: Pay 2 Win: The World is Mine

items.description: IT’S YOUR BIRTHDAY!!! and nobody came to celebrate with you… Hell of a Birthday is a First-Person comedic horror game where you play as the Birthday Boy trying to survive your special day. From the maker of Bite Night and Invasion of the Halloween Fiends comes another unique adventure.
items.description_ja: IT’S YOUR BIRTHDAY!!! and nobody came to celebrate with you… Hell of a Birthday is a First-Person comedic horror game where you play as the Birthday Boy trying to survive your special day. From the maker of Bite Night and Invasion of the Halloween Fiends comes another unique adventure.
items.title: Hell of a Birthday

items.description: Based on the real Left By Angels Mansion! After your wife vanishes, a strange sighting draws you to an abandoned mansion. Trapped inside, haunted by the past, and hunted by truth, you must survive a looping nightmare where light is your only ally. She’s here—and she remembers everything.
items.description_ja: Based on the real Left By Angels Mansion! After your wife vanishes, a strange sighting draws you to an abandoned mansion. Trapped inside, haunted by the past, and hunted by truth, you must survive a looping nightmare where light is your only ally. She’s here—and she remembers everything.
items.title: Left By Angels

items.description: Iron Blight is a survival horror game set in a cold, rainy Eastern Bloc town. You are trapped in a room as abominations claw at your door, with nowhere to run. You must survive the feverish night, uncover the horrors lurking in the shadows, and above all, find your wife, Valeria.
items.description_ja: 『Iron Blight』は冷たい雨が降る旧東側諸国の町を舞台にしたサバイバルホラー。逃げ場のない部屋で異形がドアを掻きむしるなか、熱病のような夜を生き延び、暗闇の恐怖を暴き、妻のヴァレリアを見つけ出せ。
items.title: Iron Blight

items.description: "When the graves stop whispering in your ear, it’s time for you to surrender to eternal silence". So says the Agreement, and so it must be fulfilled. Welcome to a new dimension of horror. Welcome to Midnight Scenes.
items.description_ja: "When the graves stop whispering in your ear, it’s time for you to surrender to eternal silence". So says the Agreement, and so it must be fulfilled. Welcome to a new dimension of horror. Welcome to Midnight Scenes.
items.title: Midnight Scenes: Among Graves

items.description: A fun cat puzzle game, with music and adorable cats keeping you company.
items.description_ja: 楽しい猫のパズルゲーム。音楽とかわいい猫たちがあなたをお供します。
items.title: Cozy Cats Fit

items.description: ESKINITA is a short atmospheric Filipino-inspired suspense horror game about working late nights in a small neighborhood lugawan and surviving the walk home through dark alleyways.
items.description_ja: ESKINITA is a short atmospheric Filipino-inspired suspense horror game about working late nights in a small neighborhood lugawan and surviving the walk home through dark alleyways.
items.title: ESKINITA

items.description: Full moon. Cold night. Dark shadow. Warm gun. The Beast of Glenkildove has stalked Ireland for centuries. Now, you must hunt it. A text-based interactive novel set in the World of Darkness.
items.description_ja: Full moon. Cold night. Dark shadow. Warm gun. The Beast of Glenkildove has stalked Ireland for centuries. Now, you must hunt it. A text-based interactive novel set in the World of Darkness.
items.title: Hunter: The Reckoning — The Beast of Glenkildove

items.description: A short Halloween-themed point n' click game featuring the dumb animal characters of Homestar Runner dot com.
items.description_ja: A short Halloween-themed point n' click game featuring the dumb animal characters of Homestar Runner dot com.
items.title: Homestar Runner: Halloween Hide n' Seek

items.description: Inspired by the classics such as Resident Evil, Silent Hill and Alone In the Dark: Detective Stone investigates a shadow conspiracy. Explore atmospheric levels, fight monsters, and solve puzzles. Unravel a story of twists and turns. Choose classic fixed camera, or over-the-shoulder.
items.description_ja: バイオハザードやサイレントヒルなどの古典にインスピレーションを得た: 探偵ストーンが影の陰謀を調査します。大気レベルを探索し、モンスターと戦い、パズルを解きましょう。紆余曲折の物語を探索してください。
items.title: Connection: The Nightmare Within

items.description: Mamma mia! Our cats are now in the great city of Rome! Let's find them! Start with a monochromatic illustration and reveal the final colored art. Play through different modes, find special cats, and unlock bonus levels! More than 970 hidden objects to find! Enjoy the extra bonus level, NERD ARENA!
items.description_ja: マンマミーア！ネコたちは偉大な都市、ローマにいる！探しに行こう。最初は美しいモノクロのイラストでリラックスし、最後に色がついた絵を明らかにしよう。さまざまなモードをプレイして、特別なネコを見つけ、ボーナスステージをアンロックしよう！隠されたオブジェクトは970個以上！追加のボーナスステージ、ナードアリーナも楽しもう！
items.title: Hidden Cats in Rome

items.description: Don’t Forget is a 3D singleplayer story and exploration game inspired by dementia. Recollect your memories by looking for clues and playing brain-stimulating minigames whilst battling the effects of dementia. Explore three different key events of your life to figure out what has happened.
items.description_ja: Don’t Forget is a 3D singleplayer story and exploration game inspired by dementia. Recollect your memories by looking for clues and playing brain-stimulating minigames whilst battling the effects of dementia. Explore three different key events of your life to figure out what has happened.
items.title: Don't Forget

items.description: Work! Wan Wan Human is an [ADV Novel Game of Human Gachi-Inukenka] that educates sinners and turns them into adorable dogs. Become a correctional officer in a city of chaos where humans, demons, and angels are all mixed together and get the job done.
items.description_ja: 就労！！わんわんヒューマンは罪人を教育し、可愛いらしい犬に変える【人間ガチ犬化ADVノベルゲーム】です。人間、悪魔、天使が混在する混沌の街で矯正官となり、仕事をこなしましょう。個性豊かな同僚と罪人たちがアナタとの出会いを待っています。
items.title: 就労！！わんわんヒューマン

items.description: The WWI story where your goal isn’t to kill, but to survive. In the still trenches, three soldiers learn the harsh truth of war: reckless missions, digging trenches, collecting dog tags and ghostly whispers in the dark. Home before the leaves fall, they thought.
items.description_ja: The WWI story where your goal isn’t to kill, but to survive. In the still trenches, three soldiers learn the harsh truth of war: reckless missions, digging trenches, collecting dog tags and ghostly whispers in the dark. Home before the leaves fall, they thought.
items.title: The Caribou Trail

items.description:
One small mistake on vacation can lead to big trouble.
Are you ready for it?
Are you ready to face the Beaver… who’s out for revenge?
items.description_ja: 休暇中の小さな過ちが、大きなトラブルを引き起こすこともある。あなたはその準備ができていますか？復讐に燃えるビーバーと対峙する覚悟はできていますか？
items.title: Don't Mess With Bober

items.description: In this game, you play as Alice, an girl trapped in a twisted, ever-changing world. Survive a frozen orphanage filled with lurking horrors, eerie classical music, and unsolved mysteries. Scavenge, evade monsters, and uncover the truth. But can you face the brutal reality—or remain trapped forever?
items.description_ja: このユニークなサバイバルホラーゲームでは、普通の少女アリスとして、歪み続ける悪意に満ちた世界に堕ちる。雪に閉ざされた孤児院では、クラシック音楽が響くが、潜む恐怖を隠せない。全てのドアの向こうに致命の脅威が待ち、謎が隠されている。物資を集め、怪物から逃げ、秘密を解き明かせ。しかし、真実が明らかになるにつれ、その残酷な現実に耐えられるか、それとも永遠に悪夢に囚われるのか？
items.title: Seek

items.description: This is a nerve-wracking horror game that puts you in a dark, claustrophobic cave with a relentless creature. Survive by flashing your dying flashlight at the right moments, too soon or too late, and it’s over. You must keep an eye on the creature, but beware: staring too long is just as deadly.
items.description_ja: このゲームは、暗くて閉所的な洞窟で、執拗に迫るクリーチャーと対峙するスリル満点のホラーゲームです。ほとんど消えかけた懐中電灯を正しいタイミングで点けて生き残らなければなりません。早すぎても遅すぎても終わりです。クリーチャーを見張る必要がありますが、見つめすぎるのも危険です。
items.title: KEEP LOOKING

items.description: The unofficial Touhou farm sim! Play as harvest god Minoriko Aki and grow your popularity with your home-grown produce and specialty sweet potatoes. Mingle with other gods and youkai in newly-constructed Yasaka Resort Town, explore Youkai Mountain, and maybe get into a fight or two!
items.description_ja: The unofficial Touhou farm sim! Play as harvest god Minoriko Aki and grow your popularity with your home-grown produce and specialty sweet potatoes. Mingle with other gods and youkai in newly-constructed Yasaka Resort Town, explore Youkai Mountain, and maybe get into a fight or two!
items.title: Touhou Farming ~ Minoriko's Homestead Harvest

items.description: Immerse yourself in a short but mysterious adventure in a black and white world full of monsters and evil! Explore the map and find 100 cleverly hidden skulls of different creatures and recreate the picture in color. Play and relax if you are not afraid!
items.description_ja: Immerse yourself in a short but mysterious adventure in a black and white world full of monsters and evil! Explore the map and find 100 cleverly hidden skulls of different creatures and recreate the picture in color. Play and relax if you are not afraid!
items.title: Hidden Skulls

items.description: Experience Will's complicated story, find a way out of the nightmare of liminal spaces by solving challenging puzzles and avoiding dangerous entities — all this awaits you in "Shifting To The Backrooms".
items.description_ja: Experience Will's complicated story, find a way out of the nightmare of liminal spaces by solving challenging puzzles and avoiding dangerous entities — all this awaits you in "Shifting To The Backrooms".
items.title: Shifting To The Backrooms

items.description: The Pinkman Files is a mini-game rich, fast paced, rhythm based combat game with a side of visual novel, that will challenge your detective skills and allow you to uncover the secrets of a peculiar town.
items.description_ja: The Pinkman Files is a mini-game rich, fast paced, rhythm based combat game with a side of visual novel, that will challenge your detective skills and allow you to uncover the secrets of a peculiar town.
items.title: The Pinkman Files

items.description: Our Brief Eternity is a visual novel in which you play as Lin Xiaocou, an ordinary office worker whose quiet life is turned upside down when two girls from another world unexpectedly move in. Amid the warmth, comedy, and chaos of everyday life together, can you find a happy ending for everyone?
items.description_ja: 『永遠と星々と日常』は、ごく平凡な会社員リン・シャオソウ（林小湊）となって、異世界の少女二人との同居生活を送るノベルゲームです。突然自宅に転がり込んできた彼女たちと、笑いの絶えない賑やかな日々が始まります。三人はそれぞれの幸せを見つけられるのでしょうか。
items.title: Our Brief Eternity

items.description: 5 byte-sized games for a cheap price! Kill Frogs, fish the fish, take care of your virtual pet, invest, and fall to your death! All this in dofhouse's dofbox Collection!
items.description_ja: 5 byte-sized games for a cheap price! Kill Frogs, fish the fish, take care of your virtual pet, invest, and fall to your death! All this in dofhouse's dofbox Collection!
items.title: dofbox

items.description: Are you Quirky enough to win The Questionably Quirky Quiz Show with Gobby McGobblenutz, and permanently enter your name into the Hall of Legends for other players around the world to see how incredibly awesome you are?! Well then... What are you waiting for?!
items.description_ja: Are you Quirky enough to win The Questionably Quirky Quiz Show with Gobby McGobblenutz, and permanently enter your name into the Hall of Legends for other players around the world to see how incredibly awesome you are?! Well then... What are you waiting for?!
items.title: Gobby McGobblenutz Presents - The Questionably Quirky Quiz Show

items.description: COVEN is a hyper-violent retro FPS where your path of vengeance will take you across time and space. Destroy your enemies and eat their flesh.
items.description_ja: COVEN is a hyper-violent retro FPS where your path of vengeance will take you across time and space. Destroy your enemies and eat their flesh.
items.title: COVEN

items.description: When the power goes out while working  night shift in the hospital, the emergency lights come on with an eerie glow...
items.description_ja: When the power goes out while working  night shift in the hospital, the emergency lights come on with an eerie glow...
items.title: Blackout Hospital

items.description: Pru the Pigeon is a bite-sized 3D platformer with precise and expressive controls. Join Pru on his quest to save his land Asasco. Explore and collect everything in sight!
items.description_ja: Pru the Pigeon is a bite-sized 3D platformer with precise and expressive controls. Join Pru on his quest to save his land Asasco. Explore and collect everything in sight!
items.title: Pru the Pigeon

items.description: Fast-paced multiplayer racing game set in the vastness of space. Compete against friends or online rivals in intense races, where quick reflexes and strategic use of diverse skills determine the victor. Embrace the challenge of swinging your way to victory in this exhilarating space-themed race!
items.description_ja: 広大な宇宙を舞台にした、テンポの速いマルチプレイヤーレーシングゲーム。フレンドやオンラインのライバルと激しいレースを繰り広げ、素早い反射神経と多彩なスキルを戦略的に駆使して勝敗を決めよう。この爽快な宇宙をテーマにしたレースで、勝利への道をスイングするという挑戦を受け入れよう！
items.title: Swing Into Zero-G: Space Parkour Race

items.description: Embark on an odyssey into the unknown! Behold the tale of Toadman, an enigmatic being born from alien tech and the mysteries of Radiant Verde. Witness his perilous quest through treacherous jungles to confront Captain Croak in an epic showdown! Welcome to "Spawn of the Spore Spectre"!
items.description_ja: Embark on an odyssey into the unknown! Behold the tale of Toadman, an enigmatic being born from alien tech and the mysteries of Radiant Verde. Witness his perilous quest through treacherous jungles to confront Captain Croak in an epic showdown! Welcome to "Spawn of the Spore Spectre"!
items.title: Croak Crusader: Spawn of the Spore Spectre

items.description: Rebel Rush is a single-player speedrunning driving platformer where you sacrifice himbos for hideous carkour moves.
items.description_ja: 反乱レースはシングルプレイのスピードランドライブ・プラットフォーマーだ。チャラ男を捧げ、車でパルクールさながらの大胆なスタントを楽しもう。
items.title: Tails Noir: Rebel Rush

items.description: This is a cyberpunk-themed pixelated psychological horror, romance, and adventure game. Amidst a chance encounter in the rain and a forced gathering, an unexpected journey unfolds—a humorous romance and adventure story between you, a robot, and your furry companions.
items.description_ja: これはサイバーパンクを背景に据えたピクセル風の心理的ホラー、恋愛、アドベンチャーゲームです。雨の中の偶然の出会いと無念の集まりをきっかけに、予期せぬ旅が始まります。ロボットのあなたと兽人仲間たちとのおかしな恋愛冒険物語がここから幕を開けます。
items.title: obi3011-prologue

items.description:
A horror walking sim that emphasizes atmosphere, tension, fear, and immersive storytelling, all heightened by well-timed jump scares. 
The game takes place in a village frozen in time, stuck somewhere in the mid-20th century.
items.description_ja:
雰囲気、緊張感、恐怖、没入感あふれるストーリーテリングを強調したホラーウォーキング シミュレーション。タイミングよくジャンプ スケアがこれらを一層高めます。

このゲームは、20 世紀半ばのどこかで時が止まった村を舞台にしています。
items.title: Greed Stays Home

items.description: 399 days ago, the world ended. Epimutation is a horror visual novel that follows seven survivors as they attempt to navigate life in the apocalypse. Make life or death decisions, form bonds with your fellow survivors, and attempt to unravel the mystery behind the outbreak.
items.description_ja: 399 days ago, the world ended. Epimutation is a horror visual novel that follows seven survivors as they attempt to navigate life in the apocalypse. Make life or death decisions, form bonds with your fellow survivors, and attempt to unravel the mystery behind the outbreak.
items.title: Epimutation

items.description: Play dice poker with the Grim Reaper in a dark strategic roguelite. Build powerful poker hands from cursed dice, stack upgrades, rig the odds, sabotage Death, and survive deadly mini-games with your life on the line.
items.description_ja: 死神とダイスポーカーで命を賭ける、ダークな戦略系ローグライト。強力な役を作り、ダイスを強化し、確率を操作し、死神を妨害しながら、命懸けの危険なミニゲームを生き延びろ。
items.title: Cheat Death

items.description: The world ended. Now the real nightmare begins. Deep underground, a child wakes in a infected facility. Minds are breaking. Bodies are changing. Crawl through vents, follow echoes, and escape before it’s too late. Your mother is waiting.
items.description_ja: The world ended. Now the real nightmare begins. Deep underground, a child wakes in a infected facility. Minds are breaking. Bodies are changing. Crawl through vents, follow echoes, and escape before it’s too late. Your mother is waiting.
items.title: R.A.T.: Human Error – Episode One

items.description: Don't touch grass. Become grass!
items.description_ja: Don't touch grass. Become grass!
items.title: Grass Life Sim 2

items.description: Camelot 10000CE is a dark fantasy typing game where you are a decayed cyborg and have to type to move and attack.
items.description_ja: Camelot 10000CE is a dark fantasy typing game where you are a decayed cyborg and have to type to move and attack.
items.title: Camelot 10000CE

items.description: Overworked office worker Tsutomu, his ramen blog dying, stops at a station-side stall and orders six toppings. A kids' rumor says six makes you vanish. His heart sinks into history's dark.
items.description_ja: 仕事に追われて心身が擦り切れ、長年のラーメン食べ歩きブログも止まりかけたサラリーマンのツトム。帰り道にラーメン屋台へ寄り、気分転換にトッピングを6つ付けてしまう。子どもたちの間には「6つ付けると行方不明になる」という噂があった。人の心の在り方が、歴史の暗闇に覆われていく。
items.title: Shoyu Ramen Forever

items.description: As captain of the Pandora sub, you must explore the Trench and retrieve data from the Neptune wreckage. But beware - the trench is home to unimaginable horrors that will test your courage. Can you survive the terrors of the deep and complete your mission, or will you become the next victim?
items.description_ja: As captain of the Pandora sub, you must explore the Trench and retrieve data from the Neptune wreckage. But beware - the trench is home to unimaginable horrors that will test your courage. Can you survive the terrors of the deep and complete your mission, or will you become the next victim?
items.title: The Trench

items.description: The platformer without a jump button! Master the art of potion propulsion in this fast-paced adventure where strategy, precision, and creativity meet explosive fun.
items.description_ja: ジャンプなしの横スクロールアクションゲーム！？戦略、正確さ、創造力と爆発を組み合わせたスピード感あふれるアドベンチャーで、爆発ポーションのテクニックをマスターしよう。
items.title: Splodey

items.description: Step into a dark world where cyberdemons haunt humankind. When mutilated bodies start appearing all over this sleepy town in the Mississippi inaka, Sawyer, ex-AGENCY operative; now unemployed shut-in, must exorcise the demon perpetrator in this story-rich, PC-98 style adventure game.
items.description_ja: サイバー悪魔が人類をおびやかす暗い世界。ミシシッピののどかな田舎街で、無惨な死体が次々と発見される。機関の元エージェントで絶賛引きこもり中のソーヤーは、この惨劇を引き起こした悪魔を祓えるだろうか？ ストーリーに重きを置いたPC-98風ADVゲーム。
items.title: DIGITAL EXORCIST case_(0);

items.description: Owinka Shooter 2 throws you right back into the story of Owinka 427. Prepare to escape the Institute once and for all!
items.description_ja: Owinka Shooter 2 throws you right back into the story of Owinka 427. Prepare to escape the Institute once and for all!
items.title: Owinka Shooter 2
