items.description_ja: 1935年の洋館を舞台に織り成す、レトロな雰囲気の怪異ホラーミステリーアドベンチャー
items.title: 星影の館殺人事件

items.description: Fashion police, open up! Collect clothes, put together fashionable outfits, and impress your captors — for a chance to regain access to the outside world!
items.description_ja: Fashion police, open up! Collect clothes, put together fashionable outfits, and impress your captors — for a chance to regain access to the outside world!
items.title: Artificial Fashionista

Outsmart and outmaneuver foes in the runners Rogue Soul & Rogue Soul 2 and solve clever puzzles with a flourish in The Gentleman.

Outsmart and outmaneuver foes in the runners Rogue Soul & Rogue Soul 2 and solve clever puzzles with a flourish in The Gentleman.

items.description_ja: A zombie ponies game where you have to survive with a shotgun.
items.title: My Putrid Ponies

items.description: Liminal Shift is a unique atmospheric suspense game developed using the latest Unreal Engine 5 technologies such as Lumen and Nanite. With every step you take, Liminal Shift pushes you deeper into an eerie, unsettling experience like no other.
items.description_ja: Liminal Shiftは、最新のUnreal Engine 5テクノロジー（LumenやNaniteなど）を使用して開発された、独特の雰囲気を持つサスペンスゲームです。あなたが一歩踏み出すたびに、Liminal Shiftは他に類を見ない不気味で不安を呼び起こす体験へとあなたを引き込みます。
items.title: LIMINAL SHIFT

items.description:
The last subway departs in a world overrun by zombies.
At each station, gather materials, find better weapons, and fight off the undead.
As you get closer to your family, the danger grows.
Survive, upgrade, and make it to the final stop.
items.description_ja:
ゾンビが蔓延る世界で最後の地下鉄が出発する。
各ステーションで資材を集め、より優れた武器を見つけて、アンデッドと戦ってください。
家族に近づくほど、危険は増大します。
生き残り、アップグレードして、最後の目的地まで到達しましょう。
items.title: The DeadLine

items.description:
Sakura Miko and the Hololive members are suddenly warped into an alternate future timeline.
In this 3D adventure game, Miko must reunite with her friends and uncover the truth of this strange world to find her way back home.
items.description_ja:
さくらみこと仲間達は、突然「別の未来の世界線」へワープしてしまう。
元の世界に戻るため、仲間と再会しながら世界の「真実」に迫っていく3Dアドベンチャーゲームです。
items.title: Holo ADV: SakuraSingularity.exe

items.description: Build PowerPoint factories in Windows 95! Manage space, make increasingly complex slides and worry about Y2K in this challenging factory builder.
items.description_ja: Factory 95 は、スライドショー工場を……スライドショーの中で作る、レトロな Windows 風オートメーションゲームです！スペースを管理し、どんどん複雑になるスライドを作成し、Y2K問題に悩まされる――そんなミニマルな工場ビルダー。
items.title: Factory 95

items.description: The Last Lodge is a medieval psychological horror game where you work as an innkeeper. Listen closely to your patrons' stories, prepare their orders, and ultimately, choose which traveller has visited their very last lodge.
items.description_ja: The Last Lodge は、宿屋の主人として働く中世の選択型サイコロジカルホラーゲームです。常連客の奇妙な話に耳を傾け、注文を準備し、最終的にどの旅人が彼らの「最後の宿」を訪れたかを選択してください。
items.title: The Last Lodge

items.description: A Short Active Incremental game where you grow clones in vats, feed them to the Entity, butcher and burn them for meat, blood, and ichor, upgrade your ship's stations, create Wardens, and fight the Entity at the end of the voyage.
items.description_ja: 培養槽でクローンを育て、「存在」に喰わせ、解体し、燃やして肉・血・イコルに変え、船のステーションを強化し、「番人」を生み出し、航海の果てで「存在」と戦う、短く濃密なアクティブ系インクリメンタルゲーム。
items.title: Feed The Vessel

items.description: The Missing Parts of Maria Gwozdek is a dark fantasy visual novel about fulfilling your aspirations by sacrificing parts of yourself. Literally.
items.description_ja: The Missing Parts of Maria Gwozdek is a dark fantasy visual novel about fulfilling your aspirations by sacrificing parts of yourself. Literally.
items.title: The Missing Parts of Maria Gwozdek

items.description:
Xion Leak is a fast-paced, two-player, cooperative platformer.
Get in sync and set the fastest times to win trophies!
Run fast, work together, and avoid the countless dangers that the mysterious Foreman has placed in your path.
items.description_ja:
Xion Leak is a fast-paced, two-player, cooperative platformer.
Get in sync and set the fastest times to win trophies!
Run fast, work together, and avoid the countless dangers that the mysterious Foreman has placed in your path.
items.title: Xion Leak

items.description:
Build your team of mechanics and work together to repair and deliver as many cars as possible before the time runs out!
Playable with up to 4 players, locally or online, Mechanic Heroes will make you love mechanics or simply hate your friends.
items.description_ja: 「最大限の修理と配車を行うため、整備士チームを結成し、時間切れになる前にできるだけ多くの車を修理・配車しましょう！ 最大4人までのプレイヤーがローカルまたはオンラインでプレイ可能で、『メカニックヒーローズ』は、整備作業を楽しませるだけでなく、友達を憎むこともできるゲームです。」
items.title: Mechanic Heroes

items.description: One night, Lyu Xuan woke up soaked in blood, a mysterious black hole in the palm of her hand, and millions pouring out of that hole, like an unstoppable fountain of wealth. Still in shock, She has to evade the monsters that rushed to her and her new riches. A strange story begins in a gloomy city…
items.description_ja: 夜の中で目を覚ました主人公、呂璇は血の海に身を包まれていました。手には神秘的な黒い穴が広がり、同時に、1億もの驚くべき財産がその穴から這い出ました。恐怖に怯える中、その財宝に引き寄せられたさまざまな異形の怪物が呂璇に向かって押し寄せます。不思議な物語が始まります。
items.title: Raining City: Millions Recollections

items.description: No Strings Attached is a puzzle platform thriller where you play as Pavo, a newly-sentient puppet, in a struggling circus. Marionette Pavo’s arms to swing, climb, and more to escape your Master’s true intentions.
items.description_ja: No Strings Attached is a puzzle platform thriller where you play as Pavo, a newly-sentient puppet, in a struggling circus. Marionette Pavo’s arms to swing, climb, and more to escape your Master’s true intentions.
items.title: No Strings Attached

items.description:
Kona, an ice artist with a reputation for mischief, and Snowrabbit, a white-furred snow rabbit full of desire.
After hearing the story of Aquus, the mermaid goddess, the two down-on-their-luck artists break into the monastery of Aquus, nicknamed "the sea on land," to make a statue of a goddess.
items.description_ja:
Kona, an ice artist with a reputation for mischief, and Snowrabbit, a white-furred snow rabbit full of desire.
After hearing the story of Aquus, the mermaid goddess, the two down-on-their-luck artists break into the monastery of Aquus, nicknamed "the sea on land," to make a statue of a goddess.
items.title: Kona & SnowRabbit: Pilot

items.description:
「発見」に満ちた、マップ探索メインの長編RPG。無数の隠し通路、隠し扉が存在する荒廃した王国。
死者の残留思念を覗いて手掛かりを掴み、隠された宝箱のアイテムで探索範囲を広げよう。
各地で得た断片的な情報はいずれ繋がり合い、自らの記憶のみならず、隠された「真実」を暴くかもしれない。
items.description_ja:
「発見」に満ちた、マップ探索メインの長編RPG。無数の隠し通路、隠し扉が存在する荒廃した王国。
死者の残留思念を覗いて手掛かりを掴み、隠された宝箱のアイテムで探索範囲を広げよう。
各地で得た断片的な情報はいずれ繋がり合い、自らの記憶のみならず、隠された「真実」を暴くかもしれない。
items.title: [DE:]Fanastasis

items.description: Tukoni: Forest Keepers is a cute & cozy puzzle adventure. Play as Traveller, a forest spirit on a special journey, as you explore magical hand-drawn locations, meet charming characters, solve handcrafted puzzles, collect herbs and tea recipes, and help the forest prepare for the coming winter.
items.description_ja: ヒューッ——落ち葉を舞い散らせる秋風がひと吹き！ ドングリリュックを背負い、カサカサと落ち葉を踏む音とともに森を探索しましょう。ひらめきいっぱいのミニゲームで、動物たちの冬支度をお手伝い。出会った友達に温かいお茶をいれ、現実の疲れをそっと吹き消してみませんか？
items.title: Tukoni: Forest Keepers

items.description: Dread whispers echo across the Information Superhighway. Y2K is coming, heralding the rise of the Old Ones. With your meatspace mind unraveling, time is running out -- barter with gods, embrace the deathless aeons, or go offline permanently in this modempunk horror story.
items.description_ja: Dread whispers echo across the Information Superhighway. Y2K is coming, heralding the rise of the Old Ones. With your meatspace mind unraveling, time is running out -- barter with gods, embrace the deathless aeons, or go offline permanently in this modempunk horror story.
items.title: The Shadow Over Cyberspace

items.description: A cute and cozy Visual Novel experience with plenty of choices to make! Come find the Familiar truly meant for you by feeding The Conjuring Cauldron with a multitude of choices, all to a relaxing Original Soundtrack!
items.description_ja: A cute and cozy Visual Novel experience with plenty of choices to make! Come find the Familiar truly meant for you by feeding The Conjuring Cauldron with a multitude of choices, all to a relaxing Original Soundtrack!
items.title: Familiar Friends: What's Your Familiar?

items.description: Your friends decided to play a prank on you for your birthday by giving you a whole box of dildos. Should you just throw this "gift" in the trash or seek revenge on those annoying pigeons? The decision is all yours!
items.description_ja: あなたの誕生日に友達がいたずらをして、のディルド。の箱を贈りました。この「贈り物」をゴミ箱に捨てるべきか、迷惑な鳩に復讐するべきか、決定はあなた次第です！
items.title: Pigeon Hater

items.description: You woke up in some basement and don't remember who you are or how you ended up here... But what you do know is that you need to get out of here...
items.description_ja: You woke up in some basement and don't remember who you are or how you ended up here... But what you do know is that you need to get out of here...
items.title: Reflection

items.description: Vacuum your way through a massive junk pit in search of a lost hard drive worth millions. Suck, sell, upgrade, and uncover absurd items, pop culture relics, and unsettling secrets in this dangerously addictive, satirical dig-'em-up.
items.description_ja:
数百万ドルの価値がある 失われたハードドライブ を求めて、巨大なゴミの穴 を掃除機で進め。
吸って、売って、強化して、この 危険なほど中毒性がある 風刺的ディグゲームで、奇妙なアイテム、ポップカルチャーの遺物、不穏な秘密を発見しよう。
items.title: One Man´s Trash

items.description: Spend your time with profit and pleasure! Play the puzzle game with the cutest and friendliest animal in the entire world! Find difference on pictures with capybaras!
items.description_ja: 有用性と喜びであなたの時間を過ごす！地球上で最もキュートでフレンドリーな生き物とパズルゲームをプレイ！カラフルなカピバラの絵の違いを見つけよう！
items.title: Cute Capybaras

items.description: Clash claws and flip opponents belly-up in physics-based crab battles! Combine dual-wielded weaponry with multiple fighting stances to create a custom fighting style. Bash, blast, scoop and pummel enemies onto their backs to achieve victory!
items.description_ja: 『カニノケンカ・ニ』は、相手のカニをいかにひっくり返すかを競うシンプルで奥深い格闘ゲームです。カニを育成し、武器、スペル、そしてスキルを組み合わせ、自分だけの最強のカニを育て上げましょう。
items.title: Fight Crab 2

items.description: Lycans is a multiplayer game. It can accommodate up to 12 players. Investigate to find the werewolves hiding among the villagers during the day and hide at night to survive their attacks !
items.description_ja: Lycans is a multiplayer game. It can accommodate up to 12 players. Investigate to find the werewolves hiding among the villagers during the day and hide at night to survive their attacks !
items.title: Lycans

items.description: If you're nervous about job searching and interviews, face your fears head-on in "Welcome to the Karoshi Club" a Japanese horror business punk visual novel.
items.description_ja: 就職活動や面接に不安を感じているなら、ジャパニーズホラー・ビジネスパンクのビジュアルノベル「Welcome to the Karoshi Club」で、恐怖に正面から立ち向かってみてください。
items.title: Welcome to the Karoshi Club

items.description: Explore '"Kittenbay Cats - A Hidden Object Game', where elusive felines await discovery in a day-and-night adventure. Find hidden cats, interact with locals, and unveil the charming secrets of Kittenbay!
items.description_ja: Explore '"Kittenbay Cats - A Hidden Object Game', where elusive felines await discovery in a day-and-night adventure. Find hidden cats, interact with locals, and unveil the charming secrets of Kittenbay!
items.title: Kittenbay Cats - A Hidden Object Game

items.description: A retro first-person shooter inspired by Blood, Duke Nukem 3D, and Rise of the Triad. REVEREND is a dark, twisted tale with religious undertones, terrifying creature designs and one hell of a personality.
items.description_ja: A retro first-person shooter inspired by Blood, Duke Nukem 3D, and Rise of the Triad. REVEREND is a dark, twisted tale with religious undertones, terrifying creature designs and one hell of a personality.
items.title: REVEREND

items.description: Escape from Horn head is 3D horror game. You need to find the keys and potions before he catches up with you. Explore the rooms, look for objects and avoid the pursuer. Try to find the best way, remember the movement of the Horned-headed demon chasing its victim, that is, you.
items.description_ja: Escape from Horn head is 3D horror game. You need to find the keys and potions before he catches up with you. Explore the rooms, look for objects and avoid the pursuer. Try to find the best way, remember the movement of the Horned-headed demon chasing its victim, that is, you.
items.title: Escape from Hornhead

items.description: Huanu Poems is a multi-ending love adventure game. As a photographer, carrying the secret of being a bloodline inheritor of HuaNu Town, you will take lovely Peach to run a B&B, encounter gentle Cloudia. Your choices will affect the direction of the story.
items.description_ja: Huanu Poems is a multi-ending love adventure game. As a photographer, carrying the secret of being a bloodline inheritor of HuaNu Town, you will take lovely Peach to run a B&B, encounter gentle Cloudia. Your choices will affect the direction of the story.
items.title: 花奴令 Huanu Poems

items.description: Oliver’s future at Reeve's Capital depends on winning over three strange colleagues while working as a secretary. Nothing ominous is happening if he doesn't think too hard about it.
items.description_ja: Oliver’s future at Reeve's Capital depends on winning over three strange colleagues while working as a secretary. Nothing ominous is happening if he doesn't think too hard about it.
items.title: Corporate Suck Up

items.description: Riichi mahjong with a twist! Play mahjong with party game elements, for both beginners and experienced players.
items.description_ja: Riichi mahjong with a twist! Play mahjong with party game elements, for both beginners and experienced players.
items.title: dirtbag MAHJONG

items.description: After a long time in isolation, something appears inside your fridge. Satisfy the meat, or resist it.
items.description_ja: After a long time in isolation, something appears inside your fridge. Satisfy the meat, or resist it.
items.title: Mr. Meat

items.description: The game that simply confuses your fingers.
items.description_ja: ただ指をもつれさせるだけのゲーム。
items.title: Fingerdance

items.description: Collect units and build powerful synergies on a restricted grid in Hell Deck, a dark roguelike deckbuilder defense game. Construct your own bizarre, twisted ecosystem through a brutal cycle of predation and sacrifice, and defend hell from the holy swarm
items.description_ja: Collect units and build powerful synergies on a restricted grid in Hell Deck, a dark roguelike deckbuilder defense game. Construct your own bizarre, twisted ecosystem through a brutal cycle of predation and sacrifice, and defend hell from the holy swarm
items.title: Hell Deck

items.description:
A tiny dog lives on your desktop.

Take care of your loyal companion, play with it, decorate its little corner, and watch it grow through everyday moments.

A relaxing pixel desktop pet game about companionship, warmth, and the simple joy of having a dog by your side.
items.description_ja:
A tiny dog lives on your desktop.

Take care of your loyal companion, play with it, decorate its little corner, and watch it grow through everyday moments.

A relaxing pixel desktop pet game about companionship, warmth, and the simple joy of having a dog by your side.
items.title: Dog

items.description: Get ready to see life through the eyes of a young man trying to escape Xipe Totec an ancient deity venerated across Mesoamerican civilizations and later embraced by the Aztecs. A chaotic experience full of horror and survival mechanics awaits.
items.description_ja: アステカの神 Xipe Totec から逃れようとする 10 代の若者の目を通して人生を見る準備をしてください。 ホラーとサバイバルのメカニクスで混沌とした体験があなたを待っています。
items.title: Death Relives

items.description: Knock down your opponents and smash their hoops! Hoop Fighters is an online, no-rules party basketball game for up to 6 players multiplayer or up to 4 player local coop. Slide into opponents, throw punches or objects at them. Do your best to get the ball. Remember, there are no rules!
items.description_ja: 相手をノックアウトして、リングをぶっ壊せ！ Hoop Fightersは最大6人のマルチプレイヤーまたは最大4人のローカルコープに対応したオンライン無ルールパーティーバスケットボールゲームです。スライディングやパンチ、さらにはアイテムを投げつけて相手からボールを奪え！ルールなんて一切ナシ、やりたい放題のバスケバトルを楽しもう！
items.title: Hoop Fighters: Party Basketball

items.description: Hunt down a beheaded ghost to save your college club from losing funding! It'll be a piece of cake— wait, what do you mean he wants to marry you!? The Groom of Gallagher Mansion is spooky comedic romantic visual novel full of laughs and scares all around!
items.description_ja: Hunt down a beheaded ghost to save your college club from losing funding! It'll be a piece of cake— wait, what do you mean he wants to marry you!? The Groom of Gallagher Mansion is spooky comedic romantic visual novel full of laughs and scares all around!
items.title: The Groom of Gallagher Mansion

items.description: CRYO is a multiplayer co-op survival horror for 1-4 players. You have been deployed by your company to various locations around the Antarctic due to communication issues. What awaits you in these dark, remote regions is far more sinister than a technical fault...
items.description_ja: CRYOは1～4人で遊べるマルチプレイ協力型サバイバルホラーゲームです。通信障害の調査のため、あなたは会社から南極各地のさまざまな施設へ派遣されます。しかし、その暗く人里離れた場所で待ち受けているものは、単なる技術的な故障などではありません……
items.title: CRYO

items.description: Seybul Tech is a walking simulator. Navigate as an office employee, confronting peculiar encounters while in search of an exit from this enigmatic abyss.
items.description_ja: Seybul Tech is a walking simulator. Navigate as an office employee, confronting peculiar encounters while in search of an exit from this enigmatic abyss.
items.title: Seybul Tech

items.description: Play through a common childhood fear about turning the lights off and going to bed. This time extended, remastered, and re-imagined.
items.description_ja: Play through a common childhood fear about turning the lights off and going to bed. This time extended, remastered, and re-imagined.
items.title: Lights Off: Director's Cut

items.description: Backrooms - 2005 is a chapter-based Backrooms exploration game.
items.description_ja: Backrooms - 2005 is a chapter-based Backrooms exploration game.
items.title: Backrooms - 2005

items.description: A 1-8 player co-op sci-fi looter horror game that takes place on a mysterious asteroid belt where players must complete contracts by traveling to exotic planets to kill creatures, find loot, and/or farm planetary materials that they must return to an ominous figure named Sketchy.
items.description_ja: A 1-8 player co-op sci-fi looter horror game that takes place on a mysterious asteroid belt where players must complete contracts by traveling to exotic planets to kill creatures, find loot, and/or farm planetary materials that they must return to an ominous figure named Sketchy.
items.title: Sketchy's Contract

items.description:
Lost in a series of endless train station hallways, find your way to the exit Platform in this First-Person Anomaly Spotting game set in the Midnight Monitor universe.

Watch out for anomalies - If you see any, turn back immediately! Can you find your way out of Aldercourt Station?
items.description_ja:
Lost in a series of endless train station hallways, find your way to the exit Platform in this First-Person Anomaly Spotting game set in the Midnight Monitor universe.

Watch out for anomalies - If you see any, turn back immediately! Can you find your way out of Aldercourt Station?
items.title: Midnight Monitor: Aldercourt

items.description: Grab your weapons and delve into this action side-scroller intense adventure. Jump around and explore the insane levels. Shoot and dodge your way through enemies. Fight to find your friend and solve the disappearance!
items.description_ja: 武器を持って、このアクション横スクロールの激しい冒険に飛び込もう。飛び跳ねて非常識なレベルを探検しよう。敵を撃ってかわしながら進んでいこう。友人を見つけ、失踪事件を解決するために戦おう！
items.title: Missing Banban

items.description: The ghosts are you. Trapped in a haunted arcade machine with up to 3 friends, you scavenge pellets to keep the safe room alive - while the thing that eats hunts you through the maze. Survive the night, uncover the machine's secrets, and escape.
items.description_ja: ペレットを集めてセーフルームにエネルギーを供給し、生き延びよう。呪われたアーケードマシンに吸い込まれた謎を解き、脱出を目指せ。
items.title: Terrorbytes

items.description: A short, interactive visual novel set in the mid-19th Century, in which a poet fights against time as she's writing the most important work of her life. Poetry is the answer, but what is the question?
items.description_ja: A short, interactive visual novel set in the mid-19th Century, in which a poet fights against time as she's writing the most important work of her life. Poetry is the answer, but what is the question?
items.title: Inversed

items.description: Meet Mina! She's a landmine girl! That means she's cute on the outside, but dangerous on the inside! But maybe she's the kind of danger you've always been looking for. This is a rogue fast-love dating sim. And the only sim that teaches you to be nice to girls. Or else.
items.description_ja: 地雷系少女MINAに会いましょう！可愛らしい見た目とは裏腹に、その内側はとっても危険。もしかしたら彼女は君が探し続けている理想の女の子かも？Landmine Princessは一風変わった恋愛シミュレーションゲーム。そして、女の子にやさしくすることを教えてくれる唯一のゲーム。さもないと
items.title: Landmine Princess

items.description: Sheriff James Cooper is slowly bleeding to death in an unfamiliar hospital. But the moment his life ends, everything starts over. He has fifteen minutes to break this endless cycle, uncover the truth, and find a way out before it's too late.
items.description_ja: ジェームズ・クーパー警長は見知らぬ病院で出血しながらゆっくりと死んでいきます。しかし、彼の命が絶たれるたびにすべてが再び始まります。彼には15分の時間があり、この無限ループを断ち切り、真実を明らかにし、出口を見つけなければなりません。時間がなくなる前に。
items.title: Fear the Timeloop - Prologue

items.description: Explore a museum containing the word's greatest collection of toilet art.
items.description_ja: 世界最大のトイレアートコレクションを所蔵する美術館を探索しよう。
items.title: La Galerie des Toilettes

items.description: Gamble your life on a coin flip against a mysterious old man sent by the CORPORATE to decide whether you keep your job. Trapped in a claustrophobic collapsing metal coffin deep under the ocean, you'll slowly lose your sanity in this eldritch, Lovecraftian horror.
items.description_ja: Gamble your life on a coin flip against a mysterious old man sent by the CORPORATE to decide whether you keep your job. Trapped in a claustrophobic collapsing metal coffin deep under the ocean, you'll slowly lose your sanity in this eldritch, Lovecraftian horror.
items.title: O.B.O.L

items.description: The Empty Eyes is a first-person psychological horror experience that immerses you in an investigation steeped in mystery. Every step inside the house brings you closer to a hidden truth, while tension mounts and fear takes root in your mind.
items.description_ja: The Empty Eyes is a first-person psychological horror experience that immerses you in an investigation steeped in mystery. Every step inside the house brings you closer to a hidden truth, while tension mounts and fear takes root in your mind.
items.title: The Empty Eyes

items.description: LiDAR Exploration Program is a relaxing atmospheric game with light horror elements, where you explore in complete darkness using a scanner to reveal the world around you.
items.description_ja: LiDAR Exploration Program is a relaxing atmospheric game with light horror elements, where you explore in complete darkness using a scanner to reveal the world around you.
items.title: LiDAR Exploration Program

items.description: A paranoid cybercriminal tries to regain control over an underground marketplace stolen by his former coworkers. You must utilize your hacking and intelligence gathering skills to get rid of hitmen sent by your enemies in a race with worsening mental state and terrifying hallucinations.
items.description_ja: A paranoid cybercriminal tries to regain control over an underground marketplace stolen by his former coworkers. You must utilize your hacking and intelligence gathering skills to get rid of hitmen sent by your enemies in a race with worsening mental state and terrifying hallucinations.
items.title: XXX_CYBERRAT_XXX

items.description: An enthralling RPG Maker horror game that explores a dark and twisted rendition of the classic fairy tale, Red Riding Hood.
items.description_ja: 古典童話『赤ずきん』をダークに、そしてひねりを加えた、魅惑的なホラー。
items.title: Mucorales

items.description: Welcome to my first game! Where you'll Immerse yourself in a unbelievable, story-rich mystery, packed with jaw-dropping plot twist, horror, and multiple endings.
items.description_ja: Welcome to my first game! Where you'll Immerse yourself in a unbelievable, story-rich mystery, packed with jaw-dropping plot twist, horror, and multiple endings.
items.title: Ethel

items.description: "You Are Grounded" is a short psychological horror-slasher game from a first-person perspective. A terrifying killer clown terrorizes a teenager and his family on Halloween Eve.
items.description_ja: "You Are Grounded" is a short psychological horror-slasher game from a first-person perspective. A terrifying killer clown terrorizes a teenager and his family on Halloween Eve.
items.title: You Are Grounded

items.description: Trapped in a cursed office overnight, you must uncover a hidden password before morning... while reality distorts, blood seeps through the walls, and something watches you. Explore branching paths, face strange encounters, and survive this psychological horror visual novel.
items.description_ja: Trapped in a cursed office overnight, you must uncover a hidden password before morning... while reality distorts, blood seeps through the walls, and something watches you. Explore branching paths, face strange encounters, and survive this psychological horror visual novel.
items.title: NO MORE WORK FOR ITO

items.description: Get ready to have your intellect enriched, your emotions manipulated and your mayonnaise expanded; as you unveil the stories and learn from mistakes. Our lives are too short not to be enhanced with meaningful stories like this one!
items.description_ja: Get ready to have your intellect enriched, your emotions manipulated and your mayonnaise expanded; as you unveil the stories and learn from mistakes. Our lives are too short not to be enhanced with meaningful stories like this one!
items.title: My Name is Mayo 3

items.description: You are the liquidator survived the samosbor in block G-326 of the endless Gigakhrushchyovka. You have to find out what happened in this block, evacuate the residents and find a way out for yourself. But is everything as simple as it seems at first glance?
items.description_ja: You are the liquidator survived the samosbor in block G-326 of the endless Gigakhrushchyovka. You have to find out what happened in this block, evacuate the residents and find a way out for yourself. But is everything as simple as it seems at first glance?
items.title: Living Cell

items.description: Find a way out of an old mansion as a priest, you have been tasked to exorcise a woman who has been possessed. Solve puzzles and complete objectives to cure her demonic possession in this SURVIVAL HORROR experience.
items.description_ja: あなたは悪魔に取り憑かれた女性を祓うために任命された司祭として、古い屋敷からの脱出方法を見つけてください。この恐ろしい体験でパズルを解き、目標を達成し、彼女の悪魔の取り憑きを治療してください。
items.title: KAMLA

items.description: The Maze Survivor is a limited space survival game that uniquely combines the characteristics of survival, horror, puzzle solving and maze adventure games. Players will wake up in the center of a complex maze without any clues. Let's try to see if they can survive and escape from this strange maze.
items.description_ja: The Maze Survivor is a limited space survival game that uniquely combines the characteristics of survival, horror, puzzle solving and maze adventure games. Players will wake up in the center of a complex maze without any clues. Let's try to see if they can survive and escape from this strange maze.
items.title: The Maze Survivor: The 9th Entrants

items.description: Skeleton Hell is a cooperative horror game where you and your friends must work together to find your missing organs and reclaim your humanity. Using your skeletal form, you can solve puzzles and collaborate with each other to escape, while avoiding the dangers that lurk within!
items.description_ja: Skeleton Hell is a cooperative horror game where you and your friends must work together to find your missing organs and reclaim your humanity. Using your skeletal form, you can solve puzzles and collaborate with each other to escape, while avoiding the dangers that lurk within!
items.title: Skeleton Hell

items.description: A yandere psychological horror visual novel. Choose a sweetheart to romance, but beware the petals of obsession.
items.description_ja: A yandere psychological horror visual novel. Choose a sweetheart to romance, but beware the petals of obsession.
items.title: Hydrangea

items.description: You and your crew are tasked with cleaning up after the last exploration team's ill-fated journey into the Backrooms. Dodge deadly incursions, scrub every surface, and leave no trace.
items.description_ja: あなたと清掃隊は、悲運に終わった前回の探検チームのBackrooms遠征の後始末を任されました。致命的なインカージョンを避けながら、すべての表面を磨き、痕跡を残さないようにしましょう。
items.title: Backrooms Cleanup Crew

items.description: Enter a corrupt and hostile library with the task of extracting forbidden knowledge from its tomes. Triumph over the entities that linger within, in this short Action-Adventure FPS made by a team of third-year university students.
items.description_ja: Enter a corrupt and hostile library with the task of extracting forbidden knowledge from its tomes. Triumph over the entities that linger within, in this short Action-Adventure FPS made by a team of third-year university students.
items.title: DREADTOME

items.description: Pirate's Gambit takes you on an unpredictable voyage, blending deck-building with Yacht Dice mechanics. Roll the dice in the dimly lit cabin, where fate shifts with every turn. Are you closing in on treasure or something far more sinister?
items.description_ja: 『海賊の賭け』は、デッキ構築とヨットダイスの要素を融合させた予測不能な航海へとあなたを誘います。薄暗い船室でサイコロを振るたびに、運命が変わる。あなたは宝を手に入れようとしているのか、それとももっと恐ろしいものが待ち受けているのか？
items.title: Pirate's Gambit

items.description: Hear that thunder? Neither do I 'cause it's THE SUNNIEST DAY OF THEM ALL! Romania's most chaotic and unpredictable hip-hop duo has FINALLY released their passion project. Master the rhythm, unlock medals, and crush the leaderboards across 29+ (and more incoming) tracks. GET IN THERE ALREADY!
items.description_ja: Hear that thunder? Neither do I 'cause it's THE SUNNIEST DAY OF THEM ALL! Romania's most chaotic and unpredictable hip-hop duo has FINALLY released their passion project. Master the rhythm, unlock medals, and crush the leaderboards across 29+ (and more incoming) tracks. GET IN THERE ALREADY!
items.title: BAZOOKA: Rhythm Game

items.description: Classic DS horror reborn. Awaken in an abandoned hospital with no memory, no escape and unspeakable horrors lurking in the dark. The horror classic Dementium: The Ward returns, enhanced for 4K display and Steam Deck Verified, where every shadow hides a new threat, and every corridor a new nightmare.
items.description_ja: Classic DS horror reborn. Awaken in an abandoned hospital with no memory, no escape and unspeakable horrors lurking in the dark. The horror classic Dementium: The Ward returns, enhanced for 4K display and Steam Deck Verified, where every shadow hides a new threat, and every corridor a new nightmare.
items.title: Dementium: The Ward

items.description: Endless Isolation is a classic first-person Survival Horror in PSX style, where the line between office routine and nightmare is erased forever.
items.description_ja: 『Endless Isolation』は、PSXスタイルのクラシックな一人称視点サバイバルホラーであり、オフィスの日常と悪夢の境界が永遠に消え去る世界を描いています。
items.title: Endless Isolation

items.description: A private-eye must deceive a rich family into revealing their darkest secrets, before the killer amongst them silences everyone.
items.description_ja: A private-eye must deceive a rich family into revealing their darkest secrets, before the killer amongst them silences everyone.
items.title: Lockheart Indigo

items.description: An atmospheric retro inspired survival horror game. Enjoy the late shift at 'The Month' in an abstract and unsettling night of terror, spooks and convenience.
items.description_ja: An atmospheric retro inspired survival horror game. Enjoy the late shift at 'The Month' in an abstract and unsettling night of terror, spooks and convenience.
items.title: Employee of The Month

items.description: This is a Ghost is an FPS psychological horror and investigation game for 1 to 4 players. Track down supernatural activity, identify demonic entities using specialised equipment, and banish them with crafted ammunition in solo or online co-op!
items.description_ja: 『This is a Ghost』は、1〜4人向けのFPS心理的ホラー＆調査ゲームです。超常現象を追跡し、専門装備を使って悪魔的実体を特定し、クラフトした弾薬でソロまたはオンライン協力プレイで除霊しましょう！
items.title: This is a Ghost

items.description: The first of seven chapters, which will tell an amazing story about the adventures of a girl and her friends. Colorful landscapes and warm sunny atmosphere. Also, they will find the real door! And take part in the contest! Can you imagine?
items.description_ja: The first of seven chapters, which will tell an amazing story about the adventures of a girl and her friends. Colorful landscapes and warm sunny atmosphere. Also, they will find the real door! And take part in the contest! Can you imagine?
items.title: Molytropia: Cloud in Shape of Hurt

items.description: Save humanity in a mutant-ridden apocalypse! Dive headfirst into Earl vs. the Mutants, a high-octane top-down survival action-roguelite set in the aftermath of a nuclear apocalypse.
items.description_ja: 「Earl vs. the Mutants」は文明滅亡後の世界をトップダウン視点で生き抜くサバイバル・ローグライトゲームです。プレイヤーはエクスターミネーターとして、絶えず襲いかかるミュータントから人類を守るミッションに繰り出します！
items.title: Earl vs. the Mutants

items.description: Jamboy and Billy are devoured by a giant and now they have to escape from its guts! Explore the giant's intestines as you defeat food monsters in this frantic, multi-genre game and go on a stomach-churning adventure!
items.description_ja: JamboyとBillyは巨大な男に丸呑みにされてしまった！今や彼らは、その体内から脱出しなければならない。消化器官の迷路を探索しながら、食べ物でできたモンスターたちを撃退せよ！ジャンルを超えたフレンジーなゲームプレイと、胃がムカムカするような奇妙な冒険があなたを待っています！
items.title: Jamboy, a Jelly-cious Hero

items.description: Find yourself on a mission exploring the depth of an ominous forgotten mine. You arrive barehanded but quickly find the tools needed to go deeper. Destroy the infected living parts of the mine and face the final threat and complete your mission.
items.description_ja: Find yourself on a mission exploring the depth of an ominous forgotten mine. You arrive barehanded but quickly find the tools needed to go deeper. Destroy the infected living parts of the mine and face the final threat and complete your mission.
items.title: The Pulse of Evil

items.description: Light Bearers 2 is a fast paced hide and seek, asymmetrical multiplayer horror game. A Shadow is trying to corrupt all Light Bears. The Light Bears must use their movement and cunning. To keep each other from becoming corrupted by darkness.
items.description_ja: Light Bearers 2 is a fast paced hide and seek, asymmetrical multiplayer horror game. A Shadow is trying to corrupt all Light Bears. The Light Bears must use their movement and cunning. To keep each other from becoming corrupted by darkness.
items.title: Light Bearers 2

items.description: 1930s. A remote mining town in the mountains of French Vietnam. As Lieutenant Chen, an ambitious Asian officer, investigate the mine's collapsing output amid warlords, locals, and eerie events. Every choice leads to one of 8 endings—or one of 11 ways to die.
items.description_ja: 1930年代、仏領ベトナムの山あいにある鉱山町ビヨドン。手柄を狙うアジア系将校チェン中尉として、鉱石の産出量が激減した謎を追え。軍閥の娘、謎めいた助手、地元の勢力、そして説明のつかない怪異が絡み合う——あなたの選択が、8つのエンディング、あるいは11通りの死へと導く。
items.title: Miss Peacock

items.description: Explore a haunted apartment building as a tiny mouse exorcist in this pint-sized pixel adventure! Save its cute and quirky residents from their inner demons in Mousebusters, also searched as “Mouse Busters.”
items.description_ja: ねずみのおばけ退治！？ゆるふわホラードット絵アドベンチャー！
items.title: Mousebusters

items.description: A short first-person horror game where you wander through an eerie forest using the dials of a microwave.
items.description_ja: A short first-person horror game where you wander through an eerie forest using the dials of a microwave.
items.title: Midnight Snack

items.description:
The Sixth Sorrow is a short, narrative-driven horror game where your choices impact the story. 
To what lengths can a mother's love drive her?
items.description_ja:
The Sixth Sorrow is a short, narrative-driven horror game where your choices impact the story. 
To what lengths can a mother's love drive her?
items.title: The Sixth Sorrow

items.description: Autumn, 1992. Anton, a 14-year-old boy, moves with his parents to a small town and is left alone in his grandmother's apartment. Meanwhile, children are disappearing across the town — the police are powerless, and no one knows who's behind it…
items.description_ja: 1992年の秋。14歳の少年アントンは両親とともに小さな町へ引っ越し、祖母のアパートに一人残される。そんな中、町では子どもたちの失踪事件が相次いでいた——警察は無力で、誰が黒幕なのか誰にもわからない……
items.title: Uncanny Tales: 1992

items.description: In a final bid to cheat death, you challenge The Alleyman to a high-stakes dice game where every roll could be your last.
items.description_ja: In a final bid to cheat death, you challenge The Alleyman to a high-stakes dice game where every roll could be your last.
items.title: PIG

items.description:
Left alone as your little village’s last hope, you: Domingo, know what you must do to save your people and also pull a hot date, and that is to do what you know best: Romance the dragon attacking your home! 
	Put your charisma to the test in this cheeky third-person soulslike boss battle!
items.description_ja:
Left alone as your little village’s last hope, you: Domingo, know what you must do to save your people and also pull a hot date, and that is to do what you know best: Romance the dragon attacking your home! 
	Put your charisma to the test in this cheeky third-person soulslike boss battle!
items.title: Dragon Kisser

items.description: Ninjin: Clash of Carrots is an anime-inspired beat-em-up with varied enemies and deep customization. Play as the rabbit Ninjin, or Akai, the ninja fox, and fight to retrieve the carrots stolen by Shogun Moe! Redeem carrots for weapons, upgrades and more! Supports 2-player online or local co-op.
items.description_ja: Ninjin: Clash of Carrotsは、アニメにアイデアを得た作品で、さまざまな敵や幅広いカスタマイズを備えた戦闘アクションです。ウサギのNinjinまたは忍者狐のAkaiとしてプレイし戦って、Shogun Moeに盗まれたニンジンを奪い返しましょう！ニンジンは武器、アップグレードなどと換金できます！2プレイヤーのオンラインゲームまたはローカルな協力プレイに対応しています。
items.title: Ninjin: Clash of Carrots

items.description: No Fair Play is a physics-based multiplayer game that combines parkour, combat, and football mechanics to offer great freedom to players.
items.description_ja: "No Fair Play"は、物理をベースにしたマルチプレイヤーゲームで、パルクール、戦闘、サッカーのメカニックを組み合わせ、プレイヤーに大きな自由度を提供します。
items.title: No Fair Play

items.description: A short point & click narrative adventure inspired by the real life experience of a struggling solo indie game developer. A story about everything and hence nothing at all. Discover what truly matters to you.
items.description_ja: A short point & click narrative adventure inspired by the real life experience of a struggling solo indie game developer. A story about everything and hence nothing at all. Discover what truly matters to you.
items.title: nothing_matters

items.description: Your choices matter in Froguelike where you play as a frog on a mission to eat all the bugs. Level up, choose new tongues and upgrades, become unstoppable and run straight into the swarm! Unlock all frogs, tongues, items and chapters to become the most powerful frog in the pond.
items.description_ja: Froguelike では、あなたはカエルとしてプレイし、すべての虫を食べるというミッションに乗り出します。 レベルアップし、新しい舌とアップグレードを選択し、止められなくなって群れに直接突入しましょう! すべてのカエル、舌、アイテム、章のロックを解除して、池で最も強力なカエルになろう。
items.title: Froguelike

items.description: Urayama | ウラヤマ is a psychological J-horror game featuring students on summer vacation.
items.description_ja: Urayama | ウラヤマ は夏休み中の学生が主人公の心理的Jホラーゲームです。
items.title: Urayama

items.description: The night watchman in the late Qing Dynasty patrolled various realms between yin and yang to expel evil spirits.
items.description_ja: The night watchman in the late Qing Dynasty patrolled various realms between yin and yang to expel evil spirits.
items.title: San Geng

items.description: Water Delivery is a first person, horror experience where you play as a water delivery boy. Ride along in the delivery truck from house to house. Deliver filled water jugs, find and return empty jugs, and collect all the payments. Will you be able to finish your final route of the evening?
items.description_ja: 「Water Delivery」は、水の配達員としてプレイする一人称視点のホラーゲームです。配達トラックに乗って家から家へと移動します。水が詰まったジャグを配達し、空のジャグを見つけて返し、すべての支払いを集めます。あなたは夜の最後のルートを終えることができるでしょうか？
items.title: Water Delivery

items.description:
A retro point-and-click horror adventure game that tests the boundries of the genre!
In this "found-footage" horror game you have to navigate the rooms and hallways of the mysterious Narrow Woods Hotel.
Collect keys and items and use them to find your way out.
items.description_ja:
A retro point-and-click horror adventure game that tests the boundries of the genre!
In this "found-footage" horror game you have to navigate the rooms and hallways of the mysterious Narrow Woods Hotel.
Collect keys and items and use them to find your way out.
items.title: Narrow Woods Hotel

items.description: Ready, set, bath! Run your bathhouse for animals in this cozy and wholesome management game. Keep your bathtubs clean and filled, serve a cast of whimsical creatures, decorate your bathhouse with your hard earned cash, and be the best bathhouse there can be!
items.description_ja: Ready, set, bath! Run your bathhouse for animals in this cozy and wholesome management game. Keep your bathtubs clean and filled, serve a cast of whimsical creatures, decorate your bathhouse with your hard earned cash, and be the best bathhouse there can be!
items.title: Bathhouse Creatures

items.description: Horror game series about the investigation of missing hikers in the U.S. National Parks. Follow the story of a wannabe reporter who got a job as a ranger to investigate the disappearances - several episodes that tell one story! Based on true events.
items.description_ja: Horror game series about the investigation of missing hikers in the U.S. National Parks. Follow the story of a wannabe reporter who got a job as a ranger to investigate the disappearances - several episodes that tell one story! Based on true events.
items.title: Forest Ranger Services: Episode 1

items.description: This is an exhilarating action and shooting game where you fight using weapons with different abilities.
items.description_ja: 異なる性能の武器を駆使して戦う爽快アクション＆シューティングゲームです。
items.title: MYRIAD DEATH

items.description: Gift Collector [ギフトコレクター] - this is a New Year's horror game from the first person, in the Japanese style and genre of walking simulator. Collect gifts and make the kids happy on New Year's Eve. But don't forget that Midnight is a time of miracles!
items.description_ja: Gift Collector [ギフトコレクター] - これは、ウォーキングシミュレータの日本スタイルとジャンルで、一人称視点からのお正月ホラーゲームです。プレゼントを集めて、大晦日に子供たちを喜ばせよう。しかし、真夜中は奇跡の時であることを忘れないでください！
items.title: Gift Collector [ギフトコレクター]

items.description: A grim RPG with card-based combat where nothing stays dead. Lead a party of survivors through a world undone by shattered Laws. Restore them and reshape the rules of the game, but be ready to face the consequences.
items.description_ja: カードベースの戦闘を採用したダークRPG。そこでは、死したものが永遠に死んだままでいることはない。砕かれた「法則」によって崩壊した世界で、生存者たちの一団を率いよ。それらを取り戻し、ゲームのルールそのものを作り変えよ――ただし、その代償を受け入れる覚悟を持て。
items.title: Shards of Order

items.description: Stack & Brew is a management simulation game where you brew potions and run your own shop. Craft the potions and magical items your customers request, deliver them on time, collect your earnings, level up, expand your business, and take on bosses!
items.description_ja: 『錬金帝国』は、ポーション調合と店舗経営をテーマにしたカード式経営シミュレーションゲームです。魔法の原料を育て、不思議なポーションを醸造し、領主たちから舞い込む特大注文をさばきながら、事業をアップグレード＆拡大していきましょう！ さあ、腕まくりをして仕事に取り掛かる時間です。新任の工房長、国王のために偉大なるポーション帝国を築き上げましょう！
items.title: Stack & Brew

items.description: An old tape replays your worst memory. Tonight, you take control as it plays out. A camping trip. A storm. Your girlfriend, gone near an abandoned mine. Scour the forest for tools to breach the entrance, but something awaits you below.  Can you survive and find her in the depths?
items.description_ja: An old tape replays your worst memory. Tonight, you take control as it plays out. A camping trip. A storm. Your girlfriend, gone near an abandoned mine. Scour the forest for tools to breach the entrance, but something awaits you below.  Can you survive and find her in the depths?
items.title: BURIED BELOW

items.description: You knew in advance before the zombie crisis breake out, go to the supermarket to buy everything you need! Then stay at home and play your mobile phone in order to survive in this madness!
items.description_ja: You knew in advance before the zombie crisis breake out, go to the supermarket to buy everything you need! Then stay at home and play your mobile phone in order to survive in this madness!
items.title: 尸来运转-Lucky Zombie Survival

items.description: Challenge the physics of Fate in this immersive Coin Pusher RPG! Topple towering "Coin Pagodas" and trigger the massive "Dragon Trial" Jackpot. Collect over 100 historical artifacts, Appraise them for permanent buffs, and define your own playstyle. No microtransactions—just pure physics strategy!
items.description_ja: 阿修羅に挑み、東方の機関閣で「乾坤一擲」を！**【物理演算】と【宝物鑑定】**が融合した没入型コイン落とし。「金貨の塔」を推し倒し、「龍門の試練」でジャックポットを狙え！百点以上の奇珍を集め、独自の「鑑定等級」でプレイスタイルを確立。永続的な蓄積と爽快感を楽しもう！
items.title: Knock on Fate：The Guardian Pusher

items.description: A juicy first-person incremental game about turning cute creatures into cans. Kill them, collect their bodies, can them, and sell them. Make money, upgrade your weapons and machines, and produce more and more.
items.description_ja: かわいい生き物を缶詰にする、一人称視点のインクリメンタルゲーム。生産ラインが軌道に乗ると、これが気持ちいい。倒して、死体を集めて、缶詰にして売りさばこう。稼いだお金で武器や機械を強化して、どんどん生産量を増やそう。
items.title: Can 'Em All

items.description: Pine Hearts is a wholesome and tender adventure about nostalgic journeys, overcoming loss, and helping others. Embark on a cozy hiking expedition to the sprawling Pine Hearts nature reserve and scale the mountain your father never managed to climb.
items.description_ja: 『Pine Hearts』は、懐かしさあふれる旅、愛する人を失った悲しみを乗り越えること、そして他者を助けるというテーマを扱った、健やかで心温まる冒険物語です。広大なパインハーツ自然保護区への心休まるハイキングの旅に出かけ、父親が到達できなかった山の頂に挑みましょう。
items.title: Pine Hearts

items.description: Reunite with your best friends, unravel the secrets of a haunted house, and assist a cute little ghost in this heartwarming adventure where every puzzle brings you closer to the mysteries within.
items.description_ja: Reunite with your best friends, unravel the secrets of a haunted house, and assist a cute little ghost in this heartwarming adventure where every puzzle brings you closer to the mysteries within.
items.title: Long Time No See

items.description: Use the specialized equipment at your disposal to locate & log as many paranormal events as possible. Decipher the ingredients needed for your ritual and try to exorcise any demons within. Any incorrect ingredients and you may never leave! 1-4 Players
items.description_ja: 超常現象をできるだけ多く発見し、記録するために、特殊な機器を自由に使ってください。儀式に必要な材料を解読し、中にいる悪魔を祓おう。材料に間違いがあると、その場を離れられなくなるかもしれません！1-4 プレイヤー
items.title: DeathWatchers

items.description: Simple, you're Fleximan and you have to remove all the speed cameras in the city.
items.description_ja: ルールは簡単。君はフレックスマンだ。街中のオービス（スピードカメラ）をすべて撤去しろ。
items.title: Fleximan

items.description: A story driven cryptid horror game featuring survival horror elements where you come face to face with a Midwest cryptid dubbed "the Wolfman". Play as Jane and fight to survive the full moon while uncovering dark secrets in the Wolfman's territory.
items.description_ja: A story driven cryptid horror game featuring survival horror elements where you come face to face with a Midwest cryptid dubbed "the Wolfman". Play as Jane and fight to survive the full moon while uncovering dark secrets in the Wolfman's territory.
items.title: Fear the Moon

items.description: Chaotic Conflicts is a casual and chaotic fast-paced Online FPS game. In this chaotic shooter you'll try to shoot your way to the top of the scoreboard while competing with other players and random events.
items.description_ja: Chaotic Conflicts is a casual and chaotic fast-paced Online FPS game. In this chaotic shooter you'll try to shoot your way to the top of the scoreboard while competing with other players and random events.
items.title: Chaotic Conflicts

items.description: A fast-paced Breakout-style arcade with a bold black-and-white aesthetic. Engage in space battles against stunning yet deadly alien foes who are determined to destroy you. Intense visuals, thrilling gameplay, and a challenge that will test your reflexes.
items.description_ja: A fast-paced Breakout-style arcade with a bold black-and-white aesthetic. Engage in space battles against stunning yet deadly alien foes who are determined to destroy you. Intense visuals, thrilling gameplay, and a challenge that will test your reflexes.
items.title: Breakout Epilepsia

items.description:
The Count of Monte Clicker is an incremental game about breaking out of prison and finding treasure. 

With the help of fellow prisoner Abbe Faria, you, Edmond Dantes must escape the notorious Chateau d'Idle and claim your destiny.
items.description_ja:
The Count of Monte Clicker is an incremental game about breaking out of prison and finding treasure. 

With the help of fellow prisoner Abbe Faria, you, Edmond Dantes must escape the notorious Chateau d'Idle and claim your destiny.
items.title: The Count of Monte Clicker

items.description: Zedfest is the goriest game show ever created! A hardcore 6 player co-op third-person shooter with the goal to complete objectives while neutralizing Zeds with lots and lots of visceral gore.
items.description_ja: Zedfest is the goriest game show ever created! A hardcore 6 player co-op third-person shooter with the goal to complete objectives while neutralizing Zeds with lots and lots of visceral gore.
items.title: Zedfest

items.description: A short exploration game about poking around a convenience store and finding a gift with the help of its owner. But sometimes the perfect gift finds you.
items.description_ja: A short exploration game about poking around a convenience store and finding a gift with the help of its owner. But sometimes the perfect gift finds you.
items.title: Depanneur Nocturne

items.description: In our festive Christmas micro-game we definitely didn't consider calling "Santa Game Solid", help Santa complete his Santa training ahead of the Christmas period by delivering presents without getting caught!
items.description_ja: In our festive Christmas micro-game we definitely didn't consider calling "Santa Game Solid", help Santa complete his Santa training ahead of the Christmas period by delivering presents without getting caught!
items.title: Ho-Ho-Home Invasion

items.description: Players will help a white-robed girl and her friends uncover the truth of the planet using unique dash gameplay. The storyline is fully voiced by renowned actors, with meticulously designed levels and energetic music for you to enjoy!
items.description_ja: 白いローブを着た少女を操作して、バラエティー豊かなステージをクリアしていこう！見事に危機を乗り越えられれば物語の意外な真実が次々と明らかに！ゲームのポイントは操作技術と反射神経！独自のダッシュシステムをマスターして様々なギミックの攻略法を見つけ出そう！
items.title: Star Leaping Story

items.description: This is a survival horror action game in which a young girl "Enri" tries to escape from a mysterious facility filled with blood and madness.
items.description_ja:
少女「エンリ」が血と狂気に満ちた謎の施設からの脱出を目指す、サバイバルホラーアクションゲームです。
物語は、多くの謎を抱えた状態から始まり、先に進むにつれて謎が少しずつ明らかになっていきます。怪物からの逃走、アイテム探し、謎解きなどの要素が含まれています。
items.title: Purgatory -NARAKU-

items.description: A survival exploration game where you navigate through a puzzly hand-crafted dungeon, with metroidvania and crafting elements. Unravel the enigmas of the dungeon’s depths solo or online co-op multiplayer.
items.description_ja: 開発が考えた謎解きダンジョンを冒険する、メトロイドヴァニアとクラフト要素を取り入れたサバイバル探索ゲーム。ソロかオンライン協力プレイで、ダンジョンの奥深くに眠る謎を解き明かそう。
items.title: Deep Dish Dungeon

items.description:
Players will use a unique dash system to navigate through various obstacles! The main challenges lie in maneuvering skills and reaction speed, utilizing it to complete different levels in the game, gradually piecing together the truth of the story.
This is a free-to-play prologue version.
items.description_ja: 白いローブを着た少女を操作して、バラエティー豊かなステージをクリアしていこう！見事に危機を乗り越えられれば物語の意外な真実が次々と明らかに！ゲームのポイントは操作技術と反射神経！独自のダッシュシステムをマスターして様々なギミックの攻略法を見つけ出そう！
items.title: Star Leaping Story:prologue

items.description: You're trapped in a small hotel where every room has it's own rules. The only way to escape is to find the anomalies and keep your family calm.
items.description_ja: 間違い探しをするが、各部屋には生き残りのルールがあります。
items.title: Trapped: Family Vacation

items.description: "Niconico-san" is a first-person, fast-paced horror game set in a Japanese residential area. Players must escape from the smiling man of urban legend, "Niconico-san," and find their way out of a terrifying otherworld.
items.description_ja:
『ニコニコさん』は日本の住宅街を舞台にした一人称視点のホラーゲームです。
都市伝説の笑顔の男「ニコニコさん」から逃げ、恐怖に満ちた裏世界からの脱出を目指すゲームです。
items.title: ニコニコさん | Niconico-san

items.description: A psychological horror game where a police officer investigates a cold case in a decaying house, uncovering a strange and haunting tape recorder that reveals a terrible secret.
items.description_ja: A psychological horror game where a police officer investigates a cold case in a decaying house, uncovering a strange and haunting tape recorder that reveals a terrible secret.
items.title: Vesnith Tapes

items.description: A deckbuilding roguelite RPG featuring hololive members.
items.description_ja: ホロライブメンバーのデッキ構築型ローグライトRPG
items.title: HoloSeeker

items.description: Dread Neighbor is a first-person, multi-perspective psychological horror game. Play as a young woman living alone in an unusually cheap apartment. As the days pass, combat the overwhelming sense of unease, malice, and the unshakable feeling that you’re being watched from every crack in the room.
items.description_ja: 『悪意（Dread Neighbor）』は、3D一人称・マルチ視点の心理ホラーゲーム。プレイヤーは一人暮らしの若い女性となり、節約のために新しくも異様に家賃の安いアパートへ引っ越し、かつてない「悪意」を感じ始める。クローゼットの隙間、ベッドの下、壁の奥、あらゆる隙間から、無数の視線が見つめてくる。

evidence.excerpt: * Feel free to stream or upload gameplay videos!

items.title: Dread Neighbor

items.description: Micro Mages is a platformer developed for the original 8-bit NES console. Now on Steam! ROM included. Play solo or with up to 4 players simultaneously. Compete over score or cooperate to overcome challenging levels.
items.description_ja: Micro Mages is a platformer developed for the original 8-bit NES console. Now on Steam! ROM included. Play solo or with up to 4 players simultaneously. Compete over score or cooperate to overcome challenging levels.
items.title: Micro Mages

items.description: Join KinnikuNeko, a cat with a bodybuilder's body, in this fun 2D platformer and fight against the mysterious alien invasion. A story full of goofy humor, friendship, drama and action. Its aesthetics are a love letter to 90s anime along with an unforgettable soundtrack.
items.description_ja: 「KinnikuNeko」はボディビルダーみたいにムキムキボディの猫が、怪しいエイリアンの侵略に立ち向かう2Dゲーム。おバカなユーモア、友情、ドラマ、そしてアクション満載のストーリーだ！ 映像のテイストや印象的なBGMは90年代アニメをリスペクトしたものとなっている。
items.title: KinnikuNeko: SUPER MUSCLE CAT

items.description: RiffTrax: The Game is a multiplayer party game where players compete to make bad movies funny. Do you have what it takes to be the next movie riffing genius? Grab your friends and make fun of some of the worst cinematic abominations ever created.
items.description_ja: RiffTrax: The Game is a multiplayer party game where players compete to make bad movies funny. Do you have what it takes to be the next movie riffing genius? Grab your friends and make fun of some of the worst cinematic abominations ever created.
items.title: RiffTrax: The Game

items.description: A treasure-hunting RPG with a lifelong friend! Escape the Crescent Moon Tower and return to the surface world... and grab lots of treasure on the way!
items.description_ja: A treasure-hunting RPG with a lifelong friend! Escape the Crescent Moon Tower and return to the surface world... and grab lots of treasure on the way!
items.title: Astra Hunter Zosma

items.description: Step into Kittenwood Cats, a charming adventure filled with elusive kitties, clever interactive surprises, and delightful mini-stories waiting to unfold. Explore richly detailed scenes, uncover hidden secrets, and experience the magic that makes Kittenwood truly special.
items.description_ja: Step into Kittenwood Cats, a charming adventure filled with elusive kitties, clever interactive surprises, and delightful mini-stories waiting to unfold. Explore richly detailed scenes, uncover hidden secrets, and experience the magic that makes Kittenwood truly special.
items.title: Kittenwood Cats - A Hidden Object Game

items.description: Want to decide where mortals go when they die? Welcome to hell! With one click, you can decide whether mortals should go to heaven or stay in hell.
items.description_ja: Want to decide where mortals go when they die? Welcome to hell! With one click, you can decide whether mortals should go to heaven or stay in hell.
items.title: Go To Hell Must

items.description: Bushside Rangers is a first-person survival horror game that forces you to use your wits as you navigate through the dark, dreary depths of an abandoned nature park.
items.description_ja: Bushside Rangers is a first-person survival horror game that forces you to use your wits as you navigate through the dark, dreary depths of an abandoned nature park.
items.title: Bushside Rangers

items.description: Blippo+ is a live-action, off-cable TV simulator. Channel-surf the stars and discover the staticky, radical world of Planet Blip through its soaps, sitcoms, news, weather, and talk shows. But don’t touch that remote—everything’s about to get bent.
items.description_ja: Blippo+ is a live-action, off-cable TV simulator. Channel-surf the stars and discover the staticky, radical world of Planet Blip through its soaps, sitcoms, news, weather, and talk shows. But don’t touch that remote—everything’s about to get bent.
items.title: Blippo+

items.description: Playing as Normis, you are a typical representative of the mainstream with a traditional stable life, ironically referring to youth subcultures, avoiding conflicts and extreme actions, preferring routine and social adaptation.
items.description_ja: Playing as Normis, you are a typical representative of the mainstream with a traditional stable life, ironically referring to youth subcultures, avoiding conflicts and extreme actions, preferring routine and social adaptation.
items.title: Normis Simulator

items.description: A first-person psychological horror game about a strict home, a child’s daily routines, and something beneath the surface that grows more disturbing the deeper you go.
items.description_ja: 厳格な家庭、子供の日々のルーティン、そして深く掘り下げるほどに恐ろしさを増していく表面下の何かを描いた一人称視点のサイコロジカルホラーゲーム。
items.title: Haze of Lucidity (Halu) - The Fish

items.description: Aurora Hills: Chapter 2 is the second part in series of point and click puzzle adventure games. Follow the journey of Ethan Hill, a park ranger tasked with investigating strange disappearances from a national park to uncover the mystery of Aurora Hills!
items.description_ja: 「オーロラヒルズ：チャプター2」は、ポイント＆クリックパズルアドベンチャーゲームシリーズの第2弾です。国立公園で発生した奇妙な失踪事件の調査を任されたパークレンジャー、イーサン・ヒルの旅を追いながら、オーロラヒルズの謎を解き明かしましょう！
items.title: Aurora Hills: Chapter 2

items.description: Grab your axe and save the environment by chopping and recycling every man-made thing in your path and solving puzzles with your charming animal friends!
items.description_ja: 斧を手に、行く先に立ちふさがるあらゆる人工物を切り刻んでリサイクルし、魅力的な動物の仲間たちとパズルを解いて自然を救いましょう！
items.title: LumbearJack

items.description: CLeM is a narrative-driven puzzle adventure game with a dark twist. Wake up in a world where puzzles intertwine with exploration, weaving a unique narrative rooted in alchemy. A voice awakens you. It gives you purpose. To guide you, you find a notebook with mysterious entries and a house to explore.
items.description_ja: 『CLeM』はダークな秘密が隠された物語を追っていくパズルアドベンチャーゲームです。ここはパズルと探索が織りなす錬金術の物語の世界。あなたは謎の声に呼ばれて目を覚まします。声が命じるままに、謎めいた文章が書かれた一冊のノートを手に屋敷を探索しましょう。
items.title: CLeM

items.description: It's football, but everyone on the pitch is drunk. Drunken FC is a physics comedy game with no coordination and no dignity, just bodies and momentum. Up to four players on one couch, as teammates or enemies. Grab a controller. Move your feet. Try not to snap the sticks.
items.description_ja:
酔っぱらってサッカーをプレイして、後で治療代を心配したいと思ったことはありますか？アニメーション嫌いで物理演算が好きですか？
そんなあなたと友達のための、物理演算のスポーツアクションゲームです。ローカル、またはリモートでプレイ。

足を動かして、コントローラーのスティックは壊さないようにしましょう。
items.title: Drunken FC

items.description: An interactive anime story! Save a beloved local sushi bar from dastardly landsharks, get distracted in countless mini games and make unforgettable friends in this larger-than-life narrative adventure. Written by Moa (Hatoful Boyfriend) and featuring a fully voiced cast!
items.description_ja: インタラクティブなアニメ物語！ 悪徳地上げ屋から愛される寿司屋を守り、数え切れないミニゲームに寄り道し、忘れられない友だちに出会う——スケール大のナラティブアドベンチャー。Moa（Hatoful Boyfriend）脚本、フルボイス対応！
items.title: Sushi Ben

items.description: REDLINE CROOKS is a fast-paced roguelite combat racing game in which you destroy cops, walls and possibly yourself in a chaotic pursuit of freedom and riches. Upgrade, Slam, Taunt and Boost your way out of imprisonment through the lawless roads that lie ahead, and you may find personal absolution.
items.description_ja: 『REDLINE CROOKS』は、ハイペースなローグライク・ビークルコンバットゲームです。自由と富を求めて警官や壁、時には自分自身さえも破壊しよう。アップグレード、スラム、タウント、ブーストを駆使して、無法地帯の道を駆け抜けよう。いつしか罪の赦しを得られるかもしれない。
items.title: REDLINE CROOKS

items.description: It's Sara's first day of work. However, when she takes the elevator to go to the office, she suddenly finds herself on a mysterious floor. What truth lies behind these weird rooms? Will you be able to move on? Or rather... will you want to move on?
items.description_ja: It's Sara's first day of work. However, when she takes the elevator to go to the office, she suddenly finds herself on a mysterious floor. What truth lies behind these weird rooms? Will you be able to move on? Or rather... will you want to move on?
items.title: I'll Do It Tomorrow

items.description: Step into the frozen unknown in Forsaken Frontiers, a cooperative analog horror adventure set in the unforgiving embrace of an everlasting winter.
items.description_ja: Step into the frozen unknown in Forsaken Frontiers, a cooperative analog horror adventure set in the unforgiving embrace of an everlasting winter.
items.title: Forsaken Frontiers

items.description: Veloria awakens from a nightmare in an abandoned orphanage. As childhood fears resurface, she must piece together fragmented memories and uncover a dark past. Explore, solve puzzles, and survive this twisted place to reach her true ending.
items.description_ja: 悪夢から目覚めた少女は、廃墟と化した孤児院を見つける。焦げた門を押し開けた瞬間、幼少期の悪夢が再び襲いかかってくる。断片的な記憶をつなぎ合わせ、闇に包まれた過去を解き明かそう。少女ヴェラリアとなって、歪んだ故郷を探索し、謎を解き、生き延びながら——彼女だけの結末を追い求める。
items.title: Veloria

items.description: Every time you die, a new story begins. You are the nighttime security guard at a hospital. Your job is to monitor the hospital and fix problems when they happen. Every night, a new horror tale will unfold. If you can survive enough nights, you will learn the truth behind all the horror!
items.description_ja: 死ぬことで新しいストーリーが始まる。病院の夜間警備員として、院内を監視し、問題が起きたらそれを解決する。毎晩、新しいホラーストーリーが明かされる。毎晩生き延びることができれば、すべての恐怖の裏に隠された真相に辿り着くことができるだろう。
items.title: Security: The Horrible Nights

items.description: Wood and Flesh: A Candleforth Short Story is a point & click puzzle adventure with hand-drawn 2D graphics and a cozy horror setting that tells a short story set in the Tales from Candleforth universe.
items.description_ja: Wood and Flesh: A Candleforth Short Story is a point & click puzzle adventure with hand-drawn 2D graphics and a cozy horror setting that tells a short story set in the Tales from Candleforth universe.
items.title: Wood and Flesh: A Candleforth Short Story

items.description: Once a family home, now stands silent. The past still whispers through every room. You are looking for inspiration for a film, but you will find much more than just a story. Whether the lights are on or off... it doesn't matter. Olivia will find you.
items.description_ja: かつては家族の家だったこの場所は、今では静寂に包まれています。過去が今もなお、すべての部屋にひそかに息づいています。あなたは映画のインスピレーションを探していますが、そこで見つけるのは単なる物語以上のものになるでしょう。明かりが点いているか消えているかは...問題ではありません。オリビアがあなたを見つけ出すでしょう。
items.title: Olivia

items.description: A small-scale horror escape game that breaks the usual genre mold. The player must escape from a house where a deranged grandfather has locked them in. But the real fear lies not in the jump scares, but in the oppressive reality of the house and its hidden corners.
items.description_ja: A small-scale horror escape game that breaks the usual genre mold. The player must escape from a house where a deranged grandfather has locked them in. But the real fear lies not in the jump scares, but in the oppressive reality of the house and its hidden corners.
items.title: DEDA

items.description: DONT OPEN is a PSX-style horror game about routine that falls apart before your eyes. A normal shift at a taco bar, an empty stairwell, and a persistent knock on the door that's impossible to ignore. Based on real events.
items.description_ja: DONT OPEN is a PSX-style horror game about routine that falls apart before your eyes. A normal shift at a taco bar, an empty stairwell, and a persistent knock on the door that's impossible to ignore. Based on real events.
items.title: DON'T OPEN

items.description: Solve riddles, puzzles and platforming challenges as you descend the cryptic pathways of a distorted microcosm reality fueled by a symbolic landscape of faith and erotic nightmares.
items.description_ja: 『神殺し』とは、パズルを解く、クローンを作る、プラットフォームの挑戦を乗り越える、エソテリックで実験的な体験です。信仰と夢魔の象徴的な風景で満たされ、歪んでいる小宇宙の謎めいた道を探索せ。
items.title: TEOCIDA

items.description: Tres-Bashers is a 2D monster-bashing adventure featuring a big interconnected map full of cryptids, secrets, and more! Find 40 different monster types and whack 'em with your baseball bat!
items.description_ja: Tres-Bashers is a 2D monster-bashing adventure featuring a big interconnected map full of cryptids, secrets, and more! Find 40 different monster types and whack 'em with your baseball bat!
items.title: Tres-Bashers

items.description: Journey through the psyche… Welcome to the Seaside Hotel, where the final hour of your night shift awaits. Tend to guests, explore their dreams, and lose your sense of Self – time and again. In this dark, labyrinthine adventure, unravel the path to the truth below.
items.description_ja: 心への旅路……ようこそ、シーサイドホテルへ。あなたの夜勤も終わりの時刻です。お客様をもてなし、その夢を巡り歩き、そして、自分自身を見失いましょう。何度も、何度も。この暗闇の迷宮で、どうぞ真実への道をお探しください。
items.title: Night Loops

items.description: Moving into a shabby apartment, a saturnine girl with hidden secrets finds a notebook that allows her to communicate with another world. A thrilling adventure taking place across multiple timelines ensues.
items.description_ja: Moving into a shabby apartment, a saturnine girl with hidden secrets finds a notebook that allows her to communicate with another world. A thrilling adventure taking place across multiple timelines ensues.
items.title: Red Line

items.description: THE NEO-SANCTUM SHALL FALL. Claim retribution against the theocratic Faiths as you master vicious hack-and-slash combat in this action-RPG where style is salvation.
items.description_ja: たたき切る、ぶった切る、洗練された技術で戦おう。この猛烈なアクションRPGは救済するゲームです。あなたを育ててくれたカルトに立ち向かおう。
items.title: Death of a Wish

items.description: We will step into the shoes of a young druid who will be called upon by her tribe to undertake an important mission. After some events in her village, she will have to leave behind the safety of the forest and venture into a world full of dangers. The fate of the grove will be in her hands.
items.description_ja: We will step into the shoes of a young druid who will be called upon by her tribe to undertake an important mission. After some events in her village, she will have to leave behind the safety of the forest and venture into a world full of dangers. The fate of the grove will be in her hands.
items.title: The Legend of Skye

items.description: The thrilling final installment of Dark One!'s hit visual novel series! Hapless protagonist Yamada is once again at the mercy of the tender depredations of the world's worst staff of nurses... and this time, it's up close and personal with the ruthless Head Nurse who dominates all the rest!
items.description_ja: The thrilling final installment of Dark One!'s hit visual novel series! Hapless protagonist Yamada is once again at the mercy of the tender depredations of the world's worst staff of nurses... and this time, it's up close and personal with the ruthless Head Nurse who dominates all the rest!
items.title: Nope Nope Nope Nope Nurses

items.description:
Pest Apocalypse is a hyper-realistic post apocalyptic physics based pizza delivery action rogue-lite! 

Boost, jump, and drift across different maps in a bouncy pizza van.

Pick up kooky passengers along the way and focus on the driving while they handle the shooting!
items.description_ja:
Pest Apocalypse is a hyper-realistic post apocalyptic physics based pizza delivery action rogue-lite! 

Boost, jump, and drift across different maps in a bouncy pizza van.

Pick up kooky passengers along the way and focus on the driving while they handle the shooting!
items.title: Pest Apocalypse

items.description:
Find 100 cats.
A carefully hand drawn scene filled with cute characters.
The process is short and won't take up too much player time.
You can choose your favorite dyeing for the convenience of color blind players.
Extremely easy to achieve.
items.description_ja:
Find 100 cats.
A carefully hand drawn scene filled with cute characters.
The process is short and won't take up too much player time.
You can choose your favorite dyeing for the convenience of color blind players.
Extremely easy to achieve.
items.title: Where Cats 猫咪在哪里

items.description: You are Simon, a lover of hotdogs. Can you guide him and his friends to collect the most hotdogs EVER?
items.description_ja: You are Simon, a lover of hotdogs. Can you guide him and his friends to collect the most hotdogs EVER?
items.title: Hotdog Runner

items.description:
The Hidden Cats continue their world trip and have now arrived in RIO! So let's search for them again.
A cozy and relaxing experience to enjoy with your friends and family! Start with a beautiful monochromatic scene, relax, and find all the cats to reveal the final colored art.
items.description_ja:
The Hidden Cats continue their world trip and have now arrived in RIO! So let's search for them again.
A cozy and relaxing experience to enjoy with your friends and family! Start with a beautiful monochromatic scene, relax, and find all the cats to reveal the final colored art.
items.title: Hidden Cats in Rio de Janeiro

items.description: Snow Cone Serenade is a short and sweet liminal adventure. Choose your mood and roll the dice to succeed or fail in spicy situations. Enter a cursed snow world to save your sick dog, Jedediah. Unravel a mind-bending mystery to face your innermost fears.
items.description_ja: Snow Cone Serenade is a short and sweet liminal adventure. Choose your mood and roll the dice to succeed or fail in spicy situations. Enter a cursed snow world to save your sick dog, Jedediah. Unravel a mind-bending mystery to face your innermost fears.
items.title: Snow Cone Serenade

items.description: Xenopurge is a tactical auto-battler where you are a Commander tasked with purging the Xenos threat. Operate from a remote command center, issuing indirect orders via multi-screen interfaces. Plan routes, set priorities, and adapt as missions escalate and feel the true weight of being in command.
items.description_ja: あなたが指揮室から指示を出し、部隊を絶望的な戦場に送り込むことになります。戦術装備を整え、リアルタイムで指示を出し、優先任務を選択してください。1発ごとの射撃は操作できませんが、全体の流れを支配し、計算で勝利を掴み取るのです。廃棄された宇宙船の真実を明かしていきましょう。（ローカライズ品質を改善中です）
items.title: Xenopurge

items.description: Scare away all the invading Hoomanz! A stealth-adventure game packed with coziness and humour, featuring non-combat gameplay & family-friendly content. Play as Shoo, the mythical guardian of Planet Erf, with a hidden dual nature. Darkness is nature’s friend, light is its enemy.
items.description_ja: Scare away all the invading Hoomanz! A stealth-adventure game packed with coziness and humour, featuring non-combat gameplay & family-friendly content. Play as Shoo, the mythical guardian of Planet Erf, with a hidden dual nature. Darkness is nature’s friend, light is its enemy.
items.title: Hoomanz!

items.description: Where home feels wrong, and you're anything but welcome
items.description_ja: Where home feels wrong, and you're anything but welcome
items.title: Welcome Home

items.description: Color Factory is a relaxing factory-building game where strategy meets automation. Start with basic colors, refine them into vivid shades, and craft canvases of all sizes. Optimize your machines, scale operations at your own pace, and master automation to build a masterpiece of efficiency.
items.description_ja: 『顔料工房』で、気軽で楽しい工房建設の旅が始まります！顔料を混ぜて、魅力的な色を作り出し、キャンバスをデザイン。すべて創造性に満ちています。機械を調整して色をよりスムーズに混ぜ、シンプルな色の塊から素晴らしい作品へと進化させ、夢のようなカラーワールドを作り上げましょう！
items.title: Color Factory: Automation Meets Canvas

items.description:
Emergency Protocol activated: Dark Energy Particle Synthesis failed.
Now you – late and alone – must navigate a facility where science and sanity have collapsed.
Face entities born from the corruption of dark energy in this atmospheric FPS-horror hybrid, where human ambition meets primal terror.
items.description_ja:
緊急プロトコル作動：ダークエネルギー粒子Synthesisが失敗しました。
今、あなたは——遅刻し、そして一人で——科学と正気が崩壊した施設を進まなければならない。
人間の野心と原始的な恐怖が出会うこの大気圏的FPSホラーハイブリッドで、ダークエネルギーの汚染から生まれた実体と対峙せよ。
items.title: Synthesis of Corruption

items.description: Unknowz is a cooperative platformer where two pirates, one alive, the other undead, must combine their unique abilities to solve puzzles, avoid traps, and escape from a skeleton-infested island. Work together... or sink!
items.description_ja: Unknowz は、協力型プラットフォーマー です。生きた海賊とアンデッドの海賊が、それぞれの特異な能力を組み合わせてパズルを解き、罠を避け、スケルトンだらけの島から脱出しなければなりません。力を合わせろ… さもなければ沈むのみ！
items.title: Unknowz

items.description: Do you have what it takes? Are you brave enough to touch the mysterious green organism known as "grass"? Grass Toucher is a clicker game where you touch grass, buy buildings, and unlock special upgrades. Experience the thrill of touching grass without ever stepping outside.
items.description_ja: Do you have what it takes? Are you brave enough to touch the mysterious green organism known as "grass"? Grass Toucher is a clicker game where you touch grass, buy buildings, and unlock special upgrades. Experience the thrill of touching grass without ever stepping outside.
items.title: Grass Toucher

items.description: Atrium Mortis is a psychological horror roguelite. Outsmart terrifying entities, stack run-based power-ups, and solve lethal minigames - from Red Light, Green Light to zero-g space parkour. Collect diamonds for permanent meta-upgrades. Toggle jumpscares anytime in settings.
items.description_ja: 『Atrium Mortis』は心理ホラーのローグライト。恐ろしい存在の裏をかき、周回ごとに強化を重ね、「だるまさんが転んだ」から無重力パルクールまで命がけのミニゲームを攻略。ダイヤで永続アップグレードを解放。ジャンプスケアはいつでもオフにできます。
items.title: Atrium Mortis

items.description:
Testimonium is a bite-sized, experimental analog horror game designed to push your psychological limits. 
PLAY THE TAPE.
items.description_ja:
Testimonium is a bite-sized, experimental analog horror game designed to push your psychological limits. 
PLAY THE TAPE.
items.title: Testimonium

items.description: Play as Emily, drawn to a remote Mayan ruin after her brother insists it’s safe, amazing and beautiful. Explore an ancient Mayan site spanning jungle, temple, and catacombs as it becomes clear that he didn’t understand what he uncovered.
items.description_ja: Play as Emily, drawn to a remote Mayan ruin after her brother insists it’s safe, amazing and beautiful. Explore an ancient Mayan site spanning jungle, temple, and catacombs as it becomes clear that he didn’t understand what he uncovered.
items.title: MITNAL

items.description: Explore a cursed theater and persevere through all manners of dangers in this first-person survival horror game. Developed by third year students from Breda University of Applied Sciences.
items.description_ja: Explore a cursed theater and persevere through all manners of dangers in this first-person survival horror game. Developed by third year students from Breda University of Applied Sciences.
items.title: Curtain Call

items.description:
Spin, aim, and go for the giant watermelon!
The fruits from the hit title Suika Game, with over 13 million downloads worldwide, take to the vast cosmos for a brand-new adventure!
items.description_ja:
回って、狙って、スイカをめざせ！
累計1,300万ダウンロードを突破した「スイカゲーム」の新作が、舞台を宇宙に移して新登場！
items.title: Suika Game Planet

items.description: Challenge your friends or face off against clumsy bots in frenetic multiplayer arena battles! Harness unique abilities, customize your member with an array of hilarious accessories, and dominate the arena. Get ready for a wild ride of phallic mayhem unlike anything you've experienced before!
items.description_ja: 友達と対戦するか、間抜けなボットと激闘を繰り広げろ！ユニークな能力を使いこなし、笑えるアクセサリーで自分をカスタマイズし、アリーナを制覇するんだ。今までにないペニス大乱闘の荒々しい冒険に備えろ！
items.title: Foreskin Fury

items.description: A first-person exploration game based on the actual memories of a 92-year-old grandmother, told to players in her own voice. Take pictures of what remains of her abandoned childhood home to uncover the dark, traumatic events that she had to fight through as a teenage girl.
items.description_ja: A first-person exploration game based on the actual memories of a 92-year-old grandmother, told to players in her own voice. Take pictures of what remains of her abandoned childhood home to uncover the dark, traumatic events that she had to fight through as a teenage girl.
items.title: Brukel

items.description: IT Simulator is a co-op horror game where two players attempt to return power to an office building. Take the role of the all-seeing Control Room or the stealthy Repair Technician as you risk everything to d̶i̶s̶c̶o̶v̶e̶r̶ ̶t̶h̶e̶ ̶t̶r̶u̶t̶h̶ escape.
items.description_ja: IT Simulator is a co-op horror game where two players attempt to return power to an office building. Take the role of the all-seeing Control Room or the stealthy Repair Technician as you risk everything to d̶i̶s̶c̶o̶v̶e̶r̶ ̶t̶h̶e̶ ̶t̶r̶u̶t̶h̶ escape.
items.title: IT Simulator

items.description: A visual novel paying satirical homage to the world’s greatest TTRPG. Make important choices, roll countless dice, build lasting relationships, explore magical lands and experience all the rest of the crap you expect from a fantasy game without the hassle of finding actual friends to play with!
items.description_ja: A visual novel paying satirical homage to the world’s greatest TTRPG.
