Make important choices, roll countless dice, build lasting relationships, explore magical lands and experience all the rest of the crap you expect from a fantasy game without the hassle of finding actual friends to play with!
items.title: Basements n' Basilisks: Storms of Sorcery

items.description: IT HAS YOUR FACE. Now it wants your life. Hide, seek, and try to kill your clone in this deceptively simple first-person horror roguelite.
items.description_ja: 殺される前にクローンを倒せ！このサンドボックス・ホラーゲームで、クローンから隠れて、戦って、狩れ。自分にそっくりなクローンの恐ろしい物語を解き明かそう。
items.title: It Has My Face

items.description: Sci-fi horror anime point and click adventure game. Guide a young woman through a nightmarish space station as she tries to uncover why she's there and how she can escape.
items.description_ja: Sci-fi horror anime point and click adventure game. Guide a young woman through a nightmarish space station as she tries to uncover why she's there and how she can escape.
items.title: the white chamber

items.description:
Care is an atmospheric first person horror game with puzzle elements, where your choices have consequences.
Be observant with your surroundings and unravel the horrific secrets that hide within these walls.
items.description_ja:
Care is an atmospheric first person horror game with puzzle elements, where your choices have consequences.
Be observant with your surroundings and unravel the horrific secrets that hide within these walls.
items.title: Care

items.description:
Ignited Entry is a full length narrative driven psychological horror game with voice acting, dreamish visuals, and horror elements that will keep you on the edge of your seat. 

Some doors should never be opened. But you must go in.
items.description_ja:
Ignited Entry is a full length narrative driven psychological horror game with voice acting, dreamish visuals, and horror elements that will keep you on the edge of your seat. 

Some doors should never be opened. But you must go in.
items.title: Ignited Entry

items.description: Your name is Hank. You are doing a Handstand. Jump to the top.
items.description_ja: あなたの名前はハンクです。あなたは逆立ちをしています。頂上まで跳び上がってください。
items.title: Handstand Hank

items.description: Restore order to three ransacked fantasy shops! Organize thousands of items, master helpful sorceries and enchantments, relax at your own pace, race the global leaderboards, and unlock new ways to play. Every item has a shelf. Can you find them all?
items.description_ja: Restore order to three ransacked fantasy shops! Organize thousands of items, master helpful sorceries and enchantments, relax at your own pace, race the global leaderboards, and unlock new ways to play. Every item has a shelf. Can you find them all?
items.title: Shelves and Sorcery: Tidy Up the Enchanted Shop

items.description: Hello there! Sorry for the rush, but could you start tomorrow? Don’t worry—think of the details as “on-the-job training.” You did study the materials I gave you in advance... right?
items.description_ja:
もしもし。申し訳ないんだけど、さっそく明日から入ってくれるかな。詳細はほら、オン・ジョブ・トレーニングってことでさ……事前に渡した資料はちゃんと覚えたかい？
あなたはホロライブ事務所の新人守衛です。それはタレントのプライバシーを守るとても大切な仕事。ニセモノ、偽造書類、嘘八百の取り調べ──タレントの正しい知識、そして愛があれば大丈夫。なんとか被害を最小限に食いとどめ、見事正式採用を勝ち取りましょう。
items.title: Hologuard

items.description: Here Comes the Horde is an incremental auto-battler where your vast armies defend your castle against hordes of undead enemies. Survive the attacks, unlock new units, obtain powerful abilities, and fill the screen with thousands of troops.
items.description_ja: インクリメンタルオートバトラー『Here Comes the Horde』で、大軍勢を率いて不死の敵の軍団から城を守ろう。襲撃を切り抜け、新しいユニットをアンロックし、強力なアビリティを手に入れ、画面を何千もの部隊でいっぱいにするのだ。
items.title: Here Comes the Horde

items.description: My Light In The Dark is a short story about a girl who lives with her abusive mother. The girl finds out some dark secrets about her mother, and she has to find a way to escape the house.
items.description_ja: My Light In The Dark is a short story about a girl who lives with her abusive mother. The girl finds out some dark secrets about her mother, and she has to find a way to escape the house.
items.title: My Light In The Dark

items.description: A ball, two goals and... toasters! Welcome to Toasterball. Play against your friends in this physics-based multiplayer sports game, where toasters are athletes, bread flies everywhere and the gameplay changes every time you score a goal!
items.description_ja: このフィールドにあるのはボール1つと2つのゴール、それと…トースターたちだ！『トースターボール』へようこそ！アスリートであるトースターたちが得点を競い合い、パンは宙を舞い、点が入るごとにゲームプレイも変化する。これは友だちと一緒に対戦できるフィジカルを使ったマルチプレイ対応のスポーツゲームだ！
items.title: Toasterball

items.description:
Every New Year is similar to the previous one. No friends, no family, no magic.
But what if a fairy tale exists? And everything can change?
HOPE: Winter Tale is a story about a man who has lost his all taste for life. But one winter night, everything changed.
items.description_ja:
Every New Year is similar to the previous one. No friends, no family, no magic.
But what if a fairy tale exists? And everything can change?
HOPE: Winter Tale is a story about a man who has lost his all taste for life. But one winter night, everything changed.
items.title: HOPE: Winter Tale

items.description: Moaisland is a humorous and surreal, first-person, retro-styled, point-and-click adventure game starring the mysterious Moai statues of Rapa Nui (Easter Island).
items.description_ja: Moaisland is a humorous and surreal, first-person, retro-styled, point-and-click adventure game starring the mysterious Moai statues of Rapa Nui (Easter Island).
items.title: Moaisland

items.description: A retro first-person game inspired by shooters of the 90s. Collect weapons and blast your way through the mysterious Toyful Wonderworld, where a cast of colorful enemies will stand in your way. Discover the secrets of this weird place and find out what has caused the Toyfriends to go crazy!
items.description_ja: A retro first-person game inspired by shooters of the 90s. Collect weapons and blast your way through the mysterious Toyful Wonderworld, where a cast of colorful enemies will stand in your way. Discover the secrets of this weird place and find out what has caused the Toyfriends to go crazy!
items.title: Toyful Wonderworld

items.description:
The much-talked-about "Polyrhythm" on social media has finally been officially released! Can you handle the 3/4, 5/4, 7/4... and all those crazy polyrhythms!? 
It’s simple yet incredibly challenging! A new kind of rhythm game is here! 
Come and test your rhythm skills in this beat-pounding madness!
items.description_ja:
SNS上で話題になったあのポリリリリズムが遂に正式版リリース！　
3拍子と5拍子と7拍子と…ややこしいポリリズムを乗りこなせるか！？
シンプルだけど難しい！新感覚リズムゲーム！
items.title: Polylylyrhythm

items.description: Relive the nostalgia with OYASUMII, a horror and exploration game inspired by PSX and N64 classics. Enter liminal spaces and face surreal terrors in an adventure that challenges your skills and sanity. Are you ready to relive the golden age of video games with OYASUMII?
items.description_ja: PSXとN64のクラシックにインスパイアされたレトロスタイルのホラーと探索ゲーム、OYASUMIIでノスタルジーに浸りましょう。境界領域を探検し、シュールな恐怖に直面し、あなたのスキルと正気を試すように設計された冒険に出かけましょう。レトロビデオゲームの黄金時代を蘇らせ、OYASUMIIの暗い秘密を明らかにする準備はできていますか？
items.title: OYASUMII

items.description: The Flayed Man is a short narrative-driven point and click horror game. Awaking without memories (or skin), you must uncover the sins of the past, pass judgement, and decide your fate in this macabre adventure.
items.description_ja: The Flayed Man is a short narrative-driven point and click horror game. Awaking without memories (or skin), you must uncover the sins of the past, pass judgement, and decide your fate in this macabre adventure.
items.title: The Flayed Man

items.description: Become Sherlock Holmes' more intelligent, more languorous older brother in this short point and click experience from the world of 'The Beekeeper's Picnic'.
items.description_ja: Become Sherlock Holmes' more intelligent, more languorous older brother in this short point and click experience from the world of 'The Beekeeper's Picnic'.
items.title: Mycroft Holmes Simulator

items.description: Ultra Foodmess is just the perfect and tasty combination of the best things in life: Food, fun, games and chaos! All of that in a single Party Game for up to 4 players that will cost your friendships, because you will be hungry for victory!
items.description_ja: Ultra Foodmess is just the perfect and tasty combination of the best things in life: Food, fun, games and chaos! All of that in a single Party Game for up to 4 players that will cost your friendships, because you will be hungry for victory!
items.title: Ultra Foodmess

items.description: LUL Inc. is a collection of 36 different microgames that will test your skills in a variety of genres. Can you beat them all and defeat the three evil machines?
items.description_ja: LUL Inc. is a collection of 36 different microgames that will test your skills in a variety of genres. Can you beat them all and defeat the three evil machines?
items.title: LUL inc.

items.description: ROSE is a violent rogue-lite arena shooter where you sacrifice your body parts to progress and gain new weapons and abilities. Slaughter waves of monstrous enemies and defeat titanic bosses in randomized arenas or die trying!
items.description_ja: ROSE is a violent rogue-lite arena shooter where you sacrifice your body parts to progress and gain new weapons and abilities. Slaughter waves of monstrous enemies and defeat titanic bosses in randomized arenas or die trying!
items.title: ROSE

items.description: Frogun ENCORE is a dashing standalone expansion/sequel to indie hit FROGUN! Join now older Renata and Jake in a trek around the whole world to prevent the return of Beelzebub.  ENCORE builds on FROGUN's retro PS1/N64 formula. Plus, enjoy the whole adventure in true couch co-op.
items.description_ja: Frogun ENCORE is a dashing standalone expansion/sequel to indie hit FROGUN! Join now older Renata and Jake in a trek around the whole world to prevent the return of Beelzebub.  ENCORE builds on FROGUN's retro PS1/N64 formula. Plus, enjoy the whole adventure in true couch co-op.
items.title: Frogun Encore

items.description: Cats on Duty is a🐱 purr-fect blend of RTS, tower defense, game genres. Manage two game fields, upgrade adorable cat towers, and watch your fluffy warriors bravely defend against foes. 🐾
items.description_ja: 『Cats on Duty』はリアルタイムストラテジー、タワーディフェンス、マッチ3を組み合わせたニャンダフルなゲーム。一度に2つのゲームフィールドを管理し、武装したりキャットタワーをアップグレードしたりして恐るべき敵の群れを打ち負かす。ニャンタスティックなバトルを楽しもう！
items.title: Cats on Duty

items.description: "MELLOWOLLEM" is an adventure game where you explore maps and find objects to progress. The main character meets a girl on a sunny summer day, and the story unfolds guided by her words. However, detailed story elements remain undisclosed, leaving only the setting of a hot, dreamy summer landscape.
items.description_ja: 『MELLOWOLLEM』はマップを探索し、オブジェクトを見つけてゲームを進めるADVです。主人公は青空の夏の日に彼女と出会い、彼女の言葉に導かれて物語が進行します。しかし、詳細なストーリーは明かされず、ただ暑い夏の白昼夢のような景色が広がる場所にいることだけがわかります。ゲームの特徴は、オブジェクトを見つけてストーリーを進めることであり、直感的で難しいパズルを楽しめます。さらに、クエストのマーカーや時間制限は存在せず、ゆったりとしたペースでプレイできる点も特筆。
items.title: MELLOWOLLEM

items.description: Lively Chair Simulator is an indie multiplayer game with strange controls. Let’s see if you are suitable to be a chair.
items.description_ja: Lively Chair Simulatorは、奇妙な操作性を持つインディーズマルチプレイヤーゲームです。あなたが椅子になれるか試してみよう！
items.title: Lively Chair Simulator

items.description: Wickeina 'Wicke' Gestalt lives in a haunted house. Trying to balance the stresses of life with the horrors of her home, play through a point-and-click psychological horror and multiple scenarios, where success and failure both progress the narrative of her story.
items.description_ja:
ウィケナ・ゲシュタルト（ウィケちゃん）はお化け屋敷に住んでいます。
生活のストレスと屋敷の恐怖の間でバランスを取ろうとしています。
クリックでサイコロジカルホラーに関わる複数のシーンをプレイして、
成功・失敗に関わらず、物語は先に進められます。
items.title: GESTALT: The Fifth Day

items.description: Witches, curses, and fairy tales meet horror in this classic walking sim with an eerie atmosphere and well-paced jumpscares.
items.description_ja: Witches, curses, and fairy tales meet horror in this classic walking sim with an eerie atmosphere and well-paced jumpscares.
items.title: Befriended Curse

items.description: POOOOL is a small, pool-inspired physics puzzler where you combine balls of similar sizes to create even bigger ones, all while trying to save room for more. Chase your hi-score, share scores with friends, and master your flinging skills!
items.description_ja: POOOOL is a small, pool-inspired physics puzzler where you combine balls of similar sizes to create even bigger ones, all while trying to save room for more. Chase your hi-score, share scores with friends, and master your flinging skills!
items.title: POOOOL

items.description: Join Julian and his friends in this psychological horror experience inspired by point-n-click computer games from the early 2000s. Witness many shenanigans with characters from the infamous 98xx.
items.description_ja: Join Julian and his friends in this psychological horror experience inspired by point-n-click computer games from the early 2000s. Witness many shenanigans with characters from the infamous 98xx.
items.title: Julian & Friends

items.description: A horror survival game set in a prison corrupted by the madness of the Italian Brainrot movement. Watch the cameras, shut the doors, and save power to survive the monsters. Each night grows more terrifying and unpredictable.
items.description_ja: Italian Brainrot運動の狂気に侵された刑務所でのサバイバルホラー。カメラを監視し、ドアを閉め、電力を節約して生き残れ。夜ごとに恐怖が増していく。
items.title: Italian Brainrot: In Prison

items.description: Occlude is a ritual disguised as Solitaire; a cosmic-horror card game where the rules are obscured and reality is at stake. Play through cryptic challenges to reveal forbidden lore in this singleplayer narrative puzzle game for the terminally curious. Don’t worry; you can always start over.
items.description_ja: OccludeはSolitaireに偽装された儀式です。ルールが隠され、現実が危機にさらされるコズミックホラーのカードゲームです。非常に好奇心旺盛なプレイヤーのためのシングルプレイヤー型ナラティブパズルゲームで、暗号のような課題を乗り越え、禁断の知識を解き明かしましょう。心配はいりません。いつでも最初からやり直せます。
items.title: Occlude

items.description: Welcome to Awkward Valley! Plan your day, tackle strange activities, and unlock bizarre new options as you go. Gym? Therapy? Vending machine snacks? It’s up to you! Featuring Awkward Yeti’s weird and wonderful characters in a totally normal town.
items.description_ja: Welcome to Awkward Valley! Plan your day, tackle strange activities, and unlock bizarre new options as you go. Gym? Therapy? Vending machine snacks? It’s up to you! Featuring Awkward Yeti’s weird and wonderful characters in a totally normal town.
items.title: Awkward Valley

items.description: An experimental work simulator where all you do is type simple data into spreadsheet
items.description_ja: An experimental work simulator where all you do is type simple data into spreadsheet
items.title: Spreadsheets and Nothing More

items.description: Explore an abandoned theater consumed by a mysterious fungal infestation. Use Poncik Bot to solve puzzles, restore power, and uncover the secrets hidden within. Something terrible happened here, and the truth is still waiting to be found.
items.description_ja: Explore an abandoned theater consumed by a mysterious fungal infestation. Use Poncik Bot to solve puzzles, restore power, and uncover the secrets hidden within. Something terrible happened here, and the truth is still waiting to be found.
items.title: Poncik's Little Tragedy

items.description: Incremental survival game where you add seconds to your life by eating and drinking increasingly surreal foods, while trying to avoid getting burnt, crushed, dehydrated, distorted, destroyed, and many other things.
items.description_ja: Incremental survival game where you add seconds to your life by eating and drinking increasingly surreal foods, while trying to avoid getting burnt, crushed, dehydrated, distorted, destroyed, and many other things.
items.title: Seconds Until You Die

items.description: Astro Duel 2 is a sci-fi combat game combining top-down space dog fights with up-close platforming action. Whether versus or co-op, battle through space and on foot at the same time! Strike within the fully-destructible arenas or just nuke ‘em from orbit.
items.description_ja: 『Astro Duel 2』はトップダウン型の宇宙での空中戦と至近距離のプラットフォームアクションを組み合わせたSF戦闘ゲーム。対人戦でも協力プレイでも、広大な宇宙空間と地上で同時に戦うことができる！完全に破壊可能なアリーナ内で攻撃するもよし、軌道上から壊滅させるもよし。
items.title: Astro Duel 2

items.description: The rave goes on! 14 years after his first rave, the elephant has returned for monumental challenge: avoiding very, very deadly beams of light
items.description_ja: The rave goes on! 14 years after his first rave, the elephant has returned for monumental challenge: avoiding very, very deadly beams of light
items.title: Elephant Rave 2

items.description: vApe Escape is a point-and-click adventure in a science fiction comedy setting. The player takes control of an innocent ape who must escape the sad destiny of becoming a vape dispenser machine for the wealthy hipsters of the universe.
items.description_ja: vApe Escape is a point-and-click adventure in a science fiction comedy setting. The player takes control of an innocent ape who must escape the sad destiny of becoming a vape dispenser machine for the wealthy hipsters of the universe.
items.title: vApe Escape

items.description: To get a "Ticket to Paradise" while being in Hell. A ticket that’s obviously worth it. A ticket that sends you to the obstacle path. What kind of road from Hell to Heaven could it be? What difficulties are awaiting you on this road? Are you worthy of a chance at redemption?
items.description_ja: To get a "Ticket to Paradise" while being in Hell. A ticket that’s obviously worth it. A ticket that sends you to the obstacle path. What kind of road from Hell to Heaven could it be? What difficulties are awaiting you on this road? Are you worthy of a chance at redemption?
items.title: Wicked Games

items.description: Ten Deadly Games is a collection of games from different developers based around the same theme - "Death is an Opportunity." These ten deadly games were all created in a week for the Jamsepticeye game jam.
items.description_ja: Ten Deadly Games is a collection of games from different developers based around the same theme - "Death is an Opportunity." These ten deadly games were all created in a week for the Jamsepticeye game jam.
items.title: Ten Deadly Games: Jamsepticeye

items.description: The Greatest Penguin Heist of All Time is a sandboxy physics game for 1-8 players, with everything from sneaky heists to hilarious stupidity to baking pizzas. With continuous updates, plenty of maps, and hundreds of items, clothes and quests, it has something for everyone.
items.description_ja: The Greatest Penguin Heist of All Time は、1〜8人で遊べるサンドボックス系物理演算ゲーム。こっそり忍び込む強盗から、腹を抱えて笑えるおバカ騒ぎ、さらにはピザ作りまで何でもあり！ 継続的なアップデートに豊富なマップ、数百種類のアイテム・服・クエストで、誰もが楽しめる一本です。
items.title: The Greatest Penguin Heist of All Time

items.description: The Nanny is a short interactive horror story about the supernatural. Follow siblings Oliver and Tina in their quest to find their nanny after she disappears in the middle of the night. Welcome to a new dimension of horror. Welcome to Midnight Scenes.
items.description_ja: The Nanny is a short interactive horror story about the supernatural. Follow siblings Oliver and Tina in their quest to find their nanny after she disappears in the middle of the night. Welcome to a new dimension of horror. Welcome to Midnight Scenes.

items.description: HYPERHELL is a breakneck top-down movement shooter featuring the talents of several prolific hyperpop musicians. Obliterate your way through a colorful city of demons to reclaim what was stolen from you: a fully stocked fridge.
items.description_ja: HYPERHELL is a breakneck top-down movement shooter featuring the talents of several prolific hyperpop musicians. Obliterate your way through a colorful city of demons to reclaim what was stolen from you: a fully stocked fridge.
items.title: Hyperhell

items.description: A surrealist text-based RPG. You will explore an island, solve puzzles, and fight enemies, all in your attempt to get the Dark Egg.
items.description_ja: A surrealist text-based RPG. You will explore an island, solve puzzles, and fight enemies, all in your attempt to get the Dark Egg.
items.title: The Dark Egg Demo

items.description: TraumaCore Violence is a 2D Action Game with a focus on intense, snappy combat and in-depth movement mechanics; set within the psyche of a woman who has just had her mind snap.
items.description_ja: TraumaCore Violence is a 2D Action Game with a focus on intense, snappy combat and in-depth movement mechanics; set within the psyche of a woman who has just had her mind snap.
items.title: TraumaCore Violence

items.description: Soulbind: Prologue is an action platformer in the Roguelike genre. The hero is a common skeleton and an outsider. But there is one special feature - you can replace your body parts with parts of your opponents' bodies. Learn the backstory and start your journey in the world of Allaar.
items.description_ja: Soulbind: Prologueはローグライクジャンルのアクションプラットフォーマー。主人公は平凡なスケルトンでアウトサイダー。しかし、一つだけ特別な特徴がある。自分の体のパーツを相手の体のパーツと交換することができるのだ。バックストーリーを学び、Allaarの世界で旅を始めよう。
items.title: Soulbind: Prologue

items.description: Sheriff James Cooper is slowly bleeding to death in an unfamiliar hospital. But the moment his life ends, everything starts over. He has fifteen minutes to break this endless cycle, uncover the truth, and find a way out before it's too late.
items.description_ja: ジェームズ・クーパー警長は見知らぬ病院で出血しながらゆっくりと死んでいきます。しかし、彼の命が絶たれるたびにすべてが再び始まります。彼には15分の時間があり、この無限ループを断ち切り、真実を明らかにし、出口を見つけなければなりません。時間がなくなる前に。
items.title: Fear The Timeloop

items.description: Just War Trains is an online shooter where players control heavily armored trains, engaging in intense battles against an opponent. The objective is to outgun the opposing train with precise shooting. You can play with up to 24 people in WAR TRAINS!
items.description_ja: Just War Trains is an online shooter where players control heavily armored trains, engaging in intense battles against an opponent. The objective is to outgun the opposing train with precise shooting. You can play with up to 24 people in WAR TRAINS!
items.title: Just War Trains

items.description: An absurdist FPS/interactive fiction game where you murder stupid robots, chat with idiot people, and explore a painstakingly hand-drawn and highly animated world!
items.description_ja: 不条理FPS×インタラクティブ・フィクション。マヌケなロボットをぶち殺し、バカな人間とくっちゃべり。さあ、死ぬほど気合いの入った手描きアニメの世界を探検だ。
items.title: Shooty Shooty Robot Invasion

items.description: In Republican-era Shanghai, Lu Ping returns to the forgotten Luchang Apartment after receiving a letter from her orphanage headmistress. As lost memories resurface, she uncovers buried secrets, her past, and the eerie truth behind the bond between humans and yaoguai.
items.description_ja: In Republican-era Shanghai, Lu Ping returns to the forgotten Luchang Apartment after receiving a letter from her orphanage headmistress. As lost memories resurface, she uncovers buried secrets, her past, and the eerie truth behind the bond between humans and yaoguai.

items.description: First-person psychological horror where the elevator is the only safe place. Each floor is a new reality. Each floor has a new inhabitant. Find it to continue your descent downward.
items.description_ja: エレベーターだけが安全な場所という一人称視点のサイコロジカルホラー。各フロアは新しい現実。各フロアには新しい住人がいる。下への降下を続けるためにそれを見つけ出せ。
items.title: Psalm 2

items.description: You are a mic! a Romanian skinless grilled sausage! on the grill! A third-person comedy sim about doing absolutely nothing while you're slowly getting smoked. Maybe you can listen to the radio? It's a nice day outside.
items.description_ja: You are a mic! a Romanian skinless grilled sausage! on the grill! A third-person comedy sim about doing absolutely nothing while you're slowly getting smoked. Maybe you can listen to the radio? It's a nice day outside.

items.description: Interrogate suspects, search for clues, & uncover a dastardly plot, as you solve a string of mystifying murders to help reluctant detective Ilmarinen escape the foreboding Fafnir Hotel.
items.description_ja: 容疑者を尋問し、手がかりを見つけ、危険な陰謀を明らかにしてください。 一連の謎の殺人事件を解決し、刑事イルマリネンがこの不吉なファフニールホテルを脱出するのを助けましょう。
items.title: The Murder Hotel

items.description: Explore a dream that refuses to end. As Zede Aksis, wander a surreal city that feels both alive and liminal, filled with digital citizens and absurd infrastructure. Can you find an escape? A way out of a world that remembers you better than you remember it?
items.description_ja: Explore a dream that refuses to end. As Zede Aksis, wander a surreal city that feels both alive and liminal, filled with digital citizens and absurd infrastructure. Can you find an escape? A way out of a world that remembers you better than you remember it?

items.description: Quacker Bros is a roguelike TD game about protecting your bounty from the intercepting chicken Mafia! Survive until the help comes and you can finally enjoy the blood and sweat of your heist!

items.description: A short narrative-driven psychological horror game about a trainee metro driver trapped in the dampest subway east of anything that matters.
items.description_ja: 重要なものすべての東にある最も湿った地下鉄に閉じ込められた研修中の地下鉄運転士を描く、短編のナラティブ重視の心理ホラーゲームです。

items.description: Build a strong defense of hololive dolls to defeat a robot army in this exciting hololive-themed tower defense game!!

items.description: Chessarama is a collection of chess-inspired puzzle and strategy games that use chess pieces and their established move sets, then reimagines their goals and themes. Solve challenges, unlock collectibles, and compete against each other on the leaderboards. Welcome to Chessarama!
items.description_ja: Chessaramaは、将棋の駒とその確立された動きを使用し、その目標とテーマを再考した将棋にインスパイアを受けたパズルと戦略のゲームのコレクションです。課題を解決し、コレクタブルをアンロックし、リーダーボードで競い合いましょう。ようこそ、Chessaramaへ！
items.title: Chessarama

items.description: In the deserts of the Baihe Continent, a girl named Mars was born, breaking the curse. -- Embarking on a journey, composing an epic adventure about courage, love and yuri.
items.description_ja: In the deserts of the Baihe Continent, a girl named Mars was born, breaking the curse. -- Embarking on a journey, composing an epic adventure about courage, love and yuri.

items.description: Everybunny has a secret. Who do you trust to keep the town safe? Trust No Bunny is a hilarious and incredibly cute social deduction game for fans of Werewolf or Among Us. It’s a game for thinkers, schemers, & downright liars, where guessing the traitors is only half the fun.
items.description_ja: どのウサギにも秘密があります。町を守るために、誰を信じますか？『ウサギを信じるな！』は、『ウェアウルフ』や『アモングアス』のファンに向けた、笑いと可愛さ満点のソーシャルデダクションゲームです。これは、考える人、策略をめぐらす人、そして平然と嘘をつく人向けのゲームで、裏切り者を推理するのが楽しみの半分に過ぎません。
items.title: Trust No Bunny

items.description: While looking for the existence of the Great Beyond, Professor Patrick Moore, aided by a fake medium, will build a device to see the other side, embark on a search for a millenary artifact, and investigate the most haunted manor of 1907 England.
items.description_ja: While looking for the existence of the Great Beyond, Professor Patrick Moore, aided by a fake medium, will build a device to see the other side, embark on a search for a millenary artifact, and investigate the most haunted manor of 1907 England.

items.description: One day, Hinako, a high school student, finds her path to school transformed into the Sanzu River, where she meets a strange-looking man named Issa. Will she be able to get through the mysterious devices of the mysterious mansion and return safely to her family?
items.description_ja: ゲームマガジン主催の新人賞で初の「大賞」を受賞し絶賛を浴びた和風ホラーADV。主人公の日向子が高校生になったある日、通学路が「三途の川」に変わってしまい、その先で奇妙な風体の色男・一茶と出会う。日向子は謎めく屋敷の奇怪陋劣な仕掛けを潜り抜け、家族の元へ無事帰れるのか？
items.title: OMUSUBI

items.description: Your task today: Memorize your environment and report any anomalies. Good luck with your shift! "Shift 87" is an observation horror game with subtle anomalies and unsettling occurrences.
items.description_ja: 本日の目標：すべての環境を記憶し、異常を報告すること。今日のシフトを頑張ってくれ！『Shift 87』は、些細な異常や不穏な出来事が起こる観察ホラーゲーム。
items.title: Shift 87

items.description: A small little game where you and your friends have a once in a lifetime opportunity: Hunt BigFool. BigFool is an elusive, fearsome creature of the night from unknown origins. Set in the Crimblr Forest, explore various points of interest, keep an eye and an ear out, and take down this iconic beast.
items.description_ja: A small little game where you and your friends have a once in a lifetime opportunity: Hunt BigFool. BigFool is an elusive, fearsome creature of the night from unknown origins. Set in the Crimblr Forest, explore various points of interest, keep an eye and an ear out, and take down this iconic beast.
items.title: BigFool

items.description: Three short ghost stories. Three everyday locations turned nightmare. Tales of the Forgotten is a PSX-style horror anthology perfect for a single terrifying session. Experience jump scares, uncover multiple endings, and discover why these ghosts can't rest—all in under an hour.
items.description_ja: 3つの短い怪談。日常の場所が悪夢へと変わる。『Tales of the Forgotten』はPSX風ホラーアンソロジー。ジャンプスケア、複数のエンディング、彷徨う霊の真実を、1時間以内で体験せよ。
items.title: Tales of the Forgotten

items.description: Den-Den: Tokyo Horror is a J-horror RPG where events unfold in real-time. Survive one night in a city where every choice you make impacts the world around you. How many deaths will you be responsible for tonight?
items.description_ja: Den-Den: 東京ホラーは、リアルタイムで展開するJホラーRPGです。すべての選択が周囲の世界に影響を与える街で、一夜を生き延びろ。今夜、あなたは何人の死に責任を持つことになるのか？
items.title: Den-Den: Tokyo Horror

items.description: Enter a winter fairy tale with cat people, elves and cute atmosphere. Explore a cozy forest and Santa's workshop, uncovering over 300 hidden objects, from winter sweets to magical surprises. Relax with hand-painted scenes and soothing melodies in this enchanting seasonal adventure.
items.description_ja: 猫の人々、エルフ、そしてかわいい雰囲気があふれる冬の童話の世界へ。居心地の良い森とサンタの工房を探検し、冬のお菓子から魔法のサプライズまで300以上の隠しアイテムを見つけましょう。手描きのシーンと穏やかなメロディーで、この魅力的な季節の冒険を楽しんでください。
items.title: Hidden Winter Things

items.description: Use your soul as a stake to gamble for a treasure of the undead captain. As long as you take the randomly distributed flintlock gun and fight a duel with the ghost pirates, you can leave with the treasure, or your soul will remain on the undead ship forever. Good luck.
items.description_ja: カリブ海賊の黄金時代には、幽霊船に出会ったら、魂をチップにして亡霊船長の宝物を手に入れることができるという亡霊の宝物があり、ランダムに配布されたスリップ銃を持って幽霊海賊と対決すれば、宝物を持って離れることができ、あるいはあなたの魂は永遠に亡霊船に残ることができ、良い雲を祈る。
items.title: The Ghost Treasure

items.description: Search for 100 hidden tomatoes in a detailed city. Explore the streets, buildings, and alleys with no time limits. Can you find them all? 🍅

items.description_ja: 今日も放課後、私は『彼女』と話す。窓から夕日が見える、誰かが校庭で遊んでいるのが見える。私たちはただそれを眺めたり、思い出話をしたりする。『TABLE GAME END』はアドベンチャーゲームです。

items.description:
Heaven Does Not Respond is a psychological and analog horror game set in an alternate 2005 timeline.

Play as an intelligence agent, exploring a retro computer interface to decipher secret files, watch mysterious videos, and uncover the dark secrets behind a young man's death.
items.description_ja:
Heaven Does Not Respondは、2005年の架空のタイムラインを舞台にした、心理的でアナログなホラーゲームです。

諜報員としてレトロなコンピューターインターフェースを探索し、秘密のファイルを解読し、謎のビデオを視聴し、ある若者の死に隠された暗い秘密を暴き出しましょう。
items.title: Heaven Does Not Respond

items.description: “SHE WAS 98” - you play as a grandson who returns to his elderly grandmother's home to care for her.....
items.description_ja: “SHE WAS 98” - you play as a grandson who returns to his elderly grandmother's home to care for her.....
items.title: SHE WAS 98

items.description: FLESHCANCER is a Fast-paced Boomer Shooter with surreal environments and old-school violence. Fight cannibal cultists, terrorists, grotesque aberrations and more. MAKE IT RAIN FLESH, ORGANS, AND BLOOD LIKE NEVER BEFORE.
items.description_ja: FLESHCANCER is a Fast-paced Boomer Shooter with surreal environments and old-school violence. Fight cannibal cultists, terrorists, grotesque aberrations and more. MAKE IT RAIN FLESH, ORGANS, AND BLOOD LIKE NEVER BEFORE.
items.title: FLESHCANCER

items.description: Fast-paced racing game based on Rocket League mechanics, race against players from all over the world, defeat them to rank up in the leaderboards and get special items to show off your skills
items.description_ja: Fast-paced racing game based on Rocket League mechanics, race against players from all over the world, defeat them to rank up in the leaderboards and get special items to show off your skills
items.title: Rocket Assault: Downhill Rush

items.description: CUCCCHI is a game where you explore beautiful dioramas and go through dangerous and trippy labyrinths, in a journey inside the paintings of Enzo Cucchi.
items.description_ja: Cuccchiは美しいジオラマを探検したり、危険で幻想的な迷路を通過したりしながらEnzo Cucchi氏の絵画の中を旅するゲーム。
items.title: CUCCCHI

items.description:
A 3 minute tag-battle with extra twists! Play as a Monster who must lock everyone into jail before time runs out, or as a Human who must avoid capture and bail their teammates out of trouble.
Invite your friends and family to play this speedy game of cat and mouse - or rather, Monsters and Humans!
items.description_ja:
ハラハラドキドキのおいかけっこバトル！
制限時間は3分！ニンゲンは仲間と協力してオバケから逃げきれ！
オバケはスキルを駆使してニンゲンを捕まえろ！
みんなで一緒に『オバケイドロ！』しよう！
items.title: Bail or Jail(OBAKEIDORO!)

items.description: Grotesque notes written not by Fyodor Dostoevsky, but by a "certain person".
items.description_ja: Grotesque notes written not by Fyodor Dostoevsky, but by a "certain person".
items.title: Bobok

items.description: Play the dynamic rhythm game to the best phonk tracks! Play solo or versus your friend, customize your cats, choose different game modes - Phonk Cats are waiting for you!
items.description_ja: Play the dynamic rhythm game to the best phonk tracks! Play solo or versus your friend, customize your cats, choose different game modes - Phonk Cats are waiting for you!
items.title: Phonk Cats

items.description: A first-person action game, inspired by Dark Messiah, that provides various ways for defeating your foes, with weaponry, sorcery, stealth, or clever tactics like kicking them into deadly spikes.
items.description_ja: A first-person action game, inspired by Dark Messiah, that provides various ways for defeating your foes, with weaponry, sorcery, stealth, or clever tactics like kicking them into deadly spikes.
items.title: The Adventures of Sir Kicksalot

items.description: Tidal Therapy is a travel novel game for tired adults. A tired office worker heads to the sea. The setting is a quiet and beautiful sea town with a seaside park, warehouse district, and tower condominiums.
items.description_ja: 「限界OL海へ行く」は、疲れた大人の旅ノベルゲーム。疲れ切ったお姉さんが海へ向かいます。舞台となるのは、海浜公園、倉庫街、タワーマンションが立ち並ぶ、静かで美しい海の街。個性豊かな旅人たちと出会いながら、自分だけのお気に入りの場所を探す旅に出かけましょう。
items.title: Tidal Therapy

items.description: In the past, the world was almost invaded by zombies.You will play the commander of the remaining survivor camp, searching for hope for the last surviving companions, forming and assigning your special police squad to explore this post-apocalyptic world filled with zombies!
items.description_ja: これは1種の戦略性のある俯瞰視点のシングルrogue-liteアクションアドベンチャーゲームで、昔の世界はほとんどゾンビに占領されて、あなたはわずかに残っている生存者のキャンプ地の指揮官を演じて、最後の生存者の仲間たちのために希望を探して、あなたの特警小隊を創立して派遣して、このゾンビだらけの終末の世界を探しに行きましょう！
items.title: FALL

items.description: PETS is a platformer puzzle game. You will cross different dimensions and go through the maze, find your dogge.
items.description_ja: 「PETS」はプラットフォームジャンプパズルゲームです。あなたは犬を見つけるために、さまざまな次元や迷路を旅することになります。
items.title: PETS

items.description: Find 500+ hidden dogs and items, with secrets and challenges, across 16 levels! Set in a charming English countryside village. Help Labby find his friends in this cozy, hand-drawn, hidden object adventure.
items.description_ja:
計16のステージを探索し、500個以上の隠れたわんこやアイテム、ヒミツにチャレンジを見つけ出そう！
舞台は、イギリスの田舎に位置する魅力あふれる村。
ほっこり手描きの世界を探検して、ラビィと一緒にお友だちを見つけ出そう！
items.title: Hidden Dogs

items.description: Embark on a moldy adventure in a land of bread. Play as Bradley the Breadapus, a waffle-tailed bread platypus, in this quirky action platformer and battle to cleanse a world infected by mold. Break the mold, save the world!
items.description_ja: Embark on a moldy adventure in a land of bread. Play as Bradley the Breadapus, a waffle-tailed bread platypus, in this quirky action platformer and battle to cleanse a world infected by mold. Break the mold, save the world!
items.title: Moldbreaker: Rise of the Loaf

items.description:
The ultimate Hololive hide-and-seek adventure!

Step into a world of coziness and colorful cuteness in Holo Hidden, a charming hidden object game where your are tasked to find hidden fans and missing items! Test your skill across 11+1 beautifully hand-drawn levels.
items.description_ja:
ホロライブのドタバタかくれんぼアドベンチャー！
かわいさ全開！推しと一緒にファンを探そう！
items.title: Holo Hidden - My Lovely Fans Can't Be This Hidden

items.description: A routine night turns into a true nightmare. You are a psychologist trapped in a building filled with unsettling secrets and rooms that seem to watch you, while an unknown presence follows you without rest.
items.description_ja: A routine night turns into a true nightmare. You are a psychologist trapped in a building filled with unsettling secrets and rooms that seem to watch you, while an unknown presence follows you without rest.
items.title: Exit: Echoes of insanity

items.description: A simple 3D platform game where a court jester gets trapped inside a game and must save her best friend within a digital world. but to achieve that, she'll have to go through many adventures that go far beyond just jumping on enemies' heads.
items.description_ja: A simple 3D platform game where a court jester gets trapped inside a game and must save her best friend within a digital world. but to achieve that, she'll have to go through many adventures that go far beyond just jumping on enemies' heads.
items.title: Outono Adventures

items.description: An FPS with ZERO graphics!? Yes, you heard right ! Run • Blast • Escape • Survive, through sound alone, as you challenge your makers and unravel the mysteries of your existence. You may be blind, but you're far from helpless !
items.description_ja: An FPS with ZERO graphics!? Yes, you heard right ! Run • Blast • Escape • Survive, through sound alone, as you challenge your makers and unravel the mysteries of your existence. You may be blind, but you're far from helpless !
items.title: Apotheorasis • Lab of the Blind Gods | Prologue

items.description: An unsettling rogue-lite survival horror adventure. Iconic levels reshape around you. Classic and original entities lurk as greater beings bid for your favor. Collect relics and strange items. Grow stronger. Survive, escape, or claim more uncertain fates. Fall in. Get lost. Go beyond The Backrooms.
items.description_ja: An unsettling rogue-lite survival horror adventure. Iconic levels reshape around you. Classic and original entities lurk as greater beings bid for your favor. Collect relics and strange items. Grow stronger. Survive, escape, or claim more uncertain fates. Fall in. Get lost. Go beyond The Backrooms.
items.title: Transliminal: Beyond The Backrooms

items.description: Chloé’s Requiem -encore- is a 2D Adventure Horror game set in Modern Europe. The genius violinist Michél is invited into an old mansion. Inside waits Chloé, who asks him to “Break the curse of the mansion”. What awaits the pair after the mystery is solved…?
items.description_ja: 「クロエのレクイエム -encore-」は近代の西欧を舞台にした2Dホラーアドベンチャーゲームです。12歳の天才バイオリニスト・ミシェルは古い洋館に誘われ、足を踏み入れるとそこには「この館の呪いを解いて」と懇願する黒髪の少女クロエが佇んでいた。呪いを解いた先に、彼らは何を見るのか…
items.title: Chloé’s Requiem -encore-

items.description: Welcome to Bonnie's Bakery! Play as Bonnie, a cute baker who needs to gather ingredients so she can make pastries! Serve up your fresh, homemade pastries to the local townsfolk and hunt for very fresh ingredients!
items.description_ja: Welcome to Bonnie's Bakery! Play as Bonnie, a cute baker who needs to gather ingredients so she can make pastries! Serve up your fresh, homemade pastries to the local townsfolk and hunt for very fresh ingredients!
items.title: Bonnie's Bakery

items.description:
Viking Hiking is a cheerful 3D Platformer. Join Bøf on his adventure to reach Valhalla. Jump, dash and use the horn as you explore a lush but challenging island!

Viking Hiking is a FREE game made by second year students from Breda University.
items.description_ja:
Viking Hiking is a cheerful 3D Platformer. Join Bøf on his adventure to reach Valhalla. Jump, dash and use the horn as you explore a lush but challenging island!

Viking Hiking is a FREE game made by second year students from Breda University.
items.title: Viking Hiking

items.description: Full tilt surveillance horror. Keep your eyes locked on security cameras for an outrageous collection of horrific anomalies, suspicious movement, and the occasional T-Rex. Observe, detect, survive!
items.description_ja: "Seeing Things" は監視型ホラーゲームです。3つの難易度設定で、さまざまな異常を見つけ出し、秘密や奇妙なキャラクター、不気味な場所と共に完成させます。あなたは監視カメラを操作し、観察し、検出し、生き残ります。
items.title: SEEING THINGS

items.description: Wizzerd Quest is a bite-sized open-world RPG with full split-screen co-op. Its aesthetic is straight out of the mid 1990's, and it's designed to be a fun little excursion without wasting your time. Play the entire game for free with zero microtransactions or DRM!
items.description_ja: Wizzerd Quest is a bite-sized open-world RPG with full split-screen co-op. Its aesthetic is straight out of the mid 1990's, and it's designed to be a fun little excursion without wasting your time. Play the entire game for free with zero microtransactions or DRM!
items.title: Wizzerd Quest

items.description: Can Luna navigate this funky world to find Halloween? - Talk to strange and compelling characters! Freeze obstacles and activate the fast Chili Pepper Mode, but beware - it also makes you uncontrollably jumpy!
items.description_ja: Can Luna navigate this funky world to find Halloween? - Talk to strange and compelling characters! Freeze obstacles and activate the fast Chili Pepper Mode, but beware - it also makes you uncontrollably jumpy!
items.title: Funky Panic Attack

items.description:
Restore your fantasy tavern to its full glory. Repair, improve and expand the establishment.
Try running a tavern for a day in Prologue.
items.description_ja:
酒場を元の栄光に修復しましょう。施設を修復、改善、拡張しましょう。
プロローグで 1 日酒場を経営してみましょう。
items.title: Tavern Manager Simulator: Prologue

items.description: Devil's Drizzle is a 2D platformer that narrates the story of a kid in pursuit of his friend, an umbrella. Brave the storm and outrun the clutches of the demonic Pazuzu in this audacious effort to save your buddy.
items.description_ja: 飛ばされたカサを取り戻す、ドット調2Dプラットフォーマー！邪神パズズの魔の手を掻い潜り、嵐の中へ飛び込もう。カミナリの力を操り、過酷な世界を突き進め！ボクの孤独な冒険が、今始まる。
items.title: Devil's Drizzle

items.description: Follow Cirno in this RPG adventure as she travels across Misty Lake and beyond, fighting fierce amphibious opponents, all to fulfill her contractual obligations to a certain disguised figure...
items.description_ja: 幻想郷のある晴れた朝、チルノは家の外に貼られた謎の張り紙に興味を惹かれる。
items.title: Touhou: Fearless Frogslayer

items.description: Panelak is an old socialist-era building where strange things happen. Can you make it to the roof and help the helpless man?
items.description_ja: Panelak is an old socialist-era building where strange things happen. Can you make it to the roof and help the helpless man?
items.title: Panelak

items.description: Last Laugh is a horror game that tells the story of the fate of 3 teenagers who often bully their classmates.
items.description_ja: Last Laugh is a horror game that tells the story of the fate of 3 teenagers who often bully their classmates.
items.title: Last Laugh

items.description: You're a journalist searching for answers... but beneath the surface lies only terror. The labyrinth you’ve entered to find the missing may never let you leave.
items.description_ja: あなたは真実を追うジャーナリスト…しかし表面の下には恐怖だけが潜む。行方不明者を探すために入り込んだ迷宮は、あなたを二度と出さないかもしれない。
items.title: Inferis: Dead Below

items.description: Drink More Glurp is a wacky physics, sports(ish), hot seat, party game set on a distant world where aliens have copied Earth’s summer games and got everything slightly wrong. Compete in crazy contests with up to 20 local players or challenge the world on the global leaderboards.
items.description_ja: Drink More Glurpはハチャメチャな物理挙動を生かした、ホットシート式スポーツ風パーティゲームです。とある遠く離れた世界で、エイリアンたちが地球のスポーツ大会を真似たけど…どれもほんの少しだけ間違っていた！ 最大20人までのローカルプレイヤーを相手にクレイジーな競技をやろう。グローバルランキングで世界中のプレイヤーと競い合おう。
items.title: Drink More Glurp

items.description: Your party finds themselves trapped in a Japanese-themed room. Solve puzzles, crack riddles and discover hidden secrets in your adventure to Escape from Kyoto House!
items.description_ja: Your party finds themselves trapped in a Japanese-themed room. Solve puzzles, crack riddles and discover hidden secrets in your adventure to Escape from Kyoto House!
items.title: Escape from Kyoto House

items.description:
Control space-time to fight an evil monster in this terror and science fiction journey set in a shattered but beautiful world. 

Bend physics, the sky and the earth itself in engaging boss-fight encounters with the full power of Unreal Engine 5 and Nvidia DLSS.
items.description_ja:
時空を操り、邪悪なモンスターと戦う恐怖と SF の旅。

Unreal Engine 5 と Nvidia DLSS のフルパワーで、物理演算、空、そして地球そのものを自在に操り、魅力的なボス戦に挑みましょう。
items.title: HORROR TALES: The Beggar

items.description: SUPER 56 challenges players to overcome 56 genre-bending mini-games with the press of a single button. Compete in daily challenges, earn achievements, and destroy high scores. Outlandish chaos awaits you in Hell!
items.description_ja: 『SUPER 56』は、ボタン1つで様々なジャンルの56のミニゲームをクリアするゲームです。デイリーチャレンジで競い合い、実績を獲得し、ハイスコアを更新しよう。地獄ではハチャメチャなカオスが君を待っている！
items.title: SUPER 56

items.description: A wacky 8-bit retro-style point and click Christmas adventure, reminiscent of '90s classics. Explore Santa's village as a devilish imp with a mischievous knack for getting into trouble. Solve puzzles and uncover mysteries while meeting some peculiar characters along the way.
items.description_ja: A wacky 8-bit retro-style point and click Christmas adventure, reminiscent of '90s classics. Explore Santa's village as a devilish imp with a mischievous knack for getting into trouble. Solve puzzles and uncover mysteries while meeting some peculiar characters along the way.
items.title: Azazel's Christmas Fable

items.description: A comedy point-and-click adventure game about a dead uncle, a hidden treasure, a reluctant ghost sidekick, old people and pizza.
items.description_ja: A comedy point-and-click adventure game about a dead uncle, a hidden treasure, a reluctant ghost sidekick, old people and pizza.
items.title: The Will of Arthur Flabbington

items.description: BROKEN LIFE is an atmospheric, fully voiced Point-and-Click Adventure set in a war-torn world. Follow Leo, a former soldier, as he returns to his hometown to uncover the fate of his family, restore his home, and confront the dark secrets hidden within.
items.description_ja: 「BROKEN LIFE」は、戦争で荒廃した世界を舞台にした、フルボイスのポイント＆クリック・アドベンチャー。元兵士のレオが故郷に戻り、家族の運命を探り、故郷を取り戻し、隠された暗い秘密に立ち向かう。
items.title: BROKEN LIFE

items.description: Pancras is a neurotic cop investigating a case of mysterious kidnapping in the town of Lupany. Help him find out, who’s behind the abduction of two orderly citizens!
items.description_ja: Pancras is a neurotic cop investigating a case of mysterious kidnapping in the town of Lupany. Help him find out, who’s behind the abduction of two orderly citizens!
items.title: Polda

items.description: Watch your back in the small peaceful town of Crystalpine Grove, as it is haunted by The Infamous Rainman.
items.description_ja: Watch your back in the small peaceful town of Crystalpine Grove, as it is haunted by The Infamous Rainman.
items.title: The Rainman

items.description: Enter the swamp and meet green ogre who will guide you through some of the struggles of life by giving you some God tier advice.
items.description_ja: Enter the swamp and meet green ogre who will guide you through some of the struggles of life by giving you some God tier advice.
items.title: green ogre gives you terrible life advice and dies

items.description:
The Candle - Rated R.

As night falls and a storm rises over the annual county carnival, you are visited by a mysterious spirit. Tasked with laying his soul to rest, you must brave his long dilapidated manor and avoid the horrifying remnants of his estate staff.
items.description_ja:
The Candle - Rated R.

As night falls and a storm rises over the annual county carnival, you are visited by a mysterious spirit. Tasked with laying his soul to rest, you must brave his long dilapidated manor and avoid the horrifying remnants of his estate staff.
items.title: The Candle

items.description: You were hired to extract a bioengineer. Now your team is cut off, your comms are dead, and you're surrounded by something wearing human skin. Hold the line, make the calls, and survive the night in this choice-driven visual novel with turn-based combat.
items.description_ja: You were hired to extract a bioengineer. Now your team is cut off, your comms are dead, and you're surrounded by something wearing human skin. Hold the line, make the calls, and survive the night in this choice-driven visual novel with turn-based combat.
items.title: SkullX: Aibohphobia

items.description: MIGAKAMIKAGAMI -reviver- is a Horror 2D Pixel art Adventure Escape game. The story is set in a rural hospital where a legend of divine abductions by a deity called "Migakami-sama" has been passed down. The protagonists, Mika and Nae, are caught up in the divine abduction.
items.description_ja: 「ミガカミカガミ -reviver-」は、ホラー２Dドット絵謎解きアドベンチャーゲーム。舞台は田舎の病院。「ミガカミ様」という神様の「神隠し」が言い伝えられています。主人公「みか」「奈恵」の二人は、そんな神隠しに巻き込まれてしまい…
items.title: ミガカミカガミ -reviver-

items.description: Welcome to "DoveDays"! This is an engaging and compact casual puzzle game. Easy to use, simple to solve puzzles. We have combined the essence elements of various casual puzzle games. Without complicated operations, just open and play. It is both a stress-reliever and a brain-energizer.
items.description_ja: DoveDaysへようこそ！アップテンポでコンパクトなカジュアルパズルゲームです。シンプルで解きやすいパズルです。数あるカジュアルパズルゲームの良いところを組み合わせました。複雑な操作は一切なく、ただ開いて遊ぶだけ。
items.title: Dove Days : Time Flies

items.description: A PSX Horror where the bizarre is routine. Survive 5 nights managing a gas station infested by 10 entities with unique death animations. Unravel the mystery buried beneath the fuel pumps before your shift ends in one of 3 endings.
items.description_ja: 奇妙な出来事が日常と化したPSXホラー。 独自の死亡アニメーションを持つ10体のエンティティが巣食うガソリンスタンドで、5日間を生き延びろ。シフトが終わる前に、給油ポンプの下に眠る謎を解き明かし、3つのマルチエンディングに到達せよ。
items.title: Last Shift: Gas Station

items.description: Rediscover the internet of the 2000s in DreamNet, a free to play Frutiger Aero exploration game. Dive into nostalgic worlds, uncover the story, and revisit the beauty of the old internet.
items.description_ja: DreamNetで2000年代のインターネットを再発見しよう。Frutiger Aeroに着想を得た基本プレイ無料の探索ゲームです。懐かしい世界に飛び込み、物語を解き明かし、古き良きインターネットの美しさをもう一度体験しましょう。
items.title: DreamNet

items.description: The Suits Have Gone Mad! is a brand new episodic horror brought to you by Blank Dream Studios. Unravel the mysteries behind the monopoly of Blake & Whitley Innovations and bring color into a dull world.
items.description_ja: The Suits Have Gone Mad! is a brand new episodic horror brought to you by Blank Dream Studios. Unravel the mysteries behind the monopoly of Blake & Whitley Innovations and bring color into a dull world.
items.title: The Suits Have Gone Mad!

items.description: You are an observer tasked with monitoring surveillance footage for suspicious activity. This innocuous job soon takes a turn for the creepy, as anomalies begin to appear, from moving furniture... to them. Experience a real-time horror straight from horror-filled creepypastas!
items.description_ja: 監視カメラの映像を見て、不審なものを探すのがキミの仕事だ。この一見なんでもない仕事は、家具が動くといった超常現象が現れると、すぐに恐怖体験へと変化し始める。さあ、おどろおどろしいシーン満載の、リアルタイムホラーを体験しよう！
items.title: Spectator

items.description: Infected with the parasite commonly known as the “brain eating amoeba”, you have 10 days left before your death. One of the symptoms is hallucinations. And through that, “he” starts to talk and confesses his love to you. Can you convince the parasite to leave your body before it’s too late?
items.description_ja: Infected with the parasite commonly known as the “brain eating amoeba”, you have 10 days left before your death. One of the symptoms is hallucinations. And through that, “he” starts to talk and confesses his love to you. Can you convince the parasite to leave your body before it’s too late?
items.title: Parasite in Love

items.description: When the clock strikes midnight, the Christmas demon will be at your door. Trapped at home, you must discover what's around you to survive the night and thwart her terror.
items.description_ja: When the clock strikes midnight, the Christmas demon will be at your door. Trapped at home, you must discover what's around you to survive the night and thwart her terror.
items.title: All She Wants For Christmas Is YOU

items.description: Returning to parents' house for Christmas and a regular holiday dinner turns into a bloody hell filled with horror and death.
items.description_ja: Returning to parents' house for Christmas and a regular holiday dinner turns into a bloody hell filled with horror and death.
items.title: Evil Holiday

items.description: A top-down action roguelite about catching fish, fighting them, selling their bones, and catching more fish. Upgrade your boat and weapons, hunt down sea monster bounties, delve into eldritch mysteries, and try to pay off a cosmic debt millennia in the making.
items.description_ja: A top-down action roguelite about catching fish, fighting them, selling their bones, and catching more fish. Upgrade your boat and weapons, hunt down sea monster bounties, delve into eldritch mysteries, and try to pay off a cosmic debt millennia in the making.
items.title: FISH FEAR ME

items.description: Keep your eyes on the exam... Study the environment, answer the questions before time runs out, find secrets in the classroom and don't even think about looking directly at that... thing.
items.description_ja: Keep your eyes on the exam... Study the environment, answer the questions before time runs out, find secrets in the classroom and don't even think about looking directly at that... thing.
items.title: EYES ON THE EXAM

items.description: Decidit is a fast FPS roguelike in which you must use all the arsenal and movement abilities at your disposal in order to progress in an unstable demonic maze. Be fast, precise but also strategic using all the demonic weapons and abilities collected on the way to create powerful synergies.
items.description_ja: Decidit is a fast FPS roguelike in which you must use all the arsenal and movement abilities at your disposal in order to progress in an unstable demonic maze. Be fast, precise but also strategic using all the demonic weapons and abilities collected on the way to create powerful synergies.
items.title: DECIDIT

items.description: Join Noah in his first year of university as he decides to overcome his heartache, pursuing either a tomboy classmate, gorgeous doctor, or junior-year goth!
items.description_ja: 大学1年生のノアと一緒に、ボーイッシュなクラスメイト、年上のお医者さん、年下のゴス系女子を追いかけて、心の傷を克服しよう！
items.title: Rivalhearts

items.description:
Forest Asylum 2 - An Indie Psychological Horror Game and the sequel to the well-received first part.

items.description: A psychological horror game about being a child in an insane asylum. You're in a cruel world but your imaginary friends have your back. Here, you will uncover a dark conspiracy where you are to receive a terrible fate.

items.description: Fight, Scavenge, Survive, and File Your Taxes. A grim yet hilarious space strategy roguelite where you must balance hull integrity against your company's relentless profit margins. Warning: Contains lethal doses of dark humor and corporate exploitation.
items.description_ja: 『銀河の暗い隅』は星間業務をテーマにした宇宙ストラテジー・ローグライク。艦隊を率いて任務を受注し、戦闘やイベントを経て資材を回収、モジュール改造で戦力を雪だるま式に強化せよ。不利な時は撤退するのも戦術だが、艦隊の損耗やペナルティは容赦なく清算書に記録される。この銀河の暗い隅では、生きて帰ることにすらコストがかかるのだ！

items.description: "シシテナオ-Even in Death-"  is  stealth horror action game that requires trial and error. It tells the story of a young girl who wakes up in a strange and unsettling world, where eerie creatures known as "Ochibito" roam.
items.description_ja: 『シシテナオ -Even in Death-』は、トライ＆エラーが求められるステルスホラーアクションで、「陥人（オチビト）」と呼ばれるクリーチャーたちが徘徊する不気味で異質な世界で目を覚ました少女の物語です。

items.description: The fate of exile, like an endless river, carries Ann to a distant and unfamiliar land. A flame of unwavering determination burns within Ann's heart. She knows that one day, either Sam or SU will surely find her. Until then, Ann must find a way to escape this place.
items.description_ja: 追放の運命は、終わりなき川のようにアンを遠く見知らぬ土地へと流します。アンの心には、いつかサムかSUが自分を見つけてくれるだろうという揺るぎない信念の炎が燃えています。しかし、その前にアンは、この場所を離れる方法を見つけなければなりません。

items.description: Embark on a relaxing yet challenging journey to manage your own supermarket. Grow organic crops, care for your animals, and sell products to your customers. Build and expand your shelves. Can you transform your supermarket into an empire?
items.description_ja: リラックスできるがやりがいのある旅に出て、自分のスーパーマーケットを管理しましょう。有機作物を育て、動物を世話し、顧客に製品を販売します。棚を作り、拡張しましょう。

items.description: A cute romance visual novel set at an international school in Japan. items.description:
Cute cats. Big guns. Two players. Zero mercy.
Grab a friend, gear up your cats, and jump into chaotic third-person battles full of bullets, explosions, and pure feline mayhem. Fight together, survive together, and turn the battlefield into your playground.
items.description_ja:
かわいい猫。大きな銃。2人プレイ。容赦なし。
友達を誘って、猫たちを武装させ、弾丸と爆発と純粋な猫科の大混乱に満ちた三人称バトルへ飛び込もう。共に戦い、共に生き残り、戦場を君の遊び場に変えよう。

items.description: A first-person potato peeling game. You have a knife. You have a bucket. You have a mountain of potatoes. Peel them with real physics. Cut thin, waste nothing. Buy better tools. Finish the pile.
items.description_ja: 一人称視点のジャガイモ皮むきゲーム。ナイフがある。バケツがある。ジャガイモの山がある。本物の物理演算で皮をむこう。薄く切って、無駄にしない。もっと良い道具を買おう。山がなくなるまでむき続けろ。君ほど上手くむける者はいない。

items.description_ja:
Only Falseは、ブラフと戦略が絶妙に組み合わさった、少しブラックなユーモアを含むパーティーゲームです。嘘に飢えているプレイヤー向けのゲームで、時には政治家のように嘘をつき、時には「Sun Tzu」のように戦略的に考える必要があります。

時には嘘の裏に隠れ、時には自分の選択の結果を受け止めることになります。

Contains jump out shock (cute)! And super cute Chinese dubbing! More scenes, more voice, more joy!

items.description: Play With Gilbert - A Small Tail is a free playable sampler for the game: Play With Gilbert - Remake, which is  a third-person sandbox game created for young children (Ages 3+). It encourages curiosity and role-play while helping them become familiarized with 3D games and gameplay.
